cards 1 and 2 stay at their default gen3. `serve.sh gen2` does the same by hand.

## Adding MTP (speculative decoding): spec (2026-10-17)

Supersedes the placement and ordering parts of "MTP scoping (2026-10-16)" and the MTP paragraph of the block math; the tensor facts there still hold. Nothing of this is built. Numbers marked *est.* are estimates, not measurements.

**Goal.** More than one token per step when the main model agrees with a cheap guess, without changing the output distribution. Acceptance criteria: greedy output identical to the engine without MTP, token for token; at temperature > 0 the sampled
token at each position is still drawn from the main model's distribution (see "Verification rule"); decode tok/s above the 34.6 of today (35.9 best, `linkmatrix_test.sh`) at the context lengths in use; no change to the memory plan of the main model (200k to 262,144 positions with KV in VRAM and ECC on): the MTP block goes on die 6.

**What MTP is in this checkpoint** (`mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0.gguf`, 4,126 MB, one block `blk.48`). Per draft the input is the main model's *4-lane expanded residual* S (10,240 wide, 40 KB; the card's figure feeds the MTP modules from the residual
before the output GR Read) and the token y_{t+1} the main model just produced: `e = RMS(token_embd[y_{t+1}]) ⊙ nextn.enorm` (2,560), `u_l = RMS(S_l) ⊙ nextn.hnorm[l]` per lane, `lane_l = eh_proj [e ; u_l]` (5,120 → 2,560, the same matrix for all four lanes), then one ordinary
attention + MoE hyper-block pair (QSA attention with its own KV cache and indexer pool, 512 experts, top 10, shared expert), then `nextn.hc_head_*` (collapse of the lanes) and a vocabulary head: the draft y_{t+2}. Bytes: routed experts 2,674 MB (5.22 MB each, 52 MB for the 10 of a token), `token_embd` + `output.weight`
1,351 MB (675 MB each), everything else 102 MB (attention + indexer 63 MB, nextn + hyper-connections 35 MB, router, shared expert). Its KV cache is one more attention layer: 1,088 B per position, 285 MB at 262,144 (218 MB at 200k), pool 17 MB.

**Placement: the MTP model on die 6, nothing of it in the main model's VRAM (Nate's suggestion, which replaces the host-RAM plan first written here).** The main model's six dies are full (160 to 200 MiB free each), but dies 6 and 7, the PCH card (x2 gen2 to the CPU, SM clock 875 MHz),
hold none of it: 7.25 GiB allocatable each, 1.4 GB of it taken by another service on each. The whole MTP file fits unquantized on die 6: 4,126 MB + its KV layer (285 MB at 262,144 positions) + pool (17 MB) is about 4.4 GB, beside the 1.4 GB service. The vocabulary head (675 MB Q8_0) can be row-split over dies 6 and 7
(same card, same PLX switch), 2 x 340 MB. So: the experts stay resident (52 MB per draft at 160 GB/s, 0.3 ms, instead of 4.4 ms over PCIe), the MTP file's own embedding table and head are used as shipped (no coarser tables, no requantization), and its KV is in VRAM. The earlier decisions on host-RAM experts, shared tables and
host KV for this layer are dropped.

*Traffic between the MTP die and the main engine* is small but not nil. Per step: the 4-lane residual S of the last accepted position (40 KB) and its token y (4 B) go to die 6, the draft token (4 B) comes back to the dies that prepare the next pass. During prefill the MTP layer's KV needs (S_t, y_{t+1}) of every prompt position, 40 KB per position, sent as the
prompt runs (off the critical path). At the 22 to 26 us per send measured over this card ("After the reset: board 3's link"), about 50 to 100 us per step against 28.9 ms. The MTP die is not in the main model's per-layer exchange group, so the 15 to 20 ms per token the PCH card cost when it carried layers does not apply to it.

*What it needs from Nate:* dies 6 and 7 are held by other services (the LFM2 server on 6, the Qwen3 embedding server on 7, `flock -x` on their lock files, which the holders' `flock -s` cannot share): either co-residence is agreed (the MTP process takes a shared lock they allow, or they drop theirs) or those services move.

**Decisions left.** (a) Co-residence on dies 6 and 7 as above. (b) Order: the two-position pass is the prerequisite of MTP, of chunked prefill and of concurrent requests (issue #7). Build it first with a free drafter (prompt lookup: the tokens that followed an earlier occurrence of the last n-gram) so the batching is proven and the gain measured with no MTP weights at all, then plug the MTP block in as a better drafter.

**Verification rule.** Step t sampled y_{t+1} from the main model as today. The pass for the next step carries two positions: y_{t+1} (certain) and the draft d (a guess for y_{t+2}). After the pass the main model's logits at position t+1 give a sample y_{t+2} (same RNG, same top-k/top-p). If y_{t+2} == d, the second position's
logits are valid and give y_{t+3} for free: two tokens in the step. If not, the second position's work is discarded and y_{t+2} stands. The draw is from the main distribution either way, so the output distribution is unchanged; the draft only decides whether the speculative position was useful. With temperature 0 this is the argmax test of the earlier spec.

**What a step is.** (1) main pass over 2 positions (all kernels take two activations: the GEMVs keep two accumulator sets and read the weights once, `dnstep` updates the DeltaNet state for position 1 then 2 into a scratch copy, the attention kernels apply the causal mask between the two, the MoE reads the union of the two token's 10 experts, exchanges carry 2x);
(2) sample, compare with d; (3) commit: on accept both positions' DeltaNet and conv state, indexer ring and KV appends stand; on reject restore the state after position 1 (the scratch copy makes that free: commit by swapping the buffer pointers) and the KV rows of position 2 are simply overwritten later (they are positional); (4) draft for the next step from the S of the last accepted position
and its token (the MTP block as above; on card 2). The draft is on the critical path of the next step, because its token is an input of that step; overlapping it with the main pass (a draft one step stale) is a later optimisation.

**Expected gain** (est.). Tokens per step 1 + p (p = P(sample == draft)); step time 1 + c times today's 28.9 ms, c = (draft + extra cost of the second position) / 28.9. Draft *est.* 4 ms (the block's ~24 phases 0.6 with its resident experts, the head split over two dies 2.5, the sends 0.2 and the handoff), the second position *est.* 3.5 ms (the profile
is dominated by per-phase latency, which a second activation shares), so c is about 0.26. Speedup (1 + p) / (1 + c) and tok/s from 34.6:

| p | c = 0.15 | c = 0.26 | c = 0.40 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.6 | 1.39x (48) | 1.27x (44) | 1.14x (39) |
| 0.7 | 1.48x (51) | 1.35x (47) | 1.21x (42) |
| 0.8 | 1.57x (54) | 1.43x (50) | 1.29x (45) |
| 0.9 | 1.65x (57) | 1.51x (52) | 1.36x (47) |

So expect 1.3x to 1.5x, 44 to 52 tok/s: worth it, not a doubling. p is unknown; M0 measures it. At temperature 1 p is lower than at temperature 0.

**Milestones, each with its own check.**
- **M0, acceptance probe.** Run the MTP block as a drafter only (no speculation: the draft for t+2 is computed each step and compared with the token the engine really produces next; counts are logged). Needs the block's kernels on die 6 but not the two-position pass. Gives p on real chat and code, greedy and temperature 1, and the true draft latency. Decide to go on from p and c.
  Check: the block against a CPU twin (`ref/`, composed from the existing hyper-block, attention and MoE twins plus eh_proj/hnorm/enorm) bit-exact on one position.
- **M1, two-position pass + prompt-lookup drafter.** The restructure above, with a drafter that costs nothing. Check: greedy output identical with and without speculation on the needle and chat prompts; accept/reject paths forced (a drafter that is always wrong, always right); the DeltaNet/conv/ring state after a reject equals a run that never speculated.
- **M2, MTP as the drafter.** Plug M0's block in; measure tok/s and p at 4k, 32k, 200k context. Check as M1.
- **M3, tune.** Overlap the draft with the next pass, drop phases, rebalance (the main split is unchanged: the MTP block lives on die 6 and costs the main dies no memory).

**Risks.** The second position makes `attnpartn` and the indexer chain run for two positions (about 0.25 ms per layer each at depth, SPEC); acceptance is unknown until M0 and lower at temperature 1; the MoE union of two tokens' experts is up to 20 reads per layer instead of 10 (the weights streaming share, 4.5 ms of the 28.9 ms, grows toward 9 ms in the worst case, which is included in the 3.5 ms est. only on average).


File: kern/actq.pl
# actq.pl: emitter for the per-32 activation quantiser (kern/actq.sass) and its
# SiLU-gated variant (kern/ffnact.sass: x = SiLU(g) * u before quantising, for
# the MoE expert activations). One warp per vector; CTA b handles vector b
# (pointers offset by b * vector). Bit-exact twins: quant_act_gpu32, and
# silu_gpu(g) * u followed by quant_act_gpu32.
#
#   gmax = max(max_{32} |x|, 2^-100)
#   r    = rcp_rn(gmax)          (MUFU.RCP + one Newton step = IEEE 1/gmax)
#   inv  = r * 127 ; q_i = F2I.RN(x_i * inv) ; as = gmax * (1/127)
#
# Lane l owns the 4-element chunks at 4 (l + 32 j); a 32-group is 8 consecutive
# lanes of one chunk, so the group max and the sums are 3-round SHFL butterflies
# (xor 1, 2, 4). Everything is done in rounds over the U chunks of an iteration
# (U instructions between dependent ops; for U < 6 the last instruction of a round
# carries the remaining stall). Barriers: 1 = loads, 2 = store reads, 3 = MUFU/F2I,
# 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
#   actq_regmap($n, $silu)   the <REGISTER_MAPPING> text
#   actq_code($n, $silu)     the kernel body

use strict;
use warnings;
require './fmath.pl';

sub actq_shape {
    my ($n) = @_;
    my $C = $n / 128;
    my $U = $ENV{ACTQ_U} || ($C <= 20 ? $C : 16);      # ACTQ_U caps the unroll (the die build keeps K=2560 under 255 registers)
    die "actq: U=$U does not divide C=$C" if $C % $U;
    return ($C, $U, $C / $U);
}

sub actq_regmap {
    my ($n, $silu) = @_;
    my ($C, $U, $NI) = actq_shape($n);
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    my $r = 0;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : x<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + 4*$U - 1, 4*$U - 1; $r += 4*$U;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : pk<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + 2*$U - 1, 2*$U - 1; $r += 2*$U;
    for my $name (qw(s16_ s32_ g r tt)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : %s<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + $U - 1, $name, $U - 1; $r += $U; }
    for my $name (qw(mneg1 c127 tid lane it t bid t2)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    if ($silu) {
        $r = ($r + 3) & ~3;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : u<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + 4*$U - 1, 4*$U - 1; $r += 4*$U;
        for my $name (qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : ft<00-09>\n", $r, $r + 9; $r += 10;
    }
    $r += $r & 1;
    my @ptr = qw(xp qp hp gp ap);
    push @ptr, 'up' if $silu;
    for my $p (@ptr) { $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : %s<0-1>\n", $r, $r + 1, $p; $r += 2; }
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;
}

sub actq_code {
    my ($n, $silu) = @_;
    my ($C, $U, $NI) = actq_shape($n);
    my $rs = $U >= 6 ? '1' : (7 - $U);     # stall on the last instruction of a round
    my %FC = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
    my $o = '';
    # a round: $f->($u) returns one instruction line with WW (wait) and SS (stall) placeholders
    my $round = sub {
        my ($f, $wait) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $u (0..$U-1) {
            my $line = $f->($u);
            my $w = ($u == 0 && $wait) ? $wait : '--';
            my $s = $u == $U-1 ? $rs : '1';
            $s = 2 if $u == $U-1 && $s eq '1' && $line =~ /\b(SHFL|MUFU|F2I|LDG)\b/;   # variable-latency op: stall >= 2 before the dependent wait
            $line =~ s/^WW/$w/; $line =~ s/:SS /:$s /;
            $x .= $line;
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # pointer = base + vector offset (bid * bytes per vector) + lane part
    my $ptr = sub {
        my ($p, $lanepart, $pervec, $base) = @_;
        my $x = $lanepart;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t2, bid, 0x%x, RZ;\n", $pervec;
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, t2;\n";
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, t, param_%s0;\n", $p, $base;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, RZ, param_%s1;\n", $p, $base;
        return $x;
    };
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I mneg1, 0xbf800000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I c127, 0x3c010204;\n";          # 1/127
    $o .= fm_consts({ map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone) }) if $silu;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV it, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P2, PT, t, RZ, PT;\n";             # lane % 4 == 0: writes s16
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 EXIT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t, lane, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, t, RZ, PT;\n";             # lane % 8 == 0: writes s32 and as
    # xp = X + 16 lane ; qp = Q + 8 lane ; hp = S16 + 4 (lane >> 2) ; gp = S32 + 4 (lane >> 3) ; ap = AS + 4 (lane >> 3)
    $o .= $ptr->('xp', "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x4;\n", 4 * $n, 'X');
    $o .= $ptr->('up', "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x4;\n", 4 * $n, 'U') if $silu;
    $o .= $ptr->('qp', "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x3;\n", 2 * $n, 'Q');
    $o .= $ptr->('hp', "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 t, lane, 0x2;\n--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, t, 0x2;\n", $n / 4, 'S16');
    $o .= $ptr->('gp', "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 t, lane, 0x3;\n--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, t, 0x2;\n", $n / 8, 'S32');
    $o .= $ptr->('ap', "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 t, lane, 0x3;\n--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, t, 0x2;\n", $n / 8, 'AS');

    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    for my $u (0..$U-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 x%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", $u == 0 ? '02' : '--', ($u == $U-1 && !$silu) ? '2' : '1', 4*$u, 512*$u;
    }
    if ($silu) {
        for my $u (0..$U-1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 u%02d, [up+0x%x];\n", $u == $U-1 ? '2' : '1', 4*$u, 512*$u;
        }
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD it, it, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, it, 0x%x, PT;\n", $NI;
    if ($silu) {
        # x = SiLU(x) * u, two interleaved chains (fm_zip lowers the stalls)
        for (my $i = 0; $i < 4*$U; $i += 2) {
            my @ch;
            for my $k (0, 1) {
                my $e = sprintf "x%02d", $i + $k;
                my $c = fm_silu($e, $e, map({ sprintf "ft%02d", 5*$k + $_ } 0..4), \%FC);
                $c .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, u%02d;\n", $e, $e, $i + $k;
                push @ch, $c;
            }
            my $z = fm_zip(@ch);
            $z =~ s/^--/01/ if $i == 0;      # first instruction waits for the loads
            $o .= $z;
        }
    }
    # lane max of the chunk
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMNMX g%02d, |x%02d|, |x%02d|, !PT;\n", $u, 4*$u, 4*$u + 1 }, '01');
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMNMX g%02d, g%02d, |x%02d|, !PT;\n", $u, $u, 4*$u + 2 });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMNMX g%02d, g%02d, |x%02d|, !PT;\n", $u, $u, 4*$u + 3 });
    # group max over 8 lanes
    for my $k (1, 2, 4) {
        $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:5:-:SS      SHFL.BFLY PT, tt%02d, g%02d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $u, $u, $k });
        $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMNMX g%02d, g%02d, tt%02d, !PT;\n", $u, $u, $u }, '10');
    }
    # clamp, reciprocal, inv and as
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMNMX g%02d, g%02d, 7.8886090522101180541e-31, !PT;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:3:-:SS      MUFU.RCP r%02d, g%02d;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FFMA tt%02d, g%02d, r%02d, mneg1;\n", $u, $u, $u }, '04');
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FADD.FTZ tt%02d, -tt%02d, -RZ;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FFMA r%02d, r%02d, tt%02d, r%02d;\n", $u, $u, $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMUL r%02d, r%02d, 127;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMUL g%02d, g%02d, c127;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:2:-:-:SS  \@P3 STG.E [ap+0x%x], g%02d;\n", 16*$u, $u });
    # codes
    for my $k (0..3) {
        $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      FMUL x%02d, x%02d, r%02d;\n", 4*$u + $k, 4*$u + $k, $u });
    }
    for my $k (0..3) {
        $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:3:-:SS      F2I.S32.F32 x%02d, x%02d;\n", 4*$u + $k, 4*$u + $k });
    }
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      IADD tt%02d, x%02d, x%02d;\n", $u, 4*$u, 4*$u + 1 }, '04');
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      IADD r%02d, x%02d, x%02d;\n", $u, 4*$u + 2, 4*$u + 3 });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      PRMT pk%02d, x%02d, 0x5410, x%02d;\n", 2*$u, 4*$u, 4*$u + 1 });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      PRMT pk%02d, x%02d, 0x5410, x%02d;\n", 2*$u + 1, 4*$u + 2, 4*$u + 3 });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      IADD tt%02d, tt%02d, r%02d;\n", $u, $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:2:-:-:SS      STG.E.64 [qp+0x%x], pk%02d;\n", 256*$u, 2*$u });
    # sums: 16 = 4 lanes (xor 1, 2), 32 = 8 lanes (xor 4)
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:5:-:SS      SHFL.BFLY PT, r%02d, tt%02d, 0x1, 0x1f;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      IADD s16_%02d, tt%02d, r%02d;\n", $u, $u, $u }, '10');
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:5:-:SS      SHFL.BFLY PT, r%02d, s16_%02d, 0x2, 0x1f;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      IADD s16_%02d, s16_%02d, r%02d;\n", $u, $u, $u }, '10');
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:2:-:-:SS  \@P2 STG.E [hp+0x%x], s16_%02d;\n", 32*$u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:5:-:SS      SHFL.BFLY PT, r%02d, s16_%02d, 0x4, 0x1f;\n", $u, $u });
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:-:-:-:SS      IADD s32_%02d, s16_%02d, r%02d;\n", $u, $u, $u }, '10');
    $o .= $round->(sub { my $u = shift; sprintf "WW:2:-:-:SS  \@P3 STG.E [gp+0x%x], s32_%02d;\n", 16*$u, $u });
    # next iteration (the stores must have read their registers: barrier 2)
    $o .= sprintf "02:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, xp0, 0x%x;\n", 512*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, xp1, RZ;\n";
    if ($silu) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD up0.CC, up0, 0x%x;\n", 512*$U;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X up1, up1, RZ;\n";
    }
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qp0.CC, qp0, 0x%x;\n", 256*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X qp1, qp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, hp0, 0x%x;\n", 32*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, hp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD gp0.CC, gp0, 0x%x;\n", 16*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X gp1, gp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, ap0, 0x%x;\n", 16*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, ap1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA LOOP;\n" if $NI > 1;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
}

1;


File: kern/actq.sass
# Kernel: actq
#
# Per-32 activation quantiser, one warp per fp32 vector of n = GEMV_K elements
# (640, 2560, 6144 or 10240): int16 codes q[n], per-32 sums s32[n/32], per-16
# sums s16[n/16] and per-32 scales as[n/32]. CTA b quantises vector b. The
# emitter lives in actq.pl (shared with ffnact). Bit-exact twin: quant_act_gpu32.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 X  1:0x148:8 Q  2:0x150:8 S32  3:0x158:8 S16  4:0x160:8 AS  5:0x168:4 n

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_Q0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_Q1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_S320 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_S321 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_S160 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_S161 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    require './actq.pl';
    return actq_regmap($ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560, 0);
</CODE>

<CODE>
    require './actq.pl';
    return actq_code($ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560, 0);
</CODE>


File: kern/actq_test.c
/*
 * actq_test: the activation quantiser kernel against quant_act_gpu, bit for bit
 * (codes, per-16 and per-32 sums, scale), on random vectors of several
 * magnitudes plus an all-zero vector.
 *
 *   actq_test N          N = 640, 2560, 6144 or 10240 (needs actq_kN.cubin)
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 7;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	int n = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 2560;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	char cubin[64];
	snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "actq_k%d.cubin", n);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "actq"));
	CUdeviceptr dX, dQ, dS32, dS16, dSC;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ, 2 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS32, 4 * n / 32 + 64));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS16, 4 * n / 16 + 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dSC, 4 * n / 32 + 64));
	float *x = malloc(4 * n);
	int16_t *q = malloc(2 * n), *qg = malloc(2 * n);
	int32_t *s32 = malloc(4 * n / 32), *s16 = malloc(4 * n / 16), *s32g = malloc(4 * n / 32), *s16g = malloc(4 * n / 16);
	float *as = malloc(4 * n / 32), *asg = malloc(4 * n / 32);
	const float mags[] = { 1.f, 1e-3f, 37.5f, 1e4f, 0.f, 3.14159f };
	int fails = 0;
	unsigned un = (unsigned)n;
	for (unsigned m = 0; m < sizeof mags / sizeof mags[0]; m++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = mags[m] * frand() * (1.f + (i % 7) * 0.25f);
		if (m == 5) x[n - 1] = 1e4f;   /* one outlier */
		quant_act_gpu32(x, n, q, s32, s16, as);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * n));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dQ, 0x7fff7fffu, n / 2));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dS32, 0x7fffffffu, n / 32)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dS16, 0x7fffffffu, n / 16)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dSC, 0x7fc00000u, n / 32));
		void *params[] = { &dX, &dQ, &dS32, &dS16, &dSC, &un };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 1, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(qg, dQ, 2 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s32g, dS32, 4 * n / 32)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s16g, dS16, 4 * n / 16)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(asg, dSC, 4 * n / 32));
		int bq = 0, b32 = 0, b16 = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (q[i] != qg[i]) { if (bq < 3) printf("  q[%d]: gpu %d ref %d (x %g)\n", i, qg[i], q[i], x[i]); bq++; }
		for (int i = 0; i < n / 32; i++) if (s32[i] != s32g[i]) { if (b32 < 3) printf("  s32[%d]: gpu %d ref %d\n", i, s32g[i], s32[i]); b32++; }
		for (int i = 0; i < n / 16; i++) if (s16[i] != s16g[i]) { if (b16 < 3) printf("  s16[%d]: gpu %d ref %d (prev %d next %d)\n", i, s16g[i], s16[i], i ? s16[i-1] : 0, i + 1 < n / 16 ? s16[i+1] : 0); b16++; }
		int bs = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n / 32; i++) if (memcmp(&as[i], &asg[i], 4)) { if (bs < 3) printf("  as[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, asg[i], as[i]); bs++; }
		printf("n=%d mag %-8g: %s (codes %d/%d differ, s32 %d, s16 %d, scales %d/%d)\n", n, mags[m],
		       (bq || b32 || b16 || bs) ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bq, n, b32, b16, bs, n / 32);
		if (bq || b32 || b16 || bs) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/aerpoll.c
/* aerpoll: count PCIe correctable-error events on the given devices while something runs.
 *
 * The AER correctable error status register is made of sticky bits, not counters. This reads it in a loop and writes back what it shows (write 1 to clear), so every
 * new event sets a bit again and is counted. Events closer together than one poll cycle merge, so the numbers are lower bounds. Needs root (extended config space).
 *
 *   aerpoll <seconds> <bdf> [<bdf> ...]     bdf like 00:03.0 or 09:00.0; a SIGTERM ends it early and prints the same summary
 *
 * Bits: RxErr (0) a receiver error at the physical layer, BadTLP (6) a packet failed its LCRC (NAK, replay), BadDLLP (7) a data-link packet failed its CRC,
 * Rollover (8) the replay counter wrapped (a packet was replayed 4 times), Timeout (12) the replay timer expired (no ACK in time: the ~2 ms stall). */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static volatile sig_atomic_t stop;
static void on_term(int s) { (void)s; stop = 1; }
static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + t.tv_nsec * 1e-9; }

#define MAXD 32
static struct { char name[16]; int fd; unsigned aer; unsigned long ev[16], polls; } d[MAXD];
static const struct { int bit; const char *name; } bits[] = { { 0, "RxErr" }, { 6, "BadTLP" }, { 7, "BadDLLP" }, { 8, "Rollover" }, { 12, "Timeout" }, { 13, "AdvNonFatal" }, { 14, "CorrInt" }, { 15, "HdrOF" } };

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: aerpoll <seconds> <bdf> [<bdf> ...]\n"); return 2; }
	double secs = atof(argv[1]); int n = 0;
	for (int i = 2; i < argc && n < MAXD; i++) {
		char path[96]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:%s/config", argv[i]);
		int fd = open(path, O_RDWR); if (fd < 0) { perror(path); return 1; }
		unsigned off = 0x100, aer = 0;
		for (int k = 0; k < 48 && off >= 0x100; k++) {   /* the extended capability list: find AER (id 1) */
			uint32_t h; if (pread(fd, &h, 4, off) != 4 || h == 0 || h == 0xffffffffu) break;
			if ((h & 0xffff) == 1) { aer = off; break; }
			off = (h >> 20) & 0xfff;
		}
		if (!aer) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: no AER capability, skipped\n", argv[i]); close(fd); continue; }
		snprintf(d[n].name, sizeof d[n].name, "%s", argv[i]); d[n].fd = fd; d[n].aer = aer; n++;
	}
	signal(SIGTERM, on_term); signal(SIGINT, on_term);
	double t0 = now();
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { uint32_t v; if (pread(d[i].fd, &v, 4, d[i].aer + 0x10) == 4 && v) pwrite(d[i].fd, &v, 4, d[i].aer + 0x10); }   /* start from clear */
	while (!stop && now() - t0 < secs) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			uint32_t v; if (pread(d[i].fd, &v, 4, d[i].aer + 0x10) != 4) continue;
			d[i].polls++;
			if (v) { for (int b = 0; b < 16; b++) if (v & (1u << b)) d[i].ev[b]++; pwrite(d[i].fd, &v, 4, d[i].aer + 0x10); }
		}
	}
	double el = now() - t0;
	printf("aerpoll: %.2f s", el);
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		printf("\n%-8s %8lu polls (%.0f/s) ", d[i].name, d[i].polls, d[i].polls / el);
		for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof bits / sizeof *bits; k++) printf("%s=%lu ", bits[k].name, d[i].ev[bits[k].bit]);
	}
	printf("\n");
	return 0;
}


File: kern/allgather.sass
# Kernel: allgather
#
# 6-die all-gather microbenchmark (the exchange of a tensor-split step): one CTA of
# 256 threads per die. Per iteration i every thread writes its 16 B chunk of this
# die's slice (SLICE = 256 x 16 B x AG_CHUNKS) into slot `me` of every die's
# payload buffer (P2P STG.128, the local one included), BAR.SYNC, warp 0 fences
# (MEMBAR.SYS) and lane 0 stores i into flag[me] of every die (STG.WT); lanes 0..5
# of warp 0 spin (LDG.CV) on this die's six flags until they read >= i; MEMBAR.SYS;
# BAR.SYNC; every thread then reads the six gathered chunks (LDG.CV) and counts
# mismatches against the pattern (i + word index). out[0] += mismatches (RED.ADD).
# Predicates are consumed >= 18 cycles after being written.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 PT (u64[6] payload bases, one per die; each holds 6 slices)
#         1:0x148 FT (u64[6] flag bases, 6 u32 each)  2:0x150 me  3:0x154 iters  4:0x158 out

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_PT0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_PT1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_FT0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_FT1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_me    : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_iters : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_out0  : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_out1  : c[0x0][0x15c]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-11  : pb<00-11>
    12-23 : fb<00-11>
    24-35 : dq<00-11>
    36-47 : fq<00-11>
    48,49 : mp<0-1>
    50,51 : sp<0-1>
    52,53 : tp<0-1>
    54,55 : op<0-1>
    56-59 : v<0-3>
    60-63 : w<0-3>
    64    : tid
    65    : me
    66    : i
    67    : t
    68    : bad
    69    : lane
    70    : base
    71    : t2
    72-83 : eq<00-11>
    84    : poff
    86,87 : mq<0-1>
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $CH = $ENV{AG_CHUNKS} || 1;          # 16 B chunks per thread per slice
    my $nopay = $ENV{AG_NOPAY} ? 1 : 0;      # flags only (the pure 6-die barrier)
    my $noverify = $ENV{AG_NOVERIFY} ? 1 : 0;
    my $SLICE = 256 * 16 * $CH;
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV me, param_me;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV tp0, param_PT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV tp1, param_PT1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV sp0, param_FT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV sp1, param_FT1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.64 pb%02d, [tp+0x%x];\n", 2 * $_, 8 * $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%d      LDG.E.64 fb%02d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, 2 * $_, 8 * $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P0, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";          # P0: not thread 0
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P5, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;\n";        # P5: not warp 0
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV i, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV bad, RZ;\n";
    # dq_p = pb_p + SLICE me + 16 tid ; fq_p = fb_p + 4 me ; mp = pb_me + 16 tid ; sp = fb_me + 4 lane
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t, me, 0x%x, RZ;\n", $SLICE;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, tid, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, t2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL base, me, 0x2;\n";
    for my $p (0..5) {
        $o .= sprintf "01:-:-:-:6      IADD dq%02d.CC, pb%02d, t;\n", 2 * $p, 2 * $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dq%02d, pb%02d, RZ;\n", 2 * $p + 1, 2 * $p + 1;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD fq%02d.CC, fb%02d, base;\n", 2 * $p, 2 * $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X fq%02d, fb%02d, RZ;\n", 2 * $p + 1, 2 * $p + 1;
    }
    # my own payload base and flag array: pick entry `me` from the tables (reload)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, me, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tp0.CC, tp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X tp1, tp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, sp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, sp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.64 mp0, [tp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.64 sp0, [sp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      IADD mp0.CC, mp0, t2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X mp1, mp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op0, param_out0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op1, param_out1;\n";
    my $lg = int(log($SLICE)/log(2) + 0.5);
    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD i, i, 0x1;\n";
    # slots double-buffered by iteration parity: a die one iteration ahead writes the other half
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND poff, i, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, poff, 0x%x;\n", $lg + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD poff, poff, t, 0x%x;\n", $lg + 2;           # (i & 1) * 6 SLICE
    for my $p (0..5) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD eq%02d.CC, dq%02d, poff;\n", 2 * $p, 2 * $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X eq%02d, dq%02d, RZ;\n", 2 * $p + 1, 2 * $p + 1;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD mq0.CC, mp0, poff;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X mq1, mp1, RZ;\n";
    # pattern: word index + i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL base, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base, base, i;\n";
    for my $c ($nopay ? () : (0..$CH-1)) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      IADD v0, base, 0x%x;\n", $c ? '01' : '--', 1024 * $c;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD v1, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c + 1;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD v2, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c + 2;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD v3, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c + 3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:%d      STG.E.128 [eq%02d+0x%x], v0;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, 2 * $_, 4096 * $c for 0..5;
    }
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P5 BRA WAITED;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.SYS;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:%d \@!P0 STG.E.WT [fq%02d], i;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, 2 * $_ for 0..5;
    # every lane of warp 0 polls all six flags (uniform control flow before the BAR.SYNC)
    $o .= "SPIN:\n";
    $o .= "01:-:3:-:1      LDG.E.CV v0, [sp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:1      LDG.E.CV v1, [sp+0x4];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:1      LDG.E.CV v2, [sp+0x8];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:1      LDG.E.CV v3, [sp+0xc];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:1      LDG.E.CV w0, [sp+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      LDG.E.CV w1, [sp+0x14];\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      IMNMX.U32 t, v0, v1, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IMNMX.U32 t2, v2, v3, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 w0, w0, w1, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 t, t, t2, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 t, t, w0, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P4, PT, t, i, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P4 BRA SPIN;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.SYS;\n";
    $o .= "WAITED:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    # verify the six gathered slices
    for my $s (($nopay || $noverify) ? () : (0..5)) {
        for my $c (0..$CH-1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.CV.128 w0, [mq+0x%x];\n", $SLICE * $s + 4096 * $c;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD v0, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD v1, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c + 1;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD v2, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c + 2;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD v3, base, 0x%x;\n", 1024 * $c + 3;
            $o .= "01:-:-:-:1      LOP.XOR v0, v0, w0;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.XOR v1, v1, w1;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.XOR v2, v2, w2;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.XOR v3, v3, w3;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.OR v0, v0, v1;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.OR v2, v2, v3;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.OR v0, v0, v2;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, v0, RZ, PT;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 IADD bad, bad, 0x1;\n";
        }
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, i, param_iters, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      RED.E.ADD [op], bad;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/allgather_test.c
/* allgather_test: time a 6-die all-gather (P2P stores + flags) per iteration.
 * usage: allgather_test [iters] [ndies] [cubin]   (dies 0..ndies-1; every pair peer-enabled) */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)
static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	unsigned iters = argc > 1 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[1]) : 2000;
	int N = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 6;
	const char *cubin = argc > 3 ? argv[3] : "allgather.cubin";
	size_t slice = 4096 * (strstr(cubin, "ag4") ? 4 : 1);
	int check = !strstr(cubin, "flags") && !strstr(cubin, "nover");
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev[8]; CUcontext ctx[8]; CUmodule mod[8]; CUfunction fn[8];
	CUdeviceptr pay[8], flg[8], out[8], ptab[8], ftab[8];
	for (int d = 0; d < N; d++) {
		CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev[d], d));
		CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx[d], CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev[d]));
		CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod[d], cubin)); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn[d], mod[d], "allgather"));
		CK(cuMemAlloc(&pay[d], 12 * slice)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&flg[d], 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&out[d], 64));
		CK(cuMemAlloc(&ptab[d], 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&ftab[d], 64));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(pay[d], 0, 12 * slice / 4)); CK(cuMemsetD32(flg[d], 0, 16)); CK(cuMemsetD32(out[d], 0, 16));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	}
	for (int a = 0; a < N; a++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[a])); for (int b = 0; b < N; b++) if (a != b) { int can; CK(cuDeviceCanAccessPeer(&can, dev[a], dev[b])); if (!can) { printf("no peer access %d -> %d\n", a, b); return 2; } CK(cuCtxEnablePeerAccess(ctx[b], 0)); } }
	unsigned long long pt[6] = { 0 }, ft[6] = { 0 };
	for (int d = 0; d < N; d++) { pt[d] = pay[d]; ft[d] = flg[d]; }
	for (int d = N; d < 6; d++) { pt[d] = pay[0]; ft[d] = flg[0]; }   /* unused dies point somewhere harmless */
	for (int d = 0; d < N; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(ptab[d], pt, 48)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(ftab[d], ft, 48)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize()); }
	double t0 = now();
	for (int d = 0; d < N; d++) {
		unsigned me = d;
		void *params[] = { &ptab[d], &ftab[d], &me, &iters, &out[d] };
		CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn[d], 1, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
	}
	for (int d = 0; d < N; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuCtxSynchronize()); }
	double dt = now() - t0;
	unsigned long long badtot = 0;
	for (int d = 0; d < N; d++) { unsigned b; CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(&b, out[d], 4)); badtot += b; }
	printf("%d dies, slice %zu B (%zu B gathered), %u iterations: %.2f us per all-gather, mismatches %llu\n", N, slice, slice * N, iters, dt / iters * 1e6, badtot);
	return (check && badtot) ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/amax.sass
# Kernel: amax
#
# Combines the dies' argmax partials after the head: PAIRS[e] = {u32 idx (within die
# e's rows), u32 max bits} for e < ndies (argmax.sass's OUT layout), BASES[e] = die e's
# first row. One warp: lane e < ndies loads its pair and adds the base, the others hold
# (-inf, 0xffffffff); a xor 16..1 butterfly keeps, at each step, the other side iff its
# max is greater or equal with a lower index (argmax's rule, so any order gives the
# same answer); lane 0 writes OUT = {idx, max bits}. Every die runs it on the same
# gathered pairs and gets the same token.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 PAIRS  1:0x148 BASES  2:0x150 ndies  3:0x158 OUT  4:0x160 IDS  5:0x168 TOKS  6:0x170 tok  7:0x174 nprompt
#         8:0x178 stop0  9:0x17c stop1  10:0x180 END (ctl[5]): a token past the prompt equal to stop0
#         or stop1 ends the turn (END = 0x80000000; the framework exits after this token)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_PAIRS0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_PAIRS1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_BASES0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_BASES1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_ndies  : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_OUT0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_OUT1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_IDS0   : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_IDS1   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_TOKS0  : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_TOKS1  : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_tok    : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_nprompt : c[0x0][0x174]
    param_stop0  : c[0x0][0x178]
    param_stop1  : c[0x0][0x17c]
    param_END0   : c[0x0][0x180]
    param_END1   : c[0x0][0x184]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0     : tid
    1     : lane
    2     : m
    3     : i
    4     : mo
    5     : io
    6     : t
    7     : base
    8,9   : pp<0-1>
    10,11 : bp<0-1>
    12,13 : op<0-1>
    14,15 : ip<0-1>
    16,17 : tp<0-1>
    18    : tk
    19    : tk1
    20,21 : ep<0-1>
    22    : ev
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I m, 0xff800000;\n";                         # -inf
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I i, 0xffffffff;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, param_ndies, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, t, param_PAIRS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_PAIRS1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD bp0.CC, t, param_BASES0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bp1, RZ, param_BASES1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1  \@P0 LDG.E i, [pp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1  \@P0 LDG.E m, [pp+0x4];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2  \@P0 LDG.E base, [bp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6  \@P0 IADD i, i, base;\n";
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      SHFL.BFLY PT, mo, m, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:2      SHFL.BFLY PT, io, i, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      FSETP.GT.AND P1, PT, mo, m, PT;\n";              # other greater
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FSETP.EQ.AND P2, PT, mo, m, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, io, i, P2;\n";          # or equal with a lower index
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      PSETP.OR.AND P1, PT, P1, P2, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 MOV m, mo;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 MOV i, io;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op0, param_OUT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op1, param_OUT1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    # the token goes to TOKS[tok] (for the host) and, once past the prompt, to IDS[tok + 1]
    # (the next embedding reads it there)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV tk, param_tok;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tk1, tk, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P4, PT, tk1, param_nprompt, P3;\n";   # lane 0 and tok + 1 >= nprompt
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tk, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tp0.CC, t, param_TOKS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X tp1, RZ, param_TOKS1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tk1, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ip0.CC, t, param_IDS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ip1, RZ, param_IDS1;\n";
    # end of turn: P5 = past the prompt (lane 0) and the token is a stop token
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P5, PT, i, param_stop0, P4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, i, param_stop1, P4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ep0, param_END0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ep1, param_END1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I ev, 0x80000000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      PSETP.OR.AND P5, PT, P5, P6, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P3 STG.E [op], i;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P3 STG.E [op+0x4], m;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P3 STG.E [tp], i;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E [ip], i;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:6  \@P5 STG.E [ep], ev;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/argmax.sass
# Kernel: argmax
#
# argmax over n fp32 logits, ties -> lowest index. Grid = G CTAs (G <= 32) x 256
# threads: thread (c, t) scans i = 256 c + t, + 256 G, ... keeping the first
# maximum; warp butterflies (xor 16..1) and an 8-entry smem round reduce the CTA;
# CTA c writes (max, idx) to PART[c]; the last CTA to bump CNT (ATOM.ADD) reduces
# the G partials with warp 0, writes OUT[0] = idx, OUT[1] = max bits and resets
# CNT. Combine rule everywhere: take the other side iff its max is greater, or
# equal with a lower index. Bit-exact twin: argmax_gpu (any order gives the same
# answer; the twin is the plain first-max scan).
#
# Params: 0:0x140 X  1:0x148 OUT  2:0x150 PART  3:0x158 CNT  4:0x160 n (u32)  5:0x164 g = grid size (u32)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0    : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1    : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_OUT0  : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_OUT1  : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_PART0 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_PART1 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_CNT0  : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_CNT1  : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_n     : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_g     : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0     : tid
    1     : cta
    2     : ncta
    3     : stride
    4     : i
    5     : m
    6     : im
    7     : v
    8     : mo
    9     : io
    10    : t
    11    : k
    12    : nk
    13    : lane
    14    : warp
    15    : t2
    16,17 : xp<0-1>
    18,19 : pp<0-1>
    20,21 : op<0-1>
    22,23 : cp<0-1>
    24,25 : qp<0-1>
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $o = '';
    # butterfly combine of (m, im) across the warp
    my $bfly = sub {
        my $x = '';
        for my $s (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:1      SHFL.BFLY PT, mo, m, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $s;
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.BFLY PT, io, im, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $s;
            $x .= "10:-:-:-:6      FSETP.EQ.AND P1, PT, mo, m, PT;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FSETP.GT.AND P0, PT, mo, m, PT;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, io, im, P1;\n";        # P1 is 18 cycles old here
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 MOV m, mo;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 MOV im, io;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 MOV m, mo;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 MOV im, io;\n";
        }
        return $x;
    };
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R cta, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ncta, param_g;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I m, 0xff800000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I im, 0xffffffff;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHL stride, ncta, 0x8;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL i, cta, 0x8;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD i, i, tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 warp, tid, 0x5;\n";
    # nk = ceil(n / stride) iterations for everyone (loads predicated), so the BAR.SYNC below is uniform
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV nk, param_n;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD nk, nk, stride;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD nk, nk, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 t, ncta, 0x1;\n";          # stride = ncta << 8 is not a power of two in general: divide by it in the loop instead
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV k, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, i, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, stride, 0x2;\n";          # byte stride
    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, i, param_n, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD k, k, stride;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P3, PT, k, param_n, PT;\n";     # another round after this one
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2  \@P2 LDG.E v, [xp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FSETP.GT.AND P0, PT, v, m, P2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, xp0, t2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, xp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 MOV m, v;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 MOV im, i;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD i, i, stride;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 BRA LOOP;\n";
    # warp reduce, then the 8 warps through smem
    $o .= $bfly->();
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P4, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P5, PT, warp, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, warp, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P4 STS [t], m;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P4 STS [t+0x4], im;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, lane, 0x8, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I m, 0xff800000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I im, 0xffffffff;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1  \@P2 LDS m, [t];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:2  \@P2 LDS im, [t+0x4];\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= $bfly->();
    # thread 0: PART[cta] = (m, im); fence; count
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, cta, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, t, param_PART0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_PART1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV cp0, param_CNT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV cp1, param_CNT1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P4, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t2, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E [pp], m;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P4 STG.E [pp+0x4], im;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:6  \@P4 ATOM.E.ADD t, [cp], t2;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:5:-:2      SHFL.IDX PT, t, t, RZ, 0x1f;\n";         # warp 0 learns the old count
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IADD t2, ncta, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, t, t2, P5;\n";       # not the last CTA (or not warp 0)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P1, PT, t, t2, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 EXIT;\n";                                # whole CTAs that are not last
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P5 EXIT;\n";                                # last CTA: only warp 0 continues
    # last CTA, warp 0: lanes < ncta read the partials (invalidate L1 first)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, lane, ncta, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qp0.CC, t, param_PART0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X qp1, RZ, param_PART1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I m, 0xff800000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I im, 0xffffffff;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1  \@P2 LDG.E.CV m, [qp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2  \@P2 LDG.E.CV im, [qp+0x4];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= $bfly->();
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op0, param_OUT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op1, param_OUT1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P4, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E [op], im;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E [op+0x4], m;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P4 STG.E [cp], RZ;\n";                      # counter back to 0 for the next call
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/argmax_test.c
/* argmax_test: argmax over n logits (ties -> lowest index) on random vectors with
 * planted maxima and ties; repeated calls check the counter reset. usage: argmax_test [n] [G] */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 3;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

static unsigned argmax_gpu(const float *x, unsigned n, float *mx) {
	unsigned im = 0;
	float m = x[0];
	for (unsigned i = 1; i < n; i++) if (x[i] > m) { m = x[i]; im = i; }
	*mx = m;
	return im;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	unsigned n = argc > 1 ? (unsigned)strtoul(argv[1], 0, 0) : 248320;
	int G = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 32;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "argmax.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "argmax"));
	CUdeviceptr dX, dOUT, dPART, dCNT;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * (size_t)n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dOUT, 8)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPART, 8 * 32)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dCNT, 4));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dCNT, 0, 1));
	float *x = malloc(4 * (size_t)n);
	int fails = 0;
	for (int trial = 0; trial < 12; trial++) {
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = 10.f * frand();
		unsigned where = (unsigned)(((uint64_t)(rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u) >> 8) % n);
		switch (trial % 4) {
		case 1: x[where] = 20.f; break;                                   /* a planted maximum */
		case 2: x[where] = 20.f; x[(where + 7) % n] = 20.f; break;        /* a tie: lowest index wins */
		case 3: x[n - 1] = 20.f; x[0] = 20.f; break;                      /* tie at both ends -> 0 */
		default: break;
		}
		float mref, mgot; unsigned iref = argmax_gpu(x, n, &mref), out[2];
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * (size_t)n));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dOUT, 0xffffffffu, 2));
		unsigned ug = (unsigned)G; void *params[] = { &dX, &dOUT, &dPART, &dCNT, &n, &ug };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, G, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out, dOUT, 8));
		memcpy(&mgot, &out[1], 4);
		int ok = out[0] == iref && mgot == mref;
		printf("trial %2d (n=%u, G=%d): gpu idx %u max %g, ref idx %u max %g -> %s\n", trial, n, G, out[0], mgot, iref, mref, ok ? "OK" : "MISMATCH");
		if (!ok) fails++;
	}
	unsigned cnt; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(&cnt, dCNT, 4));
	printf("counter after %d calls: %u (want 0)\n", 12, cnt);
	return (fails || cnt) ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/attn_test.c
/* attn_test: attnpart + attnmerge against attn_partials_gpu / attn_merge_gpu, bit for bit.
 * usage: attn_test [n keys] [timing iterations] */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "attn.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 77;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }

static int cmp(const char *what, const float *ref, const float *got, size_t cnt, int show) {
	int bad = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) if (memcmp(&ref[i], &got[i], 4)) {
		if (bad < show) printf("  %s[%zu]: gpu %.9g (%08x) ref %.9g (%08x)\n", what, i, got[i], *(uint32_t *)&got[i], ref[i], *(uint32_t *)&ref[i]);
		bad++;
	}
	printf("%s: %s (%d of %zu differ)\n", what, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, cnt);
	return bad;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	unsigned n = argc > 1 ? (unsigned)strtoul(argv[1], 0, 0) : 3000;
	int iters = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 0;
	unsigned npos = (n + 8192 + 64 + 31) / 32 * 32;      /* chunk round-up plus the loops' stray prefetches */
	size_t kcf = ATTN_KC_FLOATS(npos), vcf = (size_t)npos * 512;
	float *qo = malloc(6144 * 4), *gate = malloc(12288 * 4), *kc = calloc(kcf, 4), *vc = calloc(vcf, 4);
	float *out = malloc(6144 * 4), *outg = malloc(6144 * 4);
	float *pm = malloc(24 * 8 * 4), *pd = malloc(24 * 8 * 4), *po = malloc(24 * 8 * 256 * 4);
	float *pmg = malloc(24 * 8 * 4), *pdg = malloc(24 * 8 * 4), *pog = malloc(24 * 8 * 256 * 4);
	for (int i = 0; i < 6144; i++) qo[i] = 2.f * frand();
	for (int i = 0; i < 12288; i++) gate[i] = 4.f * frand();
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < n; t++)
		for (int kv = 0; kv < 2; kv++)
			for (int d = 0; d < 256; d++) { kc[attn_kidx(t, kv, d)] = 2.f * frand(); vc[(size_t)t * 512 + 256 * kv + d] = frand(); }
	double t0 = now();
	attn_partials_gpu(qo, kc, vc, n, pm, pd, po);
	attn_merge_gpu(pm, pd, po, gate, out);
	printf("n=%u: reference %.2f s\n", n, now() - t0);

	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mp, mm; CUfunction fp, fm;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mp, "attnpart.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fp, mp, "attnpart"));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mm, "attnmerge.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fm, mm, "attnmerge"));
	int nregs, maxb, nregs2;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fp));
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs2, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fm));
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fp, 256, 0));
	printf("attnpart: %d regs, %d CTAs/SM; attnmerge: %d regs\n", nregs, maxb, nregs2);
	CUdeviceptr dQO, dKC, dVC, dPM, dPD, dPO, dGATE, dOUT;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQO, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dKC, kcf * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dVC, vcf * 4));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPM, 24 * 8 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPD, 24 * 8 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPO, 24 * 8 * 256 * 4));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dGATE, 12288 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dOUT, 6144 * 4));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQO, qo, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKC, kc, kcf * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dVC, vc, vcf * 4));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dGATE, gate, 12288 * 4));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dPM, 0x7fc00000u, 24 * 8)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dPD, 0x7fc00000u, 24 * 8));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dPO, 0x7fc00000u, 24 * 8 * 256)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dOUT, 0x7fc00000u, 6144));
	void *pp[] = { &dQO, &dKC, &dVC, &dPM, &dPD, &dPO, &n };
	void *pmg_[] = { &dPM, &dPD, &dPO, &dGATE, &dOUT };
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fp, 32, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, pp, NULL));
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fm, 24, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, pmg_, NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(pmg, dPM, 24 * 8 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(pdg, dPD, 24 * 8 * 4));
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(pog, dPO, 24 * 8 * 256 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(outg, dOUT, 6144 * 4));
	if (getenv("ATTN_PRINT")) for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) printf("hq0 c%d: m gpu %.9g ref %.9g | den gpu %.9g ref %.9g | po0 gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", c, pmg[c], pm[c], pdg[c], pd[c], pog[c * 256], po[c * 256]);
	int bad = 0;
	bad += cmp("pm", pm, pmg, 24 * 8, 4);
	bad += cmp("pd", pd, pdg, 24 * 8, 4);
	bad += cmp("po", po, pog, 24 * 8 * 256, 4);
	bad += cmp("out", out, outg, 6144, 4);
	if (iters > 0) {
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fp, 32, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, pp, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double t1 = now();
		for (int it = 0; it < iters; it++) {
			CK(cuLaunchKernel(fp, 32, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, pp, NULL));
			CK(cuLaunchKernel(fm, 24, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, pmg_, NULL));
		}
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double dt = (now() - t1) / iters;
		printf("timing: %.1f us per step, %.1f GB/s of K+V (%.1f MB)\n", dt * 1e6, (double)n * 4096 / dt / 1e9, (double)n * 4096 / 1e6);
	}
	return bad ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/attnmerge.sass
# Kernel: attnmerge
#
# Combines the 8 chunk partials of attnpart per query head and applies the output
# gate. Grid = 24 CTAs (one per head) x 256 threads (one per dim):
#   M = max_c m_c; e_c = exp(m_c - M); den = pd_0 e_0, then fmaf over c = 1..7;
#   o = po_0[d] e_0, fmaf over c; o *= rcp(den); out[256 h + d] = o * sigmoid(gate[512 h + 256 + d])
# Bit-exact twin: ref/attn.c attn_merge_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 PM  1:0x148 PD  2:0x150 PO  3:0x158 GATE  4:0x160 OUT

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_PM0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_PM1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_PD0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_PD1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_PO0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_PO1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_GATE0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_GATE1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_OUT0  : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_OUT1  : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-7   : pm<0-7>
    8-15  : pd<0-7>
    16-23 : po<0-7>
    24-31 : e<0-7>
    32    : mval
    33    : den
    34    : rd
    35    : g
    36    : sg
    37    : o
    38    : log2e
    39    : ln2hi
    40    : ln2lo

    42    : c120
    43    : c24

    48-63 : t<00-15>
