<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R hq, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, hq, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, tmp, param_PM0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_PM1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dp0.CC, tmp, param_PD0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dp1, RZ, param_PD1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 pm0, [pp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 pm4, [pp+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 pd0, [dp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 pd4, [dp+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tt, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, hq, 0xd;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tmp, tmp, tt;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD op0.CC, tmp, param_PO0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X op1, RZ, param_PO1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E po%d, [op+0x%x];\n", $_, $_ * 0x400 for 0..7;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, hq, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tmp, tmp, tt;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tmp, tmp, 0x400;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD gp0.CC, tmp, param_GATE0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X gp1, RZ, param_GATE1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:5:-:1      LDG.E g, [gp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, hq, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tmp, tmp, tt;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, tmp, param_OUT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_OUT1;\n";
    # M, e_c
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mval, pm0, pm1, !PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mval, mval, pm%d, !PT;\n", $_ for 2..7;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD e%d, pm%d, -mval;\n", $_ == 7 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..7;
    $o .= fm_zip(map { fm_exp_ip("e$_", sprintf("t%02d", 2 * $_), sprintf("t%02d", 2 * $_ + 1), \%C) } 0..7);
    # den and its reciprocal
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL den, pd0, e0;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA den, pd%d, e%d, den;\n", $_, $_ for 1..7;
    $o .= fm_rcp('rd', 'den', 't00', \%C);
    # o
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      FMUL o, po0, e0;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA o, po%d, e%d, o;\n", $_, $_ for 1..7;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL o, o, rd;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      MOV t04, g;\n";
    $o .= fm_sigmoid('sg', 't04', 't00', 't01', 't02', 't03', \%C);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL o, o, sg;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6      STG.E [yp], o;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/attnpart.sass
# Kernel: attnpart
#
# Decode-attention partials (flash-decoding style). Grid = 32 CTAs x 256 threads,
# 2 CTAs per SM: CTA b owns key chunk c = b & 7, head half hh = (b >> 3) & 1 and KV
# head kv = b >> 4, i.e. query heads 12 kv + 6 hh + 0..5, over keys [c CK, (c+1) CK)
# with CK = ceil(n / 8192) * 1024, in tiles of 1024 keys:
#   QK phase: thread t = 32 w + l holds keys tb + 256 s + t (s = 0..3): one K chunk
#     (4 dims, LDG.128, coalesced across the warp thanks to the blocked K layout) per
#     slot and 6 heads' q (LDS.64 broadcast from smem) per 4 dims -> 96 FFMAs per step,
#     64 steps. Scores start at 0 (-inf for keys >= n), end * 1/16.
#   softmax: slot max -> warp butterfly -> 8 warp maxima in smem -> m_new;
#     scale = exp(m - m_new), p = exp(s - m_new) (0 past n), den likewise with sums.
#   V phase: p for the tile sits in smem [1024][6]; thread (dg = t >> 2, r = t & 3)
#     accumulates dims 4 dg..4 dg+3 over keys tb + 4 k + r (k in order); the 4 streams
#     are combined (r0 + r1) + (r2 + r3) at the end of the chunk.
# Bit-exact twin: ref/attn.c attn_partials_gpu. K/V caches must be zero-filled at
# allocation and hold >= n + 8192 + 64 positions (the loops' stray prefetches).
#
# Params: 0:0x140 QO  1:0x148 KC  2:0x150 VC  3:0x158 PM  4:0x160 PD  5:0x168 PO  6:0x170 n (u32)
# smem: q 0x0000 (6 KB), p 0x1800 (24 KB), red_max 0x7800 (8 x 32 B), red_den 0x7900

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_QO0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_QO1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_KC0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_KC1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_VC0 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_VC1 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_PM0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_PM1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_PD0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_PD1 : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_PO0 : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_PO1 : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_n   : c[0x0][0x170]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-23    : vacc<00-23>
    24-29   : mx<0-5>
    30-35   : den<0-5>
    36,37   : kcb<0-1>
    38,39   : vcb<0-1>
    40      : tid
    41      : tbase
    42      : tend
    43      : qs
    44-59   : ka<00-15>
    60-75   : kb<00-15>
    76-99   : q<00-23>
    100-123 : sacc<00-23>
    124     : cnt

    44-75   : p<00-31>
    76-81   : scale<0-5>
    82,83   : t<1-2>
    84-89   : tm<0-5>
    90      : log2e
    91      : ln2hi
    92      : ln2lo
    93      : c720
    94      : c120
    95      : c24
    96      : c6
    97      : chalf
    98      : cone
    99      : t3
    100-107 : ga<0-7>
    108-115 : gb<0-7>
    116-121 : dp<0-5>
    44-51   : ra<0-7>
    52-59   : rb<0-7>

    44-47   : va<0-3>
    48-51   : vb<0-3>
    52-57   : pa<0-5>
    60-65   : pb<0-5>
    66,67   : vp<0-1>
    74      : ps
    75      : itc

    44-67   : st<00-23>
    68,69   : pop<0-1>
    70,71   : pmp<0-1>
    72,73   : pdp<0-1>
    84      : w
    85      : l
    86      : cta
    87      : tmp
    88,89   : qp<0-1>
    90      : u1
    91      : u2
    92      : u3
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone);
    # temp pairs for 6 interleaved exp chains (p06.. are the pad slots of p's 8-wide rows)
    my @xt = (['t1', 't2'], ['t3', 'cnt'], ['qs', 'p06'], ['p07', 'p14'], ['p15', 'p22'], ['p23', 'p30']);
    # vacc register of (head h, dim i): rotated by 2 so va_i and vacc land in different banks
    my $vreg = sub { my ($h, $i) = @_; sprintf "vacc%02d", 4 * $h + (($i + 2) & 3) };
    my $o = '';
    # ---------------- prologue ----------------
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R cta, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV ka%02d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..15;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV kb%02d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..15;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV vacc%02d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..23;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV den%d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I mx%d, 0xf149f2ca;\n", $_ for 0..5;              # -1e30
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 w, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND l, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND tmp, cta, 0x7;\n";                                 # c
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u3, cta, 0x4;\n";                                     # kv
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P5, PT, l, RZ, PT;\n";                           # P5: lane 0
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P6, PT, tid, 0x80, PT;\n";                   # P6: loads q's second half
    # nt = (n + 8191) >> 13 tiles per chunk; tbase = (c nt) << 10; tend = tbase + (nt << 10)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV u1, param_n;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, 0x1fff;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u1, u1, 0xd;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD tbase, tmp, u1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tbase, tbase, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u1, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tend, tbase, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV u2, param_n;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 tend, tend, u2, PT;\n";                                # tiles past n are empty: stop there
    # kcb = KC + 32768 kv + 65536 w + 16 l + (tbase << 11)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL kcb0, u3, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, w, 0x10;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0, kcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, l, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0, kcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, tbase, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0, kcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0.CC, kcb0, param_KC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kcb1, RZ, param_KC1;\n";
    # vcb = VC + 2048 (tid & 3) + 1024 kv + 16 (tid >> 2)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL vcb0, u2, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u3, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vcb0, vcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u2, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u2, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vcb0, vcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vcb0.CC, vcb0, param_VC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vcb1, RZ, param_VC1;\n";
    # q -> smem: QO + 12288 kv + 6144 hh + 16 tid (+ 4096 for tid < 128)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u2, cta, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, u2, 0x1;\n";                                   # hh
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u1, u2, 0xc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u2, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u3, 0xd;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u3, 0xc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, tid, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qp0.CC, u1, param_QO0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X qp1, RZ, param_QO1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 q00, [qp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:6  \@P6 LDG.E.128 q04, [qp+0x1000];\n";
    $o .= "01:1:-:-:1      STS.128 [u2], q00;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P6 STS.128 [u2+0x1000], q04;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    # a chunk that starts past n has nothing to do
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P4, PT, tbase, param_n, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA FINAL;\n";

    # ---------------- tile ----------------
    $o .= "\nTILE:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, tbase, tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P0, PT, u1, param_n, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u2, u1, 0x100;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, u2, param_n, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u2, u1, 0x200;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, u2, param_n, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u2, u1, 0x300;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P3, PT, u2, param_n, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV qs, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV cnt, 0x10;\n";
    # K chunk 0 -> ka; wait out the previous loop's stray prefetches into these registers
    $o .= sprintf "%s:3:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 ka%02d, [kcb+0x%x];\n", $_ == 0 ? '09' : '--', 4 * $_, $_ * 0x80000 for 0..3;
    for my $s (0..3) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV sacc%02d, RZ;\n", 6 * $s + $_ for 0..5; }
    for my $s (0..3) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1 \@!P%d MOV32I sacc%02d, 0xff800000;\n", $s, 6 * $s + $_ for 0..5; }

    $o .= "\nQKLOOP:\n";
    for my $j (0..3) {
        my ($cur, $nxt, $cw, $nb) = $j % 2 ? ('kb', 'ka', '02', '1') : ('ka', 'kb', '01', '2');
        # prefetch the next chunk into the other buffer
        $o .= sprintf "--:3:%s:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 %s%02d, [kcb+0x%x];\n", $nb, $nxt, 4 * $_, $_ * 0x80000 + ($j + 1) * 0x200 for 0..3;
        # q dims 4j..4j+3 of the 6 heads, halves swapped so q and k sit in different banks
        for my $h (0..5) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 q%02d, [qs+0x%x];\n", 4 * $h + 2, $h * 0x400 + $j * 0x10;
            $o .= sprintf "--:5:4:-:%d      LDS.64 q%02d, [qs+0x%x];\n", $h == 5 ? 2 : 1, 4 * $h, $h * 0x400 + $j * 0x10 + 8;   # last load: stall 2 before the dependent wait
        }
        my $first = 1;
        for my $i (0..3) { for my $s (0..3) { for my $h (0..5) {
            my $wait = $first ? sprintf("%02x", hex($cw) | 0x08) : '--';
            $first = 0;
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      FFMA sacc%02d, q%02d, %s%02d, sacc%02d;\n", $wait, 6 * $s + $h, 4 * $h + (($i + 2) & 3), $cur, 4 * $s + $i, 6 * $s + $h;
        } } }
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cnt, cnt, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P4, PT, cnt, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0.CC, kcb0, 0x800;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kcb1, kcb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IADD qs, qs, 0x40;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA QKLOOP;\n";

    # ---------------- tile epilogue: online softmax ----------------
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMUL sacc%02d, sacc%02d, 0.0625;\n", $_ == 0 ? '03' : '--', $_ == 23 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..23;
    # per-thread max over the 4 slots, then across the warp
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      FMNMX p%02d, sacc%02d, sacc%02d, !PT;\n", $_, 12 + $_, 18 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, sacc%02d, sacc%02d, !PT;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 6 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, p%02d, !PT;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:6:-:%d      SHFL.BFLY PT, p%02d, tm%d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, 8 + $_, $_, $x for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, p%02d, !PT;\n", $_ == 0 ? '20' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 8 + $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # warp maxima -> red_max[w] (lane 0); everyone folds the 8 rows
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 cnt, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL qs, cnt, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qs, qs, 0x7800;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P5 STS.128 [qs], tm0;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P5 STS.64 [qs+0x10], tm4;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    for my $w (0, 2, 4, 6) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.128 ra0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + $w * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.64 ra4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + $w * 32 + 16;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:1      LDS.128 rb0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + ($w + 1) * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      LDS.64 rb4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + ($w + 1) * 32 + 16;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, ra%d, !PT;\n", $_ == 0 ? ($w == 0 ? '09' : '08') : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, rb%d, !PT;\n", $_ == 0 ? '10' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # m_new = max(m, tile max); scale = exp(m - m_new); m = m_new
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, mx%d, !PT;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD scale%d, mx%d, -tm%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= fm_zip(map { fm_exp_ip("scale$_", @{$xt[$_]}, \%C) } 0..5);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      MOV mx%d, tm%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    # p = exp(s - m_new) for keys < n, else 0; one slot (6 heads) at a time
    for my $s (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD p%02d, sacc%02d, -tm%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, 8 * $s + $_, 6 * $s + $_, $_ for 0..5;
        $o .= fm_zip(map { fm_exp_ip(sprintf("p%02d", 8 * $s + $_), @{$xt[$_]}, \%C) } 0..5);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d \@!P%d MOV p%02d, RZ;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $s, 8 * $s + $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # tile den: ((p0 + p1) + p2) + p3 per thread, warp butterfly, warps in order
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, p%02d, p%02d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 8 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, p%02d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 16 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, p%02d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 24 + $_ for 0..5;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:6:-:%d      SHFL.BFLY PT, tm%d, dp%d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, $_, $_, $x for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, tm%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '20' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # acc *= scale
    for my $h (0..5) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      FMUL %s, %s, scale%d;\n", $vreg->($h, $_), $vreg->($h, $_), $h for 0..3; }
    # lane 0: warp den -> red_den[w]; all: p -> smem rows of 24 B at 0x1800 + 24 (256 s + t)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 cnt, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL cnt, cnt, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cnt, cnt, 0x7900;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, tid, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, t2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, 0x1800;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P5 STS.128 [cnt], dp0;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P5 STS.64 [cnt+0x10], dp4;\n";
    for my $s (0..3) {
        # 24-byte rows are only 8-aligned: three STS.64
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:1      STS.64 [t1+0x%x], p%02d;\n", $s * 0x1800 + 8 * $_, 8 * $s + 2 * $_ for 0..1;
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:%d      STS.64 [t1+0x%x], p%02d;\n", $s == 3 ? 6 : 1, $s * 0x1800 + 16, 8 * $s + 4;
    }
    $o .= "03:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    for my $w (0, 2, 4, 6) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.128 ga0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + $w * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.64 ga4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + $w * 32 + 16;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:1      LDS.128 gb0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + ($w + 1) * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      LDS.64 gb4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + ($w + 1) * 32 + 16;
        if ($w == 0) {
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, ga%d, gb%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '19' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
        } else {
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, ga%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '08' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, gb%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '10' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
        }
    }
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FFMA den%d, den%d, scale%d, dp%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;

    # ---------------- V phase ----------------
    # itc = ceil(clamp(ceil((n - tbase) / 4), 0, 256) / 2) iterations of two keys per stream
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV itc, param_n;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, -tbase;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR itc, itc, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX itc, itc, RZ, !PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX itc, itc, 0x100, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 itc, itc, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P4, PT, itc, RZ, PT;\n";
    # vp = vcb + (tbase << 11); ps = 0x1800 + 24 (tid & 3)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t3, tbase, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vp0.CC, vcb0, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vp1, vcb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t3, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL ps, t3, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t3, t3, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ps, ps, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ps, ps, 0x1800;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA VDONE;\n";
    # key 0 of each stream -> A (p registers were just stored: wait for the STS reads)
    $o .= "02:3:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 va0, [vp];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa0, [ps];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa2, [ps+0x8];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:6      LDS.64 pa4, [ps+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "\nVLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:3:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 vb0, [vp+0x2000];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:6:-:1      LDS.64 pb0, [ps+0x60];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:6:-:1      LDS.64 pb2, [ps+0x68];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:6:-:1      LDS.64 pb4, [ps+0x70];\n";
    my $first = 1;
    for my $h (0..5) { for my $i (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      FFMA %s, pa%d, va%d, %s;\n", $first ? '09' : '--', $vreg->($h, $i), $h, $i, $vreg->($h, $i);
        $first = 0;
    } }
    $o .= "--:3:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 va0, [vp+0x4000];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa0, [ps+0xc0];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa2, [ps+0xc8];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa4, [ps+0xd0];\n";
    $first = 1;
    for my $h (0..5) { for my $i (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      FFMA %s, pb%d, vb%d, %s;\n", $first ? '22' : '--', $vreg->($h, $i), $h, $i, $vreg->($h, $i);
        $first = 0;
    } }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P4, PT, itc, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      IADD vp0.CC, vp0, 0x4000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vp1, vp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IADD ps, ps, 0xc0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA VLOOP;\n";
    $o .= "\nVDONE:\n";
    # next tile: kcb advanced 32 KB in the loop, a tile is 2 MB
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t3, 0x1f8000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0.CC, kcb0, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kcb1, kcb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tbase, tbase, 0x400;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, tbase, tend, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA TILE;\n";

    # ---------------- chunk result ----------------
    $o .= "\nFINAL:\n";
    for my $x (1, 2) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:6:-:%d      SHFL.BFLY PT, st%02d, vacc%02d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", ($x == 1 && $_ == 0) ? '09' : '--', $_ == 23 ? 2 : 1, $_, $_, $x for 0..23;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD vacc%02d, vacc%02d, st%02d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '20' : '--', $_ == 23 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..23;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R cta, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u1, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P0, PT, u1, RZ, PT;\n";                          # stream-0 lanes hold the sums
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P1, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";                         # thread 0 writes m, den
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u1, cta, 0x4;\n";                                     # kv
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u2, cta, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, u2, 0x1;\n";                                   # hh
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u3, cta, 0x7;\n";                                  # c
    # po + 98304 kv + 49152 hh + 1024 c + 16 (tid >> 2)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL pop0, u1, 0x10;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u1, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0xe;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u3, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 tmp, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, tmp, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0.CC, pop0, param_PO0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pop1, RZ, param_PO1;\n";
    # pm/pd + 384 kv + 192 hh + 4 c
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL pmp0, u1, 0x8;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u1, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u3, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pdp0.CC, pmp0, param_PD0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pdp1, RZ, param_PD1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0.CC, pmp0, param_PM0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pmp1, RZ, param_PM1;\n";
    for my $h (0..5) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P0 STG.E.64 [pop+0x%x], vacc%02d;\n", $h * 0x2000, 4 * $h + 2;        # dims 0, 1
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P0 STG.E.64 [pop+0x%x], vacc%02d;\n", $h * 0x2000 + 8, 4 * $h;        # dims 2, 3
    }
    for my $h (0..5) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P1 STG.E [pmp+0x%x], mx%d;\n", $h * 0x20, $h;
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P1 STG.E [pdp+0x%x], den%d;\n", $h * 0x20, $h;
    }
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/attnpartn.sass
# Kernel: attnpartn
#
# Decode-attention partials (flash-decoding style). Grid = 32 CTAs x 256 threads,
# 2 CTAs per SM: CTA b owns key chunk c = b >> 2, head half hh = (b >> 1) & 1 and KV
# head kv = b & 1 (the chunk is the high part of the unit id: the units with keys are the low ids, so they sit on different physical CTAs; the physical CTA runs units b and b + 16, and with the chunk in the low bits the two units of a CTA were both busy), i.e. query heads 12 kv + 6 hh + 0..5, over keys [c CK, (c+1) CK)
# with CK = ceil(n / 8192) * 1024, in tiles of 1024 keys:
#   QK phase: thread t = 32 w + l holds keys tb + 256 s + t (s = 0..3): one K chunk
#     (4 dims, LDG.128, coalesced across the warp thanks to the blocked K layout) per
#     slot and 6 heads' q (LDS.64 broadcast from smem) per 4 dims -> 96 FFMAs per step,
#     64 steps. Scores start at 0 (-inf for keys >= n), end * 1/16.
#   softmax: slot max -> warp butterfly -> 8 warp maxima in smem -> m_new;
#     scale = exp(m - m_new), p = exp(s - m_new) (0 past n), den likewise with sums.
#   V phase: p for the tile sits in smem [1024][6]; thread (dg = t >> 2, r = t & 3)
#     accumulates dims 4 dg..4 dg+3 over keys tb + 4 k + r (k in order); the 4 streams
#     are combined (r0 + r1) + (r2 + r3) at the end of the chunk.
# Bit-exact twin: ref/attn.c attn_partials_gpu. K/V caches must be zero-filled at
# allocation and hold >= n + 8192 + 64 positions (the loops' stray prefetches).
#
# attnpartn: the key count is derived from the token position, for the QSA gather (the compact caches hold the
# attended keys): n = t + 1 while nv = (t + 1) >> 2 <= NBLK, else 4 NBLK + (t + 1) % 4 (ref/qsa.h qsa_nkeys).
# Params: 0:0x140 QO  1:0x148 KC  2:0x150 VC  3:0x158 PM  4:0x160 PD  5:0x168 PO  6:0x170 tp1 = t + 1 (u32)  7:0x174 NBLK (u32)
# smem: q 0x0000 (6 KB), p 0x1800 (24 KB), red_max 0x7800 (8 x 32 B), red_den 0x7900

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_QO0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_QO1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_KC0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_KC1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_VC0 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_VC1 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_PM0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_PM1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_PD0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_PD1 : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_PO0 : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_PO1 : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_tp1 : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_nblk : c[0x0][0x174]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-23    : vacc<00-23>
    24-29   : mx<0-5>
    30-35   : den<0-5>
    36,37   : kcb<0-1>
    38,39   : vcb<0-1>
    40      : tid
    41      : tbase
    42      : tend
    43      : qs
    44-59   : ka<00-15>
    60-75   : kb<00-15>
    76-99   : q<00-23>
    100-123 : sacc<00-23>
    124     : cnt

    44-75   : p<00-31>
    76-81   : scale<0-5>
    82,83   : t<1-2>
    84-89   : tm<0-5>
    90      : log2e
    91      : ln2hi
    92      : ln2lo
    93      : c720
    94      : c120
    95      : c24

    98      : cone
    99      : t3
    100-107 : ga<0-7>
    108-115 : gb<0-7>
    116-121 : dp<0-5>

    52-59   : rb<0-7>

    44-47   : va<0-3>
    48-51   : vb<0-3>
    52-57   : pa<0-5>
    60-65   : pb<0-5>
    66,67   : vp<0-1>
    74      : ps
    75      : itc

    44-67   : st<00-23>
    68,69   : pop<0-1>
    70,71   : pmp<0-1>
    72,73   : pdp<0-1>
    84      : w
    85      : l
    86      : cta

    88,89   : qp<0-1>

</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone);
    # temp pairs for 6 interleaved exp chains (p06.. are the pad slots of p's 8-wide rows)
    my @xt = (['t1', 't2'], ['t3', 'cnt'], ['qs', 'p06'], ['p07', 'p14'], ['p15', 'p22'], ['p23', 'p30']);
    # vacc register of (head h, dim i): rotated by 2 so va_i and vacc land in different banks
    my $vreg = sub { my ($h, $i) = @_; sprintf "vacc%02d", 4 * $h + (($i + 2) & 3) };
    my $o = '';
    # ---------------- prologue ----------------
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R cta, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV ka%02d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..15;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV kb%02d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..15;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV vacc%02d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..23;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV den%d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I mx%d, 0xf149f2ca;\n", $_ for 0..5;              # -1e30
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 w, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND l, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 tmp, cta, 0x2;\n";                                 # c
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u3, cta, 0x1;\n";                                     # kv
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P5, PT, l, RZ, PT;\n";                           # P5: lane 0
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P6, PT, tid, 0x80, PT;\n";                   # P6: loads q's second half
    # nn = the key count: tp1 while nv = tp1 >> 2 <= NBLK, else 4 NBLK + (tp1 & 3)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV nn, param_tp1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u1, nn, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, nn, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GT.U32.AND P4, PT, u1, param_nblk, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u1, param_nblk, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 MOV nn, u1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    # nt = (n + 8191) >> 13 tiles per chunk; tbase = (c nt) << 10; tend = tbase + (nt << 10)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV u1, nn;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, 0x1fff;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u1, u1, 0xd;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD tbase, tmp, u1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tbase, tbase, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u1, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tend, tbase, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV u2, nn;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 tend, tend, u2, PT;\n";                                # tiles past n are empty: stop there
    # kcb = KC + 32768 kv + 65536 w + 16 l + (tbase << 11)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL kcb0, u3, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, w, 0x10;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0, kcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, l, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0, kcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, tbase, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0, kcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0.CC, kcb0, param_KC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kcb1, RZ, param_KC1;\n";
    # vcb = VC + 2048 (tid & 3) + 1024 kv + 16 (tid >> 2)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL vcb0, u2, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u3, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vcb0, vcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u2, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u2, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vcb0, vcb0, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vcb0.CC, vcb0, param_VC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vcb1, RZ, param_VC1;\n";
    # q -> smem: QO + 12288 kv + 6144 hh + 16 tid (+ 4096 for tid < 128)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u2, cta, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, u2, 0x1;\n";                                   # hh
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u1, u2, 0xc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u2, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u3, 0xd;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, u3, 0xc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL u2, tid, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, u1, u2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qp0.CC, u1, param_QO0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X qp1, RZ, param_QO1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 q00, [qp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:6  \@P6 LDG.E.128 q04, [qp+0x1000];\n";
    $o .= "01:1:-:-:1      STS.128 [u2], q00;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P6 STS.128 [u2+0x1000], q04;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    # a chunk that starts past n has nothing to do
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P4, PT, tbase, nn, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA FINAL;\n";

    # ---------------- tile ----------------
    $o .= "\nTILE:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, tbase, tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P0, PT, u1, nn, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u2, u1, 0x100;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, u2, nn, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u2, u1, 0x200;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, u2, nn, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u2, u1, 0x300;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P3, PT, u2, nn, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV qs, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV cnt, 0x10;\n";
    # K chunk 0 -> ka; wait out the previous loop's stray prefetches into these registers
    $o .= sprintf "%s:3:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 ka%02d, [kcb+0x%x];\n", $_ == 0 ? '09' : '--', 4 * $_, $_ * 0x80000 for 0..3;
    for my $s (0..3) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV sacc%02d, RZ;\n", 6 * $s + $_ for 0..5; }
    for my $s (0..3) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1 \@!P%d MOV32I sacc%02d, 0xff800000;\n", $s, 6 * $s + $_ for 0..5; }

    $o .= "\nQKLOOP:\n";
    for my $j (0..3) {
        my ($cur, $nxt, $cw, $nb) = $j % 2 ? ('kb', 'ka', '02', '1') : ('ka', 'kb', '01', '2');
        # prefetch the next chunk into the other buffer
        $o .= sprintf "--:3:%s:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 %s%02d, [kcb+0x%x];\n", $nb, $nxt, 4 * $_, $_ * 0x80000 + ($j + 1) * 0x200 for 0..3;
        # q dims 4j..4j+3 of the 6 heads, halves swapped so q and k sit in different banks
        for my $h (0..5) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 q%02d, [qs+0x%x];\n", 4 * $h + 2, $h * 0x400 + $j * 0x10;
            $o .= sprintf "--:5:4:-:%d      LDS.64 q%02d, [qs+0x%x];\n", $h == 5 ? 2 : 1, 4 * $h, $h * 0x400 + $j * 0x10 + 8;   # last load: stall 2 before the dependent wait
        }
        my $first = 1;
        for my $i (0..3) { for my $s (0..3) { for my $h (0..5) {
            my $wait = $first ? sprintf("%02x", hex($cw) | 0x08) : '--';
            $first = 0;
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      FFMA sacc%02d, q%02d, %s%02d, sacc%02d;\n", $wait, 6 * $s + $h, 4 * $h + (($i + 2) & 3), $cur, 4 * $s + $i, 6 * $s + $h;
        } } }
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cnt, cnt, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P4, PT, cnt, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0.CC, kcb0, 0x800;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kcb1, kcb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IADD qs, qs, 0x40;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA QKLOOP;\n";

    # ---------------- tile epilogue: online softmax ----------------
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMUL sacc%02d, sacc%02d, 0.0625;\n", $_ == 0 ? '03' : '--', $_ == 23 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..23;
    # per-thread max over the 4 slots, then across the warp
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      FMNMX p%02d, sacc%02d, sacc%02d, !PT;\n", $_, 12 + $_, 18 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, sacc%02d, sacc%02d, !PT;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 6 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, p%02d, !PT;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:6:-:%d      SHFL.BFLY PT, p%02d, tm%d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, 8 + $_, $_, $x for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, p%02d, !PT;\n", $_ == 0 ? '20' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 8 + $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # warp maxima -> red_max[w] (lane 0); everyone folds the 8 rows
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 cnt, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL qs, cnt, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qs, qs, 0x7800;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P5 STS.128 [qs], tm0;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P5 STS.64 [qs+0x10], tm4;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    for my $w (0, 2, 4, 6) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.128 ra0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + $w * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.64 ra4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + $w * 32 + 16;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:1      LDS.128 rb0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + ($w + 1) * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      LDS.64 rb4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7800 + ($w + 1) * 32 + 16;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, ra%d, !PT;\n", $_ == 0 ? ($w == 0 ? '09' : '08') : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, rb%d, !PT;\n", $_ == 0 ? '10' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # m_new = max(m, tile max); scale = exp(m - m_new); m = m_new
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMNMX tm%d, tm%d, mx%d, !PT;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD scale%d, mx%d, -tm%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= fm_zip(map { fm_exp_ip("scale$_", @{$xt[$_]}, \%C) } 0..5);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      MOV mx%d, tm%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    # p = exp(s - m_new) for keys < n, else 0; one slot (6 heads) at a time
    for my $s (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD p%02d, sacc%02d, -tm%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, 8 * $s + $_, 6 * $s + $_, $_ for 0..5;
        $o .= fm_zip(map { fm_exp_ip(sprintf("p%02d", 8 * $s + $_), @{$xt[$_]}, \%C) } 0..5);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d \@!P%d MOV p%02d, RZ;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $s, 8 * $s + $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # tile den: ((p0 + p1) + p2) + p3 per thread, warp butterfly, warps in order
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, p%02d, p%02d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 8 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, p%02d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 16 + $_ for 0..5;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, p%02d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, 24 + $_ for 0..5;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:6:-:%d      SHFL.BFLY PT, tm%d, dp%d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, $_, $_, $x for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, tm%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '20' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
    }
    # acc *= scale
    for my $h (0..5) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      FMUL %s, %s, scale%d;\n", $vreg->($h, $_), $vreg->($h, $_), $h for 0..3; }
    # lane 0: warp den -> red_den[w]; all: p -> smem rows of 24 B at 0x1800 + 24 (256 s + t)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 cnt, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL cnt, cnt, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cnt, cnt, 0x7900;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, tid, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, t2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, 0x1800;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P5 STS.128 [cnt], dp0;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P5 STS.64 [cnt+0x10], dp4;\n";
    for my $s (0..3) {
        # 24-byte rows are only 8-aligned: three STS.64
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:1      STS.64 [t1+0x%x], p%02d;\n", $s * 0x1800 + 8 * $_, 8 * $s + 2 * $_ for 0..1;
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:%d      STS.64 [t1+0x%x], p%02d;\n", $s == 3 ? 6 : 1, $s * 0x1800 + 16, 8 * $s + 4;
    }
    $o .= "03:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    for my $w (0, 2, 4, 6) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.128 ga0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + $w * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS.64 ga4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + $w * 32 + 16;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:1      LDS.128 gb0, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + ($w + 1) * 32;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      LDS.64 gb4, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x7900 + ($w + 1) * 32 + 16;
        if ($w == 0) {
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, ga%d, gb%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '19' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
        } else {
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, ga%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '08' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD dp%d, dp%d, gb%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '10' : '--', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;
        }
    }
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FFMA den%d, den%d, scale%d, dp%d;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_, $_ for 0..5;

    # ---------------- V phase ----------------
    # itc = ceil(clamp(ceil((n - tbase) / 4), 0, 256) / 2) iterations of two keys per stream
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV itc, nn;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, -tbase;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR itc, itc, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX itc, itc, RZ, !PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX itc, itc, 0x100, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 itc, itc, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P4, PT, itc, RZ, PT;\n";
    # vp = vcb + (tbase << 11); ps = 0x1800 + 24 (tid & 3)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t3, tbase, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vp0.CC, vcb0, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vp1, vcb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t3, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL ps, t3, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t3, t3, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ps, ps, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ps, ps, 0x1800;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA VDONE;\n";
    # key 0 of each stream -> A (p registers were just stored: wait for the STS reads)
    $o .= "02:3:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 va0, [vp];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa0, [ps];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa2, [ps+0x8];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:6      LDS.64 pa4, [ps+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "\nVLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:3:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 vb0, [vp+0x2000];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:6:-:1      LDS.64 pb0, [ps+0x60];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:6:-:1      LDS.64 pb2, [ps+0x68];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:6:-:1      LDS.64 pb4, [ps+0x70];\n";
    my $first = 1;
    for my $h (0..5) { for my $i (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      FFMA %s, pa%d, va%d, %s;\n", $first ? '09' : '--', $vreg->($h, $i), $h, $i, $vreg->($h, $i);
        $first = 0;
    } }
    $o .= "--:3:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 va0, [vp+0x4000];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa0, [ps+0xc0];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa2, [ps+0xc8];\n";
    $o .= "--:5:4:-:1      LDS.64 pa4, [ps+0xd0];\n";
    $first = 1;
    for my $h (0..5) { for my $i (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      FFMA %s, pb%d, vb%d, %s;\n", $first ? '22' : '--', $vreg->($h, $i), $h, $i, $vreg->($h, $i);
        $first = 0;
    } }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD itc, itc, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P4, PT, itc, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      IADD vp0.CC, vp0, 0x4000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vp1, vp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IADD ps, ps, 0xc0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA VLOOP;\n";
    $o .= "\nVDONE:\n";
    # next tile: kcb advanced 32 KB in the loop, a tile is 2 MB
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t3, 0x1f8000;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kcb0.CC, kcb0, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kcb1, kcb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tbase, tbase, 0x400;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, tbase, tend, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA TILE;\n";

    # ---------------- chunk result ----------------
    $o .= "\nFINAL:\n";
    for my $x (1, 2) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:6:-:%d      SHFL.BFLY PT, st%02d, vacc%02d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", ($x == 1 && $_ == 0) ? '09' : '--', $_ == 23 ? 2 : 1, $_, $_, $x for 0..23;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FADD vacc%02d, vacc%02d, st%02d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '20' : '--', $_ == 23 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..23;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R cta, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u1, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P0, PT, u1, RZ, PT;\n";                          # stream-0 lanes hold the sums
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P1, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";                         # thread 0 writes m, den
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u1, cta, 0x1;\n";                                    # kv
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u2, cta, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND u2, u2, 0x1;\n";                                   # hh
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u3, cta, 0x2;\n";                                  # c
    # po + 98304 kv + 49152 hh + 1024 c + 16 (tid >> 2)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL pop0, u1, 0x10;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u1, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0xe;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u3, 0xa;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 tmp, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, tmp, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0, pop0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pop0.CC, pop0, param_PO0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pop1, RZ, param_PO1;\n";
    # pm/pd + 384 kv + 192 hh + 4 c
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL pmp0, u1, 0x8;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u1, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u2, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, u3, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0, pmp0, tmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pdp0.CC, pmp0, param_PD0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pdp1, RZ, param_PD1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pmp0.CC, pmp0, param_PM0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pmp1, RZ, param_PM1;\n";
    for my $h (0..5) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P0 STG.E.64 [pop+0x%x], vacc%02d;\n", $h * 0x2000, 4 * $h + 2;        # dims 0, 1
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P0 STG.E.64 [pop+0x%x], vacc%02d;\n", $h * 0x2000 + 8, 4 * $h;        # dims 2, 3
    }
    for my $h (0..5) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P1 STG.E [pmp+0x%x], mx%d;\n", $h * 0x20, $h;
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P1 STG.E [pdp+0x%x], den%d;\n", $h * 0x20, $h;
    }
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/attnpartn_unitmap.c
/* attnpartn_unitmap.c: offline check of the attnpartn unit-id remap (no GPU): cc -O2 -o unitmap attnpartn_unitmap.c && ./unitmap
 * Both decodes must be bijections onto (kv, hh, c); the table shows how many CTAs the units with keys land on and how many run back to back
 * (a CTA runs units b and b + 16). The output slots depend only on (kv, hh, c), so the results do not change, only which CTA computes which unit. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
static void old_(int b, int *kv, int *hh, int *c) { *c = b & 7; *hh = (b >> 3) & 1; *kv = b >> 4; }
static void new_(int b, int *kv, int *hh, int *c) { *c = b >> 2; *hh = (b >> 1) & 1; *kv = b & 1; }
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	int duplicate = argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--inject-duplicate");
	int missing = argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--inject-missing");
	if (argc > 2 || (argc == 2 && !duplicate && !missing)) {
		fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s [--inject-duplicate|--inject-missing]\n", argv[0]); return 2;
	}
	int bad = 0;
	void (*dec[2])(int, int *, int *, int *) = { old_, new_ }; const char *nm[2] = { "old", "new" };
	for (int m = 0; m < 2; m++) {   /* a bijection of the 32 unit ids onto (kv, hh, c) */
		int seen[2][2][8]; memset(seen, 0, sizeof seen); int ok = 1;
		for (int b = 0; b < 32; b++) {
			if (missing && b == 31) continue;
			int kv, hh, c; dec[m](duplicate && b == 31 ? 30 : b, &kv, &hh, &c);
			if (kv < 0 || kv > 1 || hh < 0 || hh > 1 || c < 0 || c > 7 || seen[kv][hh][c]++) ok = 0;
		}
		for (int kv = 0; kv < 2; kv++) for (int hh = 0; hh < 2; hh++) for (int c = 0; c < 8; c++) if (seen[kv][hh][c] != 1) ok = 0;
		printf("%s decode: %s\n", nm[m], ok ? "bijection onto (kv, hh, c)" : "NOT a bijection");
		bad += !ok;
	}
	int ns[] = { 500, 1024, 2048, 2049, 2050, 2051, 4096, 8192 };
	printf("%6s | %-34s | %-34s\n", "n keys", "old: busy units / CTAs / deepest CTA", "new: busy units / CTAs / deepest CTA");
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof ns / sizeof *ns; i++) {
		int n = ns[i], CK = ((n + 8191) / 8192) * 1024; char col[2][64];
		for (int m = 0; m < 2; m++) {
			int depth[16] = { 0 }, busy = 0, ctas = 0, deep = 0;
			for (int b = 0; b < 32; b++) { int kv, hh, c; dec[m](b, &kv, &hh, &c); if (c * CK < n) { busy++; depth[b % 16]++; } }   /* the CTA runs units b and b + 16 one after the other */
			for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { if (depth[k]) ctas++; if (depth[k] > deep) deep = depth[k]; }
			snprintf(col[m], sizeof col[m], "%2d units / %2d CTAs / %d sequential", busy, ctas, deep);
		}
		printf("%6d | %-34s | %-34s\n", n, col[0], col[1]);
	}
	return bad ? 1 : 0;
}


File: kern/attnqk.sass
# Kernel: attnqk
#
# Attention q/k RMSNorm + RoPE + KV-cache append. Grid = 26 warps (one CTA of 32
# threads each): CTA h < 24 normalises query head h (Q + 512 h, the gate half is
# left where it is) with q_norm and writes QO + 256 h; CTA h >= 24 normalises key
# head h-24 (K + 256 (h-24)) with k_norm, writes it to the blocked K cache (below),
# and copies V + 256 (h-24) to VC + 2048 t + 256 (h-24).
# Lane l owns dims 8l..8l+7; RoPE pairs (p, p+32) for p < 32 live in lanes 0-3 and
# 4-7 and exchange through SHFL.BFLY xor 4. Bit-exact twin: qk_norm_rope_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 Q  1:0x148 K  2:0x150 V  3:0x158 QN  4:0x160 KN  5:0x168 CS  6:0x170 SN
#         7:0x178 QO  8:0x180 KC  9:0x188 VC  10:0x190 t (u32)  11:0x194 eps (f32)
# K cache layout is blocked (ref/attn.h attn_kidx): position t, kv head kh, dims 4c..4c+3
# live at KC + 65536 (t>>5) + 32768 kh + 512 c + 16 (t&31); lane l holds chunks 2l, 2l+1.

File: kern/attnqk_test.c
/* attnqk_test: q/k RMSNorm + RoPE + KV append against qk_norm_rope_gpu, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "attn.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 41;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(void) {
	const int T = 5;   /* positions exercised */
	float eps = 1e-6f;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "attnqk.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "attnqk"));
	float *q = malloc(12288 * 4), *k = malloc(512 * 4), *v = malloc(512 * 4), qn[256], kn[256], cs[32], sn[32];
	float *qo = malloc(6144 * 4), *qog = malloc(6144 * 4), *vc = malloc(T * 2048), *vcg = malloc(T * 2048), kt[256];
	size_t kcb = ATTN_KC_FLOATS(T) * 4;
	float *kc = malloc(kcb), *kcg = malloc(kcb);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < kcb / 4; i++) ((uint32_t *)kc)[i] = 0x7fc00000u;
	for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) { qn[i] = 1.f + 0.3f * frand(); kn[i] = 1.f + 0.3f * frand(); }
	CUdeviceptr dQ, dK, dV, dQN, dKN, dCS, dSN, dQO, dKC, dVC;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ, 12288 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dK, 512 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dV, 512 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQN, 1024)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dKN, 1024));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dCS, 128)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dSN, 128)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQO, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dKC, kcb)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dVC, T * 2048));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQN, qn, 1024)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKN, kn, 1024));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dKC, 0x7fc00000u, kcb / 4)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dVC, 0x7fc00000u, T * 512));
	int fails = 0;
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < (unsigned)T; t++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < 12288; i++) q[i] = 3.f * frand();
		for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) { k[i] = 3.f * frand(); v[i] = frand(); }
		rope_table_gpu(t * 977 + 3, 1e7f, cs, sn);
		for (int h = 0; h < 24; h++) qk_norm_rope_gpu(q + 512 * h, qn, eps, cs, sn, qo + 256 * h);
		for (int h = 0; h < 2; h++) { qk_norm_rope_gpu(k + 256 * h, kn, eps, cs, sn, kt); for (int d = 0; d < 256; d++) kc[attn_kidx(t, h, d)] = kt[d]; memcpy(vc + 512 * t + 256 * h, v + 256 * h, 1024); }
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQ, q, 12288 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dK, k, 2048)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dV, v, 2048));
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCS, cs, 128)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSN, sn, 128)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dQO, 0x7fc00000u, 6144));
		CUdeviceptr dCSb = dCS - 128u * t, dSNb = dSN - 128u * t;   /* the kernel indexes its tables by t */
		void *params[] = { &dQ, &dK, &dV, &dQN, &dKN, &dCSb, &dSNb, &dQO, &dKC, &dVC, &t, &eps };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 26, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(qog, dQO, 6144 * 4));
		int bq = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 6144; i++) if (memcmp(&qo[i], &qog[i], 4)) { if (bq < 3) printf("  qo[%d] (head %d dim %d): gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, i / 256, i % 256, qog[i], qo[i]); bq++; }
		printf("t=%u: q %s (%d of 6144 differ)\n", t, bq ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bq);
		if (bq && t == 0) { printf("  head 0 bad dims:"); for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) if (memcmp(&qo[i], &qog[i], 4)) printf(" %d", i); printf("\n  head 1 bad dims:"); for (int i = 256; i < 512; i++) if (memcmp(&qo[i], &qog[i], 4)) printf(" %d", i - 256); printf("\n"); }
		if (bq) fails++;
	}
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(kcg, dKC, kcb)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(vcg, dVC, T * 2048));
	int bk = 0, bv = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < kcb / 4; i++) if (memcmp(&kc[i], &kcg[i], 4)) bk++;
	for (int i = 0; i < T * 512; i++) if (memcmp(&vc[i], &vcg[i], 4)) bv++;
	printf("  V bad (pos 0):"); for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) if (memcmp(&vc[i], &vcg[i], 4)) printf(" %d", i); printf("\n");
	printf("KV cache: K %s (%d differ), V %s (%d differ)\n", bk ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bk, bv ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bv);
	return (fails || bk || bv) ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/attnqkq.sass
# Kernel: attnqkq
#
# attnqk with an int8 KV cache (ref/qsa.h): attention q/k RMSNorm + RoPE, and the key heads' K (after RoPE) and
# V (as projected) are quantised in blocks of 32 values (gmax = max(max|x|, 2^-100), inv = rcp(gmax) * 127,
# q = rint(x inv), fp16 scale = gmax / 127) and appended to the layer's cache at position t:
#   KQ / VQ: int8 [position][kv head][256], KS / VS: fp16 [position][kv head][8].
# Grid = 26 warps (one CTA of 32 threads each): CTA h < 24 normalises query head h (Q + 512 h, the gate half is
# left where it is) with q_norm and writes QO + 256 h; CTA h >= 24 normalises key head h-24 with k_norm.
# Lane l owns dims 8l..8l+7 (a 32-block is 4 lanes: xor 1, 2 butterflies); RoPE pairs (p, p+32), p < 32, live in
# lanes 0-3 and 4-7 and exchange through SHFL.BFLY xor 4. Bit-exact twins: qk_norm_rope_gpu, kv_quant32_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 Q  1:0x148 K  2:0x150 V  3:0x158 QN  4:0x160 KN  5:0x168 CS  6:0x170 SN

# QSA_KV_UNBOUNDED=1 removes clipping solely for same-source overhead comparison.

<CODE>
    my $o = '';
    my $trace = ($ENV{QSA_KV_TRACE} // '0') eq '1';
    my $unbounded = ($ENV{QSA_KV_UNBOUNDED} // '0') eq '1';
    # quantise the 8 values R[0..7] of this lane (a 32-block = 4 lanes) and store them: 8 bytes to [$dp], the
    # fp16 scale to [$spp] from the lanes with (lane & 3) == 0 (P3)
    my $q8 = sub {
        my ($R, $dp, $spp, $kind) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        if ($trace) {
            # Integer magnitude max preserves NaN/Inf instead of FMNMX masking it.
            # 0xffffffff is an impossible sign-cleared result: the host's unwritten sentinel.
            $x .= "08:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND raw_g, $R->[0], 0x7fffffff;\n";
            for my $e (1..7) {
                $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND raw_tmp, $R->[$e], 0x7fffffff;\n";
                $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 raw_g, raw_g, raw_tmp, !PT;\n";
            }
            for my $m (1, 2) {
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, raw_tmp, raw_g, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $m;
                $x .= "10:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 raw_g, raw_g, raw_tmp, !PT;\n";
            }
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV raw_tmp, param_RAW0;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.OR raw_tmp, raw_tmp, param_RAW1;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, raw_tmp, RZ, P3;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV raw_tmp, param_t;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL raw_p0, raw_tmp, 0x7;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL raw_tmp, kh, 0x5;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD raw_p0, raw_p0, raw_tmp;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND raw_tmp, lane, 0x1c;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD raw_p0, raw_p0, raw_tmp;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD raw_p0, raw_p0, 0x40;\n" if $kind;
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD raw_p0.CC, raw_p0, param_RAW0;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X raw_p1, RZ, param_RAW1;\n";
            $x .= "--:4:-:-:6  \@P4 STG.E [raw_p], raw_g;\n";
        }
        # Clip components, not only the stored scale. Keep the original input wait.
        if (!$unbounded) {
            $x .= "08:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t, 0x4afde040;\n";
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      FMNMX $_, $_, t, PT;\n" for @$R;
            $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      FMNMX $_, $_, -t, !PT;\n" for @$R;
        }
        $x .= ($unbounded ? '08' : '--') . ":-:-:-:6      FMNMX g, |$R->[0]|, |$R->[1]|, !PT;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX g, g, |$R->[$_]|, !PT;\n" for 2..7;
        for my $m (1, 2) {
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, g, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $m;
            $x .= "10:-:-:-:6      FMNMX g, g, t, !PT;\n";
        }
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX g, g, 7.8886090522101180541e-31, !PT;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RCP qi, g;\n";
        $x .= "04:-:-:-:6      FFMA t, g, qi, mneg1;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ t, -t, -RZ;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA qi, qi, t, qi;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL qi, qi, 127;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL g, g, c127;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:3:-:2      F2F.F16.F32 h16, g;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      FMUL $R->[$_], $R->[$_], qi;\n" for 0..6;
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL $R->[7], $R->[7], qi;\n";

        $x .= "--:-:3:-:2      F2I.S32.F32 $R->[7], $R->[7];\n";

        $x .= "04:-:-:-:1      PRMT ta0, $R->[0], 0x40, $R->[1];\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT ta1, $R->[2], 0x40, $R->[3];\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT pk0, $R->[4], 0x40, $R->[5];\n";

        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      PRMT ta1, pk0, 0x5410, pk1;\n";

        $x .= "--:4:-:-:6  \@P3 STG.E.U16 [$spp], h16;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R head, SR_CTAID.X;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, lane, 0x8, PT;\n";           # P1: lanes 0-7 take part in RoPE
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, lane, 0x4, PT;\n";           # P2: lanes 0-3 hold p, 4-7 hold p+32
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kh, head, -0x18;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x5;\n";                                 # 32 lane: byte offset of 8 dims
    # x: Q + 512 head + 32 lane  |  K + 256 kh + 32 lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P0 SHL xp0, head, 0xb;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 SHL xp0, kh, 0xa;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P0 IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_Q1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 IADD xp0.CC, xp0, param_K0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_K1;\n";
    # weights: QN / KN + 32 lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P0 IADD wp0.CC, t, param_QN0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P0 IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_QN1;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_KN1;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P0 IADD op0.CC, op0, param_QO0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P0 IADD.X op1, RZ, param_QO1;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 MOV ss, param_t;\n";

File: kern/bartest.sass
# Kernel: bartest
#
# How many outstanding LDG.128s does one write barrier track? Lane l issues BT_N
# loads of 16 B at src + 512 i + 16 l into registers pre-filled with 0xdeadbeef,
# waits on the barrier once (or BT_SPLIT: loads alternate barriers 1/2 and the wait
# covers both), then stores all registers to dst. src is slow (host-mapped) so an
# untracked load is still in flight when its register is stored.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 src  1:0x148:8 dst  2:0x150:4 n (unused)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_src0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_src1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_dst0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_dst1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $N = $ENV{BT_N} || 20;
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= sprintf "    0-%d : r<00-%02d>\n", 4*$N - 1, 4*$N - 1;
    my $b = 4*$N; $b += $b & 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : tid\n    %d : t\n    %d,%d : sp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : dp<0-1>\n", $b, $b+1, $b+2, $b+3, $b+4, $b+5;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>

<CODE>
    my $N = $ENV{BT_N} || 20;
    my $split = $ENV{BT_SPLIT} ? 1 : 0;
    my $ci = $ENV{BT_CI} ? ".CI" : "";
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I r%02d, 0xdeadbeef;\n", $_ for 0..4*$N-1;
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tid, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t, param_src0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_src1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dp0.CC, t, param_dst0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dp1, RZ, param_dst1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$N-1) {
        my $bar = $split ? 1 + ($i & 1) : 1;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:%d:-:%s      LDG.E.128 r%02d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $bar, $i == $N-1 ? '2' : '1', 4*$i, 512*$i;
    }
    my $wait = $split ? '03' : '01';
    for my $i (0..$N-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [dp+0x%x], r%02d;\n", $i == 0 ? $wait : '--', 512*$i, 4*$i;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/bartest_test.c
/* bartest_test: count stale registers after one barrier wait over N slow loads. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	const char *cubin = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "bartest.cubin";
	int N = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 20;
	int host = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 1;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "bartest"));
	size_t bytes = 512 * (size_t)N;
	unsigned *h;
	CUdeviceptr dsrc, ddst;
	if (host) {
		void *p;
		CK(cuMemHostAlloc(&p, bytes, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP));
		h = p;
		CK(cuMemHostGetDevicePointer(&dsrc, p, 0));
	} else {
		h = malloc(bytes);
		CK(cuMemAlloc(&dsrc, bytes));
	}
	for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes / 4; i++) h[i] = (unsigned)i;
	if (!host) CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dsrc, h, bytes));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&ddst, bytes));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(ddst, 0x11111111u, bytes / 4));
	unsigned un = (unsigned)N;
	void *params[] = { &dsrc, &ddst, &un };
	int stale_total = 0, runs = 20;
	int stale_per_load[64] = { 0 };
	for (int r = 0; r < runs; r++) {
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 1, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		unsigned *out = malloc(bytes);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out, ddst, bytes));
		for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
			int bad = 0;
			for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) if (out[128 * i + 4 * l + k] != (unsigned)(128 * i + 4 * l + k)) bad++;
			if (bad) { stale_per_load[i]++; stale_total++; }
		}
		free(out);
	}
	printf("N=%d %s: loads with stale data in %d of %d runs; per load:", N, host ? "host-mapped" : "device", stale_total ? 1 : 0, runs);
	for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) printf(" %d", stale_per_load[i]);
	printf("\n");
	return 0;
}


File: kern/conv1d.sass
# Kernel: conv1d
#
# Depthwise causal conv1d (kernel 4) + SiLU over n channels (n = CONV_N, default
# 10240), 4 channels per thread, 256 threads per CTA, grid = n / 1024.
# Ring state[4][n]: slot t mod 4 receives x(t); taps read slots t-3..t-1 and x.
#   y = w0 * x(t-3); y = fma(w1, x(t-2), y); y = fma(w2, x(t-1), y); y = fma(w3, x(t), y)
#   u = SiLU(y)
# Bit-exact twin: ref/deltanet.c conv1d_silu_gpu. Weights are [c][k], k contiguous.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 X  1:0x148:8 STATE  2:0x150:8 W  3:0x158:8 U  4:0x160:4 t  5:0x164:4 n

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0  : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1  : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_S0  : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_S1  : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_W0  : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_W1  : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_U0  : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_U1  : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_t   : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_n   : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-3   : x<0-3>
    4-7   : a<0-3>
    8-11  : b<0-3>
    12-15 : d<0-3>
    16-31 : w<00-15>
    32-35 : y<0-3>
    36-40 : ft<1-5>
    41    : log2e
    42    : ln2hi
    43    : ln2lo
    44    : c720
    45    : c120
    46    : c24
    47    : c6
    48    : c11
    49    : c9
    50    : c7
    51    : c5
    52    : c3
    53    : mneg1
    54    : chalf
    55    : cone
    56    : tid
    57    : bid
    58    : tg
    59    : t
    60    : t2
    61    : t3
    62,63 : xp<0-1>
    64,65 : wp<0-1>
    66,67 : up<0-1>
    68,69 : s0p<0-1>
    70,71 : s1p<0-1>
    72,73 : s2p<0-1>
    74,75 : swp<0-1>
    76    : n4
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 c11 c9 c7 c5 c3 mneg1 chalf cone);
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $rr, $cst) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $cst & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $first;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $x;
    };
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      ISCADD tg, bid, tid, 0x8;\n";                 # global thread = 256 bid + tid
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tg, 0x2;\n";                           # first channel of this thread
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, t, param_n, PT;\n";      # beyond n: nothing to do
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV n4, param_n;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL n4, n4, 0x2;\n";                            # bytes per ring slot
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, tg, 0x4;\n";                          # 16 tg: byte offset of 4 channels
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t2, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD up0.CC, t2, param_U0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X up1, RZ, param_U1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tg, 0x6;\n";                           # 64 tg: 16 weights
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, t, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # ring slots: (t+1)&3, (t+2)&3, (t+3)&3 read; t&3 written
    my @slots = (['s0p', 1], ['s1p', 2], ['s2p', 3], ['swp', 0]);
    for my $s (@slots) {
        my ($pr, $add) = @$s;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, RZ, param_t;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, t3, 0x%x;\n", $add if $add;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t3, t3, 0x3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t, t3, n4, RZ;\n";                       # slot offset (4 n < 2^16)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, t2;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, t, param_S0;\n", $pr;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, RZ, param_S1;\n", $pr;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 EXIT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 x0, [xp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 a0, [s0p];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 b0, [s1p];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 d0, [s2p];\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s      LDG.E.128 w%02d, [wp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 3 ? '2' : '1', 4*$_, 16*$_ for 0..3;
    # y_c for c = 0..3: taps w[4c+k]
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL y%d, w%02d, a%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, 4*$_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FFMA y%d, w%02d, b%d, y%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, 4*$_ + 1, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FFMA y%d, w%02d, d%d, y%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, 4*$_ + 2, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FFMA y%d, w%02d, x%d, y%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, 4*$_ + 3, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    # x(t) into its slot (its registers stay intact)
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [swp], x0;\n";
    for my $k (0..3) { $o .= fm_silu("a$k", "y$k", 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', 'ft5', \%C); }
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [up], a0;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/conv1d_test.c
/* conv1d_test: conv1d + SiLU state step against conv1d_silu_gpu, bit for bit, over 4 consecutive positions. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "deltanet.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 29;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(void) {
	const int n = 10240;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "conv1d.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "conv1d"));
	float *x = malloc(4 * n), *w = malloc(16 * n), *state = malloc(16 * n), *stateg = malloc(16 * n), *u = malloc(4 * n), *ug = malloc(4 * n);
	for (int i = 0; i < 4 * n; i++) { w[i] = frand(); state[i] = 3.f * frand(); }
	CUdeviceptr dX, dS, dW, dU;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, 16 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, 16 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dU, 4 * n));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, state, 16 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, w, 16 * n));
	int fails = 0;
	unsigned un = (unsigned)n;
	for (unsigned t = 5; t < 9; t++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = 4.f * frand();
		conv1d_silu_gpu(x, state, w, t, u, n);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dU, 0x7fc00000u, n));
		void *params[] = { &dX, &dS, &dW, &dU, &t, &un };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, n / 1024, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ug, dU, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(stateg, dS, 16 * n));
		int bu = 0, bs = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&u[i], &ug[i], 4)) { if (bu < 3) printf("  u[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, ug[i], u[i]); bu++; }
		for (int i = 0; i < 4 * n; i++) if (memcmp(&state[i], &stateg[i], 4)) bs++;
		printf("t=%u: %s (u %d of %d differ, state %d of %d differ)\n", t, (bu || bs) ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bu, n, bs, 4 * n);
		if (bu || bs) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/die.pl
#!/usr/bin/perl
# die.pl: assembles die.sass, the persistent per-die kernel, out of the standalone
# op generators (kern/*.sass). Run from kern/:   perl die.pl > die.sass
#
# The kernel runs a program of phases (128-byte descriptors in `prog`): for each
# phase every CTA copies the descriptor into shared memory, dispatches on its op,
# loops its unit over the op's virtual units and then passes a grid barrier.
# Framework registers R0-R15: tid lane warp cta vid vtid units pidx nph prog<0-1>
# ctl<0-1> op fw<0-1>. Every op keeps its own code; this script
#   - evaluates its <CODE> blocks the way MaxAs does, with the op's environment,
#   - moves its registers up by 16 and prefixes its register names and labels,
#   - turns its param_* constants into registers loaded (LDS) from the descriptor
#     in shared memory (DESC_OFF), gridDimX becoming the unit count,
#   - replaces S2R SR_TID.X / SR_CTAID.X with the virtual thread / unit ids,
#   - replaces EXIT with a branch to the op's unit-loop end.
# Descriptor words: [0] op, [1] units, [2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4] = the op's
# parameter words (its CONSTANT_MAPPING layout). Unit kinds: cta (256 threads,
# vid = cta, cta + 16, ...) and warp (32 threads, vid = 8 cta + warp, + 128, ...,
# vtid = lane). Ctl: u32 ctr @0, u32 gen @4 (grid barrier state).

use strict;
use warnings;

my $BASE = 16;             # first op register
my $NCTA = 16;             # CTAs per die (1 per SM)
my $DESC_OFF = 0xbf80;     # descriptor in shared memory (ops use smem from 0)
my $TOK_OFF = 0xbf70;      # the token counter (u32), kept per CTA in shared memory
my $XG_OFF = 0xbf74;       # the exchange count (u32), per CTA in shared memory (xsend bumps it)
my $GEN_OFF = 0xbf78;      # the grid barrier generation (u32), per CTA in shared memory
my $PAIR_DESC_OFF = 0xbe80; # second position's unchanged 128-byte descriptor
my $STEP_OFF = 0xbf50;     # physical descriptors consumed by this phase (1 or 2)
my $PAIR_MODE_OFF = 0xbf54; # word 30 bits 3/4: generic paired / fused paired body
my $FLAGS_OFF = 0xbf58;    # primary descriptor's exchange / barrier flags

# opcode = index. tag, file, unit kind, environment for the generator
my @OPS = (
    # tag           file                unit    env
    [ 'embrow',     'embrow.sass',      'cta',  {} ],
    [ 'plegate',    'plegate.sass',     'cta',  {} ],
    [ 'argmax',     'argmax.sass',      'cta',  {} ],
    [ 'actq2560',   'actq.sass',        'warp', { GEMV_K => 2560, ACTQ_U => 10 } ],
    [ 'ffnact',     'ffnact.sass',      'warp', { GEMV_K => 640 } ],
    [ 'actq6144',   'actq.sass',        'warp', { GEMV_K => 6144 } ],
    [ 'actq10240',  'actq.sass',        'warp', { GEMV_K => 10240 } ],
    [ 'actq256',    'actq.sass',        'warp', { GEMV_K => 256 } ],    # n/256 units in parallel instead of one warp
    [ 'rms2560',    'rmsnorm.sass',     'warp', { GEMV_K => 2560 } ],
    [ 'rms10240',   'rmsnorm.sass',     'warp', { GEMV_K => 10240 } ],
    # normq (RMSNorm + quantiser, 228 registers) does not fit beside the framework; nothing in the v1 block needs it
    [ 'hcsilu',     'hcops.sass',       'cta',  { HC_OP => 'silu' } ],
    [ 'hcmix',      'hcops.sass',       'cta',  { HC_OP => 'mix' } ],
    [ 'hcmixx',     'hcops.sass',       'cta',  { HC_OP => 'mix', HC_XOUT => 1 } ],
    [ 'hcwrite',    'hcops.sass',       'cta',  { HC_OP => 'write' } ],
