    [ 'idxsel',    'idxsel.sass',     'cta',  {} ],
    [ 'xcopy',     'xcopy.sass',      'cta',  {} ],
    # Paired BF16 opcodes are appended to retain the scalar descriptor ABI.
    [ 'bf16biasp',  'gemv_bf16_pair.sass', 'cta', { GEMV_K => 2560, GEMV_BIAS => 1 } ],
    [ 'bf16k2560p', 'gemv_bf16_pair.sass', 'cta', { GEMV_K => 2560 } ],
    [ 'bf16k320p',  'gemv_bf16_pair.sass', 'cta', { GEMV_K => 320 } ],
    [ 'bf16hcp',    'gemv_bf16_pair.sass', 'cta', { GEMV_K => 2560, GEMV_SLICES => 4 } ],
    [ 'bf16hcxp',   'gemv_bf16_pair.sass', 'cta', { GEMV_K => 2560, GEMV_SLICES => 4, GEMV_XOUT => 1 } ],
);

sub expand_names {                       # x<00-15> -> x00 .. x15
    my ($field) = @_;
    my @out;
    for my $tok (split /[\s,]+/, $field) {
        next unless length $tok;
        if ($tok =~ /^(\w+)<(\d+)-(\d+)>$/) {
            my ($n, $a, $b) = ($1, $2, $3);
            push @out, sprintf "%s%0*d", $n, length($a), $_ for $a .. $b;
        } else {
            push @out, $tok;
        }
    }
    return @out;
}

sub load_op {
    my ($tag, $file, $env) = @_;
    local %ENV = (%ENV, %$env);
    open my $fh, '<', $file or die "$file: $!";
    my $text = do { local $/; <$fh> };
    close $fh;
    $text =~ s/#.*$//mg;                                  # comments, as MaxAs strips them before CODE runs
    1 while $text =~ s|<CODE>(.*?)</CODE>| my $out = eval "package MaxAs::MaxAs::CODE; $1"; die "CODE in $file: $@" if $@; $out |se;
    # parameters
    my @params;
    my $has_grid = 0;
    if ($text =~ s|<CONSTANT_MAPPING>(.*?)</CONSTANT_MAPPING>||s) {
        for my $l (split /\n/, $1) {
            next unless $l =~ /^\s*(\w+)\s*:\s*c\[0x([02])\]\[0x([0-9a-f]+)\]/;
            my ($name, $bank, $addr) = ($1, $2, hex $3);
            if ($addr == 0x14) { $has_grid = 1; next; }
            die "$file: parameter $name at 0x$3 outside the descriptor" if $addr < 0x140 || $addr >= 0x140 + 4 * 30;
            push @params, [ $name, 2 + ($addr - 0x140) / 4, $bank eq '2' ? $PAIR_DESC_OFF : $DESC_OFF ];
        }
    }
    # registers: keep each mapping line (templates included, so MaxAs still knows the
    # 64-bit pair base names), offset by BASE and prefixed
    my (@maplines, @names, $max);
    $max = -1;
    while ($text =~ s|<REGISTER_MAPPING>(.*?)</REGISTER_MAPPING>||s) {
        for my $l (split /\n/, $1) {
            next unless $l =~ /^\s*([\d,\-]+)\s*:\s*(.+?)\s*$/;
            my ($nums, $field) = ($1, $2);
            my @n = $nums =~ /^(\d+)-(\d+)$/ ? ($1 .. $2) : split /,/, $nums;
            my @nm = expand_names($field);
            die "$file: '$l' lists ", scalar(@n), " registers for ", scalar(@nm), " names" unless @n == @nm;
            $max = $_ > $max ? $_ : $max for @n;
            push @names, @nm;
            my @toks = grep { length } split /[\s,]+/, $field;
            for my $t (@toks) { push @names, $1 if $t =~ /^(\w+)</; }          # pair/vector base names ([xp])
            my $shifted = $nums =~ /^(\d+)-(\d+)$/ ? sprintf("%d-%d", $1 + $BASE, $2 + $BASE) : join(",", map { $_ + $BASE } split /,/, $nums);
            push @maplines, sprintf "    %s : %s\n", $shifted, join(" ", map { "${tag}_$_" } @toks);
        }
    }
    push @params, [ 'gridDimX', 1 ] if $has_grid;
    my $r = $max + 1;
    my @pregs = map { [ $r++, $_->[0] ] } @params;
    warn sprintf("%-10s %3d op registers + %2d params -> last register %d\n", $tag, $max + 1, scalar(@params), $BASE + $r - 1) if $ENV{DIE_VERBOSE};
    die "$tag: registers reach ", $BASE + $r - 1, " (> 255)" if $BASE + $r - 1 > 255;
    # labels and names to prefix
    my @labels = $text =~ /^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*):\s*$/mg;
    my %seen;
    @names = grep { !$seen{$_}++ } (@names, map($_->[1], @pregs), @labels);
    my $alt = join '|', map { quotemeta } sort { length $b <=> length $a } @names;
    my $code = $text;
    $code =~ s/\b($alt)\b/${tag}_$1/g;
    # virtual ids, exits
    $code =~ s/^.*?S2R\s+(\w+),\s*SR_TID\.X;.*$/--:-:-:-:6      MOV $1, vtid;/mg;
    $code =~ s/^.*?S2R\s+(\w+),\s*SR_CTAID\.X;.*$/--:-:-:-:6      MOV $1, vid;/mg;
    $code =~ s/\bEXIT;/BRA ${tag}_END;/g;
    $code =~ s/^\s*\n//mg;
    # parameter prologue
    my $pro = '';
    for my $i (0 .. $#params) {
        my ($name, $word, $desc) = @{$params[$i]};
        $desc = $DESC_OFF unless defined $desc;
        $pro .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%d      LDS %s_%s, [RZ+0x%x];\n", $i == $#params ? 2 : 1, $tag, $name, $desc + 4 * $word;
    }
    $pro .= "01:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" if @params;
    my $map = join('', @maplines) . join('', map { sprintf "    %d : %s_%s\n", $BASE + $_->[0], $tag, $_->[1] } @pregs);
    return { map => $map, code => $pro . $code };
}

# "perl die.pl header" prints the opcode header for the host
if (@ARGV && $ARGV[0] eq 'header') {
    print "/* generated by die.pl: opcodes of the persistent kernel */\n#ifndef DIEOPS_H\n#define DIEOPS_H\n";
    printf "#define OP_%s %d\n", uc($OPS[$_][0]), $_ for 0 .. $#OPS;
    printf "#define OP_COUNT %d\n#define DIE_NOPS OP_COUNT\n", scalar @OPS;
    print "static const char *const die_opname[] __attribute__((unused)) = { ", join(', ', map { "\"$_->[0]\"" } @OPS), " };\n#endif\n";
    exit 0;
}
my $maps = '';
my $body = '';
my $dispatch = '';
for my $k (0 .. $#OPS) {
    my ($tag, $file, $kind, $env) = @{$OPS[$k]};
    my $op = load_op($tag, $file, $env);
    $maps .= $op->{map};
    $dispatch .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, op, 0x%x, PT;\n", $k;
    $dispatch .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $dispatch .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA ${tag}_SETUP;\n";
    my $step = $kind eq 'cta' ? $NCTA : 8 * $NCTA;
    $body .= "\n${tag}_SETUP:\n";
    if ($kind eq 'cta') {
        $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV vid, cta;\n";
        $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV vtid, tid;\n";
    } else {
        $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL vid, cta, 0x3;\n";
        $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vid, vid, warp;\n";
        $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV vtid, lane;\n";
    }
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P6, PT, vid, units, PT;\n";
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA POSITION_END;\n";
    $body .= "${tag}_BEGIN:\n";
    $body .= $op->{code};
    $body .= "${tag}_END:\n";
    # a CTA unit owns the shared memory: no warp may start the next unit (and
    # store into smem) while a lagging warp still reads the previous unit's data,
    # so the whole CTA syncs here, after every outstanding load has landed.
    $body .= "3f:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n" if $kind eq 'cta';
    $body .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vid, vid, 0x%x;\n", $step;
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P6, PT, vid, units, PT;\n";
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA ${tag}_BEGIN;\n";
    $body .= "--:-:-:-:6      BRA POSITION_END;\n";
}

--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P6, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;

# (the prefetch reads its address registers late: read barrier 3 guards fw/dsp, which
# the barrier code below reuses as xa/xb)
# flag-array barrier: thread 0 of every CTA writes the generation it arrives at
# (GEN in shared memory + 1) to ctl[32 + cta]; lanes 0..15 of warp 0 poll the 16
# words until all read >= it (VOTE.ALL keeps the warp together); no atomics, no
# last-arriver release. CTA 0 thread 0 mirrors the generation to ctl[1].
--:-:1:-:1      LDS bar_g, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $GEN_OFF]}];

--:-:-:-:6      SHL bar_g2, cta, 0x2;

# descriptor word 30 bit 2: the next phase does not depend on this one (and writes
# nothing this one reads), so no grid barrier: the CTA syncs and moves on
--:-:2:-:2      LDS bar_old, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $FLAGS_OFF]}];
02:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND bar_old, bar_old, 0x4;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, bar_old, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA BDONE;
--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA BDONE;
04:-:-:-:6      IADD xa0.CC, bar_cp0, bar_t;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xa1, bar_cp1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xb0.CC, bar_cp0, bar_g2;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xb1, bar_cp1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD;
01:-:-:-:6      IADD bar_g, bar_g, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I bar_g2, 0xffffffff;
--:2:-:-:6 \@!P5 STG.E.WT [xb+0x80], bar_g;
# a send phase (descriptor word 30 bit 0): thread 0 of every CTA fences (its CTA's
# stores to the peers' inboxes are ordered before it by the BAR.SYNC above), bumps the
# CTA's exchange count XG and stores it to flags_e[me][cta] of every die e
# (ctl[16 + 2e] = &flags_e[me][0]; the host points absent dies at a scratch word, so
# all six stores are unconditional); CTA 0 mirrors the count to ctl[8]. This runs
# while the other CTAs' arrivals propagate, ahead of the poll below.
--:-:1:-:2      LDS bar_old, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $FLAGS_OFF]}];
01:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND bar_old, bar_old, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, bar_old, RZ, !P5;
--:-:-:-:6      SHL units, cta, 0x2;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.64 xc0, [bar_cp+0x40];
--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.64 xd0, [bar_cp+0x48];
--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.64 xf0, [bar_cp+0x50];
--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.64 xg0, [bar_cp+0x58];
--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.64 xh0, [bar_cp+0x60];
--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.64 xi0, [bar_cp+0x68];
--:-:1:-:2  \@P4 LDS op, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $XG_OFF]}];
--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 MEMBAR.SYS;
01:-:-:-:6      IADD op, op, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xc0.CC, xc0, units;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xc1, xc1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xd0.CC, xd0, units;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xd1, xd1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xf0.CC, xf0, units;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xf1, xf1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xg0.CC, xg0, units;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xg1, xg1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xh0.CC, xh0, units;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xh1, xh1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD xi0.CC, xi0, units;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xi1, xi1, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P2, PT, cta, RZ, P4;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E.WT [xc], op;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E.WT [xd], op;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E.WT [xf], op;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E.WT [xg], op;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E.WT [xh], op;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E.WT [xi], op;
--:2:-:-:1  \@P4 STS [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $XG_OFF]}], op;
--:2:-:-:6  \@P2 STG.E [bar_cp+0x20], op;
BSPIN:
--:-:1:-:2  \@P3 LDG.E.CV bar_g2, [xa+0x80];
01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P4, PT, bar_g2, bar_g, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      VOTE.ALL P4, P4;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6 \@!P4 BRA BSPIN;
--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD;
02:-:-:-:6      IADD bar_t, cta, tid;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P4, PT, bar_t, RZ, PT;
--:2:-:-:6      STS [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $GEN_OFF]}], bar_g;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:2:-:-:6  \@P4 STG.E [bar_cp+0x4], bar_g;
BDONE:
02:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x1;
# ---- phase timestamp: CTA 0 thread 0 writes %globaltimer.lo to ctl[16 + pidx] ----
--:-:-:-:6      IADD bar_t, cta, tid;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P4, PT, bar_t, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      SHL bar_g, pidx, 0x2;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD bar_cp0.CC, bar_cp0, bar_g;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bar_cp1, bar_cp1, RZ;
--:-:6:-:2  \@P4 S2R bar_g2, SR_GLOBALTIMERLO;
20:-:-:-:6  \@P4 STG.E [bar_cp+0x100], bar_g2;
# ---- next phase ----
--:-:1:-:2      LDS bar_t, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $STEP_OFF]}];
01:-:-:-:6      IADD pidx, pidx, bar_t;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P6, PT, pidx, nph, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA PHASE;
# ---- token done: thread 0 bumps TOK (and CTA 0 mirrors it to ctl[2]); everyone
# re-reads it behind a barrier and runs the program again while tok < ntok ----
# End of turn: amax sets ctl[5] = 0x80000000 when it picks a stop token after the
# prompt (every die picks the same token, so every die stops after the same one).
# Thread 0 ors it into TOK: the unsigned tok < ntok test fails on every CTA, and
# ctl[2] tells the host both the count (low 31 bits) and that the turn ended.
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P5, PT, tid, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV bar_cp0, ctl0;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV bar_cp1, ctl1;
--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x1;
--:-:1:-:1 \@!P5 LDS bar_t, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $TOK_OFF]}];
--:-:3:-:1 \@!P5 LDG.E.CV bar_old, [bar_cp+0x14];
--:-:3:-:1 \@!P5 LDG.E.CV bar_g2, [bar_cp+0x18];
--:-:3:-:2 \@!P5 LDG.E.CV bar_one, [bar_cp+0x24];
# ctl[9] is the number of known positions in a pass. Zero retains the B=1 ABI.
05:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, bar_one, RZ, !P5;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 MOV bar_one, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6 \@!P5 IADD bar_t, bar_t, bar_one;
04:-:-:-:6 \@!P5 LOP.OR bar_t, bar_t, bar_old;
# Abort: the host writes ctl[6] = a token count a few tokens ahead of every die (0: none); the
# die whose count reaches it ends the turn exactly like a stop token, so all dies stop together.
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P3, PT, bar_g2, RZ, !P5;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P3, PT, bar_t, bar_g2, P3;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 LOP32I.OR bar_t, bar_t, 0x80000000;
--:2:-:-:6 \@!P5 STS [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $TOK_OFF]}], bar_t;
--:2:-:-:6  \@P4 STG.E [bar_cp+0x8], bar_t;
02:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x1;
--:-:1:-:2      LDS bar_t, [RZ+0x@{[sprintf '%x', $TOK_OFF]}];
--:-:-:-:6      MOV pidx, RZ;
01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P6, PT, bar_t, param_ntok, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA PHASE;
--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;
EOF


File: kern/die_test.c
/* die_test: the persistent kernel framework on a 5-phase program (embrow, plegate,
 * actq, ffnact, argmax), each phase checked against its C twin; the program is run
 * twice so the barrier state is exercised across launches. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "quant.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include "ple.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 101;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static uint32_t urand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return rs >> 8; }

#include "dieops.h"
static void desc_init(uint32_t *d, int op, unsigned units) { memset(d, 0, 128); d[0] = op; d[1] = units; }
static void desc_ptr(uint32_t *d, int addr, CUdeviceptr p) { int w = 2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4; d[w] = (uint32_t)p; d[w + 1] = (uint32_t)(p >> 32); }
static void desc_u32(uint32_t *d, int addr, uint32_t v) { d[2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4] = v; }

static int cmpf(const char *what, const float *ref, const float *got, size_t n) {
	int bad = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&ref[i], &got[i], 4)) { if (bad < 3) printf("  %s[%zu]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", what, i, got[i], ref[i]); bad++; }
	printf("  %-8s %s (%d of %zu differ)\n", what, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, n);
	return bad;
}

int main(void) {
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "die.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "die"));
	int nregs, maxb;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fn, 256, 0));
	printf("die: %d registers, %d CTAs/SM\n", nregs, maxb);
	if (maxb < 1) { printf("kernel cannot be resident\n"); return 2; }

	/* ---- phase 0: embrow ---- */
	const int R = 64; unsigned id = 17;
	uint8_t *tab = malloc((size_t)R * 1100);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)R * 1100; i++) tab[i] = (uint8_t)urand();
	for (int r = 0; r < R; r++) for (int b = 0; b < 10; b++) { uint16_t h = (uint16_t)(0x2c00 + (urand() % 0x1000)); memcpy(tab + (size_t)r * 1100 + 110 * b + 108, &h, 2); }
	float *emb_ref = malloc(4 * 2560), *emb_got = malloc(4 * 10240);
	dequant(GG_Q3_K, tab + (size_t)id * 1100, emb_ref, 2560);
	CUdeviceptr dE, dS; CK(cuMemAlloc(&dE, (size_t)R * 1100)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, 4 * 10240));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dE, tab, (size_t)R * 1100));
	/* ---- phase 1: plegate ---- */
	float *kn = malloc(4 * 10240), *qn = malloc(4 * 10240), *v = malloc(4 * 2560), *g_ref = malloc(4 * 10240), *g_got = malloc(4 * 10240), gates_ref[4], gates_got[4];
	for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) { kn[i] = frand(); qn[i] = frand(); }
	for (int i = 0; i < 2560; i++) v[i] = 3.f * frand();
	ple_gate_gpu(kn, qn, v, g_ref, gates_ref);
	CUdeviceptr dKN, dQN, dV, dG, dGT;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dKN, 4 * 10240)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQN, 4 * 10240)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dV, 4 * 2560)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dG, 4 * 10240)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dGT, 16));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKN, kn, 4 * 10240)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQN, qn, 4 * 10240)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dV, v, 4 * 2560));
	/* ---- phase 2: actq (2560) ---- */
	const int n1 = 2560;
	float *x1 = malloc(4 * n1), *as1 = malloc(4 * n1 / 32), *as1g = malloc(4 * n1 / 32);
	int16_t *q1 = malloc(2 * n1), *q1g = malloc(2 * n1);
	int32_t *s32_1 = malloc(4 * n1 / 32), *s16_1 = malloc(4 * n1 / 16), *s32_1g = malloc(4 * n1 / 32), *s16_1g = malloc(4 * n1 / 16);
	for (int i = 0; i < n1; i++) x1[i] = 5.f * frand();
	quant_act_gpu32(x1, n1, q1, s32_1, s16_1, as1);
	CUdeviceptr dX1, dQ1, dS32_1, dS16_1, dAS1;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX1, 4 * n1)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ1, 2 * n1)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS32_1, 4 * n1 / 32)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS16_1, 4 * n1 / 16)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dAS1, 4 * n1 / 32));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX1, x1, 4 * n1));
	/* ---- phase 3: ffnact (11 x 640) ---- */
	const int n2 = 640, E = 11; size_t N2 = (size_t)n2 * E;
	float *gg = malloc(4 * N2), *uu = malloc(4 * N2), *xx = malloc(4 * N2), *as2 = malloc(4 * N2 / 32), *as2g = malloc(4 * N2 / 32);
	int16_t *q2 = malloc(2 * N2), *q2g = malloc(2 * N2);
	int32_t *s32_2 = malloc(4 * N2 / 32), *s16_2 = malloc(4 * N2 / 16), *s32_2g = malloc(4 * N2 / 32), *s16_2g = malloc(4 * N2 / 16);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < N2; i++) { gg[i] = 4.f * frand(); uu[i] = 2.f * frand(); xx[i] = silu_gpu(gg[i]) * uu[i]; }
	for (int e = 0; e < E; e++) quant_act_gpu32(xx + (size_t)e * n2, n2, q2 + (size_t)e * n2, s32_2 + (size_t)e * n2 / 32, s16_2 + (size_t)e * n2 / 16, as2 + (size_t)e * n2 / 32);
	CUdeviceptr dGG, dUU, dQ2, dS32_2, dS16_2, dAS2;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dGG, 4 * N2)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dUU, 4 * N2)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ2, 2 * N2)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS32_2, 4 * N2 / 32)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS16_2, 4 * N2 / 16)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dAS2, 4 * N2 / 32));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dGG, gg, 4 * N2)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dUU, uu, 4 * N2));
	/* ---- phase 4: argmax ---- */
	const unsigned NL = 248320; float *lg = malloc(4 * NL);
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < NL; i++) lg[i] = 10.f * frand();
	unsigned where = urand() % NL; lg[where] = 20.f; lg[(where + 5) % NL] = 20.f;
	unsigned am_ref = 0; for (unsigned i = 1; i < NL; i++) if (lg[i] > lg[am_ref]) am_ref = i;
	CUdeviceptr dL, dOUT, dPART, dCNT;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dL, 4 * NL)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dOUT, 8)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPART, 8 * 16)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dCNT, 4));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dL, lg, 4 * NL)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dCNT, 0, 1));

	/* ---- the program ---- */
	uint32_t prog[5][32];
	CUdeviceptr dIDS; CK(cuMemAlloc(&dIDS, 16)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIDS, &id, 4));   /* embrow: the row is IDS[pos] */
	desc_init(prog[0], OP_EMBROW, 10); desc_ptr(prog[0], 0x140, dE); desc_ptr(prog[0], 0x148, dS); desc_u32(prog[0], 0x150, 0); desc_ptr(prog[0], 0x158, dIDS);
	desc_init(prog[1], OP_PLEGATE, 4); desc_ptr(prog[1], 0x140, dKN); desc_ptr(prog[1], 0x148, dQN); desc_ptr(prog[1], 0x150, dV); desc_ptr(prog[1], 0x158, dG); desc_ptr(prog[1], 0x160, dGT);
	desc_init(prog[2], OP_ACTQ2560, 1); desc_ptr(prog[2], 0x140, dX1); desc_ptr(prog[2], 0x148, dQ1); desc_ptr(prog[2], 0x150, dS32_1); desc_ptr(prog[2], 0x158, dS16_1); desc_ptr(prog[2], 0x160, dAS1); desc_u32(prog[2], 0x168, n1);
	desc_init(prog[3], OP_FFNACT, E); desc_ptr(prog[3], 0x140, dGG); desc_ptr(prog[3], 0x148, dUU); desc_ptr(prog[3], 0x150, dQ2); desc_ptr(prog[3], 0x158, dS32_2); desc_ptr(prog[3], 0x160, dS16_2); desc_ptr(prog[3], 0x168, dAS2); desc_u32(prog[3], 0x170, n2);
	desc_init(prog[4], OP_ARGMAX, 16); desc_ptr(prog[4], 0x140, dL); desc_ptr(prog[4], 0x148, dOUT); desc_ptr(prog[4], 0x150, dPART); desc_ptr(prog[4], 0x158, dCNT); desc_u32(prog[4], 0x160, NL); desc_u32(prog[4], 0x164, 16);
	if (getenv("DIE_OP0")) prog[0][0] = (uint32_t)atoi(getenv("DIE_OP0"));
	if (getenv("DIE_UNITS0")) prog[0][1] = (uint32_t)atoi(getenv("DIE_UNITS0"));
	if (getenv("DIE_ONLY_ACTQ")) memcpy(prog[0], prog[2], 128);
	CUdeviceptr dPROG, dCTL;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPROG, sizeof prog)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dCTL, 8192)); CK(cuMemsetD8(dCTL, 0, 8192));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPROG, prog, sizeof prog)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dCTL, 0, 32));
	unsigned nph = getenv("DIE_NPH") ? (unsigned)atoi(getenv("DIE_NPH")) : getenv("DIE_ONLY_ACTQ") ? 1 : 5;
	{ float mx = 0; int am = -1; for (int i = 1216; i < 1248; i++) if (fabsf(x1[i]) > mx) { mx = fabsf(x1[i]); am = i; }
	  printf("group 38: max |x| %.9g at %d (lane %d of chunk 9, 8-lane half %s)\n", mx, am, (am - 1152) / 4, ((am - 1152) / 4) & 4 ? "20-23" : "16-19");
	  float m4[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }; for (int i = 1216; i < 1248; i++) { int q = ((i - 1152) / 4 - 16) / 2; if (fabsf(x1[i]) > m4[q]) m4[q] = fabsf(x1[i]); }
	  printf("  lane-pair maxima: %.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g\n", m4[0], m4[1], m4[2], m4[3]); }
	unsigned ntok = 1; void *params[] = { &dPROG, &nph, &dCTL, &ntok };
	int fails = 0;
	for (int run = 0; run < 2; run++) {
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dS, 0x7fc00000u, 10240)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dG, 0x7fc00000u, 10240)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dGT, 0x7fc00000u, 4));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dQ1, 0x7fff7fffu, n1 / 2)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dAS1, 0x7fc00000u, n1 / 32));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dQ2, 0x7fff7fffu, N2 / 2)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dAS2, 0x7fc00000u, N2 / 32));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dOUT, 0xffffffffu, 2));
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 16, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		printf("run %d:\n", run);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(emb_got, dS, 4 * 10240));
		for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) { char nm[16]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "emb.l%d", l); fails += cmpf(nm, emb_ref, emb_got + 2560 * l, 2560); }
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(g_got, dG, 4 * 10240)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(gates_got, dGT, 16));
		fails += cmpf("gates", gates_ref, gates_got, 4); fails += cmpf("G", g_ref, g_got, 10240);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(q1g, dQ1, 2 * n1)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s32_1g, dS32_1, 4 * n1 / 32)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s16_1g, dS16_1, 4 * n1 / 16)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(as1g, dAS1, 4 * n1 / 32));
		int bq = 0, b32 = 0, b16 = 0, bs = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n1; i++) if (q1[i] != q1g[i]) { if (bq < 2) printf("  actq q[%d]: gpu %d ref %d\n", i, q1g[i], q1[i]); bq++; }
		for (int i = 0; i < n1 / 32; i++) { if (s32_1[i] != s32_1g[i]) b32++; if (memcmp(&as1[i], &as1g[i], 4)) { if (bs < 2) printf("  actq as[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, as1g[i], as1[i]); bs++; } }
		for (int i = 0; i < n1 / 16; i++) if (s16_1[i] != s16_1g[i]) b16++;
		int b = bq || b32 || b16 || bs;
		printf("  actq     %s (q %d, s32 %d, s16 %d, as %d differ)\n", b ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bq, b32, b16, bs); fails += b;
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(q2g, dQ2, 2 * N2)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s32_2g, dS32_2, 4 * N2 / 32)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s16_2g, dS16_2, 4 * N2 / 16)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(as2g, dAS2, 4 * N2 / 32));
		b = memcmp(q2, q2g, 2 * N2) || memcmp(s32_2, s32_2g, 4 * N2 / 32) || memcmp(s16_2, s16_2g, 4 * N2 / 16) || memcmp(as2, as2g, 4 * N2 / 32);
		printf("  ffnact   %s\n", b ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT"); fails += b;
		unsigned out[2]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out, dOUT, 8));
		printf("  argmax   gpu %u ref %u -> %s\n", out[0], am_ref, out[0] == am_ref ? "OK" : "MISMATCH"); fails += out[0] != am_ref;
		unsigned ctl[2]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ctl, dCTL, 8));
		printf("  barrier  ctr %u gen %u\n", ctl[0], ctl[1]);
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}

/* dies_test: one Gated DeltaNet block split over n dies (expert split + row split),
 * each die running its own persistent-kernel program with the exchange ops, against
 * the C block twin, bit for bit, over T tokens with the states carried.
 *
 *   dies_test <fullcache> <blk> <T> <manifest0> [manifest1 ...]
 *
 * fullcache: a holder's tile cache of the whole block (hold ... cache=DIR without
 * split), read by the twin; manifest_i: the running holder of die i's slice
 * (hold ... split=i/n). n = number of manifests (1..6). Env: DIES_NPH caps the
 * program (a prefix on every die), DIES_PROF prints die 0's per-phase times. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "block.h"
#include "attn.h"
#include "ple.h"
#include "hold.h"
#include "prog.h"
#include "split.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)
static uint32_t rs = 909;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }
/* IEEE half -> float (exact) */
static float h2f(uint16_t h) {
	uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000) << 16, e = (h >> 10) & 0x1f, m = h & 0x3ff, u;
	if (e == 0) { if (!m) u = s; else { int sh = 0; while (!(m & 0x400)) { m <<= 1; sh++; } m &= 0x3ff; u = s | ((uint32_t)(113 - sh) << 23) | (m << 13); } }
	else if (e == 31) u = s | 0x7f800000u | (m << 13);
	else u = s | ((e + 112) << 23) | (m << 13);
	float f; memcpy(&f, &u, 4); return f;
}

#define MAXD 6
static int nd, blk;
static const char *fullcache;
static CUcontext ctx[MAXD];
static hold_arena ar[MAXD];
static char tname[128];
static const char *tn(const char *suffix) { snprintf(tname, sizeof tname, "blk.%d.%s", blk, suffix); return tname; }
static void *hostimg_raw(const char *name) {
	char fn[512]; snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/%s", fullcache, name);
	FILE *f = fopen(fn, "rb"); if (!f) { perror(fn); exit(1); }
	fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long n = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
	void *p = malloc((size_t)n);
	if (fread(p, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) { fprintf(stderr, "short read %s\n", fn); exit(1); }
	fclose(f);
	return p;
}
static void *hostimg(const char *suffix) { return hostimg_raw(tn(suffix)); }
static CUdeviceptr dptr_raw(int d, const char *name) { CUdeviceptr p = hold_ptr(&ar[d], name); if (!p) { fprintf(stderr, "die %d: no %s\n", d, name); exit(1); } return p; }
static CUdeviceptr dptr(int d, const char *suffix) { return dptr_raw(d, tn(suffix)); }
static uint32_t ttype(int d, const char *suffix) { const hold_tensor *t = hold_find(&ar[d], tn(suffix)); if (!t) { fprintf(stderr, "no %s\n", tname); exit(1); } return t->type; }
static CUdeviceptr dalloc(size_t bytes) { CUdeviceptr p; CK(cuMemAlloc(&p, bytes)); CK(cuMemsetD8(p, 0, bytes)); return p; }

static int cmpbuf(const char *what, const void *ref, CUdeviceptr dev, size_t bytes, int elemsz) {
	void *got = malloc(bytes);
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(got, dev, bytes));
	size_t n = bytes / elemsz; int bad = 0; size_t first = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp((const char *)ref + i * elemsz, (const char *)got + i * elemsz, elemsz)) { if (!bad) first = i; bad++; }
	if (bad) {
		printf("  %-10s MISMATCH %d of %zu (first at %zu", what, bad, n, first);
		if (elemsz == 4) printf(": gpu %.9g ref %.9g", ((float *)got)[first], ((const float *)ref)[first]);
		printf(")\n");
	if (bad && getenv("DIES_HIST")) { int per = atoi(getenv("DIES_HIST")); printf("   per-%d:", per); for (size_t c = 0; c < (n + per - 1) / per; c++) { int k = 0; for (size_t i = c * per; i < n && i < (c + 1) * per; i++) if (memcmp((const char *)ref + i * elemsz, (const char *)got + i * elemsz, elemsz)) k++; if (k) printf(" %zu:%d", c, k); } printf("\n"); }
	} else printf("  %-10s exact (%zu)\n", what, n);
	free(got);
	return bad;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 5) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: dies_test <fullcache> <blk|head|embed> <T> <manifest0> [manifest1 ...]\n"); return 2; }

	blk = mode ? 0 : atoi(whatarg);
	if (nd > MAXD) { fprintf(stderr, "at most %d dies\n", MAXD); return 2; }
	int is_attn = mode == 0 && BLK_IS_ATTN(blk), has_ple = mode == 0 && blk == 1;

		hw.attn_gate = hostimg("attn_gate.weight"); hw.attn_gate_type = ttype(0, "attn_gate.weight");
		hw.ssm_out = hostimg("ssm_out.weight"); hw.ssm_out_type = ttype(0, "ssm_out.weight");

		if (!is_attn) {

			w->attn_output = dptr(d, "attn_output.weight"); w->attn_output_type = hw.attn_output_type;

		b->ly = dalloc(4u * (unsigned)s->yn); b->r = dalloc(4 * 513); b->idx = dalloc(64); b->w = dalloc(64); b->s = dalloc(16);

	}
	printf("%d die(s):", nd);
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) printf(" [%d: gpu %d dj %d+%d cb %d+%d h %d+%d k %d..%d y %d+%d e %d+%d%s]", d, dev_of[d], sp[d].dj0, sp[d].djn, sp[d].cb0, sp[d].cbn, sp[d].h0, sp[d].hn, sp[d].klo, sp[d].khi, sp[d].y0, sp[d].yn, sp[d].e0, sp[d].en, sp[d].shexp ? " shexp" : "");
	printf("\n");
	int fails = 0;
	for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
		double t0 = now();
		if (getenv("DIES_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "[token %d] twin...\n", t);

		if (mode == 1) {   /* a fresh random stream per token */
			for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) hb->S[i] = 0.5f * frand();
			for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(db[d].S, hb->S, 4 * 10240)); }

			else if (mode == 2) embed_gpu(&hw, hb, id);

				if (is_attn) attn_block_gpu(&hw, hb, (unsigned)t, eps, nd, blk, stage); else deltanet_block_gpu(&hw, hb, (unsigned)t, eps, nd, blk, stage);

		}

		if (getenv("DIES_TRACE")) fprintf(stderr, "[token %d] done\n", t);

		printf("token %d: %u phases; twin %.2f s, dies %.3f ms\n", t, nph[0], t1 - t0, (t3 - t2) * 1e3);
		int bad = 0;
		if ((t3 - t2) > 1.5e-3 && getenv("DIES_STALL")) {   /* which die stalled where: the two longest phases per die */
			for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {

				free(ts);
			}
		}
		if (notwin) { for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) prog_free(&P[d]); continue; }
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
			char what[32];
			printf(" die %d\n", d);

			}

				}
				bad += cmpbuf("oq", hb->oq, db[d].oq, 2 * 6144, 2);
				bad += cmpbuf("ly", hb->y + s->y0, db[d].ly, 4u * (unsigned)s->yn, 4);
			} else {   /* attention-side locals (not overwritten by the FFN half) */
				unsigned nk = (unsigned)s->nk, hn = (unsigned)s->hn;
				float kq[128 * 16], kk[128 * 16], ku[128 * 16];   /* the die's key heads (klo + j) % 16, in its local order */
				for (unsigned j = 0; j < nk; j++) { int kh = (s->klo + (int)j) % 16; memcpy(kq + 128 * j, hb->qkv + 128 * kh, 512); memcpy(kk + 128 * j, hb->qkv + 2048 + 128 * kh, 512); memcpy(ku + 128 * j, hb->u + 128 * kh, 512); }

				bad += cmpbuf("lqkv.v", hb->qkv + 4096 + 128 * s->h0, db[d].lqkv + 4 * 256 * nk, 4 * 128 * hn, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("lgate", hb->gate + 128 * s->h0, db[d].lgate, 4 * 128 * hn, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("la", hb->a + s->h0, db[d].la, 4 * hn, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("lb", hb->a + 48 + s->h0, db[d].la + 4 * hn, 4 * hn, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("lu.q", ku, db[d].lu, 4 * 128 * nk, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("lu.v", hb->u + 4096 + 128 * s->h0, db[d].lu + 4 * 256 * nk, 4 * 128 * hn, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("lo", hb->o + 128 * s->h0, db[d].lo, 4 * 128 * hn, 4);
				bad += cmpbuf("oq", hb->oq, db[d].oq, 2 * 6144, 2);
				bad += cmpbuf("ly", hb->y + s->y0, db[d].ly, 4u * (unsigned)s->yn, 4);
			}
			bad += cmpbuf("r", hb->r, db[d].r, 4 * 513, 4);
			bad += cmpbuf("idx", hb->idx, db[d].idx, 40, 4);
			bad += cmpbuf("w", hb->w, db[d].w, 40, 4);
			bad += cmpbuf("part", hb->part[d], db[d].part, 4 * 2560, 4);
			if (getenv("DIES_DUMP")) for (int sdie = 0; sdie < nd; sdie++) { char nm[16]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "parts.%d", sdie); bad += cmpbuf(nm, hb->part[sdie], xc[d].inbox + 10240u * (unsigned)sdie, 4 * 2560, 4); }   /* the gathered copies (slot 0 at the end) */
			bad += cmpbuf("out", hb->out, db[d].out, 4 * 2560, 4);
			bad += cmpbuf("S", hb->S, db[d].S, 4 * 10240, 4);
		}
		if (bad) fails++;
		if (t == T - 1 && getenv("DIES_PROF")) {
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0]));
			uint32_t *ts = malloc(4 * (64 + nph[0])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ts, dCTL[0], 4 * (64 + nph[0])));
			unsigned byop[DIE_NOPS] = {0}; unsigned prev = ts[15];
			for (unsigned i = 0; i < nph[0]; i++) {
				unsigned dd = ts[64 + i] - prev; prev = ts[64 + i];
				byop[P[0].p[i].w[0]] += dd;
				printf("   %2u %-10s units %5u %7.1f\n", i, die_opname[P[0].p[i].w[0]], P[0].p[i].w[1], dd / 1e3);
			}

			printf("\n  total %.1f us\n", (ts[64 + nph[0] - 1] - ts[15]) / 1e3);
			free(ts);
		}
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) prog_free(&P[d]);
	}
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); hold_close(&ar[d]); }
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/dn_l2norm_test.c
/* Independent arithmetic witnesses, not a second copy of the GPU reduction. */
#include "deltanet.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) {
    const float scales[] = {0.f, 1e-8f, 1e-3f, 1.f, 100.f};
    for (unsigned s = 0; s < sizeof scales / sizeof scales[0]; s++) {
        float q[128] = {0}, out[128]; q[0] = scales[s];
        l2norm128_gpu(q, 1e-6f, out);
        double expected = (double)q[0] / sqrt((double)q[0] * q[0] + (double)1e-6f);
        if (!isfinite(out[0]) || fabs((double)out[0] - expected) > 2e-7) {
            fprintf(stderr, "x=%g: got %.9g expected %.9g\n", q[0], out[0], expected); return 1;
        }
        for (int k = 1; k < 128; k++) if (out[k] != 0.f) return 1;
        printf("x=%g q[0]=%.9g expected=%.9g\n", q[0], out[0], expected);
    }
    puts("PASS: x / sqrt(sum(x*x) + eps), including zero and tiny inputs");
    return 0;
}


File: kern/dnnorm.sass
# Kernel: dnnorm
#
# DeltaNet readout norm and gate: one warp per value head h (CTA h, 48 of them),
# lane l owns o[128 h + 4 l .. + 3]:
#   ss = fmaf chain over the 4 (xor 16..1 butterfly); m = ss * (1/128); v = m + eps;
#   s = sqrt_rn(v); r = rcp_rn(s); y = ((o * r) * w) * sigmoid(gate)      (w: ssm_norm, 128)
# gate = attn_gate output, head-major (6144). Bit-exact twin: ref/deltanet.c dnnorm_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 O (6144)  1:0x148 W (128)  2:0x150 G (6144)  3:0x158 Y (6144)  4:0x160 eps (f32)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_O0  : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_O1  : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_W0  : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_W1  : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_G0  : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_G1  : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_Y0  : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Y1  : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_eps : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_xoff : c[0x0][0x168]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-3   : x<0-3>
    4-7   : w<0-3>
    8-11  : g<0-3>
    12-15 : sg<0-3>
    16    : ss
    17    : nrm
    18    : rr
    19    : ee
    20    : hh
    21    : s0
    22    : t
    23    : tid
    24    : head
    25    : lane
    26    : log2e
    27    : ln2hi
    28    : ln2lo
    29    : c720
    30    : c120
    31    : c24
    32    : c6
    33    : chalf
    34    : cone
    35    : mneg1
    36-39 : ft<1-4>
    40,41 : xp<0-1>
    42,43 : wp<0-1>
    44,45 : gp<0-1>
    46,47 : yp<0-1>
    48-59 : dq<00-11>
    60    : xo
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
    my $xout = $ENV{DN_XOUT} ? 1 : 0;   # y goes to every die's inbox: TAB at the Y param + xoff + 16 lane + 512 head; the phase is a send
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R head, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    if ($xout) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV yp0, param_Y0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV yp1, param_Y1;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:%d      LDG.E.64 dq%02d, [yp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, 2 * $_, 8 * $_ for 0..5;
    }
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x4;\n";                                 # 16 B per lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, t, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t, head, t, 0x9;\n";                           # + 512 head
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xo, t, param_xoff;\n" if $xout;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 EXIT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t, param_O0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_O1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD gp0.CC, t, param_G0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X gp1, RZ, param_G1;\n";
    unless ($xout) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t, param_Y0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 x0, [xp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.128 w0, [wp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDG.E.128 g0, [gp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMUL ss, x0, x0;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, x%d, x%d, ss;\n", $_, $_ for 1..3;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, ss, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD ss, ss, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL ss, ss, 0.0078125;\n";                           # 1/128
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD ss, ss, param_eps;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RSQ rr, ss;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      FMUL.FTZ s0, ss, rr;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL.FTZ hh, rr, 0.5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ ee, -s0, -RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ee, s0, ee, ss;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA nrm, ee, hh, s0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RCP rr, nrm;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      FFMA ee, nrm, rr, mneg1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ ee, -ee, -RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA rr, rr, ee, rr;\n";
    # sigmoid of the 4 gates (interleaved chains)
    $o .= sprintf("%s:-:-:-:6      MOV sg0, g0;\n", '02');                       # wait for w and gate
    for my $k (0..3) { $o .= fm_sigmoid("sg$k", "g$k", 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', \%C); }
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMUL x%d, x%d, rr;\n", $_ == 0 ? '02' : '--', $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMUL x%d, x%d, w%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FMUL x%d, x%d, sg%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    if ($xout) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      IADD dq%02d.CC, dq%02d, xo;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dq%02d, dq%02d, RZ;\n", $_ ? "--" : "04", 2 * $_, 2 * $_, 2 * $_ + 1, 2 * $_ + 1 for 0..5;
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:%d      STG.E.WT.128 [dq%02d], x0;\n", $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, 2 * $_ for 0..5;
    } else { $o .= "--:1:-:-:6      STG.E.128 [yp], x0;\n"; }
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/dnnorm_test.c
/* dnnorm_test: the DeltaNet readout norm + gate against dnnorm_gpu, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "deltanet.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 61;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(void) {
	float eps = 1e-6f;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "dnnorm.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "dnnorm"));
	float *o = malloc(6144 * 4), *g = malloc(6144 * 4), *y = malloc(6144 * 4), *yg = malloc(6144 * 4), w[128];
	CUdeviceptr dO, dW, dG, dY;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dO, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, 512)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dG, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, 6144 * 4));
	int fails = 0;
	for (int trial = 0; trial < 3; trial++) {
		float sc = trial == 1 ? 1e-3f : trial == 2 ? 30.f : 1.f;
		for (int i = 0; i < 6144; i++) { o[i] = sc * frand(); g[i] = 6.f * frand(); }
		for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) w[i] = 1.f + 0.5f * frand();
		dnnorm_gpu(o, w, g, eps, y);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dO, o, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, w, 512)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dG, g, 6144 * 4)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, 6144));
		void *params[] = { &dO, &dW, &dG, &dY, &eps };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 48, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(yg, dY, 6144 * 4));
		int bad = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 6144; i++) if (memcmp(&y[i], &yg[i], 4)) { if (bad < 3) printf("  y[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, yg[i], y[i]); bad++; }
		printf("trial %d: %s (%d of 6144 differ)\n", trial, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad);
		if (bad) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/dnstep.sass
# Kernel: dnstep
#
# Gated DeltaNet head step, one CTA of 256 threads per value head h (grid = 48).
# Bit-exact twin: ref/deltanet.c deltanet_step_gpu (see its header for the maths
# and the reduction shapes). Key head kh = h / 3 (DN_TILED=1: h & 15).
#
# Phase A (warps 0-2, then BAR.SYNC): warp 0 L2-normalises q[kh], warp 1 k[kh]
# (4 elements per lane, xor 16..1 butterfly, sqrt_rn, max eps, rcp_rn) into
# shared memory; warp 2 copies v[h] and lane 0 computes alpha = exp(ssm_a *
# softplus(a)), beta = sigmoid(b) with fmath.pl.
# Phase B (all threads): thread (g = tid >> 3, p = tid & 7) owns S[4g..4g+3][16p..
# 16p+15] (state stored value-major, 64 KB per head): decay, r (16-term chains per
# column, xor 1,2,4 over the 8 parts), e, be = beta e, rank-1 update, readout o
# with q^, o * (1/sqrt 128) stored by part 0, state stored back.
# Shared: qn 0, kn 512, v 1024, alpha 1536, beta 1540.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 S  1:0x148:8 Q  2:0x150:8 K  3:0x158:8 V  4:0x160:8 A  5:0x168:8 B
#         6:0x170:8 SSMA  7:0x178:8 O  8:0x180:4 eps

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_S0    : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_S1    : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_Q0    : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_Q1    : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_K0    : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_K1    : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_V0    : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_V1    : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_A0    : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_A1    : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_B0    : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_B1    : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_SA0   : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_SA1   : c[0x0][0x174]
    param_O0    : c[0x0][0x178]
    param_O1    : c[0x0][0x17c]
    param_eps   : c[0x0][0x180]
    param_hb    : c[0x0][0x184]
    param_kb    : c[0x0][0x188]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-63    : s<00-63>
    64-79   : kk<00-15>
    80-83   : r<0-3>

<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 c11 c9 c7 c5 c3 mneg1 chalf cone);
    my $tiled = $ENV{DN_TILED} ? 1 : 0;
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R head, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I mneg1, 0xbf800000;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 w, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 g, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND p, tid, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P5, PT, w, 0x3, PT;\n";          # P5: warps 3..7 (idle in phase A)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, w, 0x2, PT;\n";          # P6: warp 2 (v and gates)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P4, PT, w, RZ, PT;\n";           # P4: warp 0 (q), else warp 1 (k)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, p, RZ, PT;\n";           # P3: part 0 stores o
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P2, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";        # P2: lane 0
    if ($tiled) { $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND kh, head, 0xf;\n"; }
    else {
        # kh = (head + hb) / 3 - kb = ((head + hb) * 0xaaab) >> 17 - kb for head + hb < 48:
        # hb = first global head of this die, kb = its first key head (both 0 standalone)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t, 0xaaab;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t2, head, param_hb;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD.U16.U16 kh, t2, t, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t2, param_kb;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 kh, kh, 0x11;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kh, kh, -t2;\n";
    }
    # phase-B pointers (computed now; their consumers are far away)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, head, 0x10;\n";                            # 65536 head
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, g, 0xb;\n";                               # 2048 g
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, t2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t, p, t, 0x6;\n";                          # + 64 p
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t, param_S0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_S1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, head, 0x9;\n";                             # 512 head
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t, g, t, 0x4;\n";                          # + 16 g
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD op0.CC, t, param_O0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X op1, RZ, param_O1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL smk, p, 0x6;\n";                              # kn part: 512 + 64 p
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD smk, smk, 0x200;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL smq, p, 0x6;\n";                              # qn part: 64 p
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, g, 0x4;\n";                               # v: 1024 + 16 g (kept in t2 until phase B)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t2, t2, 0x400;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P5 BRA PHASEA_DONE;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA VPART;\n";
    # ---- warps 0 and 1: normalise q[kh] / k[kh] ----
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, kh, 0x9;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t, lane, t, 0x4;\n";                       # + 16 lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 IADD vp0.CC, t, param_Q0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 IADD.X vp1, RZ, param_Q1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P4 IADD vp0.CC, t, param_K0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P4 IADD.X vp1, RZ, param_K1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL smaddr, w, 0x9;\n";                           # 512 w
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD smaddr, lane, smaddr, 0x4;\n";             # + 16 lane
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.128 x0, [vp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMUL ss, x0, x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, x1, x1, ss;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, x2, x2, ss;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, x3, x3, ss;\n";
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, ss, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD ss, ss, t;\n";
    }
    # nrm = sqrt_rn(ss + eps): eps inside the root, as Transformers (rsqrt(sum(x x) + eps)) and flash-linear-attention (x / sqrt(sum(x x) + 1e-6)) have it;
    # it was max(sqrt(ss), eps) (ggml_l2_norm's form), see issue #2. ss + eps >= eps > 0, so the rsqrt below is never of zero.
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD ss, ss, param_eps;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RSQ rr, ss;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      FMUL.FTZ s0, ss, rr;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL.FTZ hh, rr, 0.5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ ee, -s0, -RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ee, s0, ee, ss;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA nrm, ee, hh, s0;\n";
    $o .= fm_rcp('rr', 'nrm', 'ee', \%C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FMUL x%d, x%d, rr;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:6      STS.128 [smaddr], x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BRA PHASEA_DONE;\n";
    # ---- warp 2: v and the gates ----
    $o .= "VPART:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, head, 0x9;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t, lane, t, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vp0.CC, t, param_V0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vp1, RZ, param_V1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL smaddr, lane, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD smaddr, smaddr, 0x400;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.128 x0, [vp];\n";
    $o .= "01:2:-:-:6      STS.128 [smaddr], x0;\n";
    # all lanes of warp 2 compute the gates (a divergent BAR.SYNC is undefined); lane 0 stores
    # alpha = exp(ssm_a * softplus(a)), beta = sigmoid(b)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, head, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t, param_A0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_A1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E fa, [ap];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t, param_B0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_B1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E fb, [ap];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t, param_SA0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_SA1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E fsa, [ap];\n";
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      MOV fg, fa;\n";
    $o .= fm_softplus('fsp', 'fa', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', 'ft5', \%C);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL fg, fsa, fsp;\n";
    $o .= fm_exp('alpha', 'fg', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', \%C);
    $o .= fm_sigmoid('beta', 'fb', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', \%C);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t, 0x600;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STS [t], alpha;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:6  \@P2 STS [t+0x4], beta;\n";
    $o .= "PHASEA_DONE:\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    # ---- phase B ----
    for my $j (0..3) {
        for my $t4 (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 s%02d, [sp+0x%x];\n", 16*$j + 4*$t4, 512*$j + 16*$t4;
        }
    }
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDS.128 kk%02d, [smk+0x%x];\n", 4*$_, 16*$_ for 0..3;
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1      LDS.128 vv0, [t2];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1      LDS alpha, [RZ+0x600];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDS beta, [RZ+0x604];\n";
    # decay
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL s%02d, s%02d, alpha;\n", $_ == 0 ? '03' : '--', $_ == 63 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..63;
    # r_j = sum_ii kk_ii s[16j+ii]: 4 chains interleaved, rounds of 6 cycles
    for my $ii (0..15) {
        for my $j (0..3) {
            my $st = $j == 3 ? '3' : '1';
            if ($ii == 0) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FMUL r%d, kk%02d, s%02d;\n", $st, $j, $ii, 16*$j + $ii; }
            else          { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FFMA r%d, kk%02d, s%02d, r%d;\n", $st, $j, $ii, 16*$j + $ii, $j; }
        }
    }
    for my $x (1, 2, 4) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:%s      SHFL.BFLY PT, e%d, r%d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 3 ? '3' : '1', $_, $_, $x for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FADD r%d, r%d, e%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '10' : '--', $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    }
    # e = v - r ; be = beta e
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FADD e%d, vv%d, -r%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FMUL e%d, beta, e%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..3;
    # update s[16j+ii] += kk_ii be_j
    for my $j (0..3) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FFMA s%02d, kk%02d, e%d, s%02d;\n", ($j == 3 && $_ == 15) ? '6' : '1', 16*$j + $_, $_, $j, 16*$j + $_ for 0..15;
    }
    # q^ part into the kk registers (the update FFMAs have read them)
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDS.128 kk%02d, [smq+0x%x];\n", $_ == 3 ? '2' : '1', 4*$_, 16*$_ for 0..3;
    for my $ii (0..15) {
        for my $j (0..3) {
            my $st = $j == 3 ? '3' : '1';
            my $wait = ($ii == 0 && $j == 0) ? '02' : '--';
            if ($ii == 0) { $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL o%d, kk%02d, s%02d;\n", $wait, $st, $j, $ii, 16*$j + $ii; }
            else          { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FFMA o%d, kk%02d, s%02d, o%d;\n", $st, $j, $ii, 16*$j + $ii, $j; }
        }
    }
    for my $x (1, 2, 4) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:%s      SHFL.BFLY PT, e%d, o%d, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 3 ? '3' : '1', $_, $_, $x for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FADD o%d, o%d, e%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '10' : '--', $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t, 0x3db504f3;\n";                         # 1/sqrt(128)
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FMUL o%d, o%d, t;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P3 STG.E.128 [op], o0;\n";
    # state back
    for my $j (0..3) {
        for my $t4 (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [sp+0x%x], s%02d;\n", 512*$j + 16*$t4, 16*$j + 4*$t4;
        }
    }
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/dnstep_test.c
/* dnstep_test: the DeltaNet head-step kernel (48 heads) against deltanet_step_gpu, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "deltanet.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 23;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	int tiled = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "tiled");
	const int H = 48, KH = 16, D = 128;
	float eps = 1e-6f;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, tiled ? "dnstep_tiled.cubin" : "dnstep.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "dnstep"));
	int nregs, maxb;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fn, 256, 0));
	size_t sbytes = (size_t)H * D * D * 4;
	float *S = malloc(sbytes), *S2 = malloc(sbytes), *Sg = malloc(sbytes);
	float *q = malloc(KH * D * 4), *k = malloc(KH * D * 4), *v = malloc(H * D * 4);
	float *a = malloc(H * 4), *b = malloc(H * 4), *sa = malloc(H * 4), *o = malloc(H * D * 4), *og = malloc(H * D * 4);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)H * D * D; i++) S[i] = 0.5f * frand();
	for (int i = 0; i < KH * D; i++) { q[i] = frand() * 2.f; k[i] = frand() * 2.f; }
	for (int i = 0; i < H * D; i++) v[i] = frand();
	for (int h = 0; h < H; h++) { a[h] = 3.f * frand(); b[h] = 3.f * frand(); sa[h] = -expf(frand()); }
	if (getenv("DN_TINY")) { memset(q, 0, KH * D * 4); memset(k, 0, KH * D * 4); for (int h = 0; h < KH; h++) q[h * D] = k[h * D] = 1e-3f; }
	memcpy(S2, S, sbytes);
	for (int h = 0; h < H; h++) {
		int kh = tiled ? (h & 15) : h / 3;
		deltanet_step_gpu(S2 + (size_t)h * D * D, q + kh * D, k + kh * D, v + h * D, a[h], b[h], sa[h], eps, o + h * D);
	}
	CUdeviceptr dS, dQ, dK, dV, dA, dB, dSA, dO;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, sbytes)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ, KH * D * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dK, KH * D * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dV, H * D * 4));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dA, H * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dB, H * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dSA, H * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dO, H * D * 4));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, S, sbytes)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQ, q, KH * D * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dK, k, KH * D * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dV, v, H * D * 4));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dA, a, H * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dB, b, H * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSA, sa, H * 4)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dO, 0x7fc00000u, H * D));
	unsigned hb = 0, kb = 0;   /* standalone: global heads from 0 */
	void *params[] = { &dS, &dQ, &dK, &dV, &dA, &dB, &dSA, &dO, &eps, &hb, &kb };
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, H, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(Sg, dS, sbytes)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(og, dO, H * D * 4));
	int bs = 0, bo = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)H * D * D; i++) if (memcmp(&Sg[i], &S2[i], 4)) { if (bs < 3) printf("  S[%zu] (head %zu c %zu i %zu): gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, i / (D * D), (i / D) % D, i % D, Sg[i], S2[i]); bs++; }
	for (int i = 0; i < H * D; i++) if (memcmp(&og[i], &o[i], 4)) { if (bo < 3) printf("  o[%d] (head %d c %d): gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, i / D, i % D, og[i], o[i]); bo++; }
	printf("dnstep %s: %d registers, %d CTAs/SM; %s (state %d of %d differ, o %d of %d differ)\n", tiled ? "tiled" : "grouped", nregs, maxb,
	       (bs || bo) ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bs, H * D * D, bo, H * D);
	/* timing: 48 heads, state 6 MB in + 6 MB out */
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, S, sbytes));
	double t0 = now();
	for (int it = 0; it < 20; it++) CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, H, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	double t1 = now();
	printf("%.1f us per step of 48 heads (%.1f GB/s of state)\n", (t1 - t0) / 20 * 1e6, 2.0 * sbytes / ((t1 - t0) / 20) / 1e9);
	return (bs || bo) ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/embrow.sass
# Kernel: embrow
#
# Token embedding row: decodes the raw Q3_K row `id` of token_embd (2560 values =
# 10 blocks of 256, 110 bytes each, row stride 1100 B) and writes it to the four
# lanes of the hyper stream S (S + 10240 l + 4 v). Grid = 10 CTAs x 256 threads,
# CTA b = block b, thread v = value v of the block, exactly as ref/quant.c
# decodes Q3_K:
#   nn = v >> 7, j = (v >> 5) & 3, which = (v >> 4) & 1, l = v & 15
#   code = (qs[32 nn + 16 which + l] >> 2j) & 3 ; h = (hm[16 which + l] >> (4 nn + j)) & 1
#   is = 8 nn + 2 j + which ; sc = 6-bit scale is (ggml unpack) - 32
#   y = (d * sc) * (code - (h ? 0 : 4))
# Bit-exact twin: dequant(GG_Q3_K, ...).
#
# A position that carries an image embedding (IMAP[pos] != 0xffffffff, a row of the fp16 table IMG [row][2560]) takes it instead:
# y = f32(IMG[row][256 b + v]), the same four stores.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 E (token_embd)  1:0x148 S (stream out)  2:0x150 pos (u32)  3:0x158 IDS (u32 tokens; the row is IDS[pos])
#         4:0x160 IMAP (u32 per position)  5:0x168 IMG (fp16 rows of 2560)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_E0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_E1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_S0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_S1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_id : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_IDS0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_IDS1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_IMAP0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_IMAP1 : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_IMG0 : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_IMG1 : c[0x0][0x16c]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0     : v
    1     : b
    2     : nn
    3     : j
    4     : which
    5     : l
    6     : is
    7     : t
    8     : t2
    9     : code
    10    : hb
    11    : sclo
    12    : schi
    13    : d
    14    : y
    15    : k
    16,17 : bp<0-1>
    18,19 : sp<0-1>
    20,21 : qp<0-1>
    22,23 : hp<0-1>
    24,25 : lp<0-1>
    26,27 : kp<0-1>
    28,29 : ip<0-1>
    30,31 : mp<0-1>
    32    : row
    33    : hh
    34,35 : gp<0-1>
</REGISTER_MAPPING>
