File: kern/ffnact_test.c
/* ffnact_test: SiLU(g) * u + per-32 quantiser (one warp per expert) against
 * silu_gpu / quant_act_gpu32, bit for bit. usage: ffnact_test [n] [experts] */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "quant.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 19;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	int n = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 640, E = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 11;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	char cubin[64];
	snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "ffnact_k%d.cubin", n);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "ffnact"));
	int nregs; CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	size_t N = (size_t)n * E;
	CUdeviceptr dG, dU, dQ, dS32, dS16, dSC;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dG, 4 * N)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dU, 4 * N)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ, 2 * N));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS32, 4 * N / 32 + 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS16, 4 * N / 16 + 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dSC, 4 * N / 32 + 64));
	float *g = malloc(4 * N), *u = malloc(4 * N), *x = malloc(4 * N);
	int16_t *q = malloc(2 * N), *qg = malloc(2 * N);
	int32_t *s32 = malloc(4 * N / 32), *s16 = malloc(4 * N / 16), *s32g = malloc(4 * N / 32), *s16g = malloc(4 * N / 16);
	float *as = malloc(4 * N / 32), *asg = malloc(4 * N / 32);
	const float mags[] = { 1.f, 6.f, 0.05f, 40.f, 0.f };
	int fails = 0;
	unsigned un = (unsigned)n;
	for (unsigned m = 0; m < sizeof mags / sizeof mags[0]; m++) {
		for (size_t i = 0; i < N; i++) { g[i] = mags[m] * frand() * (1.f + (i % 5) * 0.5f); u[i] = 2.f * frand(); }
		if (m == 3) g[7] = 100.f, g[9] = -100.f;    /* saturated gates */
		for (size_t i = 0; i < N; i++) x[i] = silu_gpu(g[i]) * u[i];
		for (int e = 0; e < E; e++) quant_act_gpu32(x + (size_t)e * n, n, q + (size_t)e * n, s32 + (size_t)e * n / 32, s16 + (size_t)e * n / 16, as + (size_t)e * n / 32);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dG, g, 4 * N)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dU, u, 4 * N));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dQ, 0x7fff7fffu, N / 2));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dS32, 0x7fffffffu, N / 32)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dS16, 0x7fffffffu, N / 16)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dSC, 0x7fc00000u, N / 32));
		void *params[] = { &dG, &dU, &dQ, &dS32, &dS16, &dSC, &un };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, E, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(qg, dQ, 2 * N)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s32g, dS32, 4 * N / 32)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s16g, dS16, 4 * N / 16)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(asg, dSC, 4 * N / 32));
		int bq = 0, b32 = 0, b16 = 0, bs = 0;
		for (size_t i = 0; i < N; i++) if (q[i] != qg[i]) { if (bq < 3) printf("  q[%zu]: gpu %d ref %d (g %g u %g x %g)\n", i, qg[i], q[i], g[i], u[i], x[i]); bq++; }
		for (size_t i = 0; i < N / 32; i++) if (s32[i] != s32g[i]) b32++;
		for (size_t i = 0; i < N / 16; i++) if (s16[i] != s16g[i]) b16++;
		for (size_t i = 0; i < N / 32; i++) if (memcmp(&as[i], &asg[i], 4)) { if (bs < 3) printf("  as[%zu]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, asg[i], as[i]); bs++; }
		printf("n=%d x%d mag %-5g: %s (codes %d/%zu differ, s32 %d, s16 %d, scales %d/%zu) [%d regs]\n", n, E, mags[m],
		       (bq || b32 || b16 || bs) ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bq, N, b32, b16, bs, N / 32, nregs);
		if (bq || b32 || b16 || bs) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/flashcore.c
/* flashcore: the long-lived process of the Flash-Next engine. It owns what is slow to build (the
 * dies' contexts and weight arenas, the PLE table pinned in host RAM) and runs the engine library
 * (libengine.so) that does everything else, reloading it on request without disturbing them.
 *
 *   flashcore <ple.bin | -> <libengine.so> <manifest0> [manifest1 ...]
 *
 * The clients speak the line protocol of engine_session() (see engine.c) on stdin/stdout, or, with
 * FLASH_SOCK=<path>, one at a time on that Unix socket (flashd). `reload [path]` swaps the library; a CUDA error
 * in the engine rebuilds the die contexts and the engine (the table is owned by an anchor context on another die).
 * Env: FLASH_MAXT (positions, default 2048), FLASH_PLE_OFF (byte offset of the table in the PLE file,
 * 192 for shard 2 itself, 0 for an extracted copy; the file "-" means no table: the PLE rows read
 * zeros, timing only), FLASH_PLE_CONSUME (see below), plus the engine's own (SPLIT_SHARES, ATTN_DIE,
 * FLASH_CUBIN). */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include "core.h"
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); fprintf(stderr, "flashcore.c:%d: %s -> %s\n", __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)
static double now(void) { struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts); return ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9; }

static core_t core;
static void *lib;
static char libpath[1024];
static int (*e_init)(core_t *);
static void (*e_fini)(void);
static int (*e_session)(FILE *, FILE *);
static const char *(*e_reload_path)(void);

/* load the engine library and initialise it; 0 on success. A library that fails to load or
 * initialise is unloaded again so the caller can fall back. */
static char libcopy[1100];   /* the private copy the running library was opened from */
static void cleanup_copy(void) { if (libcopy[0]) unlink(libcopy); }
static int copy_file(const char *from, const char *to) {
	FILE *a = fopen(from, "rb"), *b = a ? fopen(to, "wb") : NULL; if (!b) { if (a) fclose(a); return -1; }
	char buf[1 << 16]; size_t k; int bad = 0;
	while ((k = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, a)) > 0) if (fwrite(buf, 1, k, b) != k) { bad = 1; break; }
	bad |= ferror(a) != 0; bad |= fclose(b) != 0; fclose(a);
	if (bad) { unlink(to); return -1; }
	return 0;
}
static int engine_open(const char *file, const char *path);
/* the library is always opened from a private copy of the file: the file at <path> can be replaced by a build at any time, and a failed reload must
 * bring back the library that was running, not whatever now sits at its name (see engine_reload) */
static int engine_load(const char *path) {
	static int gen, registered; char cp[1100]; snprintf(cp, sizeof cp, "/tmp/flashcore-%d-gen%d.so", (int)getpid(), ++gen);
	if (copy_file(path, cp)) { fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: cannot copy %s to %s\n", path, cp); return -1; }
	if (engine_open(cp, path)) { unlink(cp); return -1; }
	snprintf(libcopy, sizeof libcopy, "%s", cp);
	if (!registered) { atexit(cleanup_copy); registered = 1; }
	return 0;
}
static int engine_open(const char *file, const char *path) {
	void *h = dlopen(file, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	if (!h) { fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: %s\n", dlerror()); return -1; }
	int (*i)(core_t *) = dlsym(h, "engine_init");
	void (*f)(void) = dlsym(h, "engine_fini");
	int (*s)(FILE *, FILE *) = dlsym(h, "engine_session");
	const char *(*rp)(void) = dlsym(h, "engine_reload_path");
	if (!i || !f || !s || !rp) { fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: %s lacks engine_init/engine_fini/engine_session/engine_reload_path\n", path); dlclose(h); return -1; }
	double t0 = now();
	if (i(&core)) { fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: engine_init failed in %s\n", path); f(); dlclose(h); return -1; }
	lib = h; e_init = i; e_fini = f; e_session = s; e_reload_path = rp;
	snprintf(libpath, sizeof libpath, "%s", path);
	fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: engine %s ready in %.1f s\n", path, now() - t0);
	return 0;
}
static void engine_unload(void) {
	if (!lib) return;
	e_fini(); dlclose(lib); lib = NULL;
}
/* replace the library (path NULL: reload the current file); on failure bring the old one back */
static int engine_reload(const char *path) {
	char old[1024]; snprintf(old, sizeof old, "%s", libpath);
	char oldcopy[1100]; snprintf(oldcopy, sizeof oldcopy, "%s", libcopy);   /* the image that is running now, kept on disk until the new one is up */
	char next[1024]; snprintf(next, sizeof next, "%s", path && *path ? path : libpath);
	engine_unload();
	if (!engine_load(next)) { if (oldcopy[0]) unlink(oldcopy); return 0; }
	fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: the new library did not come up; falling back to the previous image of %s\n", old);
	if (oldcopy[0] && !engine_open(oldcopy, old)) { snprintf(libcopy, sizeof libcopy, "%s", oldcopy); return -1; }
	fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: cannot bring the previous library back; exiting\n"); exit(1);
}

static char *manifest[CORE_MAXD];
static CUcontext anchor;

/* The die contexts, peer access and weight arenas; 0 on success. A device fault leaves the contexts unusable:
   close_dies + open_dies rebuild them without touching the PLE table, which belongs to the anchor context. */
/* a holder writes <manifest>.ready when its arena is complete; the core, which loads the PLE table first, waits here for the rest (FLASH_HOLD_WAIT_S, default 7200),
   so the holders and the core can be started together and their loads overlap. A manifest without the marker (an older holder) is taken as it is. */
static void wait_holder(const char *mpath) {
	char ready[600]; snprintf(ready, sizeof ready, "%s.ready", mpath);
	double limit = getenv("FLASH_HOLD_WAIT_S") ? atof(getenv("FLASH_HOLD_WAIT_S")) : 7200.0, t0 = now(); int said = 0;
	while (access(ready, F_OK) && now() - t0 < limit) {
		if (!said && now() - t0 > 2.0) { fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: waiting for the holder of %s\n", mpath); said = 1; }
		struct timespec nap = { 2, 0 }; nanosleep(&nap, NULL);
	}
}
static int open_dies(void) {
	for (int d = 0; d < core.nd; d++) {
		wait_holder(manifest[d]);
		FILE *f = fopen(manifest[d], "r"); size_t bytes; int die;
		if (!f || fscanf(f, "arena %zu die %d", &bytes, &die) != 2) { fprintf(stderr, "bad manifest %s\n", manifest[d]); if (f) fclose(f); return -1; }
		fclose(f);
		CUdevice dev; if (hold_ordinal(die) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "die %d is not in CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES\n", die); return -1; }
		if (cuDeviceGet(&dev, hold_ordinal(die)) || cuCtxCreate_v2(&core.ctx[d], CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev)) { fprintf(stderr, "cannot create a context on die %d\n", die); return -1; }
		if (hold_open(&core.ar[d], manifest[d])) return -1;
	}
	for (int d = 0; d < core.nd; d++) { if (cuCtxSetCurrent(core.ctx[d])) return -1; for (int e = 0; e < core.nd; e++) if (e != d && cuCtxEnablePeerAccess(core.ctx[e], 0)) return -1; }
	return 0;
}
static void close_dies(void) {
	for (int d = 0; d < core.nd; d++) {
		if (core.ctx[d]) { cuCtxSetCurrent(core.ctx[d]); hold_close(&core.ar[d]); cuCtxDestroy(core.ctx[d]); core.ctx[d] = NULL; }
	}
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: flashcore <ple.bin | -> <libengine.so> <manifest0> [manifest1 ...]\n"); return 2; }
	const char *plefile = argv[1], *libfile = argv[2];
	core.abi = CORE_ABI; core.nd = argc - 3;
	if (core.nd > CORE_MAXD) { fprintf(stderr, "at most %d dies\n", CORE_MAXD); return 2; }
	core.maxt = getenv("FLASH_MAXT") ? atoi(getenv("FLASH_MAXT")) : 2048;
	double ts0 = now();
	signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
	CK(cuInit(0));
	for (int d = 0; d < core.nd; d++) manifest[d] = argv[3 + d];
	/* the anchor: a context on a die the engine never runs on (FLASH_ANCHOR_DIE, default 7; the first die if that one is not
	   visible) owns the pinned table, so destroying the die contexts after a device fault does not free it */
	{
		const char *ad = getenv("FLASH_ANCHOR_DIE"); int die = ad ? atoi(ad) : 7, ord = hold_ordinal(die);
		if (ord < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: anchor die %d is not visible, anchoring on the first die\n", die); ord = 0; }
		CUdevice dev; CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, ord)); CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&anchor, 0, dev));
	}
	if (open_dies()) return 1;
	/* ---- the PLE table: pinned host memory, read from the file (CUDA 11.4 cannot pin a file mapping) ---- */
	CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(anchor));
	const size_t PLE_ROWS = 320001536, PLE_BYTES = PLE_ROWS * 90;
	int have = strcmp(plefile, "-") != 0;
	/* FLASH_PLE_DISK: the table stays in its file. ple_host is only the compact table of the 16 rows of each position plus a ready flag per position; the engine reads the
	   rows of a position from the file when that position is about to run (a token touches 16 x 90 B of the 28.8 GB) and sets its flag, plerows waits for the flag */
	int disk = have && getenv("FLASH_PLE_DISK") != NULL;
	size_t sz = (have && !disk) ? PLE_BYTES : (size_t)core.maxt * 16 * 90;   /* no table: a zero compact table (16 rows per position) keeps plerows in bounds */
	size_t rdy_off = disk ? (sz + 4095) & ~(size_t)4095 : 0, alloc = disk ? rdy_off + 4 * ((size_t)core.maxt + 2) + 4096 : sz + 4096;
	CK(cuMemHostAlloc((void **)&core.ple_host, alloc, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_PORTABLE | CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP));
	memset(core.ple_host, 0, (have && !disk) ? 4096 : alloc);
	core.ple_compact = !have || disk;
	core.ple_disk = disk; core.ple_rdy_off = rdy_off; core.ple_fd = -1; core.ple_off = 0;
	if (disk) {
		core.ple_fd = open(plefile, O_RDONLY); if (core.ple_fd < 0) { perror(plefile); return 1; }
		core.ple_off = getenv("FLASH_PLE_OFF") ? (off_t)atoll(getenv("FLASH_PLE_OFF")) : 0;
		/* 16 random 90 B reads per token: no readahead. On the NFS mount (rsize 1 MB) a 90 B read otherwise pulls in a readahead window, about 100 ms per position when cold. */
		posix_fadvise(core.ple_fd, 0, 0, POSIX_FADV_RANDOM);
		fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: PLE rows are read from %s on demand (FLASH_PLE_DISK): %.0f MB pinned instead of %.1f GB, no table load\n", plefile, alloc / 1e6, PLE_BYTES / 1e9);
	}
	if (have && !disk) {
		int fd = open(plefile, O_RDONLY); if (fd < 0) { perror(plefile); return 1; }
		off_t off = getenv("FLASH_PLE_OFF") ? (off_t)atoll(getenv("FLASH_PLE_OFF")) : 0;
		/* FLASH_PLE_CONSUME=1: the file is a tmpfs copy that does not fit in RAM next to the pinned
		   table; read it from the end and truncate as we go, so its pages are freed as ours fill */
		int consume = getenv("FLASH_PLE_CONSUME") != NULL; if (consume) { close(fd); fd = open(plefile, O_RDWR); if (fd < 0) { perror(plefile); return 1; } }
		size_t done = 0; double tp0 = now();
		while (done < PLE_BYTES) {
			size_t chunk = PLE_BYTES - done > (64u << 20) ? (64u << 20) : PLE_BYTES - done;
			size_t at = consume ? PLE_BYTES - done - chunk : done;   /* backwards when consuming */
			size_t got = 0;
			while (got < chunk) { ssize_t n = pread(fd, core.ple_host + at + got, chunk - got, off + (off_t)(at + got)); if (n <= 0) { perror("pread ple"); return 1; } got += (size_t)n; }
			if (consume && ftruncate(fd, off + (off_t)at)) { perror("ftruncate ple"); return 1; }
			done += chunk;
			if ((done >> 30) != ((done - chunk) >> 30)) fprintf(stderr, "\rPLE table: %zu of %zu GB (%.0f MB/s)", done >> 30, PLE_BYTES >> 30, done / 1e6 / (now() - tp0));
		}
		if (consume) unlink(plefile);
		close(fd);
		fprintf(stderr, "\rPLE table: %.2f GB pinned in %.0f s\n", PLE_BYTES / 1e9, now() - tp0);
	}
	fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: %d dies, weights and PLE table resident after %.0f s\n", core.nd, now() - ts0);
	if (engine_load(libfile)) fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: starting without an engine; \"reload <path>\" loads one (the weights and the table stay resident)\n");
	printf("ready\n"); fflush(stdout);

	const char *sock = getenv("FLASH_SOCK");
	int ls = -1;
	if (sock) {
		ls = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0); struct sockaddr_un sa = { .sun_family = AF_UNIX };
		snprintf(sa.sun_path, sizeof sa.sun_path, "%s", sock); unlink(sock);
		if (ls < 0 || bind(ls, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa) || listen(ls, 4)) { perror(sock); return 1; }
		fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: listening on %s\n", sock);
	}
	for (;;) {
		FILE *in = stdin, *out = stdout;
		if (ls >= 0) {
			int c = accept(ls, NULL, NULL); if (c < 0) { perror("accept"); continue; }
			in = fdopen(c, "r"); out = fdopen(dup(c), "w");
		}
		int q;
		if (lib) q = e_session(in, out);
		else {   /* no engine: only reload and quit are understood */
			char buf[1024]; q = 0;
			while (fgets(buf, sizeof buf, in)) {
				if (!strncmp(buf, "quit", 4)) { q = 1; break; }
				if (!strncmp(buf, "reload", 6)) {
					char path[1000] = ""; sscanf(buf + 6, "%999s", path);
					int rc = engine_load(*path ? path : libfile);
					fprintf(out, rc ? "error: could not load the engine\n" : "ok: engine loaded\n"); fflush(out);
					if (!rc) break;
				} else { fprintf(out, "error: no engine loaded; send \"reload <path>\"\n"); fflush(out); }
			}
		}
		if (q == 3) {   /* the engine hit a CUDA error: the contexts are unusable, the table (anchor) is not */
			fprintf(stderr, "flashcore: device fault; rebuilding the die contexts and the engine\n");
			char keep[1024]; snprintf(keep, sizeof keep, "%s", libpath);
			engine_unload(); close_dies();
			int rc = open_dies() ? -1 : engine_load(keep);
			fprintf(out, rc ? "error: could not recover from the device fault; the process exits\n" : "ok: contexts rebuilt, engine reloaded\n"); fflush(out);
			if (rc) { if (ls >= 0) { fclose(in); fclose(out); } exit(1); }
		}
		if (q == 2) {
			const char *next = e_reload_path();
			char keep[1024]; snprintf(keep, sizeof keep, "%s", next ? next : "");
			int rc = engine_reload(keep);
			fprintf(out, rc ? "error: reload failed, the previous engine is back\n" : "ok: engine reloaded\n"); fflush(out);
		}
		if (ls >= 0) { fclose(in); fclose(out); } else if (q != 2) break;
		if (q == 1) break;
	}
	engine_unload();
	close_dies();
	if (ls >= 0) { close(ls); unlink(sock); }
	return 0;
}


File: kern/flashd.c
/* flashd: the HTTP front-end of the Flash-Next engine, speaking the subset of llama-server's API
 * that https://nm-z.com/chat/ uses:
 *
 *   GET  /v1/models            {"data":[{"id": name}]}
 *   GET  /props               {"default_generation_settings":{"n_ctx": positions}, "chat_template": ...}
 *   GET  /health
 *   POST /v1/chat/completions  {"messages":[...], "stream":bool, "max_tokens":n,
 *                               "chat_template_kwargs":{"enable_thinking":bool}}
 *
 * The prompt is the GGUF's own chat template (jinja.c) over the request's messages, tokenized
 * with the GGUF's vocabulary (tok.c), and run on the engine (flash, FLASH_SOCK) greedily until
 * <|im_end|>/EOS or max_tokens. The reply streams as server-sent events: reasoning tokens as
 * delta.reasoning_content up to </think>, the answer as delta.content, and the final event
 * carries timings (prompt_per_second, predicted_per_second). One request runs at a time; the
 * others wait in a FIFO queue (see "the request queue"; GET endpoints never wait).
 *
 *   flashd <shard-1.gguf> <flash-socket> <host:port>      env FLASHD_NAME, FLASHD_THINKING (0: off by default),
 *   FLASHD_QUEUE_MAX (waiting requests, default 8), FLASHD_QUEUE_WAIT_S (default 600) */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include "jinja.h"
#include "tok.h"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <utime.h>

static tok_vocab *V;
static jinja *TPL;
static const char *SOCK, *NAME = "Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-sass";
static int POSITIONS = 2048, THINK_DEFAULT = 1;
// Output budgets in thinking mode: up to 262,144 tokens of reasoning and 131,072 of final answer (the context bounds both).
static long REASONING_MAX = 262144, ANSWER_MAX = 131072;
static double DEF_TEMP = 0.0, DEF_TOPP = 1.0; static int DEF_TOPK = 0;   /* general.sampling.* from the GGUF; temperature 0 = greedy */
static uint32_t ID_END, ID_THINK_END;


/* ---- output ---- */
static int wr(int fd, const char *s, size_t n) {
	while (n) { ssize_t k = send(fd, s, n, MSG_NOSIGNAL); if (k <= 0) return -1; s += k; n -= (size_t)k; }
	return 0;
}
static int wrs(int fd, const char *s) { return wr(fd, s, strlen(s)); }
static int chunk(int fd, const char *s, size_t n) { char h[24]; int k = snprintf(h, sizeof h, "%zx\r\n", n); return wr(fd, h, (size_t)k) || wr(fd, s, n) || wr(fd, "\r\n", 2); }
static void reply(int fd, int status, const char *ctype, const char *body, size_t n) {
	char h[256]; const char *r = status == 200 ? "OK" : status == 400 ? "Bad Request" : status == 404 ? "Not Found" : status == 413 ? "Payload Too Large" : "Internal Server Error";
	int k = snprintf(h, sizeof h, "HTTP/1.1 %d %s\r\nContent-Type: %s\r\nCache-Control: no-store\r\nContent-Length: %zu\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n", status, r, ctype, n);
	wr(fd, h, (size_t)k); wr(fd, body, n);
}
static void error(int fd, int status, const char *msg) {
	sbuf b = {0}; sb_puts(&b, "{\"error\":{\"message\":"); sb_json_str(&b, msg, strlen(msg)); sb_printf(&b, ",\"code\":%d}}", status);
	reply(fd, status, "application/json", b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
}


/* ---- the request queue ----
   The engine runs one sequence, so one request runs at a time and the others wait here in arrival order. A request whose client goes away
   leaves the queue (or, running, stops the engine) instead of being served to nobody; a full queue or a long wait is a 503 with Retry-After.
   FLASHD_QUEUE_MAX (waiting requests, default 8), FLASHD_QUEUE_WAIT_S (default 600). GET /queue shows the depth. */
typedef struct waiter { struct waiter *next; } waiter;
static pthread_mutex_t QM = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER; static pthread_cond_t QC = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static waiter *QHEAD, *QTAIL; static int QBUSY, QLEN, QMAX = 8, QWAIT_S = 600;
static int client_gone(int fd) {   /* the peer closed or reset its end */
	struct pollfd p = { .fd = fd, .events = POLLRDHUP };
	return poll(&p, 1, 0) > 0 && (p.revents & (POLLRDHUP | POLLHUP | POLLERR));
}
static void q_remove(waiter *w) {   /* QM held */
	waiter *prev = NULL; for (waiter *x = QHEAD; x; prev = x, x = x->next) if (x == w) { if (prev) prev->next = x->next; else QHEAD = x->next; if (QTAIL == x) QTAIL = prev; QLEN--; break; }
}
static double mono_ms(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec * 1e3 + t.tv_nsec / 1e6; }
static int try_send(int fd, const char *s, size_t n) { return send(fd, s, n, MSG_NOSIGNAL | MSG_DONTWAIT) == (ssize_t)n ? 0 : -1; }
/* 0: the engine is yours (queue_leave when done); -1: the client left; -2: the queue is full; -3: waited too long. *hdr is set once SSE headers have gone out while waiting. */
static int queue_enter(int fd, int stream, int *hdr, double *waited_ms) {
	double t0 = mono_ms(), last_note = t0; waiter me = { 0 };
	pthread_mutex_lock(&QM);
	if (!QBUSY && !QHEAD) { QBUSY = 1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&QM); *waited_ms = 0; return 0; }
	if (QLEN >= QMAX) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&QM); *waited_ms = 0; return -2; }
	if (QTAIL) QTAIL->next = &me; else QHEAD = &me;
	QTAIL = &me; QLEN++;
	int rc = 0;
	while (!(QHEAD == &me && !QBUSY)) {
		struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts); ts.tv_sec += 1;
		pthread_cond_timedwait(&QC, &QM, &ts);
		if (QHEAD == &me && !QBUSY) break;
		double now = mono_ms();
		if (client_gone(fd)) { rc = -1; break; }
		if (QWAIT_S > 0 && now - t0 > QWAIT_S * 1e3) { rc = -3; break; }
		if (stream && now - last_note > 10e3) {   /* keep the connection open through proxies, and say where it stands */
			int pos = 1; for (waiter *x = QHEAD; x && x != &me; x = x->next) pos++;
			char c[160], m[96]; int mn = snprintf(m, sizeof m, ": queued, position %d\n\n", pos), k = 0;
			if (!*hdr) { const char *h = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\r\nCache-Control: no-cache\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"; k = snprintf(c, sizeof c, "%s", h); }
			k += snprintf(c + k, sizeof c - (size_t)k, "%x\r\n%s\r\n", mn, m);
			if (try_send(fd, c, (size_t)k)) { rc = -1; break; }
			*hdr = 1; last_note = now;
		}
	}
	if (rc) q_remove(&me);
	else { QHEAD = me.next; if (!QHEAD) QTAIL = NULL; QLEN--; QBUSY = 1; }
	pthread_cond_broadcast(&QC); pthread_mutex_unlock(&QM);
	*waited_ms = mono_ms() - t0;
	return rc;
}
static void queue_leave(void) { pthread_mutex_lock(&QM); QBUSY = 0; pthread_cond_broadcast(&QC); pthread_mutex_unlock(&QM); }
static void busy(int fd, const char *msg, int retry_after) {
	sbuf b = {0}; sb_puts(&b, "{\"error\":{\"message\":"); sb_json_str(&b, msg, strlen(msg)); sb_puts(&b, ",\"code\":503}}");
	char h[256]; int k = snprintf(h, sizeof h, "HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nRetry-After: %d\r\nCache-Control: no-store\r\nContent-Length: %zu\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n", retry_after, b.n);
	wr(fd, h, (size_t)k); wr(fd, b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
}

/* ---- the engine socket ---- */
static FILE *engine_open(FILE **out) {
	int s = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0); struct sockaddr_un sa = { .sun_family = AF_UNIX };
	snprintf(sa.sun_path, sizeof sa.sun_path, "%s", SOCK);
	if (s < 0 || connect(s, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa)) { if (s >= 0) close(s); return NULL; }
	*out = fdopen(dup(s), "w"); return fdopen(s, "r");
}

/* ---- one reply being decoded ---- */
typedef struct {
	int fd, stream, in_think, gone, started_content, started_reasoning;
	unsigned char pend[8]; int npend;
	sbuf content, reasoning;
	long created;
	long n_reason, n_answer; int cap_hit;   /* tokens so far in each part; set when one reaches its budget */
} gen;

static void emit_delta(gen *g, const char *field, const char *s, size_t n) {
	if (!n) return;
	if (g->stream && !g->gone) {
		sbuf b = {0};
		sb_printf(&b, "data: {\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{\"%s\":", field); sb_json_str(&b, s, n);
		sb_printf(&b, "},\"finish_reason\":null}],\"created\":%ld,\"id\":\"chatcmpl-flash\",\"model\":\"%s\",\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\"}\n\n", g->created, NAME);
		if (chunk(g->fd, b.s, b.n)) g->gone = 1;
		sb_free(&b);
	}
	sbuf *acc = field[0] == 'r' ? &g->reasoning : &g->content;
	sb_put(acc, s, n);
}
/* text from the model: drop the whitespace that opens each part, hold back an incomplete UTF-8 tail */
static void emit_text(gen *g, const char *s, size_t n) {
	unsigned char buf[16 + 4096]; size_t k = 0;
	if (g->npend) memcpy(buf, g->pend, (size_t)g->npend), k = (size_t)g->npend;
	if (n > 4096) n = 4096;
	memcpy(buf + k, s, n); k += n;
	size_t keep = k;   /* an incomplete trailing character waits for its next bytes */
	for (size_t back = 1; back <= 3 && back <= k; back++) {
		unsigned char c = buf[k - back];
		if ((c & 0xc0) == 0x80) continue;
		size_t need = c >= 0xf0 ? 4 : c >= 0xe0 ? 3 : c >= 0xc0 ? 2 : 1;
		if (need > back) keep = k - back;
		break;
	}
	g->npend = (int)(k - keep); memcpy(g->pend, buf + keep, (size_t)g->npend);
	const char *p = (const char *)buf; size_t m = keep;
	int *started = g->in_think ? &g->started_reasoning : &g->started_content;
	while (!*started && m && (*p == '\n' || *p == ' ' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\t')) { p++; m--; }
	if (m) *started = 1;
	emit_delta(g, g->in_think ? "reasoning_content" : "content", p, m);
}
static void on_token(gen *g, uint32_t id) {
	if (id == ID_THINK_END) { g->in_think = 0; return; }
	if (tok_is_hidden(V, id)) return;   /* control and unknown tokens only: <tool_call> and </tool_call> are USER_DEFINED and are part of the answer */
	if (g->in_think ? ++g->n_reason > REASONING_MAX : ++g->n_answer > ANSWER_MAX) { g->cap_hit = 1; return; }
	char piece[256]; int n = tok_piece(V, id, piece, sizeof piece);
	if (n > 0) emit_text(g, piece, (size_t)n);
}

/* ---- images: the vision encoder daemon (flashvis) and its cache ----
   A request's image parts (data: URLs) are decoded, run through flashvis (CPU, seconds per image) and the embeddings are kept in files
   under IMGDIR keyed by a hash of the image bytes, so the images of earlier turns, which the page sends again with every question, cost nothing the
   second time. The engine reads those files (the `img` command). */
static const char *VIS_SOCK;               /* FLASHVIS_SOCK: the encoder; NULL: no images */
static char IMGDIR[200] = "/var/tmp/flash-img";
static int ID_IMGPAD = -1;
static unsigned IMG_ROWS = 0;              /* image tokens one response can hold (the engine's FLASH_MAXIMG), from `info` */
static int b64val(int c) { return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? c - 'A' : c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' ? c - 'a' + 26 : c >= '0' && c <= '9' ? c - '0' + 52 : c == '+' || c == '-' ? 62 : c == '/' || c == '_' ? 63 : -1; }
/* base64 (standard or URL alphabet, padding optional) -> bytes; returns the length or -1 */
static long b64decode(const char *s, size_t n, unsigned char *out) {
	size_t o = 0; unsigned acc = 0; int bits = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (s[i] == '=' || s[i] == '\n' || s[i] == '\r' || s[i] == ' ') continue;
		int v = b64val((unsigned char)s[i]); if (v < 0) return -1;
		acc = (acc << 6) | (unsigned)v; bits += 6;
		if (bits >= 8) { bits -= 8; out[o++] = (unsigned char)(acc >> bits); acc &= (1u << bits) - 1; }
	}
	return (long)o;
}
static unsigned long long fnv64(const unsigned char *p, size_t n) { unsigned long long h = 1469598103934665603ull; for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { h ^= p[i]; h *= 1099511628211ull; } return h ^ ((unsigned long long)n << 1); }
/* the cache file of an image (written when missing): its header gives the token count and the positions the image takes.
 * Returns 0, or an error text. */
typedef struct { char path[240]; unsigned ntok, npos; } imgrec;
static const char *vis_image(const unsigned char *bytes, size_t n, imgrec *r) {
	if (!VIS_SOCK) return "this engine was started without a vision encoder";
	char *dir = IMGDIR; mkdir(dir, 0755);
	snprintf(r->path, sizeof r->path, "%s/%016llx.bin", dir, fnv64(bytes, n));
	FILE *f = fopen(r->path, "rb"); uint32_t hd[5];
	if (f) { int ok = fread(hd, 4, 5, f) == 5; fclose(f); if (ok) { r->ntok = hd[0]; r->npos = hd[3]; utime(r->path, NULL); return NULL; } }
	int s = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0); struct sockaddr_un sa = { .sun_family = AF_UNIX }; snprintf(sa.sun_path, sizeof sa.sun_path, "%s", VIS_SOCK);
	if (s < 0 || connect(s, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa)) { if (s >= 0) close(s); return "the vision encoder is not running"; }
	char head[64]; int hn = snprintf(head, sizeof head, "enc %zu\n", n);
	if (wr(s, head, (size_t)hn) || wr(s, (const char *)bytes, n)) { close(s); return "the vision encoder closed the connection"; }
	char line[160]; size_t ll = 0;
	while (ll + 1 < sizeof line) { char c; if (recv(s, &c, 1, 0) != 1) { close(s); return "the vision encoder closed the connection"; } if (c == '\n') break; line[ll++] = c; }
	line[ll] = 0;
	unsigned ntok, nx, ny, dim; long npos;
	if (sscanf(line, "ok %u %u %u %ld %u", &ntok, &nx, &ny, &npos, &dim) != 5) { close(s); static char em[200]; snprintf(em, sizeof em, "the vision encoder: %.150s", line); return em; }
	size_t body = (size_t)ntok * dim * 4 + (size_t)ntok * 12; unsigned char *buf = malloc(body); size_t got = 0;
	while (got < body) { ssize_t k = recv(s, buf + got, body - got, 0); if (k <= 0) break; got += (size_t)k; }
	close(s);
	if (got != body || dim != 2560) { free(buf); return "the vision encoder sent a short answer"; }
	char tmp[260]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.%d.tmp", r->path, (int)getpid());
	f = fopen(tmp, "wb"); uint32_t h5[5] = { ntok, nx, ny, (uint32_t)npos, dim };
	int ok = f && fwrite(h5, 4, 5, f) == 5 && fwrite(buf, 1, body, f) == body; if (f) fclose(f);
	free(buf);
	if (!ok || rename(tmp, r->path)) { unlink(tmp); return "cannot write the image cache"; }
	r->ntok = ntok; r->npos = (unsigned)npos;
	/* keep the newest 24 files */
	{ DIR *d = opendir(dir); struct dirent *e; struct { time_t t; char name[64]; } keep[64]; int nk = 0;
	  while (d && (e = readdir(d))) { if (e->d_name[0] == '.' || strstr(e->d_name, ".tmp")) continue; struct stat st; char p[300]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name); if (stat(p, &st)) continue; if (nk < 64) { keep[nk].t = st.st_mtime; snprintf(keep[nk].name, sizeof keep[nk].name, "%s", e->d_name); nk++; } }
	  if (d) closedir(d);
	  for (int guard = 0; nk > 24 && guard < 64; guard++) { int old = 0; for (int i = 1; i < nk; i++) if (keep[i].t < keep[old].t) old = i; char p[300]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, keep[old].name); unlink(p); keep[old] = keep[--nk]; } }
	return NULL;
}

/* ---- POST /v1/chat/completions ---- */
static void chat(int fd, const char *body, size_t bn) {
	arena *a = arena_new(); const char *je = NULL;
	jv *req = json_parse(a, body, bn, &je);
	if (!req || req->k != J_DICT) { error(fd, 400, "the body is not a JSON object"); arena_free(a); return; }
	jv *msgs = jv_getz(req, "messages");
	if (!msgs || msgs->k != J_LIST || !msgs->l.n) { error(fd, 400, "messages must be a non-empty list"); arena_free(a); return; }
	/* The sampler has no penalties: the thinking-mode settings presence_penalty 0.0 and repetition_penalty 1.0 are what it does, so
	   those values are accepted and any other is refused rather than silently ignored. */
	{
		static const struct { const char *key; double fixed; } pen[] = { { "presence_penalty", 0.0 }, { "frequency_penalty", 0.0 }, { "repetition_penalty", 1.0 }, { "repeat_penalty", 1.0 } };
		for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof pen / sizeof pen[0]; i++) {
			jv *x = jv_getz(req, pen[i].key); double v = x && x->k == J_NUM ? x->d : x && x->k == J_INT ? (double)x->i : pen[i].fixed;
			if (v != pen[i].fixed) { char m[160]; snprintf(m, sizeof m, "%s is fixed at %g (the engine has no penalties)", pen[i].key, pen[i].fixed); error(fd, 400, m); arena_free(a); return; }
		}
	}
	/* Image parts: data: URLs, decoded and encoded by flashvis (cached by hash); the template only needs to see that there is an image,
	   so the data is dropped from the variables before rendering. */
	imgrec imgs[8]; int nim = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < msgs->l.n; i++) {
		jv *c = jv_getz(msgs->l.a[i], "content");
		if (!c || c->k != J_LIST) continue;
		for (int j = 0; j < c->l.n; j++) {
			jv *part = c->l.a[j], *ty = jv_getz(part, "type");
			if (!(ty && ty->k == J_STR && ((ty->s.n == 9 && !memcmp(ty->s.s, "image_url", 9)) || (ty->s.n == 5 && !memcmp(ty->s.s, "image", 5))))) continue;
			if (nim >= 8) { error(fd, 400, "at most 8 images per request"); arena_free(a); return; }
			jv *iu = jv_getz(part, "image_url"); const char *url = NULL; size_t un = 0;
			if (iu && iu->k == J_STR) { url = iu->s.s; un = iu->s.n; } else if (iu && iu->k == J_DICT) { jv *u = jv_getz(iu, "url"); if (u && u->k == J_STR) { url = u->s.s; un = u->s.n; } }
			const char *comma = url && un > 5 && !memcmp(url, "data:", 5) ? memchr(url, ',', un < 200 ? un : 200) : NULL;
			if (!comma || !memmem(url, (size_t)(comma - url), ";base64", 7)) { error(fd, 400, "an image must be a data: URL with base64 data"); arena_free(a); return; }
			unsigned char *raw = malloc(un); long rn = b64decode(comma + 1, un - (size_t)(comma + 1 - url), raw);
			if (rn <= 0) { free(raw); error(fd, 400, "the image is not valid base64"); arena_free(a); return; }
			const char *ie = vis_image(raw, (size_t)rn, &imgs[nim]); free(raw);
			if (ie) { error(fd, 503, ie); arena_free(a); return; }
			if (iu->k == J_DICT) jv_set(a, iu, "url", 3, jv_str(a, "", 0)); else jv_set(a, part, "image_url", 9, jv_str(a, "", 0));
			nim++;
		}
	}
	unsigned img_tokens = 0; for (int i = 0; i < nim; i++) img_tokens += imgs[i].ntok;
	if (img_tokens > IMG_ROWS) { char m[160]; snprintf(m, sizeof m, "the images take %u tokens; one response holds %u", img_tokens, IMG_ROWS); error(fd, 400, m); arena_free(a); return; }
	jv *vars = jv_new(a, J_DICT);
	jv_set(a, vars, "messages", 8, msgs);
	jv_set(a, vars, "add_generation_prompt", 21, jv_bool(a, 1));
	jv *tools = jv_getz(req, "tools"); if (tools && tools->k == J_LIST && tools->l.n) jv_set(a, vars, "tools", 5, tools);
	jv *kw = jv_getz(req, "chat_template_kwargs");
	jv *think = kw ? jv_getz(kw, "enable_thinking") : NULL;
	if (think && think->k == J_BOOL) jv_set(a, vars, "enable_thinking", 15, think);
	else if (!THINK_DEFAULT) jv_set(a, vars, "enable_thinking", 15, jv_bool(a, 0));
	jv *eff = kw ? jv_getz(kw, "reasoning_effort") : NULL;
	if (!eff) eff = jv_getz(req, "reasoning_effort");   /* the OpenAI spelling */
	if (eff && eff->k == J_STR) jv_set(a, vars, "reasoning_effort", 16, eff);
	double temp = DEF_TEMP, topp = DEF_TOPP; long topk = DEF_TOPK; unsigned long long seed = 0; int have_seed = 0;
	{ jv *x;
	  if ((x = jv_getz(req, "temperature")) && (x->k == J_NUM || x->k == J_INT)) temp = x->k == J_NUM ? x->d : (double)x->i;
	  if ((x = jv_getz(req, "top_p")) && (x->k == J_NUM || x->k == J_INT)) topp = x->k == J_NUM ? x->d : (double)x->i;
	  if ((x = jv_getz(req, "top_k")) && x->k == J_INT) topk = (long)x->i;
	  if ((x = jv_getz(req, "seed")) && x->k == J_INT && x->i >= 0) { seed = (unsigned long long)x->i; have_seed = 1; } }
	if (!have_seed) { struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts); seed = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec * 1000003ull ^ (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull ^ (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)body; }
	int stream = 0; jv *sv = jv_getz(req, "stream"); if (sv && sv->k == J_BOOL) stream = sv->b;
	long max_tokens = 512; jv *mt = jv_getz(req, "max_tokens"); if (!mt) mt = jv_getz(req, "max_completion_tokens");
	if (mt && mt->k == J_INT && mt->i > 0) max_tokens = (long)mt->i;

	char err[512]; size_t pn;
	char *prompt = jinja_render(TPL, a, vars, &pn, err, sizeof err);
	if (!prompt) { error(fd, 400, err); arena_free(a); return; }

	int hdr = 0; double qwait = 0;
	int qr = queue_enter(fd, stream, &hdr, &qwait);
	if (qr) {
		free(prompt); arena_free(a);
		if (qr == -1) fprintf(stderr, "flashd: the client left the queue after %.1f s\n", qwait / 1e3);
		else if (qr == -2) { fprintf(stderr, "flashd: queue full (%d waiting): 503\n", QMAX); busy(fd, "the request queue is full", 30); }
		else { fprintf(stderr, "flashd: waited %.0f s in the queue: 503\n", qwait / 1e3); if (hdr) { chunk(fd, "data: {\"error\":{\"message\":\"waited too long in the request queue\",\"type\":\"queue_timeout\"}}\n\n", 90); chunk(fd, "data: [DONE]\n\n", 14); wrs(fd, "0\r\n\r\n"); } else busy(fd, "waited too long in the request queue", 30); }
		return;
	}
	if (client_gone(fd)) { queue_leave(); free(prompt); arena_free(a); fprintf(stderr, "flashd: the client left while queued (%.1f s); not started\n", qwait / 1e3); return; }
	uint32_t *ids = malloc(4 * (pn + 16));
	int np = tok_encode(V, prompt, pn, 1, ids, (int)pn + 16);
	if (np < 1 || np + 1 >= POSITIONS) {
		queue_leave(); free(ids); free(prompt); arena_free(a);
		error(fd, 400, np < 1 ? "empty prompt" : "the prompt is longer than the engine's context"); return;
	}
	/* the engine returns n_new + 1 tokens (the one predicted at the last prompt position, then n_new more) */
	long n_new = max_tokens - 1 < POSITIONS - np ? max_tokens - 1 : POSITIONS - np;
	/* the prefix cache: the next turn of this conversation will start with this prompt up to the assistant turn it appends, so
	   render the conversation plus an assistant message and keep the tokens the two share (at least one prompt token must run) */
	int snap = 0;
	{
		jv *l2 = jv_new(a, J_LIST), *am = jv_new(a, J_DICT);
		for (int i = 0; i < msgs->l.n; i++) jv_push(a, l2, msgs->l.a[i]);
		jv_set(a, am, "role", 4, jv_str(a, "assistant", 9)); jv_set(a, am, "content", 7, jv_str(a, "x", 1)); jv_push(a, l2, am);
		jv_set(a, vars, "messages", 8, l2);
		size_t pn2; char *p2 = jinja_render(TPL, a, vars, &pn2, err, sizeof err);
		jv_set(a, vars, "messages", 8, msgs);
		if (p2) {
			uint32_t *ids2 = malloc(4 * (pn2 + 16)); int n2 = tok_encode(V, p2, pn2, 1, ids2, (int)pn2 + 16);
			int l = 0; while (l < n2 && l < np && ids2[l] == ids[l]) l++;
			snap = l < np - 1 ? l : np - 1;
			if (snap < 16) snap = 0;
			free(ids2); free(p2);
		}
	}
	/* images: every <|image_pad|> placeholder becomes one token per embedding row (the engine swaps in the embeddings), and a snapshot stops
	   before the first image */
	int istart[8] = { 0 };
	if (nim) {
		int found = 0, first_img = -1; for (int i = 0; i < np; i++) if ((int)ids[i] == ID_IMGPAD) found++;
		if (found != nim || ID_IMGPAD < 0) { queue_leave(); free(ids); free(prompt); arena_free(a); error(fd, 400, "the chat template did not place one image token per image"); return; }
		uint32_t *ex = malloc(4 * ((size_t)np + img_tokens + 16)); int k = 0, im = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < np; i++) {
			if ((int)ids[i] == ID_IMGPAD) { if (first_img < 0) first_img = i; istart[im] = k; for (unsigned q = 0; q < imgs[im].ntok; q++) ex[k++] = ids[i]; im++; }
			else ex[k++] = ids[i];
		}
		free(ids); ids = ex; np = k;
		if (snap > first_img) snap = first_img < 16 ? 0 : first_img;
		if (np + 1 >= POSITIONS) { queue_leave(); free(ids); free(prompt); arena_free(a); error(fd, 400, "the prompt is longer than the engine's context"); return; }
		n_new = max_tokens - 1 < POSITIONS - np ? max_tokens - 1 : POSITIONS - np;
	}
	FILE *out = NULL, *in = engine_open(&out);
	if (!in) { queue_leave(); free(ids); free(prompt); arena_free(a); error(fd, 500, "the engine is not running"); return; }
	fprintf(out, "stop %u %u\n", ID_END, tok_eos(V) == ID_END ? 0xffffffffu : tok_eos(V));
	fprintf(out, "sample %llu %.6g %ld %.6g\n", seed, temp, topk <= 0 ? 32 : topk, topp);
	for (int i = 0; i < nim; i++) fprintf(out, "img %s %d\n", imgs[i].path, istart[i]);
	if (snap) fprintf(out, "snap %d\n", snap);
	fprintf(out, "chat %ld", n_new); for (int i = 0; i < np; i++) fprintf(out, " %u", ids[i]); fputc('\n', out); fflush(out);
	free(ids);

	gen g = { .fd = fd, .stream = stream, .created = (long)time(NULL) };
	g.in_think = pn >= 8 && !memcmp(prompt + pn - 8, "<think>\n", 8);
	if (stream) {
		const char *h = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\r\nCache-Control: no-cache\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n";
		if (!hdr && wrs(fd, h)) g.gone = 1;
		sbuf b = {0};
		sb_printf(&b, "data: {\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{\"role\":\"assistant\",\"content\":null},\"finish_reason\":null}],\"created\":%ld,\"id\":\"chatcmpl-flash\",\"model\":\"%s\",\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\"}\n\n", g.created, NAME);
		if (!g.gone && chunk(fd, b.s, b.n)) g.gone = 1;
		sb_free(&b);
	}
	char line[256]; int quiet = 0, ngen = 0, ended = 0, resumed = 0, snapped = 0, done = 0, failed = 0; double run_ms = 0, first_ms = 0;
	/* a long prompt takes minutes before the first token: an idle stream is cut by proxies (Cloudflare closes after 100 s), so an SSE comment goes out
	   every 10 s while the engine is silent */
	{ struct timeval tv = { 2, 0 }; setsockopt(fileno(in), SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof tv); }
	for (;;) {
		if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, in)) {
			if ((errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) && !g.gone) { clearerr(in); if (client_gone(fd)) { g.gone = 1; break; } if (stream && ++quiet >= 5) { quiet = 0; if (chunk(fd, ": keepalive\n\n", 13)) { g.gone = 1; break; } } continue; }
			break;
		}
		unsigned id; int e, npm; double r, f;
		if (sscanf(line, "tok %u", &id) == 1) { on_token(&g, id); if (g.gone || g.cap_hit) break; }
		else if (sscanf(line, "done %d %d %d %lf %lf %d %d", &ngen, &e, &npm, &r, &f, &resumed, &snapped) >= 5) { ended = e; run_ms = r; first_ms = f; done = 1; break; }
		else if (!strncmp(line, "error", 5)) { fprintf(stderr, "flashd: engine: %s", line); failed = 1; break; }
	}
	if (!done && !g.gone && !g.cap_hit) failed = 1;   /* the engine's stream ended without its "done" line: the response is not complete */
	fclose(in); fclose(out);
	queue_leave();
	free(prompt);
	if (failed) {   /* an engine error or an engine that went away is an error to the client, not a normal completion with finish_reason "length" */
		fprintf(stderr, "flashd: the engine failed during the response (%ld reasoning + %ld answer tokens had been generated)\n", g.n_reason, g.n_answer);
		if (stream) {
			if (!g.gone) {
				sbuf b = {0};
				sb_puts(&b, "data: {\"error\":{\"message\":\"the engine failed during the response\",\"type\":\"engine_error\"}}\n\n");
				chunk(fd, b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
				chunk(fd, "data: [DONE]\n\n", 14); wrs(fd, "0\r\n\r\n");
			}
		} else error(fd, 502, "the engine failed during the response");
		sb_free(&g.content); sb_free(&g.reasoning); arena_free(a);
		return;
	}

	if (g.gone) fprintf(stderr, "flashd: client left after %d bytes of text; the engine is told to stop\n", (int)(g.content.n + g.reasoning.n));
	double pp = first_ms > 0 ? (np - resumed) / (first_ms / 1e3) : 0, dec_ms = run_ms - first_ms, dec = (ngen > 1 && dec_ms > 0) ? (ngen - 1) / (dec_ms / 1e3) : 0;
	sbuf t = {0};
	sb_printf(&t, "{\"prompt_n\":%d,\"cache_n\":%d,\"prompt_ms\":%.1f,\"prompt_per_second\":%.2f,\"predicted_n\":%d,\"predicted_ms\":%.1f,\"predicted_per_second\":%.2f,\"decode_intervals\":%d,\"decode_ms\":%.1f}", np, resumed, first_ms, pp, ngen, dec_ms > 0 ? dec_ms : 0, dec, ngen > 1 ? ngen - 1 : 0, dec_ms > 0 ? dec_ms : 0);   /* predicted_per_second = decode_intervals / decode_ms: the time after the first generated token, over the G - 1 tokens after it; predicted_n is all G */
	const char *fin = ended ? "stop" : "length";
	fprintf(stderr, "flashd: %d prompt (%d from the cache, snapshot at %d) + %d generated tokens, %.1f ms (first %.1f), %s, pp %.1f decode %.1f tok/s, queued %.1f s\n", np, resumed, snapped, ngen, run_ms, first_ms, fin, pp, dec, qwait / 1e3);
	if (stream) {
		if (!g.gone) {
			sbuf b = {0};
			sb_printf(&b, "data: {\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"delta\":{},\"finish_reason\":\"%s\"}],\"created\":%ld,\"id\":\"chatcmpl-flash\",\"model\":\"%s\",\"object\":\"chat.completion.chunk\",\"usage\":{\"completion_tokens\":%d,\"prompt_tokens\":%d,\"total_tokens\":%d},\"timings\":%s}\n\n", fin, g.created, NAME, ngen, np, ngen + np, t.s);
			chunk(fd, b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
			chunk(fd, "data: [DONE]\n\n", 14); wrs(fd, "0\r\n\r\n");
		}
	} else {
		sbuf b = {0};
		sb_puts(&b, "{\"choices\":[{\"index\":0,\"finish_reason\":\""); sb_puts(&b, fin); sb_puts(&b, "\",\"message\":{\"role\":\"assistant\",\"content\":");
		sb_json_str(&b, g.content.s ? g.content.s : "", g.content.n);
		if (g.reasoning.n) { sb_puts(&b, ",\"reasoning_content\":"); sb_json_str(&b, g.reasoning.s, g.reasoning.n); }
		sb_printf(&b, "}}],\"created\":%ld,\"id\":\"chatcmpl-flash\",\"model\":\"%s\",\"object\":\"chat.completion\",\"usage\":{\"completion_tokens\":%d,\"prompt_tokens\":%d,\"total_tokens\":%d},\"timings\":%s}", g.created, NAME, ngen, np, ngen + np, t.s);
		reply(fd, 200, "application/json", b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
	}
	sb_free(&t); sb_free(&g.content); sb_free(&g.reasoning); arena_free(a);
}

/* ---- HTTP ---- */
static void *serve(void *arg) {
	int fd = (int)(long)arg; struct timeval tv = { 30, 0 };
	setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof tv);
	setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof tv);   /* a client that stops reading must not hold the engine lock: a send that blocks 30 s fails and the response is dropped */
	char *req = malloc(1 << 16); size_t n = 0; char *hend = NULL;
	while (!hend && n < (1 << 16) - 1) {
		ssize_t k = recv(fd, req + n, (1 << 16) - 1 - n, 0); if (k <= 0) { free(req); close(fd); return NULL; }
		n += (size_t)k; req[n] = 0; hend = strstr(req, "\r\n\r\n");
	}
	if (!hend) { error(fd, 400, "bad request"); free(req); close(fd); return NULL; }
	size_t hl = (size_t)(hend - req) + 4, clen = 0;
	for (char *p = req; p < hend; p = strchr(p, '\n') ? strchr(p, '\n') + 1 : hend)
		if (!strncasecmp(p, "content-length:", 15)) clen = (size_t)strtoull(p + 15, NULL, 10);
	if (clen > (128u << 20)) { error(fd, 413, "request too large"); free(req); close(fd); return NULL; }
	char *body = malloc(clen + 1); size_t have = n - hl > clen ? clen : n - hl; memcpy(body, req + hl, have);
	while (have < clen) { ssize_t k = recv(fd, body + have, clen - have, 0); if (k <= 0) break; have += (size_t)k; }
	body[have] = 0;
	char method[16] = "", path[256] = ""; sscanf(req, "%15s %255s", method, path);
	char *q = strchr(path, '?'); if (q) *q = 0;
	if (!strcmp(method, "GET") && !strcmp(path, "/health")) reply(fd, 200, "application/json", "{\"status\":\"ok\"}", 15);
	else if (!strcmp(method, "GET") && !strcmp(path, "/queue")) {
		char q[96]; pthread_mutex_lock(&QM); int k = snprintf(q, sizeof q, "{\"running\":%d,\"waiting\":%d,\"max\":%d}", QBUSY, QLEN, QMAX); pthread_mutex_unlock(&QM);
		reply(fd, 200, "application/json", q, (size_t)k);
	}
	else if (!strcmp(method, "GET") && !strcmp(path, "/v1/models")) {
		sbuf b = {0}; sb_puts(&b, "{\"object\":\"list\",\"data\":[{\"id\":"); sb_json_str(&b, NAME, strlen(NAME)); sb_puts(&b, ",\"object\":\"model\",\"created\":0,\"owned_by\":\"flashd\"}]}");
		reply(fd, 200, "application/json", b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
	} else if (!strcmp(method, "GET") && !strcmp(path, "/props")) {
		sbuf b = {0}; const char *t = tok_template(V);
		sb_printf(&b, "{\"default_generation_settings\":{\"n_ctx\":%d,\"temperature\":%g,\"top_k\":%d,\"top_p\":%g,\"presence_penalty\":0.0,\"repeat_penalty\":1.0,\"max_reasoning_tokens\":%ld,\"max_answer_tokens\":%ld},\"modalities\":{\"vision\":%s},\"model_alias\":", POSITIONS, DEF_TEMP, DEF_TOPK, DEF_TOPP, REASONING_MAX, ANSWER_MAX, VIS_SOCK ? "true" : "false"); sb_json_str(&b, NAME, strlen(NAME));
		sb_puts(&b, ",\"chat_template\":"); sb_json_str(&b, t ? t : "", t ? strlen(t) : 0); sb_putc(&b, '}');
		reply(fd, 200, "application/json", b.s, b.n); sb_free(&b);
	} else if (!strcmp(method, "POST") && !strcmp(path, "/v1/chat/completions")) chat(fd, body, have);
	else error(fd, 404, "not found");
	free(body); free(req); close(fd);
	return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: flashd <shard-1.gguf> <flash-socket> <host:port>\n"); return 2; }
	signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
	SOCK = argv[2];
	if (getenv("FLASHD_NAME")) NAME = getenv("FLASHD_NAME");
	if (getenv("FLASHD_THINKING")) THINK_DEFAULT = atoi(getenv("FLASHD_THINKING"));
	if (getenv("FLASHD_QUEUE_MAX")) QMAX = atoi(getenv("FLASHD_QUEUE_MAX"));
	if (getenv("FLASHD_QUEUE_WAIT_S")) QWAIT_S = atoi(getenv("FLASHD_QUEUE_WAIT_S"));
	V = tok_load(argv[1]); if (!V) return 1;
	VIS_SOCK = getenv("FLASHVIS_SOCK"); if (getenv("FLASHD_IMGDIR")) snprintf(IMGDIR, sizeof IMGDIR, "%s", getenv("FLASHD_IMGDIR"));
	ID_IMGPAD = tok_find(V, "<|image_pad|>");
	{ double x; if (!tok_meta_num(V, "general.sampling.temp", &x)) DEF_TEMP = x; if (!tok_meta_num(V, "general.sampling.top_p", &x)) DEF_TOPP = x; if (!tok_meta_num(V, "general.sampling.top_k", &x)) DEF_TOPK = (int)x;
	  if (getenv("FLASHD_GREEDY")) DEF_TEMP = 0.0; }
	const char *ts = tok_template(V); char err[512];
	if (!ts) { fprintf(stderr, "%s has no chat template\n", argv[1]); return 1; }
	TPL = jinja_compile(ts, strlen(ts), err, sizeof err);
	if (!TPL) { fprintf(stderr, "chat template: %s\n", err); return 1; }
	int e = tok_find(V, "<|im_end|>"), te = tok_find(V, "</think>");
	if (e < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "no <|im_end|> token\n"); return 1; }
	ID_END = (uint32_t)e; ID_THINK_END = te < 0 ? 0xffffffffu : (uint32_t)te;
	FILE *out = NULL, *in = engine_open(&out);
	if (!in) { fprintf(stderr, "cannot reach the engine at %s\n", SOCK); return 1; }
	fprintf(out, "info\n"); fflush(out);
	char line[128]; if (fgets(line, sizeof line, in) && sscanf(line, "info %d %u", &POSITIONS, &IMG_ROWS) >= 1) {} else { fprintf(stderr, "engine did not answer info\n"); return 1; }
	fclose(in); fclose(out);

	char host[128]; int port;
	if (sscanf(argv[3], "%127[^:]:%d", host, &port) != 2) { fprintf(stderr, "listen address must be host:port\n"); return 2; }
	int ls = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0), one = 1; setsockopt(ls, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &one, sizeof one);
	struct sockaddr_in sa = { .sin_family = AF_INET, .sin_port = htons((uint16_t)port) }; inet_pton(AF_INET, host, &sa.sin_addr);
	if (bind(ls, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa) || listen(ls, 64)) { perror(argv[3]); return 1; }
	fprintf(stderr, "flashd: %s, %d positions, sampling defaults from the GGUF: temp %g top_k %d top_p %g%s, listening on %s\n", NAME, POSITIONS, DEF_TEMP, DEF_TOPK, DEF_TOPP, DEF_TEMP > 0 ? "" : " (greedy)", argv[3]);
	for (;;) {
		int c = accept(ls, NULL, NULL); if (c < 0) { if (errno != EINTR) perror("accept"); continue; }
		pthread_t th; if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, serve, (void *)(long)c)) { close(c); continue; }
		pthread_detach(th);
	}
}


File: kern/flashvis.c
/* flashvis: the vision encoder of the chat engine, a small daemon around llama.cpp's libmtmd (MIT) running the
 * Qwen3.8-Flash-Next projector (mmproj: ViT 1152 x 27, patch 16, merge 2, no deepstack) on the CPU.
 *
 *   flashvis <mmproj.gguf> <text.gguf> <socket> [threads]
 *
 * The text model is opened vocab-only (mtmd wants it for the embedding width and the special tokens). One client at a
 * time; each request is
 *     enc <nbytes>\n<image file bytes: jpeg / png / bmp / gif ...>
 * and the answer
 *     ok <ntok> <nx> <ny> <npos> <dim>\n   then ntok x dim float32 (the embeddings that replace the <|image_pad|> tokens) and
 *     ntok x 3 uint32 (t, y, x: the M-RoPE position of each token relative to the position of the first one)
 * or  err <message>\n. npos is the number of sequence positions the image occupies (max(nx, ny)): the text after it
 * continues at the first position + npos. The image is resized by the projector's own preprocessing (patch 16, merge 2,
 * pixels within the model's image_min / image_max tokens, see kern/vision/preprocessor_config.json). */
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include "llama.h"
#include "mtmd.h"
#include "mtmd-helper.h"
#include <errno.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static double now(void) { struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts); return ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9; }
static int read_full(int fd, void *buf, size_t n) { uint8_t *p = buf; while (n) { ssize_t r = read(fd, p, n); if (r <= 0) { if (r < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue; return -1; } p += r; n -= (size_t)r; } return 0; }
static int write_full(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n) { const uint8_t *p = buf; while (n) { ssize_t r = write(fd, p, n); if (r <= 0) { if (r < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue; return -1; } p += r; n -= (size_t)r; } return 0; }
static int read_line(int fd, char *line, size_t cap) {
	size_t n = 0;
	for (;;) { char c; ssize_t r = read(fd, &c, 1); if (r <= 0) return -1; if (c == '\n') break; if (n + 1 < cap) line[n++] = c; }
	line[n] = 0; return 0;
}
static void err(int fd, const char *msg) { char b[300]; int n = snprintf(b, sizeof b, "err %s\n", msg); write_full(fd, b, (size_t)n); }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: flashvis <mmproj.gguf> <text.gguf> <socket> [threads]\n"); return 2; }
	signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
	int threads = argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 8;
	llama_backend_init();
	struct llama_model_params mp = llama_model_default_params();
	mp.vocab_only = true;
	struct llama_model *model = llama_model_load_from_file(argv[2], mp);
	if (!model) { fprintf(stderr, "flashvis: cannot load %s (vocab only)\n", argv[2]); return 1; }
	struct mtmd_context_params cp = mtmd_context_params_default();
	cp.use_gpu = false; cp.n_threads = threads; cp.print_timings = false; cp.warmup = false;
	mtmd_context *ctx = mtmd_init_from_file(argv[1], model, cp);
	if (!ctx) { fprintf(stderr, "flashvis: cannot load the projector %s\n", argv[1]); return 1; }
	if (!mtmd_support_vision(ctx)) { fprintf(stderr, "flashvis: %s has no vision encoder\n", argv[1]); return 1; }
	int dim = (int)llama_model_n_embd_inp(model); if (dim <= 0) dim = 2560;   /* a vocab-only model does not know it: the projector writes the text embedding width (clip.vision.projection_dim) */
	fprintf(stderr, "flashvis: ready, embedding width %d, %d threads, mrope %d\n", dim, threads, (int)mtmd_decode_use_mrope(ctx));
	int ls = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
	struct sockaddr_un sa = { .sun_family = AF_UNIX }; snprintf(sa.sun_path, sizeof sa.sun_path, "%s", argv[3]);
	unlink(argv[3]);
	if (bind(ls, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa) || listen(ls, 4)) { perror(argv[3]); return 1; }
	for (;;) {
		int fd = accept(ls, NULL, NULL);
		if (fd < 0) { if (errno == EINTR) continue; perror("accept"); return 1; }
		char line[256];
		while (read_line(fd, line, sizeof line) == 0) {
			size_t nbytes = 0;
			if (sscanf(line, "enc %zu", &nbytes) != 1 || nbytes == 0 || nbytes > ((size_t)64 << 20)) { err(fd, "bad request"); break; }
			uint8_t *buf = malloc(nbytes);
			if (!buf || read_full(fd, buf, nbytes)) { free(buf); break; }
			double t0 = now();
			struct mtmd_helper_bitmap_wrapper bw = mtmd_helper_bitmap_init_from_buf(ctx, buf, nbytes, false, mtmd_helper_init_opt_default());
			mtmd_bitmap *bm = bw.bitmap;
			free(buf);
			if (!bm) { err(fd, "cannot decode the image"); continue; }
			mtmd_input_text text = { .text = mtmd_default_marker(), .text_len = strlen(mtmd_default_marker()), .add_special = false, .parse_special = false };
			mtmd_input_chunks *chunks = mtmd_input_chunks_init();
			const mtmd_bitmap *bms[1] = { bm };
			int rc = mtmd_tokenize(ctx, chunks, &text, bms, 1);
			if (rc) { mtmd_bitmap_free(bm); mtmd_input_chunks_free(chunks); err(fd, "preprocessing failed"); continue; }
			const mtmd_input_chunk *img = NULL;
			for (size_t i = 0; i < mtmd_input_chunks_size(chunks); i++) { const mtmd_input_chunk *c = mtmd_input_chunks_get(chunks, i); if (mtmd_input_chunk_get_type(c) == MTMD_INPUT_CHUNK_TYPE_IMAGE) img = c; }
			if (!img) { mtmd_bitmap_free(bm); mtmd_input_chunks_free(chunks); err(fd, "no image chunk"); continue; }
			size_t ntok = mtmd_input_chunk_get_n_tokens(img); long npos = (long)mtmd_input_chunk_get_n_pos(img);
			const mtmd_image_tokens *it = mtmd_input_chunk_get_tokens_image(img);
			double t1 = now();
			if (mtmd_encode_chunk(ctx, img)) { mtmd_bitmap_free(bm); mtmd_input_chunks_free(chunks); err(fd, "encoding failed"); continue; }
			float *emb = mtmd_get_output_embd(ctx);
			uint32_t *pos = malloc(12 * ntok);
			unsigned nx = 0, ny = 0;
			for (size_t i = 0; i < ntok; i++) { struct mtmd_decoder_pos p = mtmd_image_tokens_get_decoder_pos(it, 0, i); pos[3 * i] = p.t; pos[3 * i + 1] = p.y; pos[3 * i + 2] = p.x; if (p.x + 1 > nx) nx = p.x + 1; if (p.y + 1 > ny) ny = p.y + 1; }
			char hdr[128]; int hn = snprintf(hdr, sizeof hdr, "ok %zu %u %u %ld %d\n", ntok, nx, ny, npos, dim);
			int bad = write_full(fd, hdr, (size_t)hn) || write_full(fd, emb, 4 * (size_t)dim * ntok) || write_full(fd, pos, 12 * ntok);
			fprintf(stderr, "flashvis: %ux%u image -> %zu tokens (%ux%u grid, %ld positions): preprocess %.0f ms, encode %.1f s\n", mtmd_bitmap_get_nx(bm), mtmd_bitmap_get_ny(bm), ntok, nx, ny, npos, (t1 - t0) * 1e3, now() - t1);
			free(pos); mtmd_bitmap_free(bm); mtmd_input_chunks_free(chunks);
			if (bad) break;
		}
		close(fd);
	}
}


File: kern/fmath.pl
# fmath.pl: SASS emitters for the transcendentals, built only from IEEE fp32
# FADD/FMUL/FFMA, FMNMX, F2I and the rcp_rn sequence, so ref/fmath.c is a
# bit-exact twin. Loaded from a generator's <CODE> block with
#     require './fmath.pl';
# Every emitter returns SASS text whose instructions carry stall 6 (every op
# depends on the previous one); callers interleave independent work if they
# care. Constants live in registers named by the %C hash (see fm_consts).
#
#   fm_consts(\%C)                        MOV32I the constants into their registers
#   fm_exp($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, \%C)  dst = exp(clamp(x, -87, 87)); x is left clamped
#   fm_rcp($dst, $x, $t1, \%C)            dst = 1/x (IEEE for normal x < 2^125)
#   fm_sigmoid($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, \%C)
#   fm_silu($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, $t5, \%C)   (x must differ from the temps)
#   fm_log1p($dst, $e, $t1, $t2, $t3, \%C)   log(1 + e), e in [0, 1]
#   fm_softplus($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, $t5, \%C)

use strict;
use warnings;

our %FM_CONST = (
    log2e => 0x3fb8aa3b, ln2hi => 0x3f317200, ln2lo => 0x35bfbe8e,
    c720 => 0x3ab60b61, c120 => 0x3c088889, c24 => 0x3d2aaaab, c6 => 0x3e2aaaab,
    c11 => 0x3dba2e8c, c9 => 0x3de38e39, c7 => 0x3e124925, c5 => 0x3e4ccccd, c3 => 0x3eaaaaab,
    mneg1 => 0xbf800000, chalf => 0x3f000000, cone => 0x3f800000,
);

sub fm_consts {
    my ($C) = @_;
    my $o = '';
    for my $k (sort keys %$C) {
        die "fm_consts: unknown constant $k" unless exists $FM_CONST{$k};
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I %s, 0x%08x;\n", $C->{$k}, $FM_CONST{$k};
    }
    return $o;
}

# dst = 1/x: MUFU.RCP + one Newton step (needs $C->{mneg1})
sub fm_rcp {
    my ($dst, $x, $t1, $C) = @_;
    my $o = '';
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RCP %s, %s;\n", $dst, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "04:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $x, $dst, $C->{mneg1};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ %s, -%s, -RZ;\n", $t1, $t1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $dst, $dst, $t1, $dst;
    return $o;
}

# dst = exp(x) with x clamped to [-87, 88] in place. Temps: t1 (t/p), t2 (n/ni), t3 (r).
sub fm_exp {
    my ($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $C) = @_;
    my $o = '';
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX %s, %s, 87, PT;\n", $x, $x;            # min
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX %s, %s, -87, !PT;\n", $x, $x;          # max
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $x, $C->{log2e};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, 12582912;\n", $t2, $t1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, -12582912;\n", $t2, $t2;        # n = rint(t)
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, -%s, %s;\n", $t3, $t2, $C->{ln2hi}, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, -%s, %s;\n", $t3, $t2, $C->{ln2lo}, $t3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $C->{c720}, $t3, $C->{c120};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $t1, $t3, $C->{c24};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $t1, $t3, $C->{c6};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $t1, $t3, $C->{chalf};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $t1, $t3, $C->{cone};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $t1, $t3, $C->{cone};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:3:-:2      F2I.S32.F32 %s, %s;\n", $t2, $t2;
    $o .= sprintf "04:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, 0x7f;\n", $t2, $t2;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x17;\n", $t2, $t2;              # bits of 2^n
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $dst, $t1, $t2;
    return $o;
}

# dst = sigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x)); x is preserved. Temps t1..t4.
sub fm_sigmoid {
    my ($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, $C) = @_;
    my $o = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, -%s, RZ;\n", $t4, $x;
    $o .= fm_exp($t4, $t4, $t1, $t2, $t3, $C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, 1;\n", $t4, $t4;
    $o .= fm_rcp($dst, $t4, $t1, $C);
    return $o;
}

sub fm_silu {
    my ($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, $t5, $C) = @_;
    my $o = fm_sigmoid($t5, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, $C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $dst, $x, $t5;
    return $o;
}

# dst = log(1 + e), e in [0, 1]: u = e / (2 + e), 2u (1 + u^2/3 + ... + u^10/11). Temps t1..t3.
sub fm_log1p {
    my ($dst, $e, $t1, $t2, $t3, $C) = @_;
    my $o = '';
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, 2;\n", $t1, $e;
    $o .= fm_rcp($t2, $t1, $t3, $C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $t1, $e, $t2;             # u
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $t2, $t1, $t1;            # u^2
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t3, $C->{c11}, $t2, $C->{c9};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t3, $t3, $t2, $C->{c7};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t3, $t3, $t2, $C->{c5};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t3, $t3, $t2, $C->{c3};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $t3, $t3, $t2, $C->{cone};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, 2;\n", $t1, $t1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $dst, $t1, $t3;
    return $o;
}

# dst = softplus(x) = max(x, 0) + log1p(exp(-|x|)); x preserved. Temps t1..t5.
sub fm_softplus {
    my ($dst, $x, $t1, $t2, $t3, $t4, $t5, $C) = @_;
    my $o = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, -|%s|, RZ;\n", $t4, $x;
    $o .= fm_exp($t4, $t4, $t1, $t2, $t3, $C);
    $o .= fm_log1p($t5, $t4, $t1, $t2, $t3, $C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX %s, %s, RZ, !PT;\n", $t1, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, %s;\n", $dst, $t1, $t5;
    return $o;
}

# In-place exp: x = exp(clamp(x)); only two temps, so several chains can be
# interleaved with fm_zip. Same operations as fm_exp (bit-identical results).
sub fm_exp_ip {
    my ($x, $ta, $tb, $C) = @_;
    my $o = '';
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX %s, %s, 87, PT;\n", $x, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX %s, %s, -87, !PT;\n", $x, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $x, $C->{log2e};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, 12582912;\n", $tb, $ta;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD %s, %s, -12582912;\n", $tb, $tb;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, -%s, %s;\n", $x, $tb, $C->{ln2hi}, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, -%s, %s;\n", $x, $tb, $C->{ln2lo}, $x;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $C->{c720}, $x, $C->{c120};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $ta, $x, $C->{c24};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $ta, $x, $C->{c6};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $ta, $x, $C->{chalf};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $ta, $x, $C->{cone};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA %s, %s, %s, %s;\n", $ta, $ta, $x, $C->{cone};
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:3:-:2      F2I.S32.F32 %s, %s;\n", $tb, $tb;
    $o .= sprintf "04:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, 0x7f;\n", $tb, $tb;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x17;\n", $tb, $tb;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL %s, %s, %s;\n", $x, $ta, $tb;
    return $o;
}

# Interleave independent instruction chains (strings of equal length) round
# robin, lowering the per-instruction stall so each chain still sees >= 6
# cycles between its own instructions. Barrier waits are kept.
sub fm_zip {
    my @chains = map { [ split /\n/, $_ ] } @_;
    my $n = @chains;
    my $stall = $n >= 6 ? 1 : $n >= 3 ? 2 : $n >= 2 ? 3 : 6;
    my $o = '';
    for my $i (0 .. $#{$chains[0]}) {
        for my $k (0 .. $#chains) {
            my $l = $chains[$k][$i];
            my $s = $stall;
            # the last chain's copy of a variable-latency op sits right before the next
            # line, which may wait on it: stall >= 2 or the wait can miss it
            $s = 2 if $k == $#chains && $s < 2 && $l =~ /\b(SHFL|MUFU|F2I|F2F|LDG|LDS|I2F)\b/;
            $l =~ s/^(..:.:.:.:)(\d)/$1$s/ if $n > 1;
            $o .= "$l\n";
        }
    }
    return $o;
}

1;

# Kernel: fmath
#
# Test driver for fmath.pl: one warp applies exp, sigmoid, SiLU and softplus to
# the 2560 elements of X (lane l owns the 4-element chunks at 4 (l + 32 j)) and
# stores four result vectors. Compared bit for bit with ref/fmath.c.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 X  1:0x148:8 E  2:0x150:8 S  3:0x158:8 L  4:0x160:8 P

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_E0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_E1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_S0 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_S1 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_L0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_L1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_P0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_P1 : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-3   : x<0-3>
    4-7   : e<0-3>
    8-11  : s<0-3>
    12-15 : l<0-3>
    16-19 : p<0-3>
    20-26 : t<1-7>
    27    : log2e
    28    : ln2hi
    29    : ln2lo
    30    : c720
    31    : c120
    32    : c24
    33    : c6
    34    : c11
    35    : c9
    36    : c7
    37    : c5
    38    : c3
    39    : mneg1
    40    : tid
    41    : it
    42    : xc
    43    : chalf
    54    : cone
    44,45 : xp<0-1>
    46,47 : ep<0-1>
    48,49 : sp<0-1>
    50,51 : lp<0-1>
    52,53 : pp<0-1>

        $o .= fm_silu("l$k", "x$k", 't1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', \%C);
        $o .= fm_softplus("p$k", "x$k", 't1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', \%C);
    }
    $o .= "--:4:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [ep], e0;\n";
    $o .= "--:4:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [sp], s0;\n";
    $o .= "--:4:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [lp], l0;\n";
    $o .= "--:4:-:-:6      STG.E.128 [pp], p0;\n";
    for my $r (qw(xp ep sp lp pp)) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, %s0, 0x200;\n", $r, $r;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, %s1, RZ;\n", $r, $r;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "08:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/fmath_test.c
/* fmath_test: exp/sigmoid/SiLU/softplus from kern/fmath.pl against ref/fmath.c, bit for bit, on 2560 inputs. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "fmath.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 17;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(void) {
	int n = 2560;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "fmath.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "fmath"));
	CUdeviceptr d[5];
	for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) CK(cuMemAlloc(&d[i], 4 * n));
	float *x = malloc(4 * n), *out[4], *ref[4];
	for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { out[i] = malloc(4 * n); ref[i] = malloc(4 * n); }
	const char *names[4] = { "exp", "sigmoid", "silu", "softplus" };
	const float mags[] = { 1.f, 8.f, 30.f, 100.f, 0.01f };
	int fails = 0;
	for (unsigned m = 0; m < sizeof mags / sizeof mags[0]; m++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = mags[m] * frand();
		x[0] = 0.f; x[1] = -0.f; x[2] = 87.f; x[3] = -87.f; x[4] = 1e-7f; x[5] = -1e-7f;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { ref[0][i] = exp_gpu(x[i]); ref[1][i] = sigmoid_gpu(x[i]); ref[2][i] = silu_gpu(x[i]); ref[3][i] = softplus_gpu(x[i]); }
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d[0], x, 4 * n));
		for (int i = 1; i < 5; i++) CK(cuMemsetD32(d[i], 0x7fc00000u, n));
		void *params[] = { &d[0], &d[1], &d[2], &d[3], &d[4] };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 1, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out[i], d[i + 1], 4 * n));
		int bad[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
		double maxrel[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
		for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			if (memcmp(&out[f][i], &ref[f][i], 4)) { if (bad[f] < 2) printf("  %s(%.9g): gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", names[f], x[i], out[f][i], ref[f][i]); bad[f]++; }
			double lib = f == 0 ? exp(x[i]) : f == 1 ? 1 / (1 + exp(-x[i])) : f == 2 ? x[i] / (1 + exp(-x[i])) : log1p(exp(-fabs(x[i]))) + (x[i] > 0 ? x[i] : 0);
			double rel = lib != 0 ? fabs(ref[f][i] - lib) / fabs(lib) : fabs(ref[f][i]);
			if (rel > maxrel[f]) maxrel[f] = rel;
		}
		printf("mag %-5g:", mags[m]);
		for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) printf(" %s %s (vs libm %.1e)", names[f], bad[f] ? "MISMATCH" : "exact", maxrel[f]);
		printf("\n");
		for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) if (bad[f]) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/gemv_b32.sass
# Kernel: gemv_b32 (assembled as gemv_q4_0 / gemv_q5_0 / gemv_q8_0 / gemv_iq4_nl)
#
# Block-32 formats at K = 640 (ffn_down_shexp): GEMV_FMT selects the format.
# Tile (ref/quant.h repack_b32): per row [prefix 48 B: fp16 d of the 20 blocks]
# [per block 16 B nibbles (element 2i low / 2i+1 high) or 32 B int8 (Q8_0)]
# [Q5_0: 20 x 4 B high-bit words, bit e = element e].
# Element value: Q4_0 d (q - 8), Q5_0 d (q - 16), Q8_0 d q, IQ4_NL d kvalues[q].
#
# 4 lanes per row (64 rows per CTA, 8 per warp); lane l owns blocks l + 4 i,
# i = 0..4, and keeps those 160 activations (int16) in registers. Per block:
#   Q4_0 / Q5_0: the Q4_K nibble stream with -8 (-16) sum32 folded into the first
#     XMAD; Q5_0 adds the Q5_K high-bit stream, dot += dh << 4
#   Q8_0: PRMT sign-extends byte pairs to int16, XMAD.S16.S16 into 8 accumulators
#   IQ4_NL: the IQ4_XS PRMT table lookup
#   accf = fma(d, (float)dot, accf)
# then a 4-lane SHFL butterfly, lane 0 stores accf * xs. gemv_b32_ref mirrors it.
#
# Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = store reads and prologue loads, 3 = I2F, 4 = F2F,
# 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 W  1:0x148:8 X16  2:0x150:8 S32  3:0x158:8 Y
#         4:0x160:4 rows  5:0x164:4 xs  6:0x168:8 dbg

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    gridDimX   : c[0x0][0x14]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_S0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_S1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_rows : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_xs   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_D0   : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_D1   : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x174]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $fmt = $ENV{GEMV_FMT} || 'q4_0';
    my $n = 5;
    my $nw = $fmt eq 'q8_0' ? 8 : 4;        # data words per block
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= "    0-79 : act<00-79>\n";
    my $r = 80;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : nb<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + $nw*$n - 1, $nw*$n - 1;   # 4-aligned
    $r += $nw * $n;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : dp<0-4>\n", $r, $r + 4;
    $r += 5;
    if ($fmt eq 'q5_0') { $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : qh<0-4>\n", $r, $r + 4; $r += 5; }
    if ($fmt eq 'q4_0' || $fmt eq 'q5_0') {
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : ns<0-4>\n", $r, $r + 4; $r += 5;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : m<00-07>\n", $r, $r + 7; $r += 8;
    }
    for my $k (0..7) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acc%d\n", $r + (($k + 1) & 7), $k; }
    $r += 8;
    if ($fmt eq 'q5_0') {
        for my $k (0..7) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acch%d\n", $r + (($k + 1) & 7), $k; }
        $r += 8;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : hs<1-3>\n", $r, $r + 2; $r += 3;
    }
    if ($fmt eq 'iq4_nl') {
        my $T = $r;
        for my $name (qw(tt x0 x1 lo hi mk lo2 hi2 mk2)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : %s<0-3>\n", $r, $r + 3, $name; $r += 4; }
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : mb<0-7>\n", $r, $r + 7; $r += 8;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : R<0-7>\n", $T, $T + 7;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : p<00-15>\n", $T + 12, $T + 27;
        for my $name (qw(tl0 tl1 th0 th1 t7f)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    }
    if ($fmt eq 'q8_0') { $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : p<00-15>\n", $r, $r + 15; $r += 16; }
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : as<0-4>\n", $r, $r + 4; $r += 5;
    for my $name (qw(dot dh dotf dd accf t u row rowpair rowstep stepw yold xsv)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    $r += $r & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : pp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : np<0-1>\n    %d,%d : hp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n",
        $r, $r+1, $r+2, $r+3, $r+4, $r+5, $r+6, $r+7;
    # prologue temporaries alias the data registers (dead before the loop)
    $o .= "    80,81 : xp<0-1>\n    82,83 : zp<0-1>\n";
    $o .= "    90,91 : ap<0-1>\n";
    $o .= "    84 : lane\n    85 : grp\n    86 : tid\n    87 : bid\n    88 : off\n    89 : t1p\n";
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;

<CODE>
    my $fmt = $ENV{GEMV_FMT} || 'q4_0';
    my $K = 640;
    my $B = 20;
    my $L = 4;
    my $n = 5;
    my $R = 64;                             # rows per CTA iteration
    my $bb = $fmt eq 'q8_0' ? 32 : 16;      # data bytes per block
    my $S = 48 + $bb * $B + ($fmt eq 'q5_0' ? 4 * $B : 0);
    my $nw = $bb / 4;
    my $nsum = $fmt eq 'q4_0' ? 3 : $fmt eq 'q5_0' ? 4 : 0;   # log2 of the offset
    my @kv = (-127, -104, -83, -65, -49, -35, -22, -10, 1, 13, 25, 38, 53, 69, 89, 113);
    my $tw = sub { my $k = shift; my $w = 0; $w |= ($kv[4*$k + $_] & 0xff) << (8*$_) for 0..3; return $w; };
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $rr, $cst) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $cst & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $first;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $x;
    };
    my $o = '';
    my $acc = $ENV{GEMV_ACC} ? 1 : 0;        # y[r] = fma(*D, dot, y[r]) (shared expert down)
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    if ($acc) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV xp0, param_D0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV xp1, param_D1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDG.E xsv, [xp];\n";
    }
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rowpair, row, 0xfffffff8;\n";
    $o .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
    if ($fmt eq 'iq4_nl') {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I tl0, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(0);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I tl1, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(1);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I th0, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(2);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I th1, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(3);
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I t7f, 0x7f7f7f7f;\n";
    }
    # pp = W + off + 2 lane ; np = W + off + 48 + bb lane ; hp = W + off + 48 + 16 B + 4 lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, lane, off, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, lane, off, 0x%x;\n", $bb == 32 ? 5 : 4;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x30;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD np0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X np1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    if ($fmt eq 'q5_0') {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, lane, off, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x%x;\n", 48 + 16 * $B;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    }
    # yp = Y + 4 row
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, row, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1p, param_Y0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    if ($nsum) {
