        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD zp0.CC, t1p, param_S0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X zp1, RZ, param_S1;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI ns%d, [zp+0x%x];\n", $_, 16*$_ for 0..$n-1;
    }
    # activation scales: block l + 4 i at AS + 4 lane + 16 i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t1p, param_AS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_AS1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI as%d, [ap+0x%x];\n", $i, 16*$i; }
    # activations: xp = X + 64 lane ; block i at + 256 i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1p, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", ($i == $n-1 && $k == 3) ? '6' : '1', 16*$i + 4*$k, 256*$i + 16*$k;
        }
    }
    if ($nsum) {

    }

    $o .= "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E yold, [yp];\n" if $acc;
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.U16 dp%d, [pp+0x%x];\n", $i, 8*$i; }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        for my $k (0..$nw/4-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 nb%02d, [np+0x%x];\n", $nw*$i + 4*$k, 4*$bb*$i + 16*$k; }
    }
    if ($fmt eq 'q5_0') { for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI qh%d, [hp+0x%x];\n", $i, 16*$i; } }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD rowpair, rowpair, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rowpair, param_rows, PT;\n";

    my $nmasks = sub {
        my ($word, $ms, $laststall) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      LOP32I.AND m%02d, %s, 0x%08x;\n", ($_ == 3 ? $laststall : '1'), $ms + $_, $word, (0x000F000F << (4*$_)) & 0xffffffff for 0..3;
        return $x;
    };
    my $nxmads = sub {
        my ($i, $k, $ms) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $hh (0, 1) {
            for my $v (0..3) {
                my $acc = sprintf "acc%d", 4*$hh + $v;
                my $c = $k ? $acc : (($hh == 0 && $v == 0) ? "ns$i" : 'RZ');
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 %s, m%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                    $acc, $ms + $v, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 4*$k + 2*$hh + ($v >> 1), ($v & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0', $c;
            }
        }
        return $x;
    };
    my $hmasks = sub {
        my ($src, $u) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND m%02d, %s, 0x%08x;\n", 4*($u & 1) + $_, $src, (0x00010001 << (4*$_)) & 0xffffffff for 0..3;
        return $x;
    };
    my $hxmads = sub {
        my ($i, $u) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $hh (0, 1) {
            for my $v (0..3) {
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 acch%d, m%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                    4*$hh + $v, 4*($u & 1) + $v, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 8*$hh + 2*$v + ($u >> 1), ($u & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0',
                    $u ? sprintf("acch%d", 4*$hh + $v) : 'RZ';
            }
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # dst = sum_v (a_v + a_{4+v}) >> 4v, first IADD >= 6 issues after the last XMAD of a_7
    my $combine4 = sub {
        my ($an, $dst) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      IADD %s%d, %s%d, %s%d;\n", ($_ == 3 ? '4' : '1'), $an, $_, $an, $_, $an, 4 + $_ for 0..3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      SHR %s%d, %s%d, 0x%x;\n", ($_ == 3 ? '5' : '1'), $an, $_, $an, $_, 4*$_ for 1..3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD %s0, %s0, %s1;\n", $an, $an, $an;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s2, %s2, %s3;\n", $an, $an, $an;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s0, %s2;\n", $dst, $an, $an;
        return $x;
    };
    # dst = sum of 8 round-robin accumulators written in order 0..7 last
    my $sum8 = sub {
        my ($dst) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc0, acc0, acc1;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc2, acc2, acc3;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc4, acc4, acc5;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc6, acc6, acc7;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc0, acc0, acc2;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc4, acc4, acc6;\n";
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, acc0, acc4;\n", $dst;
        return $x;
    };

    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        my $wait = $i == 0 ? '03' : '--';
        my @w = map { sprintf "nb%02d", $nw*$i + $_ } 0..$nw-1;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:4:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 dd, dp%d;\n", $wait, $i;
        if ($fmt eq 'q4_0' || $fmt eq 'q5_0') {
            $o .= $nmasks->($w[0], 0, '1');
            $o .= $nmasks->($w[1], 4, '3');
            $o .= $nxmads->($i, 0, 0);
            $o .= $nmasks->($w[2], 0, '1');
            $o .= $nxmads->($i, 1, 4);
            $o .= $nmasks->($w[3], 4, '1');
            $o .= $nxmads->($i, 2, 0);
            if ($fmt eq 'q5_0') {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs1, qh%d, 0x1;\n", $i;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs2, qh%d, 0x2;\n", $i;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs3, qh%d, 0x3;\n", $i;
                $o .= $hmasks->("qh$i", 0);
                $o .= $nxmads->($i, 3, 4);
                $o .= $hmasks->('hs1', 1);
                $o .= $hxmads->($i, 0);
                $o .= $hmasks->('hs2', 2);
                $o .= $hxmads->($i, 1);
                $o .= $hmasks->('hs3', 3);
                $o .= $hxmads->($i, 2);
                $o .= $hxmads->($i, 3);
                $o .= $combine4->('acc', 'dot');
                $o .= $combine4->('acch', 'dh');
                $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD dot, dh, dot, 0x4;\n";
            } else {
                $o .= $nxmads->($i, 3, 4);
                # the combine's first IADD reads acc4 written 4 issues ago: pad
                $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV dh, RZ;\n";
                $o .= $combine4->('acc', 'dot');
            }
        } elsif ($fmt eq 'q8_0') {
            for my $k (0..7) {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, %s, 0x9180, RZ;\n", 2*$k, $w[$k];
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, %s, 0xb3a2, RZ;\n", 2*$k + 1, $w[$k];
            }
            my $j = 0;
            for my $k (0..7) {
                for my $kk (0..1) {
                    for my $hh (0, 1) {
                        my $acc = sprintf "acc%d", $j & 7;
                        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.S16.S16 %s, p%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                            $acc, 2*$k + $kk, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 2*$k + $kk, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', $j < 8 ? 'RZ' : $acc;
                        $j++;
                    }
                }
            }
            $o .= $sum8->('dot');
        } else {   # iq4_nl
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 tt%d, %s, 0x10;\n", $_, $w[$_] for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      LOP32I.XOR x0%d, %s, 0x88888888;\n", ($_ == 3 ? '3' : '1'), $_, $w[$_] for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 x1%d, x0%d, 0x10;\n", $_, $_ for 0..3;
            for my $k (0..3) {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT lo%d, tl0, %s, tl1;\n", $k, $w[$k];
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT hi%d, th0, x0%d, th1;\n", $k, $k;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT mk%d, t7f, %s, t7f;\n", $k, $w[$k];
            }
            for my $k (0..3) {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT lo2%d, tl0, tt%d, tl1;\n", $k, $k;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT hi2%d, th0, x1%d, th1;\n", $k, $k;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT mk2%d, t7f, tt%d, t7f;\n", $k, $k;
            }
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHL mb%d, mk%d, 0x1;\n", $_, $_ for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHL mb%d, mk2%d, 0x1;\n", 4 + $_, $_ for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.OR mk%d, mk%d, mb%d;\n", $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.OR mk2%d, mk2%d, mb%d;\n", $_, $_, 4 + $_ for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP3.LUT R%d, lo%d, mk%d, hi%d, 0xe2;\n", $_, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP3.LUT R%d, lo2%d, mk2%d, hi2%d, 0xe2;\n", 4 + $_, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
            for my $k (0..3) {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0x9180, RZ;\n", 4*$k, $k;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0xb3a2, RZ;\n", 4*$k + 1, $k;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0x9180, RZ;\n", 4*$k + 2, 4 + $k;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0xb3a2, RZ;\n", 4*$k + 3, 4 + $k;
            }
            my $j = 0;
            for my $k (0..3) {
                for my $kk (0..3) {
                    for my $hh (0, 1) {
                        my $acc = sprintf "acc%d", $j & 7;
                        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.S16.S16 %s, p%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                            $acc, 4*$k + $kk, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 4*$k + $kk, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', $j < 8 ? 'RZ' : $acc;
                        $j++;
                    }
                }
            }
            $o .= $sum8->('dot');
        }
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:6      I2F.F32.S32 dotf, dot;\n";
        $o .= "0c:-:-:-:6      FMUL u, dd, dotf;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, as%d, u, accf;\n", $i;
    }
    for (my $x = $L / 2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, accf, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, accf, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, xsv, accf, yold;\n" if $acc;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], accf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, pp0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, pp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD np0.CC, np0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X np1, np1, RZ;\n";
    if ($fmt eq 'q5_0') {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, hp0, stepw;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, hp1, RZ;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, rowstep, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/gemv_bf16.sass
# Kernel: gemv_bf16
#
# y[r] = sum_k W[r][k] * x[k] for bf16 rows W (row stride 2K bytes) and fp32 x.
# GEMV_K=2560 (default) or GEMV_K=320 at assembly time. GEMV_ROWSTRIDE overrides
# the row stride and GEMV_ACC=1 makes the store y += partial. GEMV_SLICES=N runs
# N consecutive K-wide column slices of a (N K)-wide row inside the kernel,
# y = (((p0 + p1) + p2) + p3) with each p_s the full K-slice reduction, exactly
# the numbers four separate slice launches produce: the K=10240 hyper-connection
# matrices (hc_*_down ++ hc_*_inject) run as one phase. With slices the
# activations are reloaded per slice and the next slice's loads are issued
# while the current slice's FFMA chain consumes the registers.
#
# L lanes per row (32 for K=2560, 8 for K=320); lane l owns the 8-element chunks
# at 8 (l + L j), j < C = K/(8L): one LDG.128 of weights and two LDG.128 of
# activations per chunk. Without slices the activations (8C fp32) stay in
# registers for the whole kernel. bf16 -> fp32 is a shift (low element) or a mask
# (high element); the products go through one FFMA chain per lane in element
# order, then a SHFL butterfly over the L lanes. The C reference (gemv_bf16_ref)
# mirrors this order.
#
# Scheduling (measured rules, see SPEC): fixed-latency 6; variable-latency ops set a
# barrier and need stall >= 2 before a dependent wait; predicates are computed at
# the loop top, ~18+ cycles before any consumer.
# Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = address/store reads and activation loads, 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 W   1:0x148:8 X   2:0x150:8 Y   3:0x158:4 rows   4:0x160:8 dbg (bias)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    gridDimX   : c[0x0][0x14]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_rows : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_D0   : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_D1   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_XOFF : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_TAB0 : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_TAB1 : c[0x0][0x174]
    param_XH0  : c[0x0][0x178]
    param_XH1  : c[0x0][0x17c]
    param_T0   : c[0x0][0x180]
    param_T1   : c[0x0][0x184]
    param_tn   : c[0x0][0x188]
    param_NW0  : c[0x0][0x190]
    param_NW1  : c[0x0][0x194]
    param_eps  : c[0x0][0x198]
    param_YG0  : c[0x0][0x1a0]
    param_YG1  : c[0x0][0x1a4]
    param_INJ0 : c[0x0][0x1a8]
    param_INJ1 : c[0x0][0x1ac]

    # register mapping depends on K: act<00-..> and w<00-..> sizes
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $NS = $ENV{GEMV_SLICES} || 1;
    my $L = $K >= 2560 ? 32 : 8;
    my $C = $K / (8 * $L);
    my $na = 8 * $C;         # activation registers
    my $nw = 4 * $C;         # weight registers
    my $wbase = $na;
    my $tmp = $wbase + $nw;  # a0 a1 b0 b1 accf t
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= sprintf "    0-%d : act<00-%02d>\n", $na - 1, $na - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : w<00-%02d>\n", $wbase, $wbase + $nw - 1, $nw - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : a<0-1>\n", $tmp, $tmp + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : b<0-1>\n", $tmp + 2, $tmp + 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : accf\n", $tmp + 4;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : t\n", $tmp + 5;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : row\n", $tmp + 6;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : rowpair\n", $tmp + 7;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : rowstep\n", $tmp + 8;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : stepw\n", $tmp + 9;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : yold\n", $tmp + 10;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : bias\n", $tmp + 11;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : ysum\n", $tmp + 12;
    my $p = $tmp + 13; $p += $p & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : wp<0-1>\n", $p, $p + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n", $p + 2, $p + 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : bp<0-1>\n", $p + 4, $p + 5;
    # the activation pointer lives for the whole kernel with slices, else only in the prologue
    if ($NS > 1) { $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n", $p + 6, $p + 7; }
    else         { $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n", $wbase, $wbase + 1; }
    # GEMV_XOUT: the six inbox destinations (TAB bases + xoff + 4 row)
    if ($ENV{GEMV_XOUT} || $ENV{GEMV_HCUP}) { my $q = $NS > 1 ? $p + 8 : $p + 6; $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : dq<00-11>\n", $q, $q + 11; $o .= sprintf "    %d : xo\n", $q + 12; }
    if ($ENV{GEMV_RMS}) {   # the fused RMS norm of the stream (prologue registers past dq/xo)
        my $h = ($NS > 1 ? $p + 8 : $p + 6) + 14;
        my @n = qw(ss mm vv s0 hh rr e mneg1 invn wq lq sw wr4);
        push @n, qw(g ij ft1 ft2 ft3 ft4 log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone) if $ENV{GEMV_RMSW};
        $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $h + $_, $n[$_] for 0 .. @n - 1;
        my $q = $h + @n; $q += $q & 1;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : sp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : np<0-1>\n    %d,%d : hp<0-1>\n", $q, $q + 1, $q + 2, $q + 3, $q + 4, $q + 5;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : ib<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yb<0-1>\n    %d,%d : ob<0-1>\n", $q + 6, $q + 7, $q + 8, $q + 9, $q + 10, $q + 11 if $ENV{GEMV_RMSW};
    }
    if ($ENV{GEMV_HCUP}) {   # the fused hc up: SiLU prologue, lane mix epilogue (registers past dq/xo)
        my $h = ($NS > 1 ? $p + 8 : $p + 6) + 14;
        my @n = qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1 ft1 ft2 ft3 ft4 ft5 su0 su1 sy0 sy1 sa col lq wr gg xl g0 g1 g2 g3 x0 x1 x2 x3 macc c0r c1r rlim zo zt);
        $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $h + $_, $n[$_] for 0 .. @n - 1;
        my $q = $h + @n; $q += $q & 1;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xa<0-1>\n    %d,%d : tp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : dp<0-1>\n", $q, $q + 1, $q + 2, $q + 3, $q + 4, $q + 5;
    }
    # prologue temporaries alias the weight registers
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : lane\n    %d : grp\n    %d : tid\n    %d : bid\n    %d : off\n    %d : t0\n    %d : t1\n",
        $wbase + 2, $wbase + 3, $wbase + 4, $wbase + 5, $wbase + 6, $wbase + 7, $wbase + 8;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $NS = $ENV{GEMV_SLICES} || 1;
    my $L = $K >= 2560 ? 32 : 8;
    my $C = $K / (8 * $L);
    my $R = 256 / $L;                     # rows per CTA iteration
    my $S = $ENV{GEMV_ROWSTRIDE} || 2 * $K * $NS;   # row stride bytes
    my $acc = $ENV{GEMV_ACC} ? 1 : 0;     # y += partial instead of y = partial
    my $bias = $ENV{GEMV_BIAS} ? 1 : 0;   # y = partial + bias[row], bias at the dbg pointer (ssm_dt.bias on the alpha logits)
    my $xout = $ENV{GEMV_XOUT} ? 1 : 0;   # y rows go to every die's inbox: TAB (at the Y param) + XOFF + 4 row, and the phase is a send
    my $rms = $ENV{GEMV_RMS} ? 1 : 0;     # x = RMSNorm(S) (4 lanes of 2560) built in shared memory by every CTA (bf16hcrx)
    my $rmsw = $ENV{GEMV_RMSW} ? 1 : 0;   # ... after applying the pending stream write (hcwrite's update) to S, stored to SOUT
    die "GEMV_RMSW needs GEMV_RMS" if $rmsw && !$rms;
    require './fmath.pl' if $rmsw;
    die "GEMV_RMS needs K = 2560, 4 slices" if $rms && ($K != 2560 || $NS != 4);
    my $hcup = $ENV{GEMV_HCUP} ? 1 : 0;   # fused hc up (K = 320): x = SiLU(0.25 DOWN) via smem, rows ordered 4 c + l over
                                          # weight rows l cols + c, z_c = mix of the 4 lane rows -> every die's inbox (see ph_hcup)
    my $RB = $ENV{GEMV_HCUP} ? 'rlim' : 'param_rows';   # the row bound (hcup: this CTA's columns)
    die "GEMV_HCUP needs K = 320, one slice" if $hcup && ($K != 320 || $NS != 1);
    require './fmath.pl' if $hcup;
    my %FC = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
    my $lgL = int(log($L)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $lgR = int(log($R)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;
    my $res = $NS > 1 ? 'ysum' : 'accf';  # the row result register
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $r, $c) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $c & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $s = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $r, $first;
        $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $r, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $s;
    };
    # activation chunk loads of slice s (two LDG.128 per chunk)
    my $xload = sub {
        my ($s, $last) = @_;
        my $o = '';
        for my $j (0..$C-1) {
            if ($rms) {   # from the normalised stream in shared memory (xp0 = 32 lane)
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDS.128 act%02d, [xp0+0x%x];\n", 8*$j, 32*$L*$j + 4*$K*$s;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDS.128 act%02d, [xp0+0x%x];\n", ($last && $j == $C-1) ? '2' : '1', 8*$j + 4, 32*$L*$j + 16 + 4*$K*$s;
                next;
            }
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", 8*$j, 32*$L*$j + 4*$K*$s;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", ($last && $j == $C-1) ? '2' : '1', 8*$j + 4, 32*$L*$j + 16 + 4*$K*$s;
        }
        return $o;
    };
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    if ($rms) {
        # xh = RMSNorm of the stream's 4 lanes, rmsnorm.sass's arithmetic bit for bit: warps 0..3 sum the
        # squares of lane w (warp lane l: chunks 4 (l + 32 j), j < 20, one FFMA chain; butterfly) and leave
        # 1/rms in shared memory at 0xa000; then thread t normalises the float4s q = 10 t .. 10 t + 9 (stream
        # lane t / 64) into shared memory [0, 40960) and CTA c stores q in [160 c, 160 c + 160) to XH (the
        # global xh hcup mixes with); the GEMV reads x from shared memory.
        # GEMV_RMSW: the stream is first updated as hcwrite would (S = fma(2 sigmoid(inj_l / 4), y_c, S),
        # y = YG, inj = INJ, S read at X): both passes form the new values the same way, and CTA c stores
        # its slice of the new stream to SOUT (the D parameter)
        my $invn = unpack("L", pack("f", 1.0 / 2560));
        my %FW = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
        my $gate = sub {   # g = 2 sigmoid(0.25 INJ[lane register]) -> g
            my ($lreg) = @_;
            my $s = "--:-:-:-:6      SHL ij, $lreg, 0x2;\n";
            $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ib0.CC, ij, param_INJ0;\n";
            $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ib1, RZ, param_INJ1;\n";
            $s .= "--:-:3:-:2      LDG.E ij, [ib];\n";
            $s .= "04:-:-:-:6      FMUL ij, ij, 0.25;\n";
            $s .= fm_sigmoid('g', 'ij', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', \%FW);
            $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL g, g, 2;\n";
            return $s;
        };
        $o .= $rmsw ? fm_consts(\%FW) : "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I mneg1, 0xbf800000;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I invn, 0x%08x;\n", $invn;
        $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 wq, tid, 0x5;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lq, tid, 0x1f;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, tid, 0x80, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD sw, wq, 0x2800, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD sw, lq, sw, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, sw, param_X0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P5, PT, lq, RZ, P4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ss, RZ;\n";
        if ($rmsw) {
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND wr4, wq, 0x3;\n";
            $o .= $gate->('wr4');
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL ij, lq, 0x4;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yb0.CC, ij, param_YG0;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yb1, RZ, param_YG1;\n";
            for my $h (0, 1) {   # 10 chunks at a time: S into act00..39, y into act40..79
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1  \@P4 LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [sp+0x%x];\n", 4 * $_, 512 * (10 * $h + $_) for 0..9;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s  \@P4 LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [yb+0x%x];\n", $_ == 9 ? '2' : '1', 40 + 4 * $_, 512 * (10 * $h + $_) for 0..9;
                $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FFMA act%02d, g, act%02d, act%02d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_ == 39 ? '6' : '1', $_, 40 + $_, $_ for 0..39;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, act%02d, act%02d, ss;\n", $_, $_ for 0..39;
            }
        } else {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s  \@P4 LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 19 ? '2' : '1', 4 * $_, 512 * $_ for 0..19;
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, act%02d, act%02d, ss;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_, $_ for 0..79;
        }
        for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, ss, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
            $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD ss, ss, t;\n";
        }
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL mm, ss, invn;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD vv, mm, param_eps;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RSQ rr, vv;\n";
        $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      FMUL.FTZ s0, vv, rr;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL.FTZ hh, rr, 0.5;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ e, -s0, -RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA e, s0, e, vv;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA s0, e, hh, s0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RCP rr, s0;\n";
        $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      FFMA e, s0, rr, mneg1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ e, -e, -RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA rr, rr, e, rr;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL sw, wq, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P5 STS [sw+0xa000], rr;\n";
        $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
        # pass 2: this thread's 40 elements (stream lane t / 64)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 lq, tid, 0x6;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL wr4, lq, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:1      LDS rr, [wr4+0xa000];\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD sw, tid, 0xa0, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, sw, param_X0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD np0.CC, sw, param_NW0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X np1, RZ, param_NW1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, sw, param_XH0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_XH1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 wq, tid, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, wq, bid, PT;\n";       # CTA c stores threads 16 c .. 16 c + 15
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [sp+0x%x];\n", 4 * $_, 16 * $_ for 0..9;
        if ($rmsw) {
            $o .= $gate->('lq');
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND ij, tid, 0x3f;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD ij, ij, 0xa0, RZ;\n";                  # y offset 160 (t mod 64)
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yb0.CC, ij, param_YG0;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yb1, RZ, param_YG1;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ob0.CC, sw, param_D0;\n";             # the new stream (SOUT)
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ob1, RZ, param_D1;\n";
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [yb+0x%x];\n", $_ == 9 ? '2' : '1', 40 + 4 * $_, 16 * $_ for 0..9;
            $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FFMA act%02d, g, act%02d, act%02d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_ == 39 ? '6' : '1', $_, 40 + $_, $_ for 0..39;
            $o .= sprintf "--:4:-:-:1  \@P6 STG.E.128 [ob+0x%x], act%02d;\n", 16 * $_, 4 * $_ for 0..9;
        }
        # (the norm weights go to act40..79: the w registers alias tid, bid, lane ... during the prologue)
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [np+0x%x];\n", $_ == 9 ? '2' : '1', 40 + 4 * $_, 16 * $_ for 0..9;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL act%02d, act%02d, rr;\n", $_ == 0 ? ($rmsw ? '0d' : '05') : '--', $_ == 39 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..39;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL act%02d, act%02d, act%02d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '02' : '--', $_ == 39 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_, 40 + $_ for 0..39;
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1      STS.128 [sw+0x%x], act%02d;\n", 16 * $_, 4 * $_ for 0..9;
        $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:1  \@P6 STG.E.128 [hp+0x%x], act%02d;\n", 16 * $_, 4 * $_ for 0..9;
        $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    }
    if ($hcup) {
        # t = SiLU(0.25 d) for d = DOWN[0, 320); DOWN[320, tn) copied unchanged (the inject values):
        # thread i does elements i and i + 256, into shared memory (and CTA 0 into T for hcwrite
        # and the checks), then every lane reads its activation chunks from shared memory
        $o .= fm_consts(\%FC);
        $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHL sa, tid, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dp0.CC, sa, param_X0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tp0.CC, sa, param_T0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X tp1, RZ, param_T1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV su1, param_tn;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD su1, su1, -0x100;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, tid, su1, PT;\n";       # element i + 256 exists (< tn)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P5, PT, tid, 0x40, PT;\n";      # and is a SiLU element (< 320)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, bid, RZ, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
        $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E su0, [dp];\n";
        $o .= "--:-:1:-:2  \@P4 LDG.E su1, [dp+0x400];\n";
        $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMUL gg, su0, 0.25;\n";
        $o .= fm_silu('sy0', 'gg', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', 'ft5', \%FC);
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL gg, su1, 0.25;\n";
        $o .= fm_silu('sy1', 'gg', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', 'ft5', \%FC);
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P5 MOV sy1, su1;\n";
        $o .= "--:1:-:-:1      STS [sa], sy0;\n";
        $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P4 STS [sa+0x400], sy1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      PSETP.AND.AND P5, PT, P4, P6, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
        $o .= "--:1:-:-:1  \@P6 STG.E [tp], sy0;\n";
        $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P5 STG.E [tp+0x400], sy1;\n";
        $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
        # the six inbox bases (XOFF + 4 c is added once the column is known)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV yp0, param_TAB0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV yp1, param_TAB1;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%d      LDG.E.64 dq%02d, [yp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, 2 * $_, 8 * $_ for 0..5;
    }
    if ($xout) {   # the six inbox bases, loaded first so their latency hides under the prologue
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV yp0, param_Y0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV yp1, param_Y1;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%d      LDG.E.64 dq%02d, [yp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 5 ? 2 : 1, 2 * $_, 8 * $_ for 0..5;
    }
    $o .= sprintf "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    if ($hcup) {
        # CTA c takes the contiguous columns [c0, c1) (ceil(cols / 16) each), 8 per iteration (one per warp):
        # row = 4 c0 + grp, 32 rows per step; z is collected in shared memory and written to the slots in one
        # coalesced burst per die at the end (single-float remote stores per column stalled the switches)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV gg, param_rows;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 gg, gg, 0x2;\n";                          # cols
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xl, gg, 0xf;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 xl, xl, 0x4;\n";                          # per CTA
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD c0r, bid, xl, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD c1r, c0r, xl;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 c1r, c1r, gg, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 c0r, c0r, c1r, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rlim, c1r, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, c0r, grp, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I rowstep, 0x20;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I stepw, 0x%x;\n", 8 * $S;                # 8 weight rows
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 zo, tid, 0x5;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL zo, zo, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD zo, zo, 0x600;\n";                          # z of this warp's column in smem
    }
    # P3: this row exists (rows beyond param_rows load nothing: the matrix may end the allocation)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P3, PT, row, $RB, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rowpair, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~($wrows - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    if ($hcup) {   # row 4 c + l <- weight row wr = l cols + c (cols = rows / 4); the lane mix needs xh[l][c]
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 col, row, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lq, row, 0x3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV gg, param_rows;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 gg, gg, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD wr, lq, gg, col;\n";
        $o .= $mulc->('off', 'wr', $S);
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD gg, lq, 0xa00, col;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL gg, gg, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xa0.CC, gg, param_XH0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xa1, RZ, param_XH1;\n";
        # the final store (after the loop: tid aliases a weight register): P6 = tid < c1 - c0, zt = its smem z
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD zt, c1r, -c0r;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P6, PT, tid, zt, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL zt, tid, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD zt, zt, 0x600;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xo, c0r, tid;\n";                           # the final store: thread t -> column c0 + t
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL xo, xo, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xo, xo, param_XOFF;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND gg, tid, 0x1f;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P4, PT, gg, RZ, PT;\n";      # P4: lane 0 of the warp (stores z_c)
    } else {
        $o .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
    }
    # wp = W + off + 16 lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1, lane, off, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, t1, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # yp = Y + 4 row (xout: t1 = XOFF + 4 row, added to the six bases below)
    $o .= $hcup ? "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, wr, 0x2;\n" : "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, row, 0x2;\n";   # hcup: Y = the lane rows (u, for checks)
    if ($xout) {   # xo = XOFF + 4 row (its own register: t1 is reused for the activation pointer below)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL xo, row, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xo, xo, param_XOFF;\n";
    } else {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1, param_Y0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    }
    if ($bias) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD bp0.CC, t1, param_D0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bp1, RZ, param_D1;\n";
    }
    # activations: xp = X + 32 lane; chunk j at +32 L j (two 16 B loads); slice s at +4 K s
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, lane, 0x5;\n";
    if ($rms) { $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV xp0, t1;\n"; }   # a shared-memory address
    else {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1, param_X0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    }
    if ($hcup) {   # the SiLU activations from shared memory (same chunk layout: lane l, chunk j at 32 l + 32 L j)
        for my $j (0..$C-1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDS.128 act%02d, [t1+0x%x];\n", 8*$j, 32*$L*$j;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDS.128 act%02d, [t1+0x%x];\n", $j == $C-1 ? '2' : '1', 8*$j + 4, 32*$L*$j + 16;
        }
    } else {
        $o .= $xload->(0, 1) if $NS == 1;     # resident for the whole kernel
    }
    if ($xout || $hcup) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      IADD dq%02d.CC, dq%02d, xo;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dq%02d, dq%02d, RZ;\n", $_ ? "--" : "02", 2 * $_, 2 * $_, 2 * $_ + 1, 2 * $_ + 1 for 0..5;
    }
    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    $o .= $xload->(0, 0) if $NS > 1;      # slice 0 of this row
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:1  \@P3 LDG.E xl, [xa];\n" if $hcup;            # xh[l][c] for the lane mix
    for my $j (0..$C-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:%s  \@P3 LDG.E.CI.128 w%02d, [wp+0x%x];\n", ($j == $C-1 && !$acc && !$bias) ? '2' : '1', 4*$j, 16*$L*$j;
    }
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:2  \@P3 LDG.E yold, [yp];\n" if $acc;
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:2  \@P3 LDG.E bias, [bp];\n" if $bias;
    # predicates for this row, far from their consumers (see SPEC: ~18 cycles)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, $RB, P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P5, PT, row, $RB, P4;\n" if $hcup;   # lane 0 of the warp, column exists
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD rowpair, rowpair, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rowpair, $RB, PT;\n";
    my $nwords = 4 * $C;
    for my $s (0..$NS-1) {
        my $pre = $s + 1 < $NS;           # issue slice s+1's loads inside this chain
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n" if $s;
        # software-pipelined conversion: word k's halves are ready two FFMAs before use
        $o .= "03:-:-:-:1      SHL a0, w00, 0x10;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND b0, w00, 0xffff0000;\n";
        for my $k (0..$nwords-1) {
            my $cur = $k & 1;
            my $nxt = 1 - $cur;
            my $x0 = sprintf "act%02d", 2*$k;
            my $x1 = sprintf "act%02d", 2*$k + 1;
            # act(4m .. 4m+3) are dead after word k = 2m+1: reload them for the next slice
            my $xpre = $pre && (($k & 1) == 1);
            my $m = ($k - 1) >> 1;
            my $xldg = $xpre ? sprintf($rms ? "--:-:2:-:1      LDS.128 act%02d, [xp0+0x%x];\n" : "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", 4*$m, 32*$L*($m >> 1) + 16*($m & 1) + 4*$K*($s+1)) : '';
            if ($k + 1 < $nwords) {
                my $wn = sprintf "w%02d", $k + 1;
                # w(4j' .. 4j'+3) are dead once word k+1 = 4j'+3 is converted: reload them
                my $wpre = $pre && ((($k + 1) & 3) == 3);
                my $jq = ($k + 1) >> 2;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      FFMA accf, a%d, %s, accf;\n", $cur, $x0;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHL a%d, %s, 0x10;\n", $nxt, $wn;
                if ($wpre) {
                    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:3      LOP32I.AND b%d, %s, 0xffff0000;\n", $nxt, $wn;
                    $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1  \@P3 LDG.E.CI.128 w%02d, [wp+0x%x];\n", 4*$jq, 16*$L*$jq + 2*$K*($s+1);
                } else {
                    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:4      LOP32I.AND b%d, %s, 0xffff0000;\n", $nxt, $wn;
                }
                if ($xpre) {
                    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:5      FFMA accf, b%d, %s, accf;\n", $cur, $x1;
                    $o .= $xldg;
                } else {
                    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, b%d, %s, accf;\n", $cur, $x1;
                }
            } else {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, a%d, %s, accf;\n", $cur, $x0;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, b%d, %s, accf;\n", $cur, $x1;
                $o .= $xldg;
            }
        }
        for (my $x = $L / 2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, accf, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
            $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, accf, t;\n";
        }
        if ($NS > 1) {
            $o .= $s ? "--:-:-:-:6      FADD ysum, ysum, accf;\n" : "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ysum, accf;\n";
        }
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD $res, yold, $res;\n" if $acc;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD $res, $res, bias;\n" if $bias;
    if ($hcup) {
        # u (this lane row) for the checks; z_c = 0.25 (((s0 x0 + s1 x1) + s2 x2) + s3 x3), s_l = sigmoid(u_l):
        # the warp holds the 4 lane rows of column c (lanes 8 l), hcmix's order and twin
        $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], accf;\n";
        $o .= fm_sigmoid('gg', 'accf', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', \%FC);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:1      SHFL.IDX PT, g%d, gg, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_, 8 * $_ for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:%d      SHFL.IDX PT, x%d, xl, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $_ == 3 ? 2 : 1, $_, 8 * $_ for 0..3;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FMUL macc, g0, x0;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA macc, g%d, x%d, macc;\n", $_, $_ for 1..3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL macc, macc, 0.25;\n";
        $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P5 STS [zo], macc;\n";
    }
    elsif ($xout) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E.WT [dq%02d], $res;\n", 2 * $_ for 0..5; }
    else { $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], $res;\n"; }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, wp0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, wp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P3, PT, row, $RB, PT;\n";   # next row (row is 12 cycles old)
    $o .= $hcup ? "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t, rowstep;\n" : "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, rowstep, 0x2;\n";   # hcup: c advances rowstep / 4 (4 bytes each)
    if ($hcup) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xa0.CC, xa0, t;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xa1, xa1, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD zo, zo, t;\n";
    }
    if ($xout) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dq%02d.CC, dq%02d, t;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dq%02d, dq%02d, RZ;\n", 2 * $_, 2 * $_, 2 * $_ + 1, 2 * $_ + 1 for 0..5; }
    elsif (!$hcup) {   # (hcup stepped yp above)
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    }
    if ($bias) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD bp0.CC, bp0, t;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bp1, bp1, RZ;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n";
    if ($hcup) {   # this CTA's z (columns c0 .. c1 - 1, in smem) to every die's slot, one coalesced store each
        $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      LDS macc, [zt];\n";
        $o .= sprintf "%s:2:-:-:%d  \@P6 STG.E.WT [dq%02d], macc;\n", $_ ? '--' : '04', $_ == 5 ? 6 : 1, 2 * $_ for 0..5;
        $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>

# Two scalar-compatible descriptors, c[0x0] and c[0x2], one weight load.
# Preserve B1 lane ownership, FFMA order, butterfly and slice-add order.

    my $o = "<CONSTANT_MAPPING>\n    gridDimX : c[0x0][0x14]\n";
    my @p = ([qw(param_W0 140)], [qw(param_W1 144)], [qw(param_X0 148)], [qw(param_X1 14c)], [qw(param_Y0 150)], [qw(param_Y1 154)], [qw(param_rows 158)]);
    push @p, [qw(param_D0 160)], [qw(param_D1 164)] if $ENV{GEMV_BIAS};
    push @p, [qw(param_XOFF 168)] if $ENV{GEMV_XOUT};
    $o .= "    $_->[0] : c[0x0][0x$_->[1]]\n" for @p;
    my @b = ([qw(param_BX0 148)], [qw(param_BX1 14c)], [qw(param_BY0 150)], [qw(param_BY1 154)]);
    push @b, [qw(param_BD0 160)], [qw(param_BD1 164)] if $ENV{GEMV_BIAS};
    push @b, [qw(param_BXOFF 168)] if $ENV{GEMV_XOUT};
    $o .= "    $_->[0] : c[0x2][0x$_->[1]]\n" for @b;
    return $o . "</CONSTANT_MAPPING>\n";

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $NS = $ENV{GEMV_SLICES} || 1;
    my $L = $K >= 2560 ? 32 : 8;
    die "unsupported paired BF16 K" unless $K == 2560 || $K == 320;
    my $C = $K / (8 * $L);
    my $R = 256 / $L;
    my $lgL = $L == 32 ? 5 : 3;
    my $lgR = $L == 32 ? 3 : 5;
    my $S = $ENV{GEMV_ROWSTRIDE} || 2 * $K * $NS;
    my $acc = $ENV{GEMV_ACC} || 0;
    my $bias = $ENV{GEMV_BIAS} || 0;
    my $xout = $ENV{GEMV_XOUT} || 0;
    die "XOUT cannot accumulate" if $xout && $acc;
    my $mul = sub {
        my ($d, $r, $n) = @_;
        my @b = grep { $n & (1 << $_) } 0..30;
        my $s = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $r, shift @b;
        $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $r, $d, $_ for @b;
        return $s;
    };
    my $o = "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n--:-:6:-:2      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= $mul->('off', 'row', $S);
    $o .= $mul->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD tmp, lane, off, 0x4;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, tmp, param_W0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, lane, 0x5;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, tmp, param_X0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD xbp0.CC, tmp, param_BX0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xbp1, RZ, param_BX1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, row, 0x2;\n";
    if ($xout) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ta0, param_Y0;\n--:-:-:-:6      MOV ta1, param_Y1;\n--:-:-:-:6      MOV tb0, param_BY0;\n--:-:-:-:6      MOV tb1, param_BY1;\n";
    } else {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, tmp, param_Y0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD ybp0.CC, tmp, param_BY0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ybp1, RZ, param_BY1;\n";
    }
    if ($bias) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD bp0.CC, tmp, param_D0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bp1, RZ, param_D1;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD bbp0.CC, tmp, param_BD0;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bbp1, RZ, param_BD1;\n";
    }
    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P3, PT, row, param_rows, PT;\n--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rownext, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~(32/$L - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD rownext, rownext, rowstep;\n--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rownext, param_rows, PT;\n";
    for my $s (0..$NS-1) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV aa, RZ;\n--:-:-:-:6      MOV ab, RZ;\n";
        for my $j (0..$C-1) {
            my $wo = 16*$L*$j + 2*$K*$s;
            my $xo = 32*$L*$j + 4*$K*$s;
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1  \@P3 LDG.E.CI.128 w0, [wp+0x%x];\n", $wo;
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 ax0, [xp+0x%x];\n", $xo;
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 ax4, [xp+0x%x];\n", $xo+16;
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 bx0, [xbp+0x%x];\n", $xo;
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:2      LDG.E.CI.128 bx4, [xbp+0x%x];\n", $xo+16;
            for my $w (0..3) {
                my $wait = $w == 0 ? '01' : '--';
                $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      SHL lo, w%d, 0x10;\n", $wait, $w;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND hi, w%d, 0xffff0000;\n", $w;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:3      FFMA aa, lo, ax%d, aa;\n--:-:-:-:3      FFMA ab, lo, bx%d, ab;\n", 2*$w, 2*$w;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:3      FFMA aa, hi, ax%d, aa;\n--:-:-:-:3      FFMA ab, hi, bx%d, ab;\n", 2*$w+1, 2*$w+1;
            }
        }
        for (my $x = $L/2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, aa, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n10:-:-:-:6      FADD aa, aa, t;\n", $x;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, ab, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n10:-:-:-:6      FADD ab, ab, t;\n", $x;
        }
        $o .= $s ? "--:-:-:-:6      FADD ya, ya, aa;\n--:-:-:-:6      FADD yb, yb, ab;\n" : "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ya, aa;\n--:-:-:-:6      MOV yb, ab;\n";
    }
    if ($acc) {
        $o .= "--:2:1:-:1  \@P3 LDG.E olda, [yp];\n--:2:1:-:2  \@P3 LDG.E oldb, [ybp];\n01:-:-:-:6      FADD ya, olda, ya;\n--:-:-:-:6      FADD yb, oldb, yb;\n";
    }
    if ($bias) {
        $o .= "--:2:1:-:1  \@P3 LDG.E biasa, [bp];\n--:2:1:-:2  \@P3 LDG.E biasb, [bbp];\n01:-:-:-:6      FADD ya, ya, biasa;\n--:-:-:-:6      FADD yb, yb, biasb;\n";
    }
    if ($xout) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL xo, row, 0x2;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD xbo, xo, param_BXOFF;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD xo, xo, param_XOFF;\n";
        for my $d (0..5) {
            $o .= sprintf "02:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.64 da0, [ta+0x%x];\n--:2:1:-:2      LDG.E.64 db0, [tb+0x%x];\n",8*$d,8*$d;
            $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      IADD da0.CC, da0, xo;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X da1, da1, RZ;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD db0.CC, db0, xbo;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X db1, db1, RZ;\n--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E.WT [da], ya;\n--:2:-:-:2  \@P2 STG.E.WT [db], yb;\n";
        }
    } else {
        $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], ya;\n--:2:-:-:2  \@P2 STG.E [ybp], yb;\n";
    }
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, wp0, stepw;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, wp1, RZ;\n--:-:-:-:6      SHL tmp, rowstep, 0x2;\n";
    unless ($xout) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, tmp;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD ybp0.CC, ybp0, tmp;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ybp1, ybp1, RZ;\n";
    }
    if ($bias) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD bp0.CC, bp0, tmp;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bp1, bp1, RZ;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD bbp0.CC, bbp0, tmp;\n--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X bbp1, bbp1, RZ;\n";
    }
    return $o . "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";

File: kern/gemv_bf16_test.c
/*
 * gemv_bf16_test: run the MaxAs gemv_bf16 kernel on a real BF16 tensor and compare
 * bit-for-bit with gemv_bf16_ref.
 *
 *   gemv_bf16_test SHARD1 [tensor] [iters]
 *
 * Default tensor blk.4.ffn_gate_inp.weight (router, 512 rows x 2560). Any BF16
 * tensor with K = 2560 or K = 320 works (e.g. blk.4.hc_attn_up.weight, 10240 x 320).
 * GEMV_GRID caps the grid (persistent-style looping).
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "gguf.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }
static uint32_t rs = 4242;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gemv_bf16_test SHARD1 [tensor] [iters]\n"); return 2; }
	const char *tname = argc > 2 ? argv[2] : "blk.4.ffn_gate_inp.weight";
	int iters = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 20;
	gguf_file g;
	if (gguf_open(&g, argv[1])) return 1;
	const gguf_tensor *t = gguf_find(&g, tname);
	if (!t || !t->data) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: not found\n", tname); return 1; }
	if (t->type != GG_BF16) { fprintf(stderr, "%s is %s, not BF16\n", tname, gguf_type_name(t->type)); return 1; }
	int K = (int)t->dims[0], rows = (int)(t->elems / K);
	if (K != 2560 && K != 320 && K != 10240) { fprintf(stderr, "kernels exist for K=2560, K=320 and K=10240 (as 4 slices), tensor has K=%d\n", K); return 1; }
	/* K=10240 runs as 4 ordered K=2560 column slices accumulating into y */
	int slices = K == 10240 ? 4 : 1, Ks = K / slices;
	int L = bf16_lanes_per_row(Ks), RPC = 256 / L;
	printf("%s: BF16 K=%d rows=%d (%.1f MB), %d lanes per row, %d slice(s)\n", tname, K, rows, (double)rows * K * 2 / 1e6, L, slices);

	const uint16_t *W = (const uint16_t *)t->data;
	float *x = malloc(sizeof(float) * K);
	for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = frand() * (1.f + (k % 3));
	const char *pat = getenv("GEMV_PATTERN");
	if (pat && !strcmp(pat, "ones")) for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 1.f;
	float *yref = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows), *y = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows);
	double t0 = now();
	if (slices == 1) gemv_bf16_ref(W, rows, K, x, yref);
	else {
		uint16_t *Ws = malloc(sizeof(uint16_t) * (size_t)rows * Ks);
		float *p = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) yref[r] = 0.f;
		for (int s = 0; s < slices; s++) {
			for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) memcpy(Ws + (size_t)r * Ks, W + (size_t)r * K + s * Ks, sizeof(uint16_t) * Ks);
			gemv_bf16_ref(Ws, rows, Ks, x + s * Ks, p);
			for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) yref[r] = yref[r] + p[r];
		}
		free(Ws); free(p);
	}
	double t1 = now();
	printf("reference %.1f ms\n", (t1 - t0) * 1e3);

	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	char cubin[64];
	if (slices == 1) snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "gemv_bf16_k%d.cubin", K);
	else snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "gemv_bf16_hc.cubin");
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "gemv_bf16"));
	int nregs, maxb;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fn, 256, 0));
	CUdeviceptr dW, dX, dY, dD;
	size_t wbytes = (size_t)rows * K * 2;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, wbytes));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, sizeof(float) * K));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, sizeof(float) * rows));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dD, 4096));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, W, wbytes));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, sizeof(float) * K));
	unsigned urows = (unsigned)rows;
	unsigned grid = (urows + RPC - 1) / RPC;
	if (getenv("GEMV_GRID") && (unsigned)atoi(getenv("GEMV_GRID")) < grid) grid = (unsigned)atoi(getenv("GEMV_GRID"));
	printf("kernel: %d registers, %d CTAs/SM; grid %u x 256, %u rows per CTA iteration\n", nregs, maxb, grid, RPC);
	CUdeviceptr sW[4], sX[4];
	void *params[4][5];
	for (int s = 0; s < slices; s++) {
		sW[s] = dW + (size_t)s * Ks * 2;
		sX[s] = dX + (size_t)s * Ks * 4;
		params[s][0] = &sW[s]; params[s][1] = &sX[s]; params[s][2] = &dY; params[s][3] = &urows; params[s][4] = &dD;
	}
	/* the accumulating slices start from y = 0; a single slice overwrites */
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, rows));
	/* the fused kernel (GEMV_SLICES=4) runs all four slices in one launch */
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params[0], NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(y, dY, sizeof(float) * rows));
	int bad = 0;
	double maxabs = 0;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		if (memcmp(&y[r], &yref[r], 4)) { if (bad < 6) printf("  row %d: gpu % .9g ref % .9g\n", r, y[r], yref[r]); bad++; }
		double a = fabs((double)y[r] - yref[r]);
		if (a > maxabs || isnan(a)) maxabs = a;
	}
	printf("%s: %d of %d rows differ (max abs %.3e)\n", bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, rows, maxabs);
	if (iters > 0) {
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params[0], NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double ta = now();
		for (int i = 0; i < iters; i++)
			CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params[0], NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double tb = now();
		double per = (tb - ta) / iters;
		printf("%.1f us per matvec, %.1f GB/s of weights\n", per * 1e6, (double)wbytes / per / 1e9);
	}
	return bad ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/gemv_iq4_xs.sass
# Kernel: gemv_iq4_xs
#
# IQ4_XS GEMV, GEMV_K=2560 (default, 16 lanes x 5 blocks) or 6144 (32 lanes x 6).
#
# Tile (ref/quant.h repack_iq4_xs): per row [prefix: Q x 16 B of fp16 d, lane group q
# holds the d of blocks Q i + q] [nibbles: block b, sub-block j at 128 b + 16 j,
# element 2i low / 2i+1 high] [scales: int8 (ls - 32) at 128 B + 8 b + j], Q = L / 8.
# Element value = d * (ls - 32) * kvalues[q], kvalues = the IQ4_NL table.
#
# Lane l = (q = l >> 3, jj = l & 7) owns sub-block jj of block Q i + q and keeps
# those 32 activations (int16) in registers. The table lookup is done with PRMT:
# a nibble word is its own PRMT selector (4 nibbles per PRMT; the upper four after
# SHR 16). With selector bit 3 set PRMT replicates the sign of the selected byte,
# so lo = PRMT(kv[0..7], w) is kv[q] for q < 8 and 0xFF otherwise (kv[0..7] < 0),
# hi = PRMT(kv[8..15], w ^ 0x8888) is kv[q] for q >= 8 and 0x00 otherwise, and
# PRMT(0x7F.., w) is 0x7F for q < 8 and 0x00 otherwise; (m | m << 1) is the byte
# select mask and LOP3 0xE2 picks lo or hi. Two more PRMTs sign-extend the bytes
# into int16 pairs for XMAD.S16.S16 into 8 round-robin accumulators.
#   dot = sum kv[q] a (exact); sumi = sc * dot (two XMADs: low half unsigned, high
#   half signed); accf = fma(d, (float)sumi, accf)
# then the SHFL butterfly, lane 0 stores accf * xs. gemv_iq4_xs_ref mirrors it.
#
# Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = store reads and prologue loads, 3 = I2F, 4 = F2F,
# 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 W  1:0x148:8 X16  2:0x150:8 (unused)  3:0x158:8 Y
#         4:0x160:4 rows  5:0x164:4 xs  6:0x168:8 dbg

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    gridDimX   : c[0x0][0x14]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_rows : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_xs   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x174]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>

    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $Q = $L / 8;
    my $n = ($K / 256) / $Q;
    my $na = 16 * $n;
    my $dp = $na;
    my $nb = $dp + 4;
    my $sc = $nb + 4 * $n;
    my $T = $sc + $n;
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= sprintf "    0-%d : act<00-%02d>\n", $na - 1, $na - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : dp<0-3>\n", $dp, $dp + 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : nb<00-%02d>\n", $nb, $nb + 4*$n - 1, 4*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : sc<0-%d>\n", $sc, $sc + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    my @t4 = qw(tt x0 x1 lo hi mk lo2 hi2 mk2);
    my $r = $T;
    for my $name (@t4) { $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : %s<0-3>\n", $r, $r + 3, $name; $r += 4; }
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : mb<0-7>\n", $r, $r + 7;
    $r += 8;
    # aliases: R over tt/x0 (dead after the lookups), p over lo/hi/mk/lo2 (dead after the LOP3s)
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : R<0-7>\n", $T, $T + 7;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : p<00-15>\n", $T + 12, $T + 27;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : acc<0-7>\n", $r, $r + 7;
    $r += 8;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : as<0-%d>\n", $r, $r + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $r += $n;
    my @scal = qw(tl0 tl1 th0 th1 t7f dot sumi t sumif dd accf u row rowpair rowstep stepw);
    for my $name (@scal) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    $r += $r & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : pp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : np<0-1>\n    %d,%d : sp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n",
        $r, $r+1, $r+2, $r+3, $r+4, $r+5, $r+6, $r+7;
    # prologue temporaries alias the nibble registers (dead before the loop)
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n", $nb, $nb + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : ap<0-1>\n", $nb + 12, $nb + 13;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : lane\n    %d : grp\n    %d : tid\n    %d : bid\n    %d : off\n    %d : t1p\n    %d : q\n    %d : jj\n    %d : base2\n",
        $nb+2, $nb+3, $nb+4, $nb+5, $nb+6, $nb+7, $nb+8, $nb+9, $nb+10;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;

<CODE>

    my $B = $K / 256;
    my $n = $B / $Q;
    my $R = 256 / $L;
    my $S = 16 * $Q + 136 * $B;
    my $lgL = int(log($L)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $lgR = int(log($R)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;
    my @kv = (-127, -104, -83, -65, -49, -35, -22, -10, 1, 13, 25, 38, 53, 69, 89, 113);
    my $tw = sub { my $k = shift; my $w = 0; $w |= ($kv[4*$k + $_] & 0xff) << (8*$_) for 0..3; return $w; };
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $rr, $cst) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $cst & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $first;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $x;
    };
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND jj, lane, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 q, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rowpair, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~($wrows - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    $o .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
    # lookup tables
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I tl0, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(0);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I tl1, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(1);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I th0, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(2);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I th1, 0x%08x;\n", $tw->(3);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I t7f, 0x7f7f7f7f;\n";
    # pp = W + off + 16 q
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, q, off, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # np = W + off + 16 Q + 128 q + 16 jj
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL base2, q, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, off;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, 0x%x;\n", 16 * $Q;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD np0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X np1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # sp = W + off + 16 Q + 128 B + 8 q + jj
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL base2, q, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, off;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, 0x%x;\n", 16 * $Q + 128 * $B;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, jj, base2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # yp = Y + 4 row
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, row, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1p, param_Y0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    # activation scales: sub-block i at AS + 4 (lane + L i)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t1p, param_AS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_AS1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI as%d, [ap+0x%x];\n", $i, 4*$L*$i; }
    # activations: xp = X + 512 q + 64 jj ; step i at + 512 Q i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, q, 0x9;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, t1p, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1p, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", ($i == $n-1 && $k == 3) ? '6' : '1',
                16*$i + 4*$k, 512*$Q*$i + 16*$k;
        }
    }

    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 dp0, [pp];\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 nb%02d, [np+0x%x];\n", 4*$i, 128*$Q*$i; }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.S8 sc%d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $i == $n-1 ? '2' : '1', $i, 8*$Q*$i; }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD rowpair, rowpair, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rowpair, param_rows, PT;\n";

    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        my $wait = $i == 0 ? '03' : '--';
        my @w = map { sprintf "nb%02d", 4*$i + $_ } 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:4:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 dd, dp%d%s;\n", $wait, $i >> 1, ($i & 1) ? '.H1' : '';
        # selectors
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 tt%d, %s, 0x10;\n", $_, $w[$_] for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      LOP32I.XOR x0%d, %s, 0x88888888;\n", ($_ == 3 ? '3' : '1'), $_, $w[$_] for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 x1%d, x0%d, 0x10;\n", $_, $_ for 0..3;
        # lookups: nibbles 0-3 of each word, then 4-7
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT lo%d, tl0, %s, tl1;\n", $k, $w[$k];
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT hi%d, th0, x0%d, th1;\n", $k, $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT mk%d, t7f, %s, t7f;\n", $k, $w[$k];
        }
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT lo2%d, tl0, tt%d, tl1;\n", $k, $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT hi2%d, th0, x1%d, th1;\n", $k, $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT mk2%d, t7f, tt%d, t7f;\n", $k, $k;
        }
        # byte select masks 0x7F -> 0xFF
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHL mb%d, mk%d, 0x1;\n", $_, $_ for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHL mb%d, mk2%d, 0x1;\n", 4 + $_, $_ for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.OR mk%d, mk%d, mb%d;\n", $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP.OR mk2%d, mk2%d, mb%d;\n", $_, $_, 4 + $_ for 0..3;
        # R = mask ? lo : hi
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP3.LUT R%d, lo%d, mk%d, hi%d, 0xe2;\n", $_, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP3.LUT R%d, lo2%d, mk2%d, hi2%d, 0xe2;\n", 4 + $_, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
        # int16 pairs: p[4w+k] = elements 8w+2k, 8w+2k+1
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0x9180, RZ;\n", 4*$k, $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0xb3a2, RZ;\n", 4*$k + 1, $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0x9180, RZ;\n", 4*$k + 2, 4 + $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT p%02d, R%d, 0xb3a2, RZ;\n", 4*$k + 3, 4 + $k;
        }
        # 32 MACs, accumulator = element & 7
        my $j = 0;
        for my $k (0..3) {
            for my $kk (0..3) {
                for my $hh (0, 1) {
                    my $acc = sprintf "acc%d", $j & 7;
                    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.S16.S16 %s, p%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                        $acc, 4*$k + $kk, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 4*$k + $kk, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', $j < 8 ? 'RZ' : $acc;
                    $j++;
                }
            }
        }
        # dot = sum acc
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc0, acc0, acc1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc2, acc2, acc3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc4, acc4, acc5;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc6, acc6, acc7;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc0, acc0, acc2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc4, acc4, acc6;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dot, acc0, acc4;\n";
        # sumi = sc * dot (32 x 16 -> 32)
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 sumi, dot, sc%d, RZ;\n", $i;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD.S16.S16 t, dot.H1, sc%d, RZ;\n", $i;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD sumi, t, sumi, 0x10;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:6      I2F.F32.S32 sumif, sumi;\n";
        $o .= "0c:-:-:-:6      FMUL u, dd, sumif;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, as%d, u, accf;\n", $i;
    }
    for (my $x = $L / 2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, accf, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, accf, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], accf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, pp0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, pp1, RZ;\n";
    for my $p (qw(np sp)) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, %s0, stepw;\n", $p, $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, %s1, RZ;\n", $p, $p;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, rowstep, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/gemv_k_test.c
/*
 * gemv_k_test: K-quant GEMV kernels on real tensors, bit-exact against the C
 * reference in the kernel's accumulation order. Q4_K and Q5_K.
 *
 *   gemv_k_test SHARD1 [tensor] [iters]
 *
 * Default tensor blk.3.attn_output.weight (Q4_K, K=6144, 2560 rows). Any Q4_K or
 * Q5_K tensor with K = 2560 or 6144 works, e.g. output.weight (Q5_K, 248320 rows)
 * or blk.0.ssm_out.weight (Q5_K, K=6144). GEMV_GRID caps the grid
 * (persistent-style looping).
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "gguf.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }
static uint32_t rs = 99;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gemv_k_test SHARD1 [tensor] [iters]\n"); return 2; }
	const char *tname = argc > 2 ? argv[2] : "blk.3.attn_output.weight";
	int iters = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 20;
	gguf_file g;
	if (gguf_open(&g, argv[1])) return 1;
	const gguf_tensor *t = gguf_find(&g, tname);
	if (!t || !t->data) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: not found\n", tname); return 1; }
	int q5 = t->type == GG_Q5_K, q3 = t->type == GG_Q3_K, q6 = t->type == GG_Q6_K, x4 = t->type == GG_IQ4_XS;
	int b32 = t->type == GG_Q4_0 || t->type == GG_Q5_0 || t->type == GG_Q8_0 || t->type == GG_IQ4_NL;
	if (t->type != GG_Q4_K && !q5 && !q3 && !q6 && !x4 && !b32) { fprintf(stderr, "%s is %s; only Q3_K, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K, IQ4_XS and the block-32 formats so far\n", tname, gguf_type_name(t->type)); return 1; }
	const char *kname = q5 ? "gemv_q5_k" : q3 ? "gemv_q3_k" : q6 ? "gemv_q6_k" : x4 ? "gemv_iq4_xs" : "gemv_q4_k";
	if (b32) kname = t->type == GG_Q4_0 ? "gemv_q4_0" : t->type == GG_Q5_0 ? "gemv_q5_0" : t->type == GG_Q8_0 ? "gemv_q8_0" : "gemv_iq4_nl";
	int K = (int)t->dims[0], rows = (int)(t->elems / K);
	if (b32 ? K != 640 : (K != 2560 && K != 6144)) { fprintf(stderr, "no kernel for %s with K=%d\n", gguf_type_name(t->type), K); return 1; }
	int L = b32 ? 4 : q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), RPC = 256 / L;
	int stride = b32 ? b32_tile_stride(t->type, K) : q5 ? q5_k_tile_stride(K) : q3 ? q3_k_tile_stride(K) : q6 ? q6_k_tile_stride(K) : x4 ? iq4_xs_tile_stride(K) : q4_k_tile_stride(K);
	printf("%s: %s K=%d rows=%d (%.1f MB), %d lanes per row, tile stride %d\n", tname, gguf_type_name(t->type), K, rows, (double)rows * stride / 1e6, L, stride);

	/* repack and check the tile against the standard dequantiser on a few rows */
	uint8_t *tile = malloc((size_t)stride * rows);
	double t0 = now();
	if (b32) repack_b32(t->type, t->data, rows, K, tile);
	else if (q5) repack_q5_k(t->data, rows, K, tile);
	else if (q3) repack_q3_k(t->data, rows, K, tile);
	else if (q6) repack_q6_k(t->data, rows, K, tile);
	else if (x4) repack_iq4_xs(t->data, rows, K, tile);
	else repack_q4_k(t->data, rows, K, tile);
	double t1 = now();
	{
		float *a = malloc(sizeof(float) * K), *b = malloc(sizeof(float) * K);
		int bad = 0, B = K / 256, Q = L / 8;
		uint32_t gelems = 0, gbytes = 0;
		gguf_block(t->type, &gelems, &gbytes);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows && r < 7; r += 3) {
			dequant(t->type, t->data + (size_t)r * (K / gelems) * gbytes, a, K);
			const uint8_t *hdr = tile + (size_t)r * stride, *codes = hdr + 16 * B, *hb = hdr + 144 * B;
			for (int e = 0; e < K; e++) {
				if (b32) {
					b[e] = b32_tile_value(t->type, tile, K, r, e);
				} else if (x4) {
					int blk = e / 256, j = (e & 255) >> 5, el = e & 31;
					const uint8_t *nib = hdr + 16 * Q + 128 * blk + 16 * j;
					int qv = (nib[el >> 1] >> (4 * (el & 1))) & 0xF;
					uint16_t dh; memcpy(&dh, hdr + 16 * (blk % Q) + 2 * (blk / Q), 2);
					b[e] = (fp16_to_fp32(dh) * (float)(int8_t)hdr[16 * Q + 128 * B + 8 * blk + j]) * (float)iq4_kvalue(qv);
				} else if (q6) {
					int blk = e / 256, j = (e & 255) >> 5, el = e & 31, g = (e & 255) >> 4;
					const uint8_t *rec = hdr + 16 * Q + 208 * blk;
					uint32_t hw; memcpy(&hw, rec + 128 + 8 * j + 4 * (el >> 4), 4);
					int eh = el & 15;
					int q6v = ((rec[16 * j + (el >> 1)] >> (4 * (el & 1))) & 0xF) | (((hw >> (16 * (eh >> 3) + 2 * (eh & 7))) & 3) << 4);
					uint16_t dh; memcpy(&dh, hdr + 16 * (blk % Q) + 2 * (blk / Q), 2);
					b[e] = fp16_to_fp32(dh) * (float)(int8_t)rec[192 + g] * (float)(q6v - 32);
				} else if (q3) {
					int blk = e / 256, g = (e & 255) >> 4, el = e & 15;
					const uint8_t *rec = hdr + 16 * Q + 112 * blk;
					uint32_t cw; memcpy(&cw, rec + 4 * g, 4);
					int code = (cw >> (16 * (el >> 3) + 2 * (el & 7))) & 3, hinv = (rec[64 + 2 * g + (el >> 3)] >> (el & 7)) & 1;
					uint16_t dh; memcpy(&dh, hdr + 16 * (blk % Q) + 2 * (blk / Q), 2);
					b[e] = (fp16_to_fp32(dh) * (float)(int8_t)rec[96 + g]) * (float)(code - 4 * hinv);
				} else {
					int s = e / 32, blk = s >> 3, j = s & 7, sc, mn;
					q4_k_scale_min(hdr + 16 * blk + 4, j, &sc, &mn);
					int q = (codes[128 * blk + 16 * j + ((e & 31) >> 1)] >> (4 * (e & 1))) & 0xF;
					if (q5) { uint32_t hw; memcpy(&hw, hb + 32 * blk + 4 * j, 4); q += 16 * ((hw >> (e & 31)) & 1); }
					uint16_t dh, mh;
					memcpy(&dh, hdr + 16 * blk, 2); memcpy(&mh, hdr + 16 * blk + 2, 2);
					b[e] = fp16_to_fp32(dh) * sc * q - fp16_to_fp32(mh) * mn;
				}
				if (b[e] != a[e]) { if (bad < 3) printf("  repack check row %d elem %d: tile %g gguf %g\n", r, e, b[e], a[e]); bad++; }
			}
		}
		printf("repack %.1f ms, tile-vs-gguf dequant check: %s\n", (t1 - t0) * 1e3, bad ? "DIFFERS" : "identical");
		free(a); free(b);
		if (bad) return 4;
	}
	float *x = malloc(sizeof(float) * K);
	for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = frand() * (1.f + (k % 5));
	const char *pat = getenv("GEMV_PATTERN");
	if (pat && !strcmp(pat, "ones")) for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 1.f;
	else if (pat && !strncmp(pat, "onehot:", 7)) { for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 0.f; x[atoi(pat + 7) % K] = 1.f; }
	else if (pat && !strncmp(pat, "twohot:", 7)) { for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 0.f; int a1 = atoi(pat + 7), b1 = atoi(strchr(pat, ',') + 1); x[a1 % K] = 1.f; x[b1 % K] = 0.5f; }
	else if (pat && !strncmp(pat, "range:", 6)) { for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 0.f; int a1 = atoi(pat + 6), b1 = atoi(strchr(pat, ',') + 1); for (int k = a1; k < b1 && k < K; k++) x[k] = 1.f; }
	else if (pat && !strncmp(pat, "lane:", 5)) { for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 0.f; int l0 = atoi(pat + 5); for (int k = 0; k < 32; k++) x[(32 * l0 + k) % K] = 1.f; }
	int32_t *sum32 = malloc(sizeof(int32_t) * K / 32);
	int16_t *x16 = malloc(sizeof(int16_t) * K);
	int32_t *sum16 = malloc(sizeof(int32_t) * K / 16);
	float *as = malloc(sizeof(float) * K / 32);
	quant_act_gpu32(x, K, x16, sum32, sum16, as);
	int8_t *xq = malloc(K);
	for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) xq[k] = (int8_t)x16[k];
	float xs = 1.f;
	float *yref = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows), *y = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows);
	t0 = now();
	if (b32) gemv_b32_ref(t->type, tile, rows, K, xq, sum32, as, yref);
	else if (q5) gemv_q5_k_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, sum32, as, yref);
	else if (q3) gemv_q3_k_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, as, yref);
	else if (q6) gemv_q6_k_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, sum16, as, yref);
	else if (x4) gemv_iq4_xs_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, as, yref);
	else gemv_q4_k_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, sum32, as, yref);
	t1 = now();
	printf("reference %.1f ms\n", (t1 - t0) * 1e3);

	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	char cubin[64];
	snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "%s_k%d.cubin", kname, K);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, kname));
	int nregs, maxb;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fn, 256, 0));
	CUdeviceptr dW, dX, dS, dY, dD, dAS;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, (size_t)stride * rows));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, sizeof(int16_t) * K));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, sizeof(int32_t) * K / 16 + 64));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, sizeof(float) * rows));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dD, 4096));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dAS, sizeof(float) * K / 32 + 64));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dAS, as, sizeof(float) * K / 32));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, tile, (size_t)stride * rows));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x16, sizeof(int16_t) * K));
	/* Q6_K takes per-16 sums in the sums slot, the others per-32 */
	if (q6) CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, sum16, sizeof(int32_t) * K / 16));
	else CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, sum32, sizeof(int32_t) * K / 32));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, rows));
	unsigned urows = (unsigned)rows;
	void *params[] = { &dW, &dX, &dS, &dY, &urows, &xs, &dD, &dAS };
	unsigned grid = (urows + RPC - 1) / RPC;
	if (getenv("GEMV_GRID") && (unsigned)atoi(getenv("GEMV_GRID")) < grid) grid = (unsigned)atoi(getenv("GEMV_GRID"));
	printf("kernel: %d registers, %d CTAs/SM; grid %u x 256, %u rows per CTA iteration\n", nregs, maxb, grid, RPC);
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(y, dY, sizeof(float) * rows));
	int bad = 0;
	double maxabs = 0;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		if (memcmp(&y[r], &yref[r], 4)) { if (bad < 6) printf("  row %d: gpu % .9g ref % .9g\n", r, y[r], yref[r]); bad++; }
		double a = fabs((double)y[r] - yref[r]);
		if (a > maxabs || isnan(a)) maxabs = a;
	}
	printf("%s: %d of %d rows differ (max abs %.3e)\n", bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, rows, maxabs);
	if (iters > 0) {
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double ta = now();
		for (int i = 0; i < iters; i++) CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double tb = now();
		double per = (tb - ta) / iters;
		printf("%.1f us per matvec, %.1f GB/s of tile\n", per * 1e6, (double)stride * rows / per / 1e9);
	}
	return bad ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/gemv_q2_0.sass
# Kernel: gemv_q2_0
#
# y[r] = xs * sum_k W[r][k] * x[k] for a Q2_0 row tile. Built for one K at a time:
# GEMV_K=2560 (default) or GEMV_K=640 in the environment when assembling.
#
# Tile layout per row: B = K/64 fp16 scales padded to 16 B, then B x 16 B of
# 2-bit codes. Activations: int16 (sign-extended int8) x[K]; sums: int32 per
# half-block (K/32 of them). L = (K/32)/5 lanes per row (16 or 4), so every lane
# owns 5 half-blocks h = lane + L i and keeps their 160 activations in registers
# act00..act79 for the whole kernel. CTA = 256 threads = 256/L rows per iteration.
#
# Per half-block, per word (16 weights): 8 LOP32I isolate weight pairs at bit shift
# 2s in both halves, then 16 XMAD.U16.S16 accumulate (q << 2s) * a into acc_s.
# dot = sum_s acc_s >> 2s, with the half-block activation sum (the q-1 offset)
# folded into acc_0's first XMAD, then accf = fma(fp32(d_b), float(dot), accf).
# Reduce the L lanes with a SHFL butterfly, scale by xs, lane 0 stores.
#
# Register banks (reg % 4): m_s sits in bank (2+s)%4 and acc_s in bank (3+s)%4
# (acc_s = R98 + (s+1)%8), so the mask and accumulator operands of an XMAD never
# share a bank; the activation operand of odd s is a reuse of the even s register.
#
# Scheduling rules used (measured on the M60, see semtest2):
#   fixed-latency ALU -> dependent ALU: 6 cycles; the 8 independent acc chains and
#   the 8 masks keep dependent XMADs >= 8 issues apart at stall 1.
#   variable-latency ops (LDG, I2F, F2F, SHFL, S2R) set a write barrier and need
#   stall >= 2 before a dependent wait is honoured.
# Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = address/store reads and prologue loads, 3 = I2F,
# 4 = F2F, 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Build switches (environment at assembly time): GEMV_K; GEMV_TRACE=1 (per-lane
# debug trace through the 7th parameter); timing-decomposition switches whose
# results are wrong: GEMV_NOLOAD=1, GEMV_NOCOMPUTE=1, GEMV_NOSCALE=1 (skip the
# scale loads), GEMV_NOCI=1 (plain LDG.E instead of the read-only LDG.E.CI path).
#
# Params:
#   0:0x140:8 W   1:0x148:8 X16   2:0x150:8 S32   3:0x158:8 Y   4:0x160:4 rows   5:0x164:4 xs   6:0x168:8 trace

    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]

    param_S1   : c[0x0][0x154]
