<CODE>
    # geometry shared by every block below (each block is evaluated on its own)
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $B = $K / 64;
    my $L = ($K / 32) / 5;                       # lanes per row: 16 or 4
    my $R = 256 / $L;                            # rows per CTA iteration
    my $pad = int((2*$B + 15) / 16) * 16;        # scale area, 16 B aligned
    my $S = $pad + 16*$B;                        # row stride in bytes
    my $lgL = int(log($L)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $lgR = int(log($R)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;                         # rows per warp
    my $ci = $ENV{GEMV_NOCI} ? '' : '.CI';

    # d = r * c as shifts and adds (c > 0), into register $d using $r
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $r, $c) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $c & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $s = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $r, $first;
        $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $r, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $s;
    };

    # MoE modes (expert-outer loop, GEMV_EXPERTS experts whose indices are in *D):
    #   gather: rows = e erows + r, weights W + idx[e] estride + r S, y + 4 (e erows + r),
    #           activations shared (gate/up of the routed experts)
    #   down:   rows r of every expert, activations/sums/scales per expert (X, S, AS +
    #           e strides), y[r] = fma(we[e], dot_e, y[r]) in expert order (e = 0: we dot)
    # GEMV_ACC (no MoE): y[r] = fma(*WE, dot, y[r]) (the shared expert's down projection)
    my $moe = $ENV{GEMV_MOE} || '';
    my $acc = $ENV{GEMV_ACC} ? 1 : 0;
    my $NE = $ENV{GEMV_EXPERTS} || 10;
    my $erows = $ENV{GEMV_EROWS} || ($K == 640 ? 2560 : 640);
    my $estride = $erows * $S;
    my $astride = 2 * $K;                        # per-expert activation codes (down)
    my $sstride = 4 * ($K / 32);                 # per-expert sums / scales (down)

    # lane geometry from tid, bid (re-derived per expert: the loop body clobbers these aliases)
    my $geom = sub {
        my $s = '';
        $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
        $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND half, lane, 0x1;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 blk0, lane, 0x1;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
        return $s;
    };
    # row, tile pointers and y pointer; $eo: add eoff (expert tile offset); $ye: y offset by expert
    my $rowsetup = sub {
        my ($eo, $ye) = @_;
        my $s = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
        $s .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD off, off, eoff;\n" if $eo;
        # ws = W + off + 2 blk0
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1, blk0, off, 0x1;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ws0.CC, t1, param_W0;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ws1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
        # wq = W + off + pad + 16 blk0 + 8 half
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1, blk0, off, 0x4;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1, half, t1, 0x3;\n";
        $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, 0x%x;\n", $pad;
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wq0.CC, t1, param_W0;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wq1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
        # yp = Y + 4 row (+ 4 erows e)
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, row, 0x2;\n";
        if ($ye) {
            $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t0, e, 0x%x, RZ;\n", 4 * $erows;
            $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, t0;\n";
        }
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1, param_Y0;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
        return $s;
    };
    # activations, sums and scales for this lane (+ per-expert strides when $pe)
    my $actload = sub {
        my ($pe) = @_;
        my $s = '';
        # activations: xp = X + 64 lane; half-block i at +64 L i
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, lane, 0x6;\n";
        if ($pe) { $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t0, e, 0x%x, RZ;\n", $astride; $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, t0;\n"; }
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1, param_X0;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
        for my $i (0..4) {
            for my $j (0..3) {
                $s .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E%s.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", $ci, 16*$i + 4*$j, 64*$L*$i + 16*$j;
            }
        }
        # sums: sp = S + 4 lane; half-block i at +4 L i
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, lane, 0x2;\n";
        if ($pe) { $s .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t0, e, 0x%x, RZ;\n", $sstride; $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, t0;\n"; }
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t1, param_S0;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_S1;\n";
        for my $i (0..4) {
            $s .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E%s s%d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $i == 4 ? '6' : '1', $ci, $i, 4*$L*$i;
        }
        # activation scales: half-block i at AS + 4 (lane + L i)
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t1, param_AS0;\n";
        $s .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_AS1;\n";
        for my $i (0..4) {
            $s .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E%s as%d, [ap+0x%x];\n", $i == 4 ? '6' : '1', $ci, $i, 4*$L*$i;
        }
        # park them in shared memory (registers are full); the loop reloads one per half-block
        for my $i (0..4) {
            $s .= sprintf "%s:4:-:-:%s      STS [smaddr+0x%x], as%d;\n", $i == 0 ? '02' : '--', $i == 4 ? '6' : '1', 4*$i, $i;
        }
        for my $i (0..4) {
            $s .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      IADD3 nsum%d, RZ, -s%d, RZ;\n", $i == 0 ? '0a' : '--', $i == 4 ? '6' : '1', $i, $i;
        }
        return $s;
    };

    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:1      MOV tidk, tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV bidk, bid;\n";
    $o .= $geom->();
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= $mulc->('smaddr', 'tid', 20);              # shared slot: 5 activation scales per thread
    if ($ENV{GEMV_TRACE} || $ENV{GEMV_TIMING} || $ENV{GEMV_DPONLY}) {
        # dp = D + 48 L row + 48 lane (12 words per lane per row)
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
        $o .= $mulc->('t0', 'row', 48 * $L);
        $o .= $mulc->('t1', 'lane', 48);
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1, t1, t0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dp0.CC, t1, param_D0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dp1, RZ, param_D1;\n";
    }
    if ($acc && !$moe) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV wep0, param_WE0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV wep1, param_WE1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDG.E we, [wep];\n";
    }
    if (!$moe) {
        $o .= $rowsetup->(0, 0);
        $o .= $actload->(0);
        return $o;
    }
    # ---- expert-outer loop ----
    if ($ENV{GEMV_NEPTR}) {              # expert count from memory (*NE, written by moesel); none: nothing to do
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV nep0, param_NE0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV nep1, param_NE1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDG.E ne, [nep];\n";
        $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, ne, RZ, PT;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6 \@!P4 EXIT;\n";
    }
    # ---- expert-outer loop ----
    $o .= $actload->(0) if $moe eq 'gather';
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV e, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "\nEXPERT:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV tid, tidk;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV bid, bidk;\n";
    $o .= $geom->();
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1, e, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ixp0.CC, t1, param_D0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ixp1, RZ, param_D1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E eoff, [ixp];\n";
    if ($moe eq 'down') {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wep0.CC, t1, param_WE0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wep1, RZ, param_WE1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDG.E we, [wep];\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, e, RZ, PT;\n";          # first expert: y = we dot
    # eoff = idx * estride (idx < 2^16)
    $o .= sprintf "02:-:-:-:6      XMAD t0, eoff, 0x%x, RZ;\n", $estride & 0xffff;
    if ($estride >> 16) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD.PSL eoff, eoff, 0x%x, t0;\n", $estride >> 16; }
    else { $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eoff, t0;\n"; }
    $o .= $rowsetup->(1, $moe eq 'gather');
    $o .= $actload->(1) if $moe eq 'down';
    return $o;

// Predicates for this row, computed here because their consumers are hundreds of
// cycles away: a predicate written by ISETP is not safe to read until ~18 cycles
// later (measured on the M60; 6-13 cycle gaps read the previous value).
// P2: store this row; P1: run another iteration after this one.
--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;
<CODE>
    # P1 from the warp's first row: (row & ~(wrows-1)) + rowstep < rows
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $L = ($K / 32) / 5;
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;
    my $o = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~($wrows - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, t, param_rows, PT;\n";
    return $o;

<CODE>
    my $trace = $ENV{GEMV_TRACE} ? 1 : 0;
    my @out;
    if ($ENV{GEMV_NOCOMPUTE}) {
        my $o = "03:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      CS2R acc1, SR_CLOCKLO;\n" if $ENV{GEMV_TIMING};
        return $o;
    }
    for my $i (0..4) {
        # scale to fp32 first; its consumer is the FFMA at the end of this half-block
        my $wait = $i == 0 ? ($ENV{GEMV_SCALEBAR} ? sprintf("%02x", 3 | (1 << ($ENV{GEMV_SCALEBAR} - 1))) : '03') : '--';
        push @out, sprintf "%s:-:4:-:2      F2F.F32.F16 t, d%d;\n", $wait, $i;
        push @out, sprintf "--:-:4:-:1      LDS d%d, [smaddr+0x%x];\n", $i, 4*$i;    # this half-block's activation scale
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:6      DEPBAR.LE SB0, 0x0;\n" if $i == 0 && $ENV{GEMV_DEPBAR};
        for my $w (0..1) {
            my $q = 'q' . (2*$i + $w);
            for my $s (0..7) {
                my $mask = sprintf '0x%08x', (0x00030003 << (2*$s)) & 0xffffffff;
                my $wt = (($trace || $ENV{GEMV_TRACEWAIT}) && $i == 1 && $w == 0 && $s == 0) ? '02' : '--';
                push @out, sprintf "%s:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND m%d, %s, %s;\n", $wt, $s, $q, $mask;
            }
            for my $hsel (0, 1) {
                for my $s (0..7) {
                    my $elem = 16*$w + 8*$hsel + $s;
                    my $reg  = 16*$i + int($elem / 2);
                    my $part = ($elem & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0';
                    my $add  = ($w == 0 && $hsel == 0) ? ($s == 0 ? "nsum$i" : 'RZ') : "acc$s";
                    push @out, sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 acc%d, m%d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                        $s, $s, ($hsel ? 'H1' : 'H0'), $reg, $part, $add;
                }
            }
        }
        # combine: acc_s >> 2s, summed as a tree; stalls follow the 6-cycle ALU latency
        for my $s (1..7) {
            push @out, sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR acc%d, acc%d, 0x%x;\n", $s, $s, 2*$s;
        }
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc0, acc0, acc1;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc2, acc2, acc3;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc4, acc4, acc5;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:2      IADD acc6, acc6, acc7;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:4      IADD acc0, acc0, acc2;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc4, acc4, acc6;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dot, acc0, acc4;\n";
        push @out, "--:-:3:-:6      I2F.F32.S32 dotf, dot;\n";
        push @out, "0c:-:-:-:6      FMUL u, t, dotf;\n";
        push @out, sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, d%d, u, accf;\n", $i;
        if ($trace && $i == 0) {
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp], q0;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp+0x4], q1;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp+0x8], act00;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp+0xc], act01;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp+0x10], nsum0;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp+0x14], d0;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [dp+0x18], dot;\n";
            push @out, "--:2:-:-:6      STG.E [dp+0x1c], accf;\n";
        }
    }
    push @out, "--:2:-:-:6      STG.E [dp+0x20], accf;\n" if $trace;
    return join '', @out;
</CODE>

File: kern/gemv_q3_k.sass
# Kernel: gemv_q3_k
#
# Q3_K GEMV, GEMV_K=2560 (default, 16 lanes x 5 blocks) or 6144 (32 lanes x 6).
#
# Tile (ref/quant.h repack_q3_k): per row [prefix: Q x 16 B of fp16 d, lane group q
# holds the d of blocks Q i + q] [per block 112 B: 16 code words (group g of 16
# elements, element e at bits 2 (e & 7) of half e >> 3), 16 half-words of inverted
# high bits (bit e = !h_e), 16 int8 scales (sc - 32)], Q = L / 8.
# Element value = d * sc * (code - 4 !h).
#
# Lane l = (q = l >> 3, jj = l & 7) owns groups 2jj and 2jj+1 (32 consecutive
# elements) of block Q i + q, i = 0..n-1, and keeps those activations (int16) in
# registers. Per block step:
#   code stream (per group word): masks 0x00030003 << 2s, XMAD.U16.S16 into acc_s
#     (H0 then H1 of the same field into the same accumulator), dot = sum acc_s >> 2s
#   hinv stream (one word, H0 = group 0, H1 = group 1): sources hw >> u, masks
#     0x00010001 << 4v into acch_{4 hh + v}, dh_hh = sum_v acch >> 4v
#   dot_g -= dh_g << 2 ; sumi = sc0 dot0 + sc1 dot1 (XMAD.S16.S16, exact)
#   accf = fma(d, (float)sumi, accf)
# then the SHFL butterfly over L lanes, lane 0 stores accf * xs. gemv_q3_k_ref
# performs the identical float sequence (the integer parts are exact).
#
# Scheduling rules as in gemv_q4_k.sass: fixed-latency 6; variable-latency ops
# need stall >= 2 before a dependent wait; predicates at the loop top; a mask LOP
# >= 6 issues before its XMAD (the next word's masks precede this word's XMADs);
# a combine reads an accumulator >= 6 issues after its last XMAD.
# Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = store reads and prologue loads, 3 = I2F, 4 = F2F,
# 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 W  1:0x148:8 X16  2:0x150:8 S32 (unused)  3:0x158:8 Y
#         4:0x160:4 rows  5:0x164:4 xs  6:0x168:8 dbg

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    gridDimX   : c[0x0][0x14]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_rows : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_xs   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x174]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $Q = $L / 8;
    my $n = ($K / 256) / $Q;                # block steps per lane: 5 or 6
    my $na = 16 * $n;
    my $c = $na;                            # code words: 2 per step (even base)
    my $hw = $c + 2 * $n;
    my $sw = $hw + $n;
    my $dp = $sw + $n;                      # 20 n: a multiple of 4
    my $m = $dp + 4;
    my $a = $m + 16;
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= sprintf "    0-%d : act<00-%02d>\n", $na - 1, $na - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : cw<00-%02d>\n", $c, $c + 2*$n - 1, 2*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : hw<0-%d>\n", $hw, $hw + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : sw<0-%d>\n", $sw, $sw + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : dp<0-3>\n", $dp, $dp + 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : m<00-15>\n", $m, $m + 15;
    for my $k (0..7)  { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acc%02d\n", $a + (($k + 1) & 7), $k; }
    for my $k (0..7)  { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acc%02d\n", $a + 8 + (($k + 1) & 7), 8 + $k; }
    for my $k (0..7)  { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acch%d\n", $a + 16 + (($k + 1) & 7), $k; }
    my $r = $a + 24;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : hs<1-3>\n", $r, $r + 2;
    $r += 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : as<0-%d>\n", $r, $r + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $r += $n;
    my @sc = qw(dot0 dot1 dh0 dh1 sumi sumif dd accf t u scw row rowpair rowstep stepw);
    for my $name (@sc) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    $r += $r & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : pp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : cp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : hp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : sp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n",
        $r, $r+1, $r+2, $r+3, $r+4, $r+5, $r+6, $r+7, $r+8, $r+9;
    # prologue temporaries alias the code-word registers (dead before the loop)
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n", $c, $c + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : ap<0-1>\n", $hw, $hw + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : lane\n    %d : grp\n    %d : tid\n    %d : bid\n    %d : off\n    %d : t1p\n    %d : q\n    %d : jj\n    %d : base2\n",
        $c+2, $c+3, $c+4, $c+5, $c+6, $c+7, $c+8, $c+9, $c+10;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $Q = $L / 8;
    my $B = $K / 256;
    my $n = $B / $Q;
    my $R = 256 / $L;                       # rows per CTA iteration
    my $S = 16 * $Q + 112 * $B;             # row stride
    my $lgL = int(log($L)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $lgR = int(log($R)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;
    my $bstep = 112 * $Q;                   # bytes between a lane's consecutive blocks
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $rr, $cst) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $cst & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $first;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $x;
    };
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND jj, lane, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 q, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rowpair, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~($wrows - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    $o .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
    # pp = W + off + 16 q
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, q, off, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # base2 = off + 16 Q + 112 q
    $o .= $mulc->('base2', 'q', 112);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, off;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, 0x%x;\n", 16 * $Q;
    # cp = W + base2 + 8 jj ; hp = W + base2 + 64 + 4 jj ; sp = W + base2 + 96 + 2 jj
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X cp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x40;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x60;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # yp = Y + 4 row
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, row, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1p, param_Y0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    # activation scales: sub-block i at AS + 4 (lane + L i)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t1p, param_AS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_AS1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI as%d, [ap+0x%x];\n", $i, 4*$L*$i; }
    # activations: xp = X + 512 q + 64 jj ; step i at + 512 Q i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, q, 0x9;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, t1p, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1p, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", ($i == $n-1 && $k == 3) ? '6' : '1',
                16*$i + 4*$k, 512*$Q*$i + 16*$k;
        }
    }

    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 dp0, [pp];\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.64 cw%02d, [cp+0x%x];\n", 2*$i, $bstep*$i; }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI hw%d, [hp+0x%x];\n", $i, $bstep*$i; }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.U16 sw%d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $i == $n-1 ? '2' : '1', $i, $bstep*$i; }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD rowpair, rowpair, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rowpair, param_rows, PT;\n";

    # 2-bit code stream of one group word into acc (base index $ab), masks m[$ms..$ms+7]
    my $cmasks = sub {
        my ($word, $ms, $laststall) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      LOP32I.AND m%02d, %s, 0x%08x;\n", ($_ == 7 ? $laststall : '1'), $ms + $_, $word, (0x00030003 << (2*$_)) & 0xffffffff for 0..7;
        return $x;
    };
    my $cxmads = sub {
        my ($i, $gg, $ms, $ab) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $hh (0, 1) {
            for my $s (0..7) {
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 acc%02d, m%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                    $ab + $s, $ms + $s, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 8*$gg + 4*$hh + ($s >> 1), ($s & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0',
                    $hh ? sprintf("acc%02d", $ab + $s) : 'RZ';
            }
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # inverted-high-bit stream: source u = hw >> u, masks 0x00010001 << 4v in m[4(u&1) .. +3]
    my $hmasks = sub {
        my ($src, $u) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND m%02d, %s, 0x%08x;\n", 4*($u & 1) + $_, $src, (0x00010001 << (4*$_)) & 0xffffffff for 0..3;
        return $x;
    };
    my $hxmads = sub {
        my ($i, $u) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $hh (0, 1) {
            for my $v (0..3) {
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 acch%d, m%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                    4*$hh + $v, 4*($u & 1) + $v, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 8*$hh + 2*$v + ($u >> 1), ($u & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0',
                    $u ? sprintf("acch%d", 4*$hh + $v) : 'RZ';
            }
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # dot = sum_s acc_s >> 2s over 8 accumulators (first SHR >= 7 issues after the last XMAD of acc_7)
    my $ccombine = sub {
        my ($ab, $dst) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      SHR acc%02d, acc%02d, 0x%x;\n", ($_ == 7 ? '4' : '1'), $ab + $_, $ab + $_, 2*$_ for 1..7;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab, $ab, $ab + 1;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab + 2, $ab + 2, $ab + 3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab + 4, $ab + 4, $ab + 5;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab + 6, $ab + 6, $ab + 7;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab, $ab, $ab + 2;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab + 4, $ab + 4, $ab + 6;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $dst, $ab, $ab + 4;
        return $x;
    };
    # dh_hh = sum_v acch_{4hh+v} >> 4v, both halves interleaved
    my $hcombine = sub {
        my $x = '';
        for my $v (1..3) {
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR acch%d, acch%d, 0x%x;\n", $v, $v, 4*$v;
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      SHR acch%d, acch%d, 0x%x;\n", ($v == 3 ? '3' : '1'), 4 + $v, 4 + $v, 4*$v;
        }
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch0, acch0, acch1;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch4, acch4, acch5;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch2, acch2, acch3;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acch6, acch6, acch7;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD dh0, acch0, acch2;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dh1, acch4, acch6;\n";
        return $x;
    };

    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        my $wait = $i == 0 ? '03' : '--';
        my $w0 = sprintf "cw%02d", 2*$i;
        my $w1 = sprintf "cw%02d", 2*$i + 1;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:4:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 dd, dp%d%s;\n", $wait, $i >> 1, ($i & 1) ? '.H1' : '';
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT scw, sw%d, 0x9180, RZ;\n", $i;
        $o .= $cmasks->($w0, 0, '1');
        $o .= $cmasks->($w1, 8, '1');
        $o .= $cxmads->($i, 0, 0, 0);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs1, hw%d, 0x1;\n", $i;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs2, hw%d, 0x2;\n", $i;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs3, hw%d, 0x3;\n", $i;
        $o .= $hmasks->("hw$i", 0);
        $o .= $cxmads->($i, 1, 8, 8);
        $o .= $hmasks->('hs1', 1);
        $o .= $hxmads->($i, 0);
        $o .= $hmasks->('hs2', 2);
        $o .= $hxmads->($i, 1);
        $o .= $hmasks->('hs3', 3);
        $o .= $hxmads->($i, 2);
        $o .= $hxmads->($i, 3);
        $o .= $ccombine->(0, 'dot0');
        $o .= $ccombine->(8, 'dot1');
        $o .= $hcombine->();
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHL dh0, dh0, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL dh1, dh1, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD3 dot0, dot0, -dh0, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD3 dot1, dot1, -dh1, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD.S16.S16 sumi, dot0, scw, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD.S16.S16 sumi, dot1, scw.H1, sumi;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:6      I2F.F32.S32 sumif, sumi;\n";
        $o .= "0c:-:-:-:6      FMUL u, dd, sumif;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, as%d, u, accf;\n", $i;
    }
    for (my $x = $L / 2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, accf, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, accf, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], accf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, pp0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, pp1, RZ;\n";
    for my $p (qw(cp hp sp)) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, %s0, stepw;\n", $p, $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, %s1, RZ;\n", $p, $p;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, rowstep, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/gemv_q4_k.sass
# Kernel: gemv_q4_k
#
# K-quant GEMV generator: GEMV_FMT=q4_k (default) or GEMV_FMT=q5_k (assemble with
# -k gemv_q5_k into the gemv_q5_k skeleton). GEMV_K=2560 (default) or 6144.
#
# y[r] = xs * sum_k W[r][k] x[k] for a sub-block-major row tile (ref/quant.h):
#   [per block 16 B header {fp16 d, fp16 dmin, u8 scales[12]}] [per block 8 x 16 B
#   nibbles, sub-block j in bytes 16j, element 2i low / 2i+1 high nibble]
#   q5_k adds [per block 8 x 4 B high-bit words, bit e = element e of sub-block j].
# Row stride 144 B (q4_k) or 176 B (q5_k) per block.
# K=2560: 16 lanes x 5 sub-blocks per row; K=6144: 32 lanes x 6. Activations: int16
# x[K]; sums: int32 per sub-block (K/32). CTA = 256 threads = 256/L rows.
#
# Per sub-block s = lane + L i (block b = s>>3, sub j = lane&7, constant per lane):
#   dot  = sum_e q4[e] a[e]  (+ 16 sum_e h[e] a[e] for q5_k)
#   value = d * ((float)dot * (float)sc) - dmin * (float)(min * sum32[s])
#   accumulated with FFMA in sub-block order per lane, then a SHFL butterfly.
# The nibble stream masks one 4-bit field per 16-bit half at shifts 0,4,8,12 and
# feeds XMAD.U16.S16 into 8 accumulators (H0 -> acc0-3, H1 -> acc4-7); the high-bit
# stream does the same with 1-bit fields of qh >> t (t = 0..3) at positions 4v.
# gemv_q4_k_ref / gemv_q5_k_ref perform the identical sequence.
#
# Scheduling rules (measured, see SPEC): fixed-latency 6; variable-latency ops set a
# barrier and need stall >= 2 before a dependent wait; predicates are computed at
# the loop top; a mask LOP is >= 6 issues before its XMAD (masks for word k+1 are
# computed before word k's XMADs: distance 12); the last XMAD before a combine
# carries stall 6. Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = address/store reads and prologue
# loads, 3 = I2F, 4 = F2F, 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 W  1:0x148:8 X16  2:0x150:8 S32  3:0x158:8 Y  4:0x160:4 rows  5:0x164:4 xs  6:0x168:8 dbg

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    gridDimX   : c[0x0][0x14]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_S0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_S1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_rows : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_xs   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x174]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $q5 = ($ENV{GEMV_FMT} || 'q4_k') eq 'q5_k';
    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $n = ($K / 32) / $L;                 # sub-blocks per lane: 5 or 6
    my $na = 16 * $n;                       # activation registers (int16 pairs)
    my $q = $na;                            # nibble words: 4 per sub-block
    my $h = $q + 4 * $n;                    # header words: 4 per sub-block
    my $m = $h + 4 * $n;                    # 8 masks (bank = index % 4)
    my $a = $m + 8;                         # 8 accumulators, bank-permuted
    my $r = $a + 8;
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= sprintf "    0-%d : act<00-%02d>\n", $na - 1, $na - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : q<00-%02d>\n", $q, $q + 4*$n - 1, 4*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : hdr<00-%02d>\n", $h, $h + 4*$n - 1, 4*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : m<0-7>\n", $m, $m + 7;
    for my $k (0..7) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acc%d\n", $a + (($k + 1) & 7), $k; }
    if ($q5) {
        for my $k (0..7) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acch%d\n", $r + (($k + 1) & 7), $k; }
        $r += 8;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : qh<0-%d>\n", $r, $r + $n - 1, $n - 1;
        $r += $n;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : hs<1-3>\n", $r, $r + 2;
        $r += 3;
        $o .= sprintf "    %d : dh\n", $r++;
    }
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : sum<0-%d>\n", $r, $r + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $r += $n;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : as<0-%d>\n", $r, $r + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $r += $n;
    my @sc = qw(sc mn dot dotf scf t1 t2 t2f dd dm accf t u u1 u2 u3 shj row rowpair rowstep stepw);
    for my $name (@sc) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    $r += $r & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : hb<0-1>\n    %d,%d : cq<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n", $r, $r+1, $r+2, $r+3, $r+4, $r+5;
    $r += 6;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : ch<0-1>\n", $r, $r+1 if $q5;
    # prologue temporaries alias the nibble registers
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : sp<0-1>\n", $q, $q+1, $q+2, $q+3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : ap<0-1>\n", $q+14, $q+15;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : lane\n    %d : grp\n    %d : tid\n    %d : bid\n    %d : off\n    %d : t0\n    %d : t1p\n    %d : l8\n    %d : jj\n",
        $q+4, $q+5, $q+6, $q+7, $q+8, $q+9, $q+10, $q+11, $q+12;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $q5 = ($ENV{GEMV_FMT} || 'q4_k') eq 'q5_k';
    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $n = ($K / 32) / $L;
    my $B = $K / 256;
    my $R = 256 / $L;                       # rows per CTA iteration
    my $S = ($q5 ? 176 : 144) * $B;         # row stride
    my $lgL = int(log($L)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $lgR = int(log($R)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;
    my $bstep = $L / 8;                     # blocks between a lane's consecutive sub-blocks
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $rr, $c) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $c & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $first;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $x;
    };
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND jj, lane, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 l8, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    # per-lane scale decode constants: shj = 8 (j & 3), P3 = j >= 4
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND shj, jj, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P3, PT, jj, 0x4, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL shj, shj, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rowpair, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~($wrows - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    $o .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
    # hb = W + off + 16 l8 ; cq = W + off + 16 B + 128 l8 + 16 j ; ch = W + off + 144 B + 32 l8 + 4 j
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, l8, off, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hb0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hb1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, l8, off, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, t1p, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x%x;\n", 16 * $B;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cq0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X cq1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    if ($q5) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, l8, off, 0x5;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, t1p, 0x2;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x%x;\n", 144 * $B;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ch0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ch1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    }
    # yp = Y + 4 row
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, row, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1p, param_Y0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    # activations: xp = X + 64 lane; sub-block i at +64 L i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1p, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        for my $jj (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", 16*$i + 4*$jj, 64*$L*$i + 16*$jj;
        }
    }
    # sums: sp = S + 4 lane; sub-block i at +4 L i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t1p, param_S0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_S1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI sum%d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $i == $n-1 ? '6' : '1', $i, 4*$L*$i;
    }
    # activation scales: sub-block i at AS + 4 (lane + L i)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t1p, param_AS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_AS1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI as%d, [ap+0x%x];\n", $i == $n-1 ? '6' : '1', $i, 4*$L*$i;
    }

    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 hdr%02d, [hb+0x%x];\n", 4*$i, 16*$bstep*$i;
    }
    if ($q5) {
        for my $i (0..$n-1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI qh%d, [ch+0x%x];\n", $i, 32*$bstep*$i;
        }
    }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 q%02d, [cq+0x%x];\n", $i == $n-1 ? '2' : '1', 4*$i, 128*$bstep*$i;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD rowpair, rowpair, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rowpair, param_rows, PT;\n";

    # one masked-field MAC stream: 4 source words, 4 masks each, 8 XMADs each into
    # accumulators $accn 0..7 (H0 -> 0-3, H1 -> 4-7); the element of (word k, field v)
    # is $elem->($k, $v, half).
    my $stream = sub {
        my ($i, $src, $maskf, $accn, $elem) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      LOP32I.AND m%d, %s, %s;\n", $_ == 3 ? '3' : '1', $_, $src->[0], $maskf->($_) for 0..3;
        for my $k (0..3) {
            my $set = ($k & 1) * 4;
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND m%d, %s, %s;\n", (1 - ($k & 1)) * 4 + $_, $src->[$k+1], $maskf->($_) for ($k < 3 ? (0..3) : ());
            my @ops;
            for my $hh (0, 1) {
                for my $v (0..3) {
                    my $e = $elem->($k, $v, $hh);
                    my $acc = $accn . (4*$hh + $v);
                    push @ops, sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 %s, m%d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                        $acc, $set + $v, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + int($e/2), ($e & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0', ($k == 0 ? 'RZ' : $acc);
                }
            }
            $ops[7] =~ s/^--:-:-:-:1/--:-:-:-:6/ if $k == 3;   # the combine reads acc4 next
            $x .= $_ for @ops;
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # combine 8 accumulators into $dst = sum_v (acc_v + acc_{4+v}) >> 4v
    my $combine = sub {
        my ($accn, $dst) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s%d, %s%d, %s%d;\n", $accn, $_, $accn, $_, $accn, $_ + 4 for 0..3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHR %s%d, %s%d, 0x%x;\n", $accn, $_, $accn, $_, 4*$_ for 1..3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s0, %s1;\n", $dst, $accn, $accn;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s2, %s2, %s3;\n", $accn, $accn, $accn;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, %s2;\n", $dst, $dst, $accn;
        return $x;
    };

    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        my $h0 = sprintf "hdr%02d", 4*$i;
        my $h1 = sprintf "hdr%02d", 4*$i + 1;
        my $h2 = sprintf "hdr%02d", 4*$i + 2;
        my $h3 = sprintf "hdr%02d", 4*$i + 3;
        my $wait = $i == 0 ? '03' : '--';
        # block scales to fp32 (consumed at the end of this sub-block)
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:4:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 dd, %s;\n", $wait, $h0;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:2      F2F.F32.F16 dm, %s.H1;\n", $h0;
        # 6-bit scale and min of sub-block j from the 12 scale bytes
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 u1, %s, shj;\n", $h1;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 u2, %s, shj;\n", $h2;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u3, %s, shj;\n", $h3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1 \@!P3 LOP32I.AND sc, u1, 0x3f;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1 \@!P3 LOP32I.AND mn, u2, 0x3f;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 LOP32I.AND sc, u3, 0xf;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 SHR.U32 mn, u3, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 SHR.U32 u1, u1, 0x6;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 SHR.U32 u2, u2, 0x6;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 LOP32I.AND u1, u1, 0x3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 LOP32I.AND u2, u2, 0x3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 LOP32I.AND mn, mn, 0xf;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 ISCADD sc, u1, sc, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 ISCADD mn, u2, mn, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:1      I2F.F32.S32 scf, sc;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD.U16.S16 t2, mn, sum%d, RZ;\n", $i;
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      I2F.F32.S32 t2f, t2;\n";
        # nibble stream: word k holds elements 8k..8k+7 at 4-bit fields
        my @w = map { sprintf "q%02d", 4*$i + $_ } 0..3;
        $o .= $stream->($i, \@w, sub { sprintf "0x%08x", (0x000F000F << (4*$_[0])) & 0xffffffff },
                        'acc', sub { my ($k, $v, $hh) = @_; 8*$k + 4*$hh + $v });
        if ($q5) {
            # high-bit stream: source t = qh >> t; field 4v of H0/H1 is element 4v+t / 16+4v+t
            my $qh = "qh$i";
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs1, %s, 0x1;\n", $qh;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 hs2, %s, 0x2;\n", $qh;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 hs3, %s, 0x3;\n", $qh;
            $o .= $stream->($i, [$qh, 'hs1', 'hs2', 'hs3'], sub { sprintf "0x%08x", (0x00010001 << (4*$_[0])) & 0xffffffff },
                            'acch', sub { my ($k, $v, $hh) = @_; 16*$hh + 4*$v + $k });
        }
        $o .= $combine->('acc', 'dot');
        if ($q5) {
            $o .= $combine->('acch', 'dh');
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL dh, dh, 0x4;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD dot, dot, dh;\n";
        }
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:6      I2F.F32.S32 dotf, dot;\n";
        $o .= "0c:-:-:-:6      FMUL t1, dotf, scf;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL u, dd, t1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA u, dm, -t2f, u;\n" unless $ENV{GEMV_NOMIN};
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, as%d, u, accf;\n", $i;
    }
    for (my $x = $L / 2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, accf, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, accf, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], accf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD hb0.CC, hb0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hb1, hb1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cq0.CC, cq0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X cq1, cq1, RZ;\n";
    if ($q5) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ch0.CC, ch0, stepw;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ch1, ch1, RZ;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, rowstep, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/gemv_q6_k.sass
# Kernel: gemv_q6_k
#
# Q6_K GEMV, GEMV_K=2560 (default, 16 lanes x 5 blocks) or 6144 (32 lanes x 6).
#
# Tile (ref/quant.h repack_q6_k): per row [prefix: Q x 16 B of fp16 d, lane group q
# holds the d of blocks Q i + q] [per block 208 B: 8 x 16 B low nibbles (sub-block
# j, element 2i low / 2i+1 high), 8 x 8 B high bits (sub-block j, word w = elements
# 16w.. as 2-bit fields at bits 2 (e & 7) of half e >> 3), 16 int8 scales], Q = L / 8.
# Element value = d * sc[g] * (q6 - 32), q6 = low | high << 4, g = 16-element group.
#
# Lane l = (q = l >> 3, jj = l & 7) owns sub-block jj of block Q i + q, i = 0..n-1,
# and keeps those 32 activations (int16) in registers. Per block step, per group:
#   nibble stream: masks 0x000F000F << 4v over the group's 2 words into 8
#     accumulators (H0 -> 0-3, H1 -> 4-7), the first XMAD seeded with -32 sum16
#   high stream: masks 0x00030003 << 2s over the group's word into 8 accumulators
#   dot = nib + (hi << 4) = sum (q6 - 32) a ; sumi = sc0 dot0 + sc1 dot1 as exact
#   32-bit integers (two XMADs per product: low half unsigned, high half signed)
#   accf = fma(d, (float)sumi, accf)
# then the SHFL butterfly over L lanes, lane 0 stores accf * xs. gemv_q6_k_ref
# performs the identical float sequence (the integer parts are exact).
#
# Scheduling rules as in gemv_q3_k.sass. Barriers: 1 = row loads, 2 = store reads
# and prologue loads, 3 = I2F, 4 = F2F, 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 W  1:0x148:8 X16  2:0x150:8 S16 (per-16 sums)  3:0x158:8 Y
#         4:0x160:4 rows  5:0x164:4 xs  6:0x168:8 dbg

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    gridDimX   : c[0x0][0x14]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_S0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_S1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_rows : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_xs   : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x174]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $Q = $L / 8;
    my $n = ($K / 256) / $Q;
    my $na = 16 * $n;
    my $dp = $na;                           # 4-aligned
    my $nb = $dp + 4;                       # nibble words, 4 per step, 4-aligned
    my $hq = $nb + 4 * $n;                  # high words, 2 per step, even
    my $ns = $hq + 2 * $n;                  # negated sums, 2 per step, even
    my $sw = $ns + 2 * $n;
    my $m = $sw + $n;
    my $a = $m + 16;
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    $o .= sprintf "    0-%d : act<00-%02d>\n", $na - 1, $na - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : dp<0-3>\n", $dp, $dp + 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : nb<00-%02d>\n", $nb, $nb + 4*$n - 1, 4*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : hq<00-%02d>\n", $hq, $hq + 2*$n - 1, 2*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : ns<00-%02d>\n", $ns, $ns + 2*$n - 1, 2*$n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : sw<0-%d>\n", $sw, $sw + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : m<00-15>\n", $m, $m + 15;
    for my $set (0, 1) {
        for my $k (0..7) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acc%02d\n", $a + 8*$set + (($k + 1) & 7), 8*$set + $k; }
    }
    for my $set (0, 1) {
        for my $k (0..7) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : acch%02d\n", $a + 16 + 8*$set + (($k + 1) & 7), 8*$set + $k; }
    }
    my $r = $a + 32;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : as<0-%d>\n", $r, $r + $n - 1, $n - 1;
    $r += $n;
    my @sc = qw(nib0 nib1 hi0 hi1 dot0 dot1 sumi t t2 sumif dd accf u scw row rowpair rowstep stepw yold);
    for my $name (@sc) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    $r += $r & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : pp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : np<0-1>\n    %d,%d : hp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : sp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n",
        $r, $r+1, $r+2, $r+3, $r+4, $r+5, $r+6, $r+7, $r+8, $r+9;
    # prologue temporaries alias the nibble registers (dead before the loop)
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : zp<0-1>\n", $nb, $nb + 1, $nb + 2, $nb + 3;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : ap<0-1>\n", $hq, $hq + 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d : lane\n    %d : grp\n    %d : tid\n    %d : bid\n    %d : off\n    %d : t1p\n    %d : q\n    %d : jj\n    %d : base2\n",
        $nb+4, $nb+5, $nb+6, $nb+7, $nb+8, $nb+9, $nb+10, $nb+11, $nb+12;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>

<CODE>
    my $K = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $L = $K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16;
    my $Q = $L / 8;
    my $B = $K / 256;
    my $n = $B / $Q;
    my $R = 256 / $L;
    my $S = 16 * $Q + 208 * $B;
    my $lgL = int(log($L)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $lgR = int(log($R)/log(2) + 0.5);
    my $wrows = 32 / $L;
    my $bstep = 208 * $Q;
    my $mulc = sub {
        my ($d, $rr, $cst) = @_;
        my @bits = grep { $cst & (1 << $_) } 0..31;
        my $first = shift @bits;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $first;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD %s, %s, %s, 0x%x;\n", $d, $rr, $d, $_ for @bits;
        return $x;
    };
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rowstep, gridDimX;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x%x;\n", $L - 1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 grp, tid, 0x%x;\n", $lgL;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHL rowstep, rowstep, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND jj, lane, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 q, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P0, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD row, bid, grp, 0x%x;\n", $lgR;
    $o .= $mulc->('stepw', 'rowstep', $S);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND rowpair, row, 0x%08x;\n", (~($wrows - 1)) & 0xffffffff;
    $o .= $mulc->('off', 'row', $S);
    # pp = W + off + 16 q
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, q, off, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # base2 = off + 16 Q + 208 q
    $o .= $mulc->('base2', 'q', 208);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, off;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD base2, base2, 0x%x;\n", 16 * $Q;
    # np = W + base2 + 16 jj ; hp = W + base2 + 128 + 8 jj ; sp = W + base2 + 192 + 2 jj
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD np0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X np1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0x80;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, base2, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t1p, t1p, 0xc0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t1p, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    # yp = Y + 4 row
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, row, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, t1p, param_Y0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    # sums: zp = S16 + 64 q + 8 jj ; step i at + 64 Q i (two int32 per step)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, q, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, t1p, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD zp0.CC, t1p, param_S0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X zp1, RZ, param_S1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI.64 ns%02d, [zp+0x%x];\n", 2*$i, 64*$Q*$i; }
    # activation scales: sub-block i at AS + 4 (lane + L i)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, lane, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ap0.CC, t1p, param_AS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ap1, RZ, param_AS1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:1      LDG.E.CI as%d, [ap+0x%x];\n", $i, 4*$L*$i; }
    # activations: xp = X + 512 q + 64 jj ; step i at + 512 Q i
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t1p, q, 0x9;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD t1p, jj, t1p, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t1p, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        for my $k (0..3) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 act%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", ($i == $n-1 && $k == 3) ? '6' : '1',
                16*$i + 4*$k, 512*$Q*$i + 16*$k;
        }
    }
    # ns = -32 sum16
    for my $g (0..2*$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      SHL ns%02d, ns%02d, 0x5;\n", $g == 0 ? '02' : '--', $g == 2*$n-1 ? '6' : '1', $g, $g; }
    for my $g (0..2*$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      IADD3 ns%02d, RZ, -ns%02d, RZ;\n", $g == 2*$n-1 ? '6' : '1', $g, $g; }

    $o .= "\nLOOP:\n";
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 dp0, [pp];\n";
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 nb%02d, [np+0x%x];\n", 4*$i, $bstep*$i; }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.64 hq%02d, [hp+0x%x];\n", 2*$i, $bstep*$i; }
    for my $i (0..$n-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:2:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.U16 sw%d, [sp+0x%x];\n", $i == $n-1 ? '2' : '1', $i, $bstep*$i; }
    $o .= "--:2:1:-:2      LDG.E yold, [yp];\n" if $ENV{GEMV_ACC};   # accumulate: y = yold + dot
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, row, param_rows, P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD rowpair, rowpair, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV accf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:2      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, rowpair, param_rows, PT;\n";

    # nibble masks of word $k into m[$ms..$ms+3]
    my $nmasks = sub {
        my ($word, $ms, $laststall) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      LOP32I.AND m%02d, %s, 0x%08x;\n", ($_ == 3 ? $laststall : '1'), $ms + $_, $word, (0x000F000F << (4*$_)) & 0xffffffff for 0..3;
        return $x;
    };
    # nibble XMADs of word k (0..3) of step i: elements 8k + 4hh + v, set k >> 1
    my $nxmads = sub {
        my ($i, $k, $ms) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        my $set = $k >> 1;
        for my $hh (0, 1) {
            for my $v (0..3) {
                my $acc = sprintf "acc%02d", 8*$set + 4*$hh + $v;
                my $c = ($k & 1) ? $acc : (($hh == 0 && $v == 0) ? sprintf("ns%02d", 2*$i + $set) : 'RZ');
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 %s, m%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                    $acc, $ms + $v, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 4*$k + 2*$hh + ($v >> 1), ($v & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0', $c;
            }
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # high-bit masks of word $w into m[$ms..$ms+7]
    my $hmasks = sub {
        my ($word, $ms) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      LOP32I.AND m%02d, %s, 0x%08x;\n", $ms + $_, $word, (0x00030003 << (2*$_)) & 0xffffffff for 0..7;
        return $x;
    };
    # high-bit XMADs of group word w (0/1) of step i: elements 16w + 8hh + s, set w
    my $hxmads = sub {
        my ($i, $w, $ms) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $hh (0, 1) {
            for my $s (0..7) {
                my $acc = sprintf "acch%02d", 8*$w + $s;
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 %s, m%02d.%s, act%02d.%s, %s;\n",
                    $acc, $ms + $s, $hh ? 'H1' : 'H0', 16*$i + 8*$w + 4*$hh + ($s >> 1), ($s & 1) ? 'H1' : 'H0', $hh ? $acc : 'RZ';
            }
        }
        return $x;
    };
    # nibble combine: dst = sum_v (acc_v + acc_{4+v}) >> 4v over set $ab
    my $ncombine = sub {
        my ($ab, $dst) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", ($_ == 3 ? '4' : '1'), $ab + $_, $ab + $_, $ab + 4 + $_ for 0..3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      SHR acc%02d, acc%02d, 0x%x;\n", ($_ == 3 ? '5' : '1'), $ab + $_, $ab + $_, 4*$_ for 1..3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab, $ab, $ab + 1;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acc%02d, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $ab + 2, $ab + 2, $ab + 3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, acc%02d, acc%02d;\n", $dst, $ab, $ab + 2;
        return $x;
    };
    # high combine: dst = sum_s acch_s >> 2s over set $ab
    my $hcombine = sub {
        my ($ab, $dst) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      SHR acch%02d, acch%02d, 0x%x;\n", ($_ == 7 ? '4' : '1'), $ab + $_, $ab + $_, 2*$_ for 1..7;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch%02d, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $ab, $ab, $ab + 1;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch%02d, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $ab + 2, $ab + 2, $ab + 3;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch%02d, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $ab + 4, $ab + 4, $ab + 5;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acch%02d, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $ab + 6, $ab + 6, $ab + 7;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      IADD acch%02d, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $ab, $ab, $ab + 2;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD acch%02d, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $ab + 4, $ab + 4, $ab + 6;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, acch%02d, acch%02d;\n", $dst, $ab, $ab + 4;
        return $x;
    };

    for my $i (0..$n-1) {
        my $wait = $i == 0 ? '03' : '--';
        my @w = map { sprintf "nb%02d", 4*$i + $_ } 0..3;
        my @h = map { sprintf "hq%02d", 2*$i + $_ } 0..1;
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:4:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 dd, dp%d%s;\n", $wait, $i >> 1, ($i & 1) ? '.H1' : '';
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      PRMT scw, sw%d, 0x9180, RZ;\n", $i;
        $o .= $nmasks->($w[0], 0, '1');
        $o .= $nmasks->($w[1], 4, '3');
        $o .= $nxmads->($i, 0, 0);
        $o .= $nmasks->($w[2], 0, '1');
        $o .= $nxmads->($i, 1, 4);
        $o .= $nmasks->($w[3], 4, '1');
        $o .= $nxmads->($i, 2, 0);
        $o .= $hmasks->($h[0], 8);
        $o .= $nxmads->($i, 3, 4);
        $o .= $hmasks->($h[1], 0);
        $o .= $hxmads->($i, 0, 8);
        $o .= $hxmads->($i, 1, 0);
        $o .= $ncombine->(0, 'nib0');
        $o .= $ncombine->(8, 'nib1');
        $o .= $hcombine->(0, 'hi0');
        $o .= $hcombine->(8, 'hi1');
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      ISCADD dot0, hi0, nib0, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD dot1, hi1, nib1, 0x4;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 sumi, dot0, scw, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:5      XMAD.S16.S16 t, dot0.H1, scw, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD.U16.S16 sumi, dot1, scw.H1, sumi;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:5      XMAD.S16.S16 t2, dot1.H1, scw.H1, RZ;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD sumi, t, sumi, 0x10;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD sumi, t2, sumi, 0x10;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:3:-:6      I2F.F32.S32 sumif, sumi;\n";
        $o .= "0c:-:-:-:6      FMUL u, dd, sumif;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA accf, as%d, u, accf;\n", $i;
    }
    for (my $x = $L / 2; $x >= 1; $x >>= 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, accf, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, accf, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD accf, yold, accf;\n" if $ENV{GEMV_ACC};
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P2 STG.E [yp], accf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD row, row, rowstep;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      IADD pp0.CC, pp0, stepw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X pp1, pp1, RZ;\n";
    for my $p (qw(np hp sp)) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, %s0, stepw;\n", $p, $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, %s1, RZ;\n", $p, $p;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, rowstep, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA LOOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/gemv_test.c
/*
 * gemv_test: run the MaxAs gemv_q2_0 kernel on a real Q2_0 tensor and compare
 * bit-for-bit with the C reference in exactly the kernel's accumulation order.
 *
 *   gemv_test SHARD1 [tensor] [expert|all] [iters]
 *
 * Default tensor blk.4.ffn_gate_exps.weight (512 experts x 640 rows x 2560).
 * "all" runs every expert's rows as one 327680-row matvec (236 MB of weights)
 * for a bandwidth number.
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "gguf.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);

#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }
static uint32_t rs = 777;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: gemv_test SHARD1 [tensor] [expert|all] [iters]\n"); return 2; }
	const char *tname = argc > 2 ? argv[2] : "blk.4.ffn_gate_exps.weight";
	const char *which = argc > 3 ? argv[3] : "0";
	int iters = argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 20;
	gguf_file g;
	if (gguf_open(&g, argv[1])) return 1;
	const gguf_tensor *t = gguf_find(&g, tname);
	if (!t || !t->data) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: not found\n", tname); return 1; }
	if (t->type != GG_Q2_0) { fprintf(stderr, "%s is %s, not Q2_0\n", tname, gguf_type_name(t->type)); return 1; }
	int K = (int)t->dims[0];
	if (K != 2560 && K != 640) { fprintf(stderr, "kernels exist for K=2560 and K=640, tensor has K=%d\n", K); return 1; }
	int L = q2_0_lanes_per_row(K), RPC = 256 / L;   /* lanes per row, rows per CTA */
	int rows_per_expert = t->nd >= 2 ? (int)t->dims[1] : (int)(t->elems / K);
	int rows, row0;
	if (!strcmp(which, "all")) { rows = (int)(t->elems / K); row0 = 0; }
	else { rows = rows_per_expert; row0 = atoi(which) * rows_per_expert; }
	printf("%s: %s K=%d rows %d..%d (%d rows, %.1f MB of tile)\n", tname, gguf_type_name(t->type), K, row0, row0 + rows - 1, rows,
	       (double)rows * q2_0_tile_stride(K) / 1e6);

	/* host side: repack, activations, reference */
	int stride = q2_0_tile_stride(K);
	uint8_t *tile = malloc((size_t)stride * rows);
	double t0 = now();
	repack_q2_0(t->data + (size_t)row0 * (K / 64) * 18, rows, K, tile);
	double t1 = now();
	float *x = malloc(sizeof(float) * K);
	for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = frand() * (1.f + (k % 5));
	/* diagnostic activation patterns: "zero", "onehot:K" (x[K] = 1, rest 0), "ones" */
	const char *pat = argc > 5 ? argv[5] : "random";
	if (!strcmp(pat, "zero")) for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 0.f;
	else if (!strncmp(pat, "onehot:", 7)) { for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 0.f; x[atoi(pat + 7) % K] = 1.f; }
	else if (!strcmp(pat, "ones")) for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 1.f;
	else if (!strcmp(pat, "alt")) for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = (k & 1) ? -1.f : 1.f;
	int8_t *xq = malloc(K);
	int32_t *sum32 = malloc(sizeof(int32_t) * K / 32), *sum16 = malloc(sizeof(int32_t) * K / 16);
	int16_t *x16 = malloc(sizeof(int16_t) * K);
	float *as = malloc(sizeof(float) * K / 32);
	quant_act_gpu32(x, K, x16, sum32, sum16, as);
	for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) xq[k] = (int8_t)x16[k];
	float xs = 1.f;
	float *yref = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows), *y = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows);
	double t2 = now();
	gemv_q2_0_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, sum32, as, yref);
	double t3 = now();
	printf("repack %.1f ms (%.2f GB/s read), reference %.1f ms\n", (t1 - t0) * 1e3, (double)rows * (K / 64) * 18 / (t1 - t0) / 1e9, (t3 - t2) * 1e3);

	/* device */
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev;
	CUcontext ctx;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CUmodule mod;
	char cubin[64];
	snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "gemv_q2_0_k%d.cubin", K);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "gemv_q2_0"));
	int nregs, smem;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&smem, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES, fn));
	int maxb;
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fn, 256, 0));
	printf("kernel: %d registers, %d B smem, %d CTAs/SM at 256 threads\n", nregs, smem, maxb);
	CUdeviceptr dW, dX, dS, dY;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, (size_t)stride * rows));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, sizeof(int16_t) * K));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, sizeof(int32_t) * K / 32));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, sizeof(float) * rows));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, tile, (size_t)stride * rows));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x16, sizeof(int16_t) * K));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, sum32, sizeof(int32_t) * K / 32));
	CUdeviceptr dAS;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dAS, sizeof(float) * K / 32 + 64));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dAS, as, sizeof(float) * K / 32));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, rows));   /* NaN: any row the kernel skips shows up */
	/* debug trace: 12 words per (row, lane16) */
	size_t dbg_bytes = (size_t)rows * L * 48;
	CUdeviceptr dD;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dD, dbg_bytes));
	CK(cuMemsetD8(dD, 0, dbg_bytes));
	unsigned urows = (unsigned)rows;
	CUdeviceptr dWE = 0;   /* the 9th parameter (pwe) is read only by the accumulate-with-scale builds; the launch still has to supply it */
	void *params[] = { &dW, &dX, &dS, &dY, &urows, &xs, &dD, &dAS, &dWE };
	unsigned grid = (urows + RPC - 1) / RPC;
	if (getenv("GEMV_GRID") && (unsigned)atoi(getenv("GEMV_GRID")) < grid) grid = (unsigned)atoi(getenv("GEMV_GRID"));
	printf("grid %u CTAs x 256 threads, %u rows per CTA iteration\n", grid, RPC);
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(y, dY, sizeof(float) * rows));

	/* compare */
	int bad = 0;
	double maxabs = 0;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		if (memcmp(&y[r], &yref[r], 4)) {
			if (bad < 8) printf("  row %d: gpu % .9g ref % .9g (diff % .3e)\n", r, y[r], yref[r], (double)y[r] - yref[r]);
			bad++;
		}
		double a = fabs((double)y[r] - yref[r]);
		if (a > maxabs || isnan(a)) maxabs = a;
	}
	printf("%s: %d of %d rows differ (max abs %.3e)\n", bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, rows, maxabs);
	if (bad) {
		for (int r = 0, k = 0; r < rows && k < 6; r++) if (memcmp(&y[r], &yref[r], 4)) { printf("  bad row %d: gpu %g ref %g\n", r, y[r], yref[r]); k++; }
		if (getenv("GEMV_DEBUGROW")) { printf("  y as int for rows 0,1,16,17,512,513,528,639:"); int rr[] = { 0, 1, 16, 17, 512, 513, 528, 639 }; for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) { uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &y[rr[k] < rows ? rr[k] : rows - 1], 4); printf(" %u", u); } printf("\n"); }
		printf("  bad row ranges:");
		int start = -1, shown = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r <= rows; r++) {
			int isbad = r < rows && memcmp(&y[r], &yref[r], 4) != 0;
			if (isbad && start < 0) start = r;
			if (!isbad && start >= 0) { if (shown++ < 10) printf(" %d-%d", start, r - 1); start = -1; }
		}
		printf("\n");
	}

	/* per-lane trace of the first rows against the same quantities computed here */
	if (bad) {
		uint32_t *tr = malloc(dbg_bytes);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(tr, dD, dbg_bytes));
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) if (memcmp(&y[r], &yref[r], 4)) { printf("  raw trace of row %d lane 0:", r); for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) printf(" %08x", tr[((size_t)r * L) * 12 + k]); printf("\n"); break; }
		int shown = 0;
		int B = K / 64, scales = stride - 16 * B;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows && shown < 12; r++) {
			const uint8_t *row = tile + (size_t)r * stride;
			float v[16];
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
				float acc = 0.f;
				uint32_t e[12] = { 0 };
				for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
					int h = l + L * i, b = h >> 1;
					const uint8_t *qs = row + scales + 16 * b + 8 * (h & 1);
					int32_t dot = 0;
					for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) dot += ((qs[j >> 2] >> (2 * (j & 3))) & 3) * xq[32 * h + j];
					uint16_t dh;
					memcpy(&dh, row + 2 * b, 2);
					dot -= sum32[h];
					acc = fmaf(fp16_to_fp32(dh), (float)dot, acc);
					if (i == 0) {
						memcpy(&e[0], qs, 4); memcpy(&e[1], qs + 4, 4);
						memcpy(&e[2], x16 + 32 * h, 4); memcpy(&e[3], x16 + 32 * h + 2, 4);
						e[4] = (uint32_t)(-sum32[h]); e[5] = dh; e[6] = (uint32_t)dot; memcpy(&e[7], &acc, 4);
					}
				}
				memcpy(&e[8], &acc, 4);
				v[l] = acc;
				e[10] = (uint32_t)r;
				const uint32_t *g = tr + ((size_t)r * L + l) * 12;
				static const char *nm[] = { "q0", "q1", "act00", "act01", "nsum0", "d0", "dot0", "accf0", "accf_pre", "accf_post", "row" };
				for (int k = 0; k < 11; k++) {
					if (k == 9) continue;
					if (g[k] != e[k]) {
						printf("  trace row %d lane %2d: %s gpu 0x%08x cpu 0x%08x", r, l, nm[k], g[k], e[k]);
						if (k >= 7) { float a, c; memcpy(&a, &g[k], 4); memcpy(&c, &e[k], 4); printf(" (%g vs %g)", a, c); }
						printf("\n");
						shown++;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			float w[16];
			for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) { for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o]; memcpy(v, w, sizeof v); }
			float gp;
			memcpy(&gp, tr + ((size_t)r * L) * 12 + 9, 4);
			if (gp != v[0] && shown < 12) { printf("  trace row %d: accf_post gpu %g cpu %g\n", r, gp, v[0]); shown++; }
		}
		/* row 0, every lane: value before the butterfly and what the GPU had after it */
		printf("  row 0 lanes (pre -> gpu post):\n");
		double sum16 = 0;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			float pre, post;
			memcpy(&pre, tr + (size_t)l * 12 + 8, 4);
			memcpy(&post, tr + (size_t)l * 12 + 9, 4);
			sum16 += pre;
			printf("    %2d: % .6g -> % .6g\n", l, pre, post);
		}
		printf("  sum of the 16 pre values: %.6g\n", sum16);
		free(tr);
	}

	/* clock stamps from a GEMV_TIMING build: words 0..3 of each (row, lane 0) trace slot */
	if (getenv("GEMV_TIMING")) {
		uint32_t *tr = malloc(dbg_bytes);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(tr, dD, dbg_bytes));
		double s1 = 0, s2 = 0, s3 = 0, st = 0;
		int n = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r += 32 / L) {
			const uint32_t *g = tr + ((size_t)r * L) * 12;
			if (!g[0] && !g[3]) continue;
			s1 += (uint32_t)(g[1] - g[0]); s2 += (uint32_t)(g[2] - g[1]); s3 += (uint32_t)(g[3] - g[2]); st += (uint32_t)(g[3] - g[0]); n++;
		}
		if (n) printf("timing over %d warp-iterations: loads %.0f + reduce %.0f + epilogue %.0f = %.0f cycles per iteration (%.1f rows)\n", n, s1 / n, s2 / n, s3 / n, st / n, 32.0 / L);
		free(tr);
	}

	if (getenv("GEMV_COUNT")) {
		uint32_t c[64];
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(c, dD, sizeof c));
		printf("  counters: loop-top %u, epilogue-end %u, branch-taken %u (lanes x warps x CTAs = %u per iteration)\n", c[0], c[16], c[32], grid * 256);
	}
	if (getenv("GEMV_DUMPREGS")) {
		uint32_t *tr = malloc(dbg_bytes);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(tr, dD, dbg_bytes));
		unsigned rs = grid * RPC;
		int slots[] = { 0, (int)rs, 2 * (int)rs };
		for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
			int s = slots[k];
			if (s >= rows) break;
			const uint32_t *g = tr + (size_t)s * 16;
			unsigned long long wq = dW + (unsigned long long)(s + rs) * stride + (stride - 16 * (K / 64)), ws = dW + (unsigned long long)(s + rs) * stride, yp = dY + 4ull * (s + rs);
			printf("  after iteration %d (slot %d): row %u/%u rowpair %u/%u rowstep %u/%u stepw %u/%u\n", k + 1, s, g[0], s + rs, g[1], (s & ~1) + rs, g[2], rs, g[3], rs * stride);
			printf("    wq %08x%08x/%016llx ws %08x%08x/%016llx yp %08x%08x/%016llx t %u/%u nsum0 %d\n", g[5], g[4], wq, g[7], g[6], ws, g[9], g[8], yp, g[10], rs * 4, (int)g[12]);
		}
		free(tr);
	}

	/* timing */
	if (iters > 0) {
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double ta = now();
		for (int i = 0; i < iters; i++) CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double tb = now();
		double per = (tb - ta) / iters;
		printf("%.1f us per matvec, %.1f GB/s of tile, %.1f GMAC/s\n", per * 1e6, (double)stride * rows / per / 1e9, (double)rows * K / per / 1e9);
	}
	return bad ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/gridbar.sass
# Kernel: gridbar
#
# Software grid barrier for co-resident CTAs (the primitive of the persistent
# kernel), with a visibility test around it.
#
# Per iteration i: thread 0 of each CTA stores i into its slot of `data`; all CTAs
# pass the barrier; thread 0 then reads the next CTA's slot and counts a mismatch
# if it is not i. out[cta] = mismatches after `iters` iterations.
#
# Barrier (warp 0 of each CTA, after BAR.SYNC): read the generation word, fence,
# lane 0 atomically counts in and the count is broadcast with SHFL; the last
# arriver resets the counter, fences and bumps the generation; the others spin on
# the generation word with LDG.CV. Then a fence and BAR.SYNC release the CTA. The
# loads bypass L1 (.CV), the stores are write-through (.WT), the fences are
# MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD as ptxas emits for membar.gl. Every branch predicate is >= 18
# cycles old when consumed (NOP padding in the spin loop).
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 ctr  1:0x148:8 gen  2:0x150:4 nctas  3:0x154:4 iters
#         4:0x158:8 out  5:0x160:8 data (128 B per CTA)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_ctr0  : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_ctr1  : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_gen0  : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_gen1  : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_nctas : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_iters : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_out0  : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_out1  : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_data0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_data1 : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-1   : cp<0-1>
    2-3   : gp<0-1>
    4-5   : dp<0-1>
    6-7   : np<0-1>
    8-9   : op<0-1>
    10    : tid
    11    : bid
    12    : i
    13    : g
    14    : g2
    15    : old
    16    : t
    17    : one
    18    : bad
    19    : v
    20    : nxt
    21    : t2
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;
--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV one, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:1      MOV i, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV bad, RZ;
20:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P0, PT, tid, RZ, PT;         # P0: not lane 0 of warp 0 (tid != 0)
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P5, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;       # P5: not warp 0
# cp = ctr, gp = gen
--:-:-:-:6      MOV cp0, param_ctr0;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV cp1, param_ctr1;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV gp0, param_gen0;
--:-:-:-:6      MOV gp1, param_gen1;
# dp = data + 128 bid ; np = data + 128 ((bid + 1) mod nctas) ; op = out + 4 bid
--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, bid, 0x7;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD dp0.CC, t, param_data0;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X dp1, RZ, param_data1;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD nxt, bid, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P1, PT, nxt, param_nctas, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  @P1 MOV nxt, RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, nxt, 0x7;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD np0.CC, t, param_data0;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X np1, RZ, param_data1;
--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, bid, 0x2;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD op0.CC, t, param_out0;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X op1, RZ, param_out1;
# slot parity predicates: P6 = even iteration, P2 = odd (two slots so a CTA that is
# already one iteration ahead cannot overwrite the value being checked)
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, i, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P2, PT, i, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;

LOOP:
--:-:-:-:6  @P6 STG.E [dp], i;                                  # publish i
--:-:-:-:6  @P2 STG.E [dp+0x4], i;
# ---- barrier ----
--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;
--:-:-:-:6  @P5 BRA BDONE;
--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.CV g, [gp];
--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD;
01:-:2:-:2 @!P0 ATOM.E.ADD old, [cp], one;
02:-:3:-:2      SHFL.IDX PT, old, old, RZ, 0x1f;
04:-:-:-:6      IADD t, old, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, t, param_nctas, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6 @!P3 BRA SPIN;
# last arriver: reset the counter, fence, bump the generation
--:-:-:-:6 @!P0 STG.E.WT [cp], RZ;
--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD g2, g, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6 @!P0 STG.E.WT [gp], g2;
--:-:-:-:6      BRA BREL;
SPIN:
--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.CV g2, [gp];
01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, g2, g, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6 @!P4 BRA SPIN;
BREL:
--:-:-:-:6      MEMBAR.GL.IVALLD;
BDONE:
--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;
# ---- end barrier ----
--:-:1:-:2  @P6 LDG.E.CV v, [np];
--:-:1:-:2  @P2 LDG.E.CV v, [np+0x4];
01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P4, PT, v, i, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      IADD i, i, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND t2, i, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, i, param_iters, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P2, PT, t2, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P6, PT, t2, RZ, PT;
--:-:-:-:6  @P4 IADD bad, bad, 0x1;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6      NOP;
--:-:-:-:6  @P1 BRA LOOP;
--:-:-:-:6 @!P0 STG.E [op], bad;
--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;


File: kern/gridbar_test.c
/*
 * gridbar_test: the MaxAs software grid barrier, checked for visibility (each CTA
 * publishes the iteration number before the barrier and reads its neighbour's
 * after it) and timed.
 *
 *   gridbar_test [iters]        runs grids of 16, 32, 64 and 128 CTAs
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	unsigned iters = argc > 1 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[1]) : 20000;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "gridbar.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "gridbar"));
	int nregs, maxb, sms;
	CK(cuFuncGetAttribute(&nregs, CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_NUM_REGS, fn));
	CK(cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&maxb, fn, 256, 0));
	CK(cuDeviceGetAttribute(&sms, CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPROCESSOR_COUNT, dev));
	printf("gridbar: %d registers, %d CTAs/SM resident, %d SMs\n", nregs, maxb, sms);
	CUdeviceptr dctr, dgen, dout, ddata;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dctr, 256));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dgen, 256));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dout, 4 * 1024));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&ddata, 128 * 1024));
	int fails = 0;
	for (unsigned grid = 16; grid <= 128; grid *= 2) {
		if ((int)grid > maxb * sms) { printf("grid %u: not co-resident, skipped\n", grid); continue; }
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dctr, 0, 64));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dgen, 0, 64));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dout, 0xffffffffu, 1024));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(ddata, 0xffffffffu, 32 * 1024));
		void *params[] = { &dctr, &dgen, &grid, &iters, &dout, &ddata };
		double t0 = now();
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		double t1 = now();
		unsigned out[1024];
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(out, dout, 4 * grid));
		unsigned bad = 0;
		for (unsigned c = 0; c < grid; c++) bad += out[c];
		printf("grid %3u: %u iterations, %u visibility mismatches, %.2f us per barrier\n", grid, iters, bad, (t1 - t0) / iters * 1e6);
		if (bad) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}

# Kernel: hcops  (HC_OP = silu | mix | write)
#
#   silu : P0 = d (320), P1 = t (320):            t = SiLU(0.25 d)          grid 2 x 256 (tid < 320)
#   mix  : P0 = up (10240), P1 = xh (10240), P2 = z (2560):
#          z_c = 0.25 ((sigmoid(up_0c) xh_0c + sigmoid(up_1c) xh_1c) + ...)  grid 10 x 256
#   write: P0 = inj (4), P1 = y (2560), P2 = S (4 x 2560):
#          S_lc = fma(2 sigmoid(0.25 inj_l), y_c, S_lc)                       grid 10 x 256
# One element (column c) per thread. Bit-exact twins in ref/hc.c.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 P0  1:0x148:8 P1  2:0x150:8 P2  3:0x158:4 n

        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL acc, g0, x0;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA acc, g%d, x%d, acc;\n", $_, $_ for 1..3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL acc, acc, 0.25;\n";

                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X aq%02d, aq%02d, RZ;\n", 2 * $e + 1, 2 * $e - 1;

            }
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tg, 0x2;\n";

        $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:1 \@!P0 STG.E [cp+0x%x], x%d;\n", 10240*$_, $_ for 0..3;
    }
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
