File: kern/hcops_test.c
/* hcops_test: hc_silu / hc_mix / hc_write kernels against ref/hc.c, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "hc.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 31;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

static int cmp(const char *what, const float *a, const float *b, int n) {
	int bad = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&a[i], &b[i], 4)) { if (bad < 3) printf("  %s[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", what, i, a[i], b[i]); bad++; }
	printf("%s: %s (%d of %d differ)\n", what, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, n);
	return bad != 0;
}

int main(void) {
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	int fails = 0;
	CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CUdeviceptr d0, d1, d2;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&d0, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&d1, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&d2, 10240 * 4));
	float *a = malloc(10240 * 4), *b = malloc(10240 * 4), *c = malloc(10240 * 4), *r = malloc(10240 * 4), *g = malloc(10240 * 4);
	/* silu */
	for (int i = 0; i < 324; i++) a[i] = 40.f * frand();
	hc_silu_gpu(a, r);
	for (int i = 320; i < 324; i++) r[i] = a[i];   /* [us, n) is copied */
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "hc_silu.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "hcops"));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d0, a, 324 * 4)); CK(cuMemsetD32(d1, 0x7fc00000u, 324));
	unsigned n = 324, us = 320;   /* silu over 320, 4 copied; mix: up rows 10240 B apart */
	void *p1[] = { &d0, &d1, &d2, &n, &us };
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 2, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, p1, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(g, d1, 324 * 4));
	fails += cmp("hc_silu", g, r, 324);
	/* mix */
	for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) { a[i] = 6.f * frand(); b[i] = 2.f * frand(); }
	hc_mix_gpu(a, b, r);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "hc_mix.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "hcops"));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d0, a, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d1, b, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemsetD32(d2, 0x7fc00000u, 2560));
	n = 2560; us = 10240;
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 10, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, p1, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(g, d2, 2560 * 4));
	fails += cmp("hc_mix", g, r, 2560);
	/* write */
	for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) a[i] = 6.f * frand();
	for (int i = 0; i < 2560; i++) b[i] = 2.f * frand();
	for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) c[i] = frand();
	memcpy(r, c, 10240 * 4);
	hc_write_gpu(a, b, r);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "hc_write.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "hcops"));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d0, a, 4 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d1, b, 2560 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(d2, c, 10240 * 4));
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 10, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, p1, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(g, d2, 10240 * 4));
	fails += cmp("hc_write", g, r, 10240);
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/hold.c
/* hold: the resident weight holder. Loads the tensors of blocks [b0, b1) (plus the
 * non-block tensors when asked) of the GGUF shard onto one die, repacked into the
 * kernels' tile layouts, in a single arena; exports the arena with a CUDA IPC
 * handle and writes a manifest (handle, then one line per tensor: name, offset,
 * bytes, type, rows, K, tile stride); then sleeps until killed, so kernel tests
 * map the arena (hold_open in hold.h) instead of reloading from NFS.
 *
 *   hold <gguf> <die> <b0> <b1> <manifest> [token_embd] [output] [cache=DIR] [split=d/n]
 *     token_embd / output also load those tensors; cache=DIR writes every device
 *     image (tiles or raw) to DIR/<name> so the C references read local disk, not NFS;
 *     split=d/n keeps only what die d of the n-die split owns (kern/prog.h split_of)
 *
 * Layout rules (what the kernels expect):
 *   Q2_0, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q3_K, Q6_K, IQ4_XS, Q4_0/Q5_0/Q8_0/IQ4_NL: repack_* tiles,
 *     rows = ne1 (output rows), K = ne0; 3-d expert tensors are repacked per
 *     expert, contiguously (expert stride = tile stride x rows).
 *   BF16 / F16 / F32: raw, as in the file.
 *   Merged rows (one GEMV phase instead of two or eight): per block
 *     hc_attn_dj / hc_ffn_dj = hc_*_down ++ hc_*_inject (324 x 10240 BF16),
 *     ffn_gate_inp_x = ffn_gate_inp ++ ffn_gate_inp_shexp (513 x 2560),
 *     ssm_ab = ssm_alpha ++ ssm_beta (96 x 2560) with ssm_ab.bias = ssm_dt.bias ++ 48
 *     zeros (so the one bias GEMV adds +0 to the beta rows). The sources are not
 *     loaded separately. emap (u32[512]) maps a global expert to the die's local
 *     expert index (0xffffffff: not here).
 *   Split rows (split=d/n): hc_*_dj rows [dj0, +djn); hc_*_up rows l 2560 + 32 cb for
 *     the die's column blocks; attn_qkv and ssm_conv1d rows q[klo..khi] k[klo..khi]
 *     v[h0..h0+hn); attn_gate rows 128 h; ssm_ab rows h and 48 + h (bias likewise);
 *     ssm_a entries h; ssm_out rows [y0, +yn); experts [e0, +en); everything else
 *     whole (replicated).
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "gguf.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include "prog.h"
#include "split.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static volatile sig_atomic_t stop;
static void onsig(int s) { (void)s; stop = 1; }

/* tile stride for a quantised matrix row of K elements, 0 for raw types */
/* Q6_K rows of K = 6144 do not fit the GEMV's registers: they are held as four K = 1536 column
 * slices, each in its own tile layout, side by side (slice s of the selected rows at
 * s * rows * q6_k_tile_stride(1536)); the GEMV runs four times, accumulating */
#define Q6K_SLICED(type, K) ((type) == GG_Q6_K && (K) == 6144)
static int tile_stride(uint32_t type, int K) {
	switch (type) {
	case GG_Q2_0: return q2_0_tile_stride(K);
	case GG_Q4_K: return q4_k_tile_stride(K);
	case GG_Q5_K: return q5_k_tile_stride(K);
	case GG_Q3_K: return q3_k_tile_stride(K);
	case GG_Q6_K: return q6_k_tile_stride(K);
	case GG_IQ4_XS: return iq4_xs_tile_stride(K);
	case GG_Q4_0: case GG_Q5_0: case GG_Q8_0: case GG_IQ4_NL: return b32_tile_stride(type, K);
	default: return 0;
	}
}
static int repack(uint32_t type, const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	switch (type) {
	case GG_Q2_0: return repack_q2_0(src, rows, K, dst);
	case GG_Q4_K: return repack_q4_k(src, rows, K, dst);
	case GG_Q5_K: return repack_q5_k(src, rows, K, dst);
	case GG_Q3_K: return repack_q3_k(src, rows, K, dst);
	case GG_Q6_K: return repack_q6_k(src, rows, K, dst);
	case GG_IQ4_XS: return repack_iq4_xs(src, rows, K, dst);
	default: return repack_b32(type, src, rows, K, dst);
	}
}

typedef struct { const char *out, *a, *b; int zero_b; } merge_t;
static const merge_t merges[] = {
	{ "hc_attn_dj.weight",    "hc_attn_down.weight", "hc_attn_inject.weight",   0 },
	{ "hc_ffn_dj.weight",     "hc_ffn_down.weight",  "hc_ffn_inject.weight",    0 },
	{ "ffn_gate_inp_x.weight", "ffn_gate_inp.weight", "ffn_gate_inp_shexp.weight", 0 },
	{ "ssm_ab.weight",        "ssm_alpha.weight",    "ssm_beta.weight",         0 },
	{ "ssm_ab.bias",          "ssm_dt.bias",         "ssm_dt.bias",             1 },
	{ "indexer_x.weight",    "indexer.q_proj.weight", "indexer.k_proj.weight",  0 },   /* the indexer projections of an attention block: 512 q rows ++ 128 k rows (BF16) */
};
#define NMERGE ((int)(sizeof merges / sizeof merges[0]))

/* the part of a block tensor name after "blk.N." */
static const char *suffix(const char *name) {
	if (strncmp(name, "blk.", 4)) return NULL;
	const char *p = strchr(name + 4, '.');
	return p ? p + 1 : NULL;
}
static int merged_source(const char *name) {
	const char *s = suffix(name);
	if (!s) return 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < NMERGE; i++) if (!strcmp(s, merges[i].a) || !strcmp(s, merges[i].b)) return 1;
	return 0;
}
static int wanted(const char *name, int b0, int b1, int extra_embd, int extra_out) {
	if (!strncmp(name, "blk.", 4)) { int b = atoi(name + 4); return b >= b0 && b < b1 && !merged_source(name); }
	if (!strncmp(name, "token_embd", 10)) return extra_embd;
	if (!strncmp(name, "output", 6)) return extra_out;
	return 0;
}
/* NULL when the block has no such tensor (attention blocks have no ssm_*) */
static const gguf_tensor *blk_tensor(const gguf_file *g, int b, const char *suf) {
	char name[128]; snprintf(name, sizeof name, "blk.%d.%s", b, suf);
	const gguf_tensor *t = gguf_find(g, name);
	return t && t->data ? t : NULL;
}

/* ---- the split: which rows (or experts) of a tensor this die keeps ---- */
typedef struct { int r0, n; } range_t;
typedef struct { range_t r[6]; int nr; int rows_total; int experts; } sel_t;   /* rows_total: rows the ranges index */
static int split_on;
static split_t SP;
static void sel_whole(sel_t *s, int rows, int experts) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0].r0 = 0; s->r[0].n = experts > 1 ? experts : rows; s->rows_total = rows; s->experts = experts; }
static void select_rows(const char *name, int rows, int experts, sel_t *s) {
	sel_whole(s, rows, experts);
	if (!split_on) return;
	const split_t *p = &SP;
	/* the head: output.weight rows, output_hc_down rows, output_hc_up the 4 lanes of the z columns; token_embd whole */
	if (!strcmp(name, "output.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->o0, p->on }; return; }
	if (!strcmp(name, "output_hc_down.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->hd0, p->hdn }; return; }
	if (!strcmp(name, "output_hc_up.weight")) { s->nr = 4; for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) s->r[l] = (range_t){ 2560 * l + 32 * p->cb0, 32 * p->cbn }; return; }
	const char *x = suffix(name);
	if (!x) return;
	/* the shared expert runs on one die per block */
	if (strstr(x, "_shexp.weight") && !p->shexp) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ 0, 0 }; return; }
	if (!strcmp(x, "hc_attn_dj.weight") || !strcmp(x, "hc_ffn_dj.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->dj0, p->djn }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "hc_attn_up.weight") || !strcmp(x, "hc_ffn_up.weight")) { s->nr = 4; for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) s->r[l] = (range_t){ 2560 * l + 32 * p->cb0, 32 * p->cbn }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "attn_qkv.weight") || !strcmp(x, "ssm_conv1d.weight")) {
		/* key heads (klo + j) % 16, j < nk: one range, or two when it wraps past head 15 */
		int n1 = p->klo + p->nk <= 16 ? p->nk : 16 - p->klo, n2 = p->nk - n1; s->nr = 0;
		s->r[s->nr++] = (range_t){ 128 * p->klo, 128 * n1 }; if (n2) s->r[s->nr++] = (range_t){ 0, 128 * n2 };
		s->r[s->nr++] = (range_t){ 2048 + 128 * p->klo, 128 * n1 }; if (n2) s->r[s->nr++] = (range_t){ 2048, 128 * n2 };
		s->r[s->nr++] = (range_t){ 4096 + 128 * p->h0, 128 * p->hn };
	}
	else if (!strcmp(x, "attn_gate.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ 128 * p->h0, 128 * p->hn }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "ssm_ab.weight") || !strcmp(x, "ssm_ab.bias")) { s->nr = 2; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->h0, p->hn }; s->r[1] = (range_t){ 48 + p->h0, p->hn }; s->rows_total = 96; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "ssm_a")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->h0, p->hn }; s->rows_total = 48; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "ssm_out.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->y0, p->yn }; }
	/* the attention proper (q/k/v, the indexer projections and norms) runs on the die of the layer (ATTN_MAP), the output projection is row-split */
	else if (!strcmp(x, "attn_q.weight") || !strcmp(x, "attn_k.weight") || !strcmp(x, "attn_v.weight") || !strcmp(x, "indexer_x.weight") || !strcmp(x, "indexer.q_norm.weight") || !strcmp(x, "indexer.k_norm.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ 0, p->d == attn_die_of(atoi(name + 4)) ? rows : 0 }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "attn_output.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->y0, p->yn }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "ple_key.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->pk0, p->pkn }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "ple_value.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->y0, p->yn }; }
	else if (!strcmp(x, "ffn_gate_exps.weight") || !strcmp(x, "ffn_up_exps.weight") || !strcmp(x, "ffn_down_exps.weight")) { s->nr = 1; s->r[0] = (range_t){ p->e0, p->en }; }
}

static FILE *m; static const char *cache; static CUdeviceptr arena; static size_t off;
static size_t cap; static uint8_t *buf;
static void need(size_t bytes) { if (bytes > cap) { free(buf); cap = bytes; buf = malloc(cap); } }
static void emit(const char *name, const uint8_t *img, size_t bytes, uint32_t type, int rows, int K, int st, int experts) {
	off = (off + 255) & ~(size_t)255;
	if (bytes) CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(arena + off, img, bytes));
	if (cache) {
		char fn[512]; snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/%s", cache, name);
		FILE *cf = fopen(fn, "wb");
		if (!cf || fwrite(img, 1, bytes, cf) != bytes) { perror(fn); exit(1); }
		fclose(cf);
	}
	fprintf(m, "%s %zu %zu %u %d %d %d %d\n", name, off, bytes, type, rows, K, st, experts);
	fprintf(stderr, "  %-40s %8.1f MB  %s%s\n", name, bytes / 1e6, gguf_type_name(type), st ? " tiles" : "");
	off += bytes;
}
/* bytes the selection occupies on the device (the pass-1 size) */
static size_t sel_bytes(const sel_t *s, size_t nbytes, int rows, int st) {
	size_t n = 0; for (int i = 0; i < s->nr; i++) n += s->r[i].n;
	if (s->experts > 1) return st ? (size_t)st * rows * n : nbytes / s->experts * n;
	size_t rowb = st ? (size_t)st : nbytes / s->rows_total;
	return rowb * n;
}
/* bytes per selected row on the device (the sliced Q6_K rows take four K = 1536 tiles) */
static int dev_row_stride(uint32_t type, int K) { return Q6K_SLICED(type, K) ? 4 * q6_k_tile_stride(1536) : tile_stride(type, K); }
/* repack / copy the selected rows (or experts) of a raw source image into buf and emit it */
static void emit_sel(const char *name, uint32_t type, const uint8_t *src, size_t nbytes, int rows, int K, int experts, const sel_t *s) {
	int st = strncmp(name, "token_embd", 10) ? dev_row_stride(type, K) : 0;   /* embrow reads raw Q3_K rows */
	size_t bytes = sel_bytes(s, nbytes, rows, st), o = 0;
	need(bytes);
	int nsel = 0;
	if (Q6K_SLICED(type, K) && experts == 1) {
		for (int i = 0; i < s->nr; i++) nsel += s->r[i].n;
		size_t srow = nbytes / s->rows_total, sl = srow / 4, st1 = (size_t)q6_k_tile_stride(1536);   /* 24 blocks of 210 B; 6 per slice */
		uint8_t *tmp = malloc(sl * (size_t)nsel);
		for (int sidx = 0; sidx < 4; sidx++) {
			int k = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < s->nr; i++) for (int r = s->r[i].r0; r < s->r[i].r0 + s->r[i].n; r++, k++) memcpy(tmp + sl * k, src + srow * r + sl * sidx, sl);
			repack_q6_k(tmp, nsel, 1536, buf + st1 * (size_t)nsel * sidx);
		}
		free(tmp);
		emit(name, buf, bytes, type, 4 * nsel, 1536, (int)st1, 1);
		return;
	}
	if (s->experts > 1) {
		size_t per = nbytes / experts, dper = st ? (size_t)st * rows : per;
		for (int i = 0; i < s->nr; i++) for (int e = s->r[i].r0; e < s->r[i].r0 + s->r[i].n; e++, nsel++) {
			if (st) repack(type, src + per * e, rows, K, buf + o); else memcpy(buf + o, src + per * e, per);
			o += dper;
		}
		emit(name, buf, bytes, type, rows, K, st, nsel);
		return;
	}
	size_t srow = nbytes / s->rows_total;
	for (int i = 0; i < s->nr; i++) {
		int r0 = s->r[i].r0, n = s->r[i].n;
		if (st) { repack(type, src + srow * r0, n, K, buf + o); o += (size_t)st * n; }
		else { memcpy(buf + o, src + srow * r0, srow * n); o += srow * n; }
		nsel += n;
	}
	emit(name, buf, bytes, type, nsel, K, st, 1);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 6) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: hold <gguf> <die> <b0> <b1> <manifest> [token_embd] [output] [cache=DIR] [split=d/n]\n"); return 2; }
	const char *path = argv[1], *mpath = argv[5];
	int die = atoi(argv[2]), b0 = atoi(argv[3]), b1 = atoi(argv[4]), xe = 0, xo = 0, sd = 0, sn = 1;
	for (int i = 6; i < argc; i++) {
		if (!strcmp(argv[i], "token_embd")) xe = 1;
		if (!strcmp(argv[i], "output")) xo = 1;
		if (!strncmp(argv[i], "cache=", 6)) cache = argv[i] + 6;
		if (!strncmp(argv[i], "split=", 6)) { if (sscanf(argv[i] + 6, "%d/%d", &sd, &sn) != 2 || sn < 1 || sn > 6 || sd < 0 || sd >= sn) { fprintf(stderr, "bad split %s\n", argv[i]); return 2; } split_on = 1; }
	}
	{ char rp[600]; snprintf(rp, sizeof rp, "%s.ready", mpath); unlink(rp); }   /* a restarted holder is not ready until it says so */
	gguf_file g;
	if (gguf_open(&g, path)) { fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", path); return 1; }
	/* pass 1: sizes (per block, the split depends on the block for the shared expert only) */
	size_t total = 0; int count = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < g.ntensors; i++) {
		const gguf_tensor *t = &g.t[i];
		if (!wanted(t->name, b0, b1, xe, xo)) continue;
		int K = (int)t->dims[0], rows = t->nd > 1 ? (int)t->dims[1] : 1, experts = t->nd > 2 ? (int)t->dims[2] : 1;
		int st = strncmp(t->name, "token_embd", 10) ? dev_row_stride(t->type, K) : 0;
		sel_t s; if (split_on) split_of(&SP, sd, sn, strncmp(t->name, "blk.", 4) ? 0 : atoi(t->name + 4)); select_rows(t->name, rows, experts, &s);
		total = (total + 255) & ~(size_t)255;
		total += sel_bytes(&s, t->nbytes, rows, st); count++;
	}
	for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
		if (split_on) split_of(&SP, sd, sn, b);
		for (int i = 0; i < NMERGE; i++) {
			const gguf_tensor *a = blk_tensor(&g, b, merges[i].a), *c = blk_tensor(&g, b, merges[i].b);
			if (!a || !c) continue;
			size_t nb = merges[i].zero_b ? a->nbytes : c->nbytes, bytes = a->nbytes + nb;
			int rows = a->nd > 1 ? (int)(bytes / (a->nbytes / a->dims[1])) : (int)(bytes / 4);
			char name[128]; snprintf(name, sizeof name, "blk.%d.%s", b, merges[i].out);
			sel_t s; select_rows(name, rows, 1, &s);
			total = (total + 255) & ~(size_t)255;
			total += sel_bytes(&s, bytes, rows, 0); count++;
		}
		total = (total + 255) & ~(size_t)255; total += 512 * 4; count++;   /* emap */
	}
	/* slack after the last tensor: a GEMV may still issue (predicated-off or
	 * otherwise harmless) loads for the rows of its last CTA iteration beyond the
	 * matrix end; keep the arena mapped there */
	total = ((total + 255) & ~(size_t)255) + (4u << 20);
	fprintf(stderr, "hold: %d tensors, %.2f GB on die %d%s\n", count, total / 1e9, die, split_on ? " (split)" : "");
	if (getenv("HOLD_DRY")) return 0;   /* sizes only: tune SPLIT_SHARES / ATTN_MAP without loading */
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx;
	/* HOLD_VISIBLE=1: the holder runs under CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<die> (so it holds no other GPU open and a
	   faulted die can be reset alone); it opens device 0 and still records the physical index */
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, getenv("HOLD_VISIBLE") ? 0 : die));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_BLOCKING_SYNC, dev));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&arena, total));
	CUipcMemHandle h;
	CK(cuIpcGetMemHandle(&h, arena));
	m = fopen(mpath, "w");
	if (!m) { perror(mpath); return 1; }
	fprintf(m, "arena %zu die %d handle ", total, die);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof h; i++) fprintf(m, "%02x", ((unsigned char *)&h)[i]);
	fprintf(m, "\n");
	/* pass 2: load */
	for (int i = 0; i < g.ntensors; i++) {
		const gguf_tensor *t = &g.t[i];
		if (!wanted(t->name, b0, b1, xe, xo)) continue;
		int K = (int)t->dims[0], rows = t->nd > 1 ? (int)t->dims[1] : 1, experts = t->nd > 2 ? (int)t->dims[2] : 1;
		if (!t->data) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: not mapped\n", t->name); return 1; }
		sel_t s; if (split_on) split_of(&SP, sd, sn, strncmp(t->name, "blk.", 4) ? 0 : atoi(t->name + 4)); select_rows(t->name, rows, experts, &s);
		emit_sel(t->name, t->type, t->data, t->nbytes, rows, K, experts, &s);
	}
	uint8_t *mb = NULL; size_t mcap = 0;
	for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
		if (split_on) split_of(&SP, sd, sn, b);
		for (int i = 0; i < NMERGE; i++) {
			const gguf_tensor *a = blk_tensor(&g, b, merges[i].a), *c = blk_tensor(&g, b, merges[i].b);
			if (!a || !c) continue;
			size_t nb = merges[i].zero_b ? a->nbytes : c->nbytes, bytes = a->nbytes + nb;
			if (a->type != c->type || a->dims[0] != c->dims[0]) { fprintf(stderr, "blk.%d.%s: cannot merge %s and %s\n", b, merges[i].out, merges[i].a, merges[i].b); return 1; }
			if (bytes > mcap) { free(mb); mcap = bytes; mb = malloc(mcap); }
			memcpy(mb, a->data, a->nbytes);
			if (merges[i].zero_b) memset(mb + a->nbytes, 0, nb); else memcpy(mb + a->nbytes, c->data, nb);
			int K = (int)a->dims[0], rows = a->nd > 1 ? (int)(bytes / (a->nbytes / a->dims[1])) : (int)(bytes / 4);
			char name[128]; snprintf(name, sizeof name, "blk.%d.%s", b, merges[i].out);
			sel_t s; select_rows(name, rows, 1, &s);
			emit_sel(name, a->type, mb, bytes, rows, K, 1, &s);
		}
		/* emap: global expert -> local index */
		uint32_t emap[512];
		int e0 = split_on ? SP.e0 : 0, en = split_on ? SP.en : 512;
		for (int e = 0; e < 512; e++) emap[e] = (e >= e0 && e < e0 + en) ? (uint32_t)(e - e0) : 0xffffffffu;
		char name[128]; snprintf(name, sizeof name, "blk.%d.emap", b);
		emit(name, (const uint8_t *)emap, sizeof emap, GG_F32, 512, 1, 0, 1);
	}
	fclose(m);
	gguf_close(&g);
	{ char rp[600]; snprintf(rp, sizeof rp, "%s.ready", mpath); FILE *rf = fopen(rp, "w"); if (rf) { fputs("ready\n", rf); fclose(rf); } }   /* the core waits for this */
	fprintf(stderr, "hold: ready (%s); holding until SIGTERM\n", mpath);
	signal(SIGTERM, onsig); signal(SIGINT, onsig);
	while (!stop) pause();
	CK(cuMemFree(arena));
	return 0;
}


File: kern/holdc.c
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "hold.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

int hold_open(hold_arena *a, const char *manifest) {
	FILE *f = fopen(manifest, "r");
	if (!f) { perror(manifest); return 1; }
	char hex[256];
	memset(a, 0, sizeof *a);
	if (fscanf(f, "arena %zu die %d handle %255s", &a->bytes, &a->die, hex) != 3) { fclose(f); return 1; }
	CUipcMemHandle h;
	if (strlen(hex) != 2 * sizeof h) { fclose(f); return 1; }
	for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof h; i++) { unsigned v; sscanf(hex + 2 * i, "%2x", &v); ((unsigned char *)&h)[i] = (unsigned char)v; }
	CUresult r = cuIpcOpenMemHandle(&a->base, h, CU_IPC_MEM_LAZY_ENABLE_PEER_ACCESS);
	if (r != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r, &s); fprintf(stderr, "cuIpcOpenMemHandle: %s (is hold running on die %d?)\n", s, a->die); fclose(f); return 1; }
	int cap = 64;
	a->t = malloc(sizeof(hold_tensor) * cap);
	hold_tensor t;
	int rc;
	while ((rc = fscanf(f, "%95s %zu %zu %u %d %d %d %d", t.name, &t.off, &t.bytes, &t.type, &t.rows, &t.K, &t.stride, &t.experts)) == 8) {
		/* every tensor must lie inside the arena the handle opens: a manifest of another split or a stale one names ranges that do not */
		if (t.off > a->bytes || t.bytes > a->bytes - t.off) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: tensor %s [%zu, +%zu) is outside the %zu-byte arena\n", manifest, t.name, t.off, t.bytes, a->bytes); fclose(f); cuIpcCloseMemHandle(a->base); free(a->t); memset(a, 0, sizeof *a); return 1; }
		if (a->n == cap) { cap *= 2; a->t = realloc(a->t, sizeof(hold_tensor) * cap); }
		a->t[a->n++] = t;
	}
	if (rc != EOF || ferror(f)) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: unreadable tensor line after %d tensors (a truncated or damaged manifest)\n", manifest, a->n); fclose(f); cuIpcCloseMemHandle(a->base); free(a->t); memset(a, 0, sizeof *a); return 1; }
	fclose(f);
	return 0;
}

const hold_tensor *hold_find(const hold_arena *a, const char *name) {
	for (int i = 0; i < a->n; i++) if (!strcmp(a->t[i].name, name)) return &a->t[i];
	return NULL;
}

CUdeviceptr hold_ptr(const hold_arena *a, const char *name) {
	const hold_tensor *t = hold_find(a, name);
	return t ? a->base + t->off : 0;
}

void hold_close(hold_arena *a) {
	if (a->base) cuIpcCloseMemHandle(a->base);
	free(a->t);
	memset(a, 0, sizeof *a);
}

int hold_ordinal(int die) {
	const char *v = getenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES");
	if (!v || !*v) return die;
	int ord = 0;
	for (const char *p = v; *p; ) {
		char *end; long d = strtol(p, &end, 10);
		if (end == p) break;
		if (d == die) return ord;
		ord++; p = end; while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
	}
	return -1;
}

# Kernel: idxqk
#
# QSA indexer, per attention layer and token t (ref/qsa.h). IQK = the projections W_iq z (512 = 4 heads x 128) ++ W_ik z (128).
# Six warp units:
#   unit h < 4: head h of the query: RMS128 * q_norm, RoPE (position t) on dims 0..63 -> IQ[h] (fp32 [4][128])
#   unit 4:     the raw key ik goes to RING slot (t & 3); the token that completes a block (t & 3 == 3) pools it:
#               mean of the 4 raw keys ((r0 + r1) + r2) + r3, times 0.25, RMS128 * k_norm, RoPE at the position of the
#               block's first token (t - 3), fp16 into the transposed pool PKT:
#               PKT + 8192 (b >> 5) + 256 chunk + 8 (b & 31) holds dims 4 chunk..4 chunk + 3 of block b = t >> 2
#   unit 5:     zeroes the selection state HST (1280 words) that idxscore / idxsel accumulate into
# Lane l owns dims 4l..4l+3 (RoPE pairs (p, p+32) sit in lanes l and l + 8: SHFL.BFLY xor 8). Bit-exact twins:
# idx_norm_rope_gpu, idx_pool_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 IQK  1:0x148 QN  2:0x150 KN  3:0x158 CS  4:0x160 SN  5:0x168 IQ  6:0x170 RING  7:0x178 PKT  8:0x180 HST
#         9:0x188 t (u32)  10:0x18c eps (f32)

File: kern/idxscore.sass
# Kernel: idxscore
#
# QSA indexer scoring (ref/qsa.h idx_scores_gpu): score[b] = sum over the 4 indexer heads of relu(q_h . pool[b]) for the
# nv = (t + 1) >> 2 complete blocks, and the first digit histogram of the selection (the top 8 bits of the score bits, which
# are a non-negative float's order: HST[digit] += 1). Does nothing while nv <= NBLK (every block is attended).
# The pool is transposed (idxqk.sass): group g of 32 blocks at PKT + 8192 g, chunk c (dims 4c..4c+3) at +256 c, block
# 8 byte. Grid = 16 CTAs x 8 warps; warp wg = 8 cta + warp scores the groups g = wg, wg + 128, ...: lane l = block 32 g + l, 32
# chunks of 4 dims (LDG.64 of 4 fp16, coalesced over the lanes), q from shared memory (broadcast LDS.128), per head
# a fmaf chain over the 128 dims in order; relu = max(x, 0) + 0 (no -0); the head sum ((s0 + s1) + s2) + s3.
# smem: q [4][128] f32 at 0 (2 KB), histogram [256] u32 at 0x800.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 PKT  1:0x148 IQ  2:0x150 SC (f32 [nv])  3:0x158 HST (u32; digit histogram at word 0)  4:0x160 t (u32)  5:0x164 NBLK

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_PKT0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_PKT1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_IQ0  : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_IQ1  : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_SC0  : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_SC1  : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_HST0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_HST1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_t    : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_nblk : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-3   : acc<0-3>
    4-7   : kf<0-3>
    8-15  : hd<0-7>
    16-31 : qv<00-15>
    32    : tid
    33    : lane

    36    : nv

    48,49 : hgp<0-1>

    52    : t3
    53    : u0
    54    : u1
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

    # chunk c + 4 is requested once chunk c has been consumed. barrier 6: the unpacked halves and the q rows of the chunk

    for my $c (0 .. 3) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:%d:-:1      LDG.E.64 hd%d, [pkp+0x%x];\n", $sw[$c], 2 * $c, 256 * $c; }
    for my $c (0 .. 31) {
        my $s = $c % 4; my $hl = "hd" . (2 * $s); my $hh = "hd" . (2 * $s + 1);
        for my $h (0 .. 3) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:6:-:%s      LDS.128 qv%02d, [RZ+0x%x];\n", $h == 3 ? '2' : '1', 4 * $h, 512 * $h + 16 * $c; }
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:6:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 kf0, %s;\n", $sm[$s], $hl;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 u0, %s, 0x10;\n", $hl;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:6:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 kf2, %s;\n", $hh;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 u1, %s, 0x10;\n", $hh;
        $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      F2F.F32.F16 kf1, u0;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:6:-:2      F2F.F32.F16 kf3, u1;\n";
        for my $j (0 .. 3) {
            for my $h (0 .. 3) {
                my $w = ($j == 0 && $h == 0) ? '20' : '--';
                $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:2      FFMA acc%d, qv%02d, kf%d, acc%d;\n", $w, $h, 4 * $h + $j, $j, $h;
            }
        }
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:%d:-:1      LDG.E.64 hd%d, [pkp+0x%x];\n", $sw[$s], 2 * $s, 256 * ($c + 4) if $c + 4 < 32;
    }
    # relu + 0, head sum, store, histogram
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FMNMX acc%d, acc%d, RZ, !PT;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0 .. 3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      FADD acc%d, acc%d, RZ;\n", $_ == 3 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0 .. 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD acc0, acc0, acc1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD acc0, acc0, acc2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD acc0, acc0, acc3;\n";
    # SC + 128 g + 4 lane
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, g, 0x7;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, t3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD scp0.CC, t, param_SC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X scp1, RZ, param_SC1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, g, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, lane;\n";                                    # the block
    $o .= "--:4:-:-:1      STG.E [scp], acc0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P1, PT, t, nv, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 sc, acc0, 0x17;\n";                             # digit: bits 30..23
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL sc, sc, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P1 ATOMS.ADD RZ, [sc+0x800], one;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD g, g, 0x80;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BRA GLOOP;\n";
    # every warp is done: the CTA's histogram goes to the global one (threads 0..255)
    $o .= "\nFLUSH:\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2      LDS t, [t2+0x800];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P1, PT, t, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hgp0.CC, t2, param_HST0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hgp1, RZ, param_HST1;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:6  \@P1 RED.E.ADD [hgp], t;\n";
    $o .= "0a:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/idxsel.sass
# Kernel: idxsel
#
# QSA block selection (ref/qsa.h idx_select_gpu): the k = NBLK best of the nv = (t + 1) >> 2 scores in SC[0..nv)
# (non-negative floats, so their bit patterns order like the values), highest first, lower index first among
# equals, written as ascending block indices to SEL[0..k). Does nothing while nv <= NBLK (every block is attended).
# A radix select over the score bits in 4 digits (8, 8, 8 and 7 bits: bits 30..23, 22..15, 14..7, 6..0) in six phases of
# one launch each (the 'pass' parameter, 2..6; pass 1, the first digit's histogram, is idxscore):
#   passes 2..4: scan the histograms of the digits found so far for the digit whose bin holds the k-th element
#                (kk: how many of the k are still undecided, pre: the digits so far), then histogram the next digit of
#                the elements that match pre (HST + 1024 (pass - 1), one count per bin);
#   pass 5:      scan all four digits: T = the k-th score's bits, need = how many elements equal to T are taken (the lowest
#                indices); every CTA counts its slice's elements > T and == T (CNT[2 cta], CNT[2 cta + 1]);
#   pass 6:      CTA c takes its slice (R = ceil(nv / 16) elements from c R) in order: element e is taken if > T or == T with
#                an equal-rank below need (the ranks continue from the CTAs before it), written at its rank among the taken.
# The scan is one warp: lane l reads bins 8l..8l+7 (from the top: the suffix sums over lanes, the lane where the running
# count crosses kk finds its bin; butterflies broadcast the bin and the count above it).
# HST (u32): G1 at 0, G2 256, G3 512, G4 768, CNT at 1024; zeroed each token by idxqk. smem: hist [256] at 0, state at 0x400.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 SC  1:0x148 HST  2:0x150 SEL  3:0x158 t (u32)  4:0x15c NBLK  5:0x160 pass (2..6)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_SC0  : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_SC1  : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_HST0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_HST1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_SEL0 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_SEL1 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_t    : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_nblk : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_pass : c[0x0][0x160]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-7   : a<0-7>
    8     : s
    9     : sx
    10    : tt
    11    : kk
    12    : pre
    13    : bb
    14    : abv
    15    : cum
    16    : tid
    17    : lane
    18    : warp
    19    : cta
    20    : nv
    21    : start
    22    : end
    23    : e
    24    : u
    25    : t
    26    : t2
    27    : t3
    28    : T
    29    : need
    30    : gtc
    31    : eqc
    32    : one
    33    : sd
    34    : sm
    35    : msk
    36    : eqf
    37    : gtf
    38    : sel
    39    : eqi
    40    : seli
    41    : eqrun
    42    : selrun
    43    : eqw
    44    : selw
    45    : eqtot
    46    : seltot
    47    : sbase
    48    : nc
    49    : pass
    50,51 : hp<0-1>
    52,53 : sp<0-1>
    54,55 : op<0-1>
    56    : lmax
    57    : nit
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

    my $o = '';
    my $nop3 = "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    # inclusive suffix / prefix scans and butterflies over a warp, value in register $v, temp tt
    my $scan_up = sub {
        my ($v) = @_; my $x = '';
        for my $off (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) {
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.UP P0, tt, %s, 0x%x, 0x0;\n", $v, $off;
            $x .= sprintf "10:-:-:-:6  \@P0 IADD %s, %s, tt;\n", $v, $v;
        }
        return $x;
    };
    my $red_add = sub {
        my ($v) = @_; my $x = '';

            $x .= sprintf "10:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, tt;\n", $v, $v;
        }
        return $x;
    };

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 nv, t, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LE.U32.AND P0, PT, nv, param_nblk, PT;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 t, t, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD start, cta, t, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD end, start, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 end, end, nv, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 start, start, nv, PT;\n";
    # lmax = min(pass - 1, 4)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD lmax, pass, -0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 lmax, lmax, 0x4, PT;\n";
    # smem histogram := 0 (all 256 threads), state area

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      STS [t2], RZ;\n";
    # ---- the scan, warp 0: kk = NBLK, pre = 0, levels 1 .. lmax ----
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV kk, param_nblk;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV pre, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P1, PT, warp, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA SCANBAR;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, lane, 0x5;\n";                                   # 32 lane: the lane's 8 bins
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, t2, param_HST0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_HST1;\n";
    for my $L (1 .. 4) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, lmax, 0x%x, PT;\n", $L;
        $o .= $nop3;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P2 BRA SCANBAR;\n";
        my $off = 1024 * ($L - 1);
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 a0, [hp+0x%x];\n", $off;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:2      LDG.E.128 a4, [hp+0x%x];\n", $off + 16;
        $o .= "01:-:-:-:1      IADD s, a0, a1;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD tt, a2, a3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      IADD t, a4, a5;\n";

        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, t2;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD s, s, t;\n";

            $o .= "10:-:-:-:6  \@P0 IADD sx, sx, tt;\n";

        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD cum, sx, -s;\n";

            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV cum, nc;\n";

            $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 bb, bb, tt, !PT;\n";
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.BFLY PT, tt, abv, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $d;
            $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IADD abv, abv, tt;\n";

        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pre, pre, bb;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD pre, pre, -0x1;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P1, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_SC1;\n";

    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 BRA CDONE;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2 \@!P0 LDG.E u, [sp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GT.U32.AND P1, PT, u, T, !P0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P2, PT, u, T, !P0;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 IADD gtc, gtc, 0x1;\n";

    $o .= $red_add->('gtc');
    $o .= $red_add->('eqc');
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, warp, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P1, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P1 STS [t+0x420], gtc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 STS [t+0x440], eqc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P1, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV gtc, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eqc, RZ;\n";
    for my $w (0 .. 7) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1      LDS t, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x420 + 4 * $w;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:2      LDS t2, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x440 + 4 * $w;
        $o .= "01:-:-:-:1      IADD gtc, gtc, t;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD eqc, eqc, t2;\n";
    }
    # CNT[2 cta], CNT[2 cta + 1] = HST + 4096 + 8 cta
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, cta, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, t, param_HST0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_HST1;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1  \@P1 STG.E [hp+0x1000], gtc;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:6  \@P1 STG.E [hp+0x1004], eqc;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    # ---- pass 6: compaction ----
    $o .= "\nCOMPACT:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV T, pre;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV need, kk;\n";
    # gt_before / eq_before: warp 0, lane l < cta reads the counts of CTA l; a butterfly sums them
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV gtc, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eqc, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P1, PT, warp, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2, PT, lane, cta, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD hp0.CC, t, param_HST0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X hp1, RZ, param_HST1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      PSETP.AND.AND P2, PT, P2, !P1, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1  \@P2 LDG.E.CV gtc, [hp+0x1000];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2  \@P2 LDG.E.CV eqc, [hp+0x1004];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 BRA CPREF;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= $red_add->('gtc');
    $o .= $red_add->('eqc');
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1  \@P3 STS [RZ+0x408], gtc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 STS [RZ+0x40c], eqc;\n";
    $o .= "\nCPREF:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDS gtc, [RZ+0x408];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2      LDS eqc, [RZ+0x40c];\n";
    # selrun = gt_before + min(eq_before, need) ; eqrun = eq_before
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 t, eqc, need, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD selrun, gtc, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eqrun, eqc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, warp, 0x2;\n";                                   # the warp's slot in the totals
    $o .= "\nKLOOP:\n";
    # the chunk base is uniform over the CTA: start + 256 k; e = base + tid
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, e, end, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, e, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t, param_SC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_SC1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV u, RZ;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2 \@!P0 LDG.E u, [sp];\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GT.U32.AND P1, PT, u, T, !P0;\n";                 # gt
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P2, PT, u, T, !P0;\n";                 # eq
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV gtf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eqf, RZ;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 MOV gtf, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P2 MOV eqf, 0x1;\n";
    # warp inclusive scan of eqf; the warp's total (lane 31) to the totals
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eqi, eqf;\n";
    $o .= $scan_up->('eqi');
    $o .= "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.IDX PT, eqw, eqi, 0x1f, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 STS [t2+0x420], eqw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    # the totals of the warps before mine and of all
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eqtot, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV sbase, RZ;\n";
    for my $w (0 .. 7) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:2      LDS tt, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x420 + 4 * $w;
        $o .= sprintf "01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GT.U32.AND P4, PT, warp, 0x%x, PT;\n", $w;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD eqtot, eqtot, tt;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 IADD sbase, sbase, tt;\n";
    }
    # eqrank (exclusive) = eqrun + sbase + eqi - eqf ; sel = gt || (eq && eqrank < need)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, eqrun, sbase;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, t3, eqi;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, t3, -eqf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, t3, need, P2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      PSETP.OR.AND P4, PT, P1, P4, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV sel, RZ;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 MOV sel, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV seli, sel;\n";
    $o .= $scan_up->('seli');
    $o .= "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.IDX PT, selw, seli, 0x1f, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 STS [t2+0x440], selw;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV seltot, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV sbase, RZ;\n";
    for my $w (0 .. 7) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:2      LDS tt, [RZ+0x%x];\n", 0x440 + 4 * $w;
        $o .= sprintf "01:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GT.U32.AND P5, PT, warp, 0x%x, PT;\n", $w;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD seltot, seltot, tt;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P5 IADD sbase, sbase, tt;\n";
    }
    # pos = selrun + sbase + seli - sel ; SEL[pos] = e for the taken ones
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, selrun, sbase;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, t3, seli;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t3, t3, -sel;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t3, t3, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD op0.CC, t3, param_SEL0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X op1, RZ, param_SEL1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:3:-:-:1  \@P4 STG.E [op], e;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD eqrun, eqrun, eqtot;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD selrun, selrun, seltot;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD e, e, 0x100;\n";
    # the next chunk exists while its first element is inside the slice (uniform over the CTA): start + 256 k < end
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, e, -tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P0, PT, t, end, PT;\n";
    $o .= $nop3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 BRA KLOOP;\n";
    $o .= "06:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
