#include "attn.h"
#include "ple.h"
#include "hold.h"
#include "prog.h"
#include "split.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)
static uint32_t rs = 909;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }
static float h2f(uint16_t h) {
	uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000) << 16, e = (h >> 10) & 0x1f, m = h & 0x3ff, u;
	if (e == 0) { if (!m) u = s; else { int sh = 0; while (!(m & 0x400)) { m <<= 1; sh++; } m &= 0x3ff; u = s | ((uint32_t)(113 - sh) << 23) | (m << 13); } }
	else if (e == 31) u = s | 0x7f800000u | (m << 13);
	else u = s | ((e + 112) << 23) | (m << 13);
	float f; memcpy(&f, &u, 4); return f;
}

#define MAXD 6
#define MAXB 48
static int nd;
static const char *fullcache;
static CUcontext ctx[MAXD];
static hold_arena ar[MAXD];
static char tname[128];
static const char *tn(int blk, const char *suffix) { snprintf(tname, sizeof tname, "blk.%d.%s", blk, suffix); return tname; }
static void *hostimg_raw(const char *name) {
	char fn[512]; snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/%s", fullcache, name);
	FILE *f = fopen(fn, "rb"); if (!f) { perror(fn); exit(1); }
	fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long n = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
	void *p = malloc((size_t)n + 16);
	if (fread(p, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) { fprintf(stderr, "short read %s\n", fn); exit(1); }
	fclose(f);
	return p;
}
static void *hostimg(int blk, const char *suffix) { return hostimg_raw(tn(blk, suffix)); }
static CUdeviceptr dptr_raw(int d, const char *name) { CUdeviceptr p = hold_ptr(&ar[d], name); if (!p) { fprintf(stderr, "die %d: no %s\n", d, name); exit(1); } return p; }
static CUdeviceptr dptr(int d, int blk, const char *suffix) { return dptr_raw(d, tn(blk, suffix)); }
static uint32_t ttype(int blk, const char *suffix) { const hold_tensor *t = hold_find(&ar[0], tn(blk, suffix)); if (!t) { fprintf(stderr, "no %s\n", tname); exit(1); } return t->type; }
static CUdeviceptr dalloc(size_t bytes) { CUdeviceptr p; CK(cuMemAlloc(&p, bytes)); CK(cuMemsetD8(p, 0, bytes)); return p; }

static int cmpbuf(const char *what, const void *ref, CUdeviceptr dev, size_t bytes, int elemsz) {
	void *got = malloc(bytes);
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(got, dev, bytes));
	size_t n = bytes / elemsz; int bad = 0; size_t first = 0;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp((const char *)ref + i * elemsz, (const char *)got + i * elemsz, elemsz)) { if (!bad) first = i; bad++; }
	if (bad) {
		printf("  %-10s MISMATCH %d of %zu (first at %zu", what, bad, n, first);
		if (elemsz == 4) printf(": gpu %.9g ref %.9g", ((float *)got)[first], ((const float *)ref)[first]);
		printf(")\n");
	}
	free(got);
	return bad;
}

/* the twin's per-block state (dn_hbufs_t carries one block's) */
typedef struct { float *dn_state, *conv_state, *ple_state, *kc, *vc; } hstate_t;

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 7) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: model_test <fullcache> <b0> <b1> <T> <flags: e h -> <manifest0> [manifest1 ...]\n"); return 2; }
	fullcache = argv[1]; int b0 = atoi(argv[2]), b1 = atoi(argv[3]), T = atoi(argv[4]); const char *flags = argv[5]; nd = argc - 6; float eps = 1e-6f;
	int do_embed = strchr(flags, 'e') != NULL, do_head = strchr(flags, 'h') != NULL, do_loop = strchr(flags, 'l') != NULL;   /* l: one launch for all T tokens */
	if (nd > MAXD || b1 > MAXB || b0 >= b1) { fprintf(stderr, "bad arguments\n"); return 2; }
	int notwin = getenv("MODEL_NOTWIN") != NULL;
	unsigned npos = ((unsigned)T + 8192 + 64 + 31) / 32 * 32;
	size_t kcf = ATTN_KC_FLOATS(npos), vcf = (size_t)npos * 512;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUmodule mod[MAXD]; CUfunction fn[MAXD]; int dev_of[MAXD];
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
		FILE *f = fopen(argv[6 + d], "r"); size_t bytes; int die;
		if (!f || fscanf(f, "arena %zu die %d", &bytes, &die) != 2) { fprintf(stderr, "bad manifest %s\n", argv[6 + d]); return 1; }
		fclose(f);
		dev_of[d] = die;
		CUdevice dev; if (hold_ordinal(die) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "die %d is not in CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES\n", die); return 1; } CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, hold_ordinal(die)));
		CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx[d], CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
		if (hold_open(&ar[d], argv[6 + d])) return 1;
		CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod[d], "die.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn[d], mod[d], "die"));
	}
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); for (int e = 0; e < nd; e++) if (e != d) CK(cuCtxEnablePeerAccess(ctx[e], 0)); }
	/* prompt ids: MODEL_IDS or random; the PLE's synthetic table and constants */
	uint32_t *ids = calloc((size_t)T + 2, 4); int nprompt = T;
	if (getenv("MODEL_IDS")) {
		FILE *f = fopen(getenv("MODEL_IDS"), "r"); if (!f) { perror(getenv("MODEL_IDS")); return 1; }
		nprompt = 0; while (nprompt < T && fscanf(f, "%u", &ids[nprompt]) == 1) nprompt++;
		fclose(f);
	} else for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) { ids[i] = (uint32_t)((rs >> 8) % 248000u); frand(); }
	const size_t PLE_R = 1u << 20; uint8_t *ptab = NULL, *ctab = NULL; unsigned pcompact = 0; uint8_t ppc[160]; uint64_t pmult[3], poff[16], pvoc[16]; uint32_t pabsent = PLE_EOS_TOKEN, pend = PLE_EOS_TOKEN;
/* the 16 real rows of position t -> the compact table slot the GPU reads (plerows compact mode) */
#define PLE_STAGE(t) do { uint64_t rows_[16]; ple_rows_c(ids, (size_t)(t), pabsent, &pend, 1, pmult, poff, pvoc, rows_); for (int h_ = 0; h_ < 16; h_++) memcpy(ctab + ((size_t)(t) * 16 + h_) * 90, ptab + rows_[h_] * 90, 90); } while (0)
	int has_ple = b0 <= 1 && 1 < b1;
	if (has_ple) {
		memcpy(pmult, ple_multipliers, sizeof pmult);
		if (getenv("MODEL_PLE")) {
			/* the real table: shard 2's tensor data (320,001,536 rows x 90 B) as a file (a tmpfs copy).
			   CUDA 11.4 refuses to pin a file mapping, so the twin reads the mapping with the real hash
			   while the GPU gets a compact table: the 16 rows of every position (teacher-forced: all T
			   ids are known up front), staged in pinned memory and indexed 16 pos + h (plerows' compact
			   mode). Free-running decode with the real table needs a long-lived pinned copy (later). */
			if (do_loop && nprompt < T) { fprintf(stderr, "MODEL_PLE in one-launch mode needs every id up front (MODEL_IDS with %d ids): the rows are staged per position\n", T); return 1; }
			int fd = open(getenv("MODEL_PLE"), O_RDONLY); if (fd < 0) { perror(getenv("MODEL_PLE")); return 1; }
			struct stat st; if (fstat(fd, &st)) { perror("fstat"); return 1; }
			size_t sz = ((size_t)st.st_size + 4095) & ~(size_t)4095;   /* whole pages (the last row ends mid-page) */
			off_t poff_ = getenv("MODEL_PLE_OFF") ? (off_t)atoll(getenv("MODEL_PLE_OFF")) : 0;   /* 192: shard 2 itself (its data section); 0: an extracted copy */
			sz = (sz - (size_t)poff_ + 4095) & ~(size_t)4095;
			ptab = mmap(NULL, sz, PROT_READ, MAP_SHARED, fd, (off_t)(poff_ & ~(off_t)4095)); if (ptab == MAP_FAILED) { perror("mmap ple"); return 1; }
			ptab += poff_ & 4095;
			memcpy(poff, ple_head_offsets, sizeof poff); memcpy(pvoc, ple_head_vocab, sizeof pvoc);
			CK(cuMemHostAlloc((void **)&ctab, (size_t)T * 16 * 90 + 4096, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_PORTABLE | CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP));
			for (int t = 0; t < nprompt; t++) PLE_STAGE(t);   /* generated positions are staged per token (per-token mode) */
			pcompact = 1;
			printf("PLE table %s mapped for the twin; %d prompt positions x 16 rows staged for the GPU\n", getenv("MODEL_PLE"), nprompt);
		} else {
			CK(cuMemHostAlloc((void **)&ptab, PLE_R * 90, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_PORTABLE | CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP));
			for (size_t r = 0; r < PLE_R; r++)
				for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
					uint16_t dd = (uint16_t)(0x3000 + (rs >> 16) % 0x1000); frand();
					memcpy(ptab + r * 90 + 18 * k, &dd, 2);
					for (int j = 2; j < 18; j++) { ptab[r * 90 + 18 * k + j] = (uint8_t)(rs >> 24); frand(); }
				}
			for (int h = 0; h < 16; h++) { poff[h] = (uint64_t)h * 65000; pvoc[h] = 60000 + 13 * h; }
		}
		memset(ppc, 0, sizeof ppc); memcpy(ppc, pmult, 24);
		for (int h = 0; h < 16; h++) { uint32_t o32 = (uint32_t)poff[h], v32 = (uint32_t)pvoc[h]; memcpy(ppc + 24 + 4 * h, &o32, 4); memcpy(ppc + 88 + 4 * h, &v32, 4); }
		memcpy(ppc + 152, &pabsent, 4); memcpy(ppc + 156, &pend, 4);
	}
	float *rcs = malloc(4 * 32 * T), *rsn = malloc(4 * 32 * T);
	for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) rope_table_gpu((unsigned)t, 1e7f, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t);
	/* ---- twin weights and states ---- */
	dn_hweights_t *hwb = calloc(MAXB, sizeof *hwb); hstate_t hs[MAXB]; memset(hs, 0, sizeof hs);
	dn_hbufs_t *hb = calloc(1, sizeof *hb);
	hb->logits = malloc(4 * 248320); hb->ids = ids;
	if (!notwin) {
		for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
			dn_hweights_t *w = &hwb[b]; int is_attn = BLK_IS_ATTN(b);
			w->hc_attn_norm = hostimg(b, "hc_attn_norm.weight"); w->hc_attn_dj = hostimg(b, "hc_attn_dj.weight"); w->hc_attn_up = hostimg(b, "hc_attn_up.weight");
			w->hc_ffn_norm = hostimg(b, "hc_ffn_norm.weight"); w->hc_ffn_dj = hostimg(b, "hc_ffn_dj.weight"); w->hc_ffn_up = hostimg(b, "hc_ffn_up.weight");
			if (!is_attn) {
				w->attn_qkv = hostimg(b, "attn_qkv.weight"); w->attn_qkv_type = ttype(b, "attn_qkv.weight");
				w->attn_gate = hostimg(b, "attn_gate.weight"); w->attn_gate_type = ttype(b, "attn_gate.weight");
				w->ssm_out = hostimg(b, "ssm_out.weight"); w->ssm_out_type = ttype(b, "ssm_out.weight");
				w->ssm_ab = hostimg(b, "ssm_ab.weight"); w->ssm_ab_bias = hostimg(b, "ssm_ab.bias"); w->ssm_conv1d = hostimg(b, "ssm_conv1d.weight");
				w->ssm_a = hostimg(b, "ssm_a"); w->ssm_norm = hostimg(b, "ssm_norm.weight");
				hs[b].dn_state = calloc(48 * 16384, 4); hs[b].conv_state = calloc(4 * 10240, 4);
			} else {
				w->attn_q = hostimg(b, "attn_q.weight"); w->attn_q_type = ttype(b, "attn_q.weight");
				w->attn_k = hostimg(b, "attn_k.weight"); w->attn_k_type = ttype(b, "attn_k.weight");
				w->attn_v = hostimg(b, "attn_v.weight"); w->attn_v_type = ttype(b, "attn_v.weight");
				w->attn_output = hostimg(b, "attn_output.weight"); w->attn_output_type = ttype(b, "attn_output.weight");
				w->attn_q_norm = hostimg(b, "attn_q_norm.weight"); w->attn_k_norm = hostimg(b, "attn_k_norm.weight");
				hs[b].kc = calloc(kcf, 4); hs[b].vc = calloc(vcf, 4);
			}
			w->ffn_gate_inp_x = hostimg(b, "ffn_gate_inp_x.weight");
			w->ffn_gate_exps = hostimg(b, "ffn_gate_exps.weight"); w->ffn_up_exps = hostimg(b, "ffn_up_exps.weight"); w->ffn_down_exps = hostimg(b, "ffn_down_exps.weight");
			w->ffn_gate_shexp = hostimg(b, "ffn_gate_shexp.weight"); w->ffn_gate_shexp_type = ttype(b, "ffn_gate_shexp.weight");
			w->ffn_up_shexp = hostimg(b, "ffn_up_shexp.weight"); w->ffn_up_shexp_type = ttype(b, "ffn_up_shexp.weight");
			w->ffn_down_shexp = hostimg(b, "ffn_down_shexp.weight"); w->ffn_down_shexp_type = ttype(b, "ffn_down_shexp.weight");
			if (b == 1) {
				w->ple_key = hostimg(b, "ple_key.weight"); w->ple_value = hostimg(b, "ple_value.weight");
				w->ple_norm_key = hostimg(b, "ple_norm_key.weight"); w->ple_norm_query = hostimg(b, "ple_norm_query.weight"); w->ple_norm_conv = hostimg(b, "ple_norm_conv.weight");
				const uint16_t *cw = hostimg(b, "ple_conv1d.weight"); float *pc = malloc(4 * 10240 * 4);
				for (int i = 0; i < 10240 * 4; i++) pc[i] = h2f(cw[i]);
				w->ple_conv_w = pc; w->ple_tab = ptab; memcpy(w->ple_mult, pmult, sizeof pmult); memcpy(w->ple_off, poff, sizeof poff); memcpy(w->ple_voc, pvoc, sizeof pvoc);
				w->ple_absent = pabsent; w->ple_end = pend;
				hs[b].ple_state = calloc(10 * 10240, 4);
			}
		}
		if (do_head) { hwb[0].output_hc_norm = hostimg_raw("output_hc_norm.weight"); hwb[0].output_hc_down = hostimg_raw("output_hc_down.weight"); hwb[0].output_hc_up = hostimg_raw("output_hc_up.weight"); hwb[0].output = hostimg_raw("output.weight"); }
		if (do_embed) hwb[0].token_embd = hostimg_raw("token_embd.weight");
	}
	/* ---- the dies ---- */
	dn_weights_t (*dw)[MAXB] = calloc(MAXD, sizeof *dw); dn_bufs_t db[MAXD]; xchg_t xc[MAXD]; split_t sp[MAXD][MAXB];
	CUdeviceptr dPROG[MAXD], dCTL[MAXD], dst_dn[MAXD][MAXB], dst_conv[MAXD][MAXB], dst_kc[MAXD][MAXB], dst_vc[MAXD][MAXB], dst_ple[MAXD];
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
		CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
		split_t s0; split_of(&s0, d, nd, 0);
		dn_bufs_t *b = &db[d]; memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
		unsigned nlocmax = 128u * (2u * (unsigned)s0.nk + (unsigned)s0.hn)   /* q, k of the die's key heads, v of its value heads */, cols = 32u * (unsigned)s0.cbn, hrows = 128u * (unsigned)s0.hn;
		b->S = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->S2 = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->xh = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->t = dalloc(4 * 324);
		b->ldown = dalloc(4 * 324); b->lup = dalloc(4 * 4 * cols); b->lz = dalloc(4 * cols);
		b->zq = dalloc(2 * 2560); b->zs32 = dalloc(4 * 80); b->zs16 = dalloc(4 * 160); b->zas = dalloc(4 * 80);
		b->lqkv = dalloc(4 * nlocmax); b->lgate = dalloc(4 * hrows); b->la = dalloc(4 * 2u * (unsigned)s0.hn); b->lu = dalloc(4 * nlocmax); b->lo = dalloc(4 * hrows); b->lon = dalloc(4 * hrows);
		b->oq = dalloc(2 * 6144); b->os32 = dalloc(4 * 192); b->os16 = dalloc(4 * 384); b->oas = dalloc(4 * 192);
		b->ly = dalloc(4u * (unsigned)s0.yn); b->r = dalloc(4 * 513); b->idx = dalloc(64); b->w = dalloc(64); b->s = dalloc(16);
		b->lidx = dalloc(64); b->lw = dalloc(64); b->ne = dalloc(16); b->part = dalloc(4 * 2560);
		b->g = dalloc(4 * 7040); b->gu = dalloc(4 * 7040); b->hq = dalloc(2 * 7040); b->hs32 = dalloc(4 * 220); b->hs16 = dalloc(4 * 440); b->has = dalloc(4 * 220);
		b->out = dalloc(4 * 2560);
		b->qg = dalloc(4 * 12288); b->k = dalloc(4 * 512); b->v = dalloc(4 * 512); b->qo = dalloc(4 * 6144); b->aout = dalloc(4 * 6144);
		b->pm = dalloc(4 * 24 * 8); b->pd = dalloc(4 * 24 * 8); b->po = dalloc(4 * 24 * 8 * 256);
		b->rope_cs = dalloc(4 * 32 * T); b->rope_sn = dalloc(4 * 32 * T);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(b->rope_cs, rcs, 4 * 32 * T)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(b->rope_sn, rsn, 4 * 32 * T));
		b->ids = dalloc(4 * ((size_t)T + 2)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(b->ids, ids, 4 * ((size_t)T + 2)));
		if (has_ple) {
			b->ple_pc = dalloc(160); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(b->ple_pc, ppc, 160)); CK(cuMemHostGetDevicePointer(&b->ple_tab, pcompact ? ctab : ptab, 0)); b->ple_compact = pcompact;
			b->pg = dalloc(4 * 2560); b->pgq = dalloc(2 * 2560); b->pgs32 = dalloc(4 * 80); b->pgs16 = dalloc(4 * 160); b->pgas = dalloc(4 * 80);
			b->lk = dalloc(4u * (unsigned)s0.pkn); b->kn = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->qn = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->lv = dalloc(4u * (unsigned)s0.yn);
			b->pG = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->pgates = dalloc(16); b->px = dalloc(4 * 10240); b->prows = dalloc(64);
			dst_ple[d] = dalloc(4 * 10 * 10240);
		}
		b->hlo = dalloc(4u * (unsigned)s0.on); b->amo = dalloc(8); b->apart = dalloc(16 * 8); b->acnt = dalloc(4); b->tokout = dalloc(8); b->toks = dalloc(4 * ((size_t)T + 2));
		for (int bb = b0; bb < b1; bb++) {
			split_t *s = &sp[d][bb]; split_of(s, d, nd, bb);
			dn_weights_t *w = &dw[d][bb]; int is_attn = BLK_IS_ATTN(bb);
			w->hc_attn_norm = dptr(d, bb, "hc_attn_norm.weight"); w->hc_attn_dj = dptr(d, bb, "hc_attn_dj.weight"); w->hc_attn_up = dptr(d, bb, "hc_attn_up.weight");
			w->hc_ffn_norm = dptr(d, bb, "hc_ffn_norm.weight"); w->hc_ffn_dj = dptr(d, bb, "hc_ffn_dj.weight"); w->hc_ffn_up = dptr(d, bb, "hc_ffn_up.weight");
			if (!is_attn) {
				w->attn_qkv = dptr(d, bb, "attn_qkv.weight"); w->attn_qkv_type = ttype(bb, "attn_qkv.weight");
				w->attn_gate = dptr(d, bb, "attn_gate.weight"); w->attn_gate_type = ttype(bb, "attn_gate.weight");
				w->ssm_out = dptr(d, bb, "ssm_out.weight"); w->ssm_out_type = ttype(bb, "ssm_out.weight");
				w->ssm_ab = dptr(d, bb, "ssm_ab.weight"); w->ssm_ab_bias = dptr(d, bb, "ssm_ab.bias");
				w->ssm_conv1d = dptr(d, bb, "ssm_conv1d.weight"); w->ssm_a = dptr(d, bb, "ssm_a"); w->ssm_norm = dptr(d, bb, "ssm_norm.weight");
				dst_dn[d][bb] = dalloc((size_t)s->hn * 16384 * 4); dst_conv[d][bb] = dalloc(4 * 4 * SPLIT_NLOC(s));
			} else {
				w->attn_q = dptr(d, bb, "attn_q.weight"); w->attn_q_type = ttype(bb, "attn_q.weight");
				w->attn_k = dptr(d, bb, "attn_k.weight"); w->attn_k_type = ttype(bb, "attn_k.weight");
				w->attn_v = dptr(d, bb, "attn_v.weight"); w->attn_v_type = ttype(bb, "attn_v.weight");
				w->attn_output = dptr(d, bb, "attn_output.weight"); w->attn_output_type = ttype(bb, "attn_output.weight");
				w->attn_q_norm = dptr(d, bb, "attn_q_norm.weight"); w->attn_k_norm = dptr(d, bb, "attn_k_norm.weight");
				dst_kc[d][bb] = dalloc(d == attn_die() ? kcf * 4 : 256); dst_vc[d][bb] = dalloc(d == attn_die() ? vcf * 4 : 256);
			}
			w->ffn_gate_inp_x = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_gate_inp_x.weight"); w->emap = dptr(d, bb, "emap");
			w->ffn_gate_exps = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_gate_exps.weight"); w->ffn_up_exps = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_up_exps.weight"); w->ffn_down_exps = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_down_exps.weight");
			w->ffn_gate_shexp = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_gate_shexp.weight"); w->ffn_gate_shexp_type = ttype(bb, "ffn_gate_shexp.weight");
			w->ffn_up_shexp = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_up_shexp.weight"); w->ffn_up_shexp_type = ttype(bb, "ffn_up_shexp.weight");
			w->ffn_down_shexp = dptr(d, bb, "ffn_down_shexp.weight"); w->ffn_down_shexp_type = ttype(bb, "ffn_down_shexp.weight");
			if (bb == 1) {
				w->ple_key = dptr(d, bb, "ple_key.weight"); w->ple_value = dptr(d, bb, "ple_value.weight");
				w->ple_norm_key = dptr(d, bb, "ple_norm_key.weight"); w->ple_norm_query = dptr(d, bb, "ple_norm_query.weight"); w->ple_norm_conv = dptr(d, bb, "ple_norm_conv.weight");
				w->ple_conv1d = dptr(d, bb, "ple_conv1d.weight");
			}
		}
		if (do_head) {
			dn_weights_t *w = &dw[d][0];
			w->output_hc_norm = dptr_raw(d, "output_hc_norm.weight"); w->output_hc_down = dptr_raw(d, "output_hc_down.weight"); w->output_hc_up = dptr_raw(d, "output_hc_up.weight"); w->output = dptr_raw(d, "output.weight");
			uint32_t ob[6]; for (int e = 0; e < 6; e++) ob[e] = split_bound(248320u, e, nd);
			w->obases = dalloc(24); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(w->obases, ob, 24));
		}
		if (do_embed) dw[d][0].token_embd = dptr_raw(d, "token_embd.weight");
		xchg_t *x = &xc[d];
		x->inbox = dalloc(2 * XSLOT); x->flags = dalloc(512); x->xtab = dalloc(128);   /* flags: u32[6 dies][16 CTAs] */
		uint32_t fl[96]; for (int e = 0; e < 96; e++) fl[e] = e / 16 < nd ? 0u : 0xffffffffu;
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(x->flags, fl, sizeof fl));
		dPROG[d] = dalloc(128 * 4096); dCTL[d] = dalloc(0x100 + 4 * 4096);
		x->xgen = dCTL[d] + 0x20;   /* the exchange count lives in ctl[8] between launches */
	}
	uint64_t tab[12] = { 0 };
	for (int d = 0; d < 6; d++) { tab[d] = (uint64_t)xc[d < nd ? d : 0].inbox; tab[6 + d] = (uint64_t)xc[d < nd ? d : 0].flags; }   /* absent dies alias die 0: duplicate writes of the same bytes */
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
		CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(xc[d].xtab, tab, sizeof tab));
		/* the framework's exchange header in ctl: [3] me, [4] ndies, [16 + 2e] = &flags_e[me][0], [28] = my flags */
		uint32_t hdr[32] = { 0 }; hdr[3] = (uint32_t)d; hdr[4] = (uint32_t)nd;
		for (int e = 0; e < 6; e++) { uint64_t a = e < nd ? (uint64_t)xc[e].flags + 64u * (unsigned)d : (uint64_t)dCTL[d] + 0xc0; memcpy(&hdr[16 + 2 * e], &a, 8); }   /* absent dies: a scratch word, so the framework's six flag stores are unconditional */
		uint64_t mf = (uint64_t)xc[d].flags; memcpy(&hdr[28], &mf, 8);
		CK(cuMemsetD8(dCTL[d], 0, 0x100)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCTL[d], hdr, sizeof hdr));   /* ctl[32..47]: the grid barrier arrival flags */
	}
	/* the initial stream: the embedding of ids[0], or random when no embedding runs */
	if (!do_embed) { for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) hb->S[i] = 0.5f * frand(); for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(db[d].S, hb->S, 4 * 10240)); } }
	printf("%d die(s), blocks [%d, %d)%s%s%s, %d tokens (%d prompt)\n", nd, b0, b1, do_embed ? ", embed" : "", do_head ? ", head" : "", do_loop ? ", one launch" : "", T, nprompt);
	int fails = 0; unsigned tok_gpu = 0, tok_twin = 0; double tsum = 0;
	if (do_loop) {
		/* the twin runs every token first (its own greedy sequence) */
		unsigned *tw = calloc((size_t)T + 1, 4);
		double t0 = now();
		if (!notwin) for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
			unsigned idt = t < nprompt ? ids[t] : tok_twin;
			if (do_embed) embed_gpu(&hwb[0], hb, idt);
			for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
				hb->dn_state = hs[b].dn_state; hb->kc = hs[b].kc; hb->vc = hs[b].vc;
				if (hs[b].conv_state) memcpy(hb->conv_state, hs[b].conv_state, sizeof hb->conv_state);
				if (hs[b].ple_state) memcpy(hb->ple_state, hs[b].ple_state, sizeof hb->ple_state);
				if (b == 1) ple_prefix_gpu(&hwb[b], hb, (unsigned)t, eps);
				if (BLK_IS_ATTN(b)) attn_block_gpu(&hwb[b], hb, (unsigned)t, eps, nd, b, 0); else deltanet_block_gpu(&hwb[b], hb, (unsigned)t, eps, nd, b, 0);
				if (hs[b].conv_state) memcpy(hs[b].conv_state, hb->conv_state, sizeof hb->conv_state);
				if (hs[b].ple_state) memcpy(hs[b].ple_state, hb->ple_state, sizeof hb->ple_state);
			}
			if (do_head) { head_gpu(&hwb[0], hb, eps, nd); tok_twin = hb->tok; tw[t] = hb->tok; if (t + 1 >= nprompt && t + 1 < T) ((uint32_t *)ids)[t + 1] = 0; }
		}
		double t1 = now();
		/* one program per die, token-relative, launched once for T tokens */
		prog_t P[MAXD]; unsigned nph[MAXD];
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
			prog_init(&P[d]); P[d].loop = 1;
			if (do_embed) prog_embed(&P[d], &dw[d][0], &db[d], 0);
			for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
				dn_bufs_t bb = db[d]; bb.dn_state = dst_dn[d][b]; bb.conv_state = dst_conv[d][b]; bb.kc = dst_kc[d][b]; bb.vc = dst_vc[d][b]; bb.ple_state = dst_ple[d];
				if (b == 1) prog_ple_prefix(&P[d], &sp[d][b], &xc[d], &dw[d][b], &bb, 0, eps);
				if (BLK_IS_ATTN(b)) prog_attn_block(&P[d], &sp[d][b], &xc[d], &dw[d][b], &bb, 0, eps);
				else prog_deltanet_block(&P[d], &sp[d][b], &xc[d], &dw[d][b], &bb, 0, eps);
			}
			if (do_head) prog_head(&P[d], &sp[d][b0], &xc[d], &dw[d][0], &db[d], eps, 0, (unsigned)nprompt);
			prog_token_end(&P[d], &xc[d], d, nd, db[d].S);
			nph[d] = (unsigned)P[d].n;
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
			CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPROG[d], P[d].p, sizeof(phase_t) * P[d].n));
		}
		double t2 = now();
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
			unsigned ntok = (unsigned)T; void *params[] = { &dPROG[d], &nph[d], &dCTL[d], &ntok };
			CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn[d], 16, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		}
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuCtxSynchronize()); }
		double t3 = now();
		printf("%u phases per token; twin %.2f s for %d tokens; dies %.3f ms total = %.3f ms per token\n", nph[0], t1 - t0, T, (t3 - t2) * 1e3, (t3 - t2) * 1e3 / T);
		if (getenv("MODEL_PROF")) {   /* die 0, the last token */
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0]));
			uint32_t *ts = malloc(4 * (64 + nph[0])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ts, dCTL[0], 4 * (64 + nph[0])));
			double byop[DIE_NOPS] = {0}; unsigned prev = ts[15], cnt[DIE_NOPS] = {0};
			for (unsigned i = 0; i < nph[0]; i++) { unsigned dd = ts[64 + i] - prev; prev = ts[64 + i]; byop[P[0].p[i].w[0]] += dd / 1e3; cnt[P[0].p[i].w[0]]++; }
			printf("  die 0 by op (us/count):");
			for (int o = 0; o < DIE_NOPS; o++) if (cnt[o]) printf(" %s %.0f/%u", die_opname[o], byop[o], cnt[o]);
			/* ts[15] is written once, at kernel entry, and the phase slots are overwritten every token: with many tokens in the launch this is the time since the
			   launch (mod 2^32 ns), NOT the last token, and the first op's bucket above absorbs every earlier token. Use the per-token launch path for a per-token profile. */
			printf("\n  since kernel entry %.1f us in %u phases (the last token only when the launch holds one token)\n", (ts[64 + nph[0] - 1] - ts[15]) / 1e3, nph[0]);
			free(ts);
		}
		unsigned *tg = calloc((size_t)T + 1, 4); int bad = 0;
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
			if (do_head) {
				CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(tg, db[d].toks, 4 * (size_t)T));
				int first = -1, nb = 0;
				for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) if (tg[t] != tw[t]) { if (first < 0) first = t; nb++; }
				if (!notwin) { if (nb) printf("  die %d tokens: %d of %d differ, first at %d (gpu %u twin %u)\n", d, nb, T, first, tg[first], tw[first]); else printf("  die %d tokens: all %d exact\n", d, T); }
				bad += nb;
			}
			if (!notwin) { char nm[16]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "S.%d", d); if (!cmpbuf(nm, hb->S, db[d].S, 4 * 10240, 4)) printf("  %s exact\n", nm); else bad++; }
		}
		if (do_head) { printf("  tokens:"); for (int t = 0; t < T && t < 40; t++) printf(" %u", tg[t]); printf("%s\n", T > 40 ? " ..." : ""); }
		if (do_head && nprompt == T && getenv("MODEL_IDS")) {   /* teacher-forced: the prediction at t against the given id at t + 1 */
			int agree = 0, first = -1;
			for (int t = 0; t + 1 < T; t++) { if (tg[t] == ids[t + 1]) agree++; else if (first < 0) first = t; }
			printf("  teacher-forced: %d of %d next-token predictions match the given ids", agree, T - 1);
			if (first >= 0) printf("; first difference at %d (gpu %u given %u)", first, tg[first], ids[first + 1]);
			printf("\n");
		}
		printf("%s\n", notwin ? "ran" : bad ? "FAIL" : "OK: one launch, every token exact");
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); hold_close(&ar[d]); }
		return bad && !notwin ? 3 : 0;
	}
	for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
		unsigned id = t < nprompt ? ids[t] : tok_gpu;
		if (t >= nprompt) ids[t] = tok_gpu;   /* the PLE's context sees the generated token */
		if (pcompact && t >= nprompt) PLE_STAGE(t);   /* and its real PLE rows get staged */
		double t0 = now();
		if (!notwin) {
			unsigned idt = t < nprompt ? ids[t] : tok_twin;
			if (do_embed) embed_gpu(&hwb[0], hb, idt);
			for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
				hb->dn_state = hs[b].dn_state; hb->kc = hs[b].kc; hb->vc = hs[b].vc;
				if (hs[b].conv_state) memcpy(hb->conv_state, hs[b].conv_state, sizeof hb->conv_state);
				if (hs[b].ple_state) memcpy(hb->ple_state, hs[b].ple_state, sizeof hb->ple_state);
				if (b == 1) ple_prefix_gpu(&hwb[b], hb, (unsigned)t, eps);
				if (BLK_IS_ATTN(b)) attn_block_gpu(&hwb[b], hb, (unsigned)t, eps, nd, b, 0); else deltanet_block_gpu(&hwb[b], hb, (unsigned)t, eps, nd, b, 0);
				if (hs[b].conv_state) memcpy(hs[b].conv_state, hb->conv_state, sizeof hb->conv_state);
				if (hs[b].ple_state) memcpy(hs[b].ple_state, hb->ple_state, sizeof hb->ple_state);
			}
			if (do_head) { head_gpu(&hwb[0], hb, eps, nd); tok_twin = hb->tok; }
			if (getenv("MODEL_DUMP_TWIN") && t == T - 1) {   /* the twin's intermediates of the last block (layer comparisons) */
				const char *dir = getenv("MODEL_DUMP_TWIN"); char fn[600];
				struct { const char *name; const void *p; size_t bytes; } bufs[] = {
					{ "S", hb->S, 4 * 10240 }, { "xh", hb->xh, 4 * 10240 }, { "z", hb->z, 4 * 2560 }, { "qkv", hb->qkv, 4 * 10240 }, { "gate", hb->gate, 4 * 6144 }, { "a", hb->a, 4 * 96 },
					{ "u", hb->u, 4 * 10240 }, { "o", hb->o, 4 * 6144 }, { "on", hb->on, 4 * 6144 }, { "y", hb->y, 4 * 2560 }, { "r", hb->r, 4 * 513 }, { "out", hb->out, 4 * 2560 }, { "t", hb->t, 4 * 324 }, { "up", hb->up, 4 * 10240 },
				};
				for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof bufs / sizeof *bufs; i++) { snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/%s.bin", dir, bufs[i].name); FILE *f = fopen(fn, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(bufs[i].p, 1, bufs[i].bytes, f); fclose(f); } }
				printf("  twin buffers dumped to %s\n", dir);
			}
		}
		double t1 = now();
		prog_t P[MAXD]; unsigned nph[MAXD];
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
			prog_init(&P[d]);
			if (do_embed) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(db[d].ids + 4u * (unsigned)t, &id, 4)); prog_embed(&P[d], &dw[d][0], &db[d], (unsigned)t); }
			for (int b = b0; b < b1; b++) {
				dn_bufs_t bb = db[d]; bb.dn_state = dst_dn[d][b]; bb.conv_state = dst_conv[d][b]; bb.kc = dst_kc[d][b]; bb.vc = dst_vc[d][b]; bb.ple_state = dst_ple[d];
				if (b == 1) prog_ple_prefix(&P[d], &sp[d][b], &xc[d], &dw[d][b], &bb, (unsigned)t, eps);
				if (BLK_IS_ATTN(b)) prog_attn_block(&P[d], &sp[d][b], &xc[d], &dw[d][b], &bb, (unsigned)t, eps);
				else prog_deltanet_block(&P[d], &sp[d][b], &xc[d], &dw[d][b], &bb, (unsigned)t, eps);
			}
			if (do_head) prog_head(&P[d], &sp[d][b0], &xc[d], &dw[d][0], &db[d], eps, (unsigned)t, (unsigned)nprompt);
			nph[d] = (unsigned)P[d].n;
			if (getenv("MODEL_NPH") && (unsigned)atoi(getenv("MODEL_NPH")) < nph[d]) nph[d] = (unsigned)atoi(getenv("MODEL_NPH"));
			if (nph[d] > 4096) { fprintf(stderr, "program too long (%u phases)\n", nph[d]); return 1; }
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
			CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPROG[d], P[d].p, sizeof(phase_t) * P[d].n));
		}
		double t2 = now();
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
			unsigned ntok = 1; void *params[] = { &dPROG[d], &nph[d], &dCTL[d], &ntok };
			CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn[d], 16, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		}
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuCtxSynchronize()); }
		double t3 = now();
		tsum += t3 - t2;
		if (do_head) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(&tok_gpu, db[0].tokout, 4)); }
		if (getenv("MODEL_DUMP_S")) {   /* this position's stream: <path>.t<pos> */
			float *St = malloc(4 * 10240); CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(St, db[0].S, 4 * 10240));
			char fnt[600]; snprintf(fnt, sizeof fnt, "%s.t%d", getenv("MODEL_DUMP_S"), t); FILE *ft = fopen(fnt, "wb"); if (ft) { fwrite(St, 4, 10240, ft); fclose(ft); } free(St);
		}
		if (do_head && getenv("MODEL_TOPK")) {   /* the position's top-k logits, gathered from the dies' row slices (reference comparisons) */
			int k = atoi(getenv("MODEL_TOPK")); static float *lg = NULL; if (!lg) lg = malloc(4 * 248320);
			for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(lg + sp[d][b0].o0, db[d].hlo, 4u * (unsigned)sp[d][b0].on)); }
			printf("  pos %d top%d:", t, k);
			for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) { int bi = 0; for (int i = 1; i < 248320; i++) if (lg[i] > lg[bi]) bi = i; printf(" %d:%.4f", bi, lg[bi]); lg[bi] = -3.4e38f; }
			printf("\n");
		}
		int bad = 0;
		if (!notwin) {
			for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) {
				CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d]));
				char nm[16]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "S.%d", d);
				bad += cmpbuf(nm, hb->S, db[d].S, 4 * 10240, 4);
				if (do_head) { uint32_t tk[2] = { hb->tok, 0 }; memcpy(&tk[1], &hb->tokmax, 4); snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "tok.%d", d); bad += cmpbuf(nm, tk, db[d].tokout, 8, 4); }
			}
		}
		printf("token %3d: id %6u -> %6u%s %u phases; twin %.2f s, dies %.3f ms%s\n", t, id, tok_gpu, do_head ? "" : " (no head)", nph[0], t1 - t0, (t3 - t2) * 1e3, bad ? "  MISMATCH" : notwin ? "" : "  exact");
		if (bad) fails++;
		if (t == T - 1 && getenv("MODEL_PROF")) {
			CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0]));
			uint32_t *ts = malloc(4 * (64 + nph[0])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ts, dCTL[0], 4 * (64 + nph[0])));
			double byop[DIE_NOPS] = {0}; unsigned prev = ts[15], cnt[DIE_NOPS] = {0};
			for (unsigned i = 0; i < nph[0]; i++) { unsigned dd = ts[64 + i] - prev; prev = ts[64 + i]; byop[P[0].p[i].w[0]] += dd / 1e3; cnt[P[0].p[i].w[0]]++; }
			printf("  die 0 by op (us, count):");
			for (int o = 0; o < DIE_NOPS; o++) if (cnt[o]) printf(" %s %.0f/%u", die_opname[o], byop[o], cnt[o]);
			printf("\n  total %.1f us in %u phases\n", (ts[64 + nph[0] - 1] - ts[15]) / 1e3, nph[0]);
			free(ts);
		}
		for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) prog_free(&P[d]);
	}
	if (getenv("MODEL_DUMP_DIR")) {   /* die 0's whole-vector buffers after the last launch (with MODEL_NPH: a snapshot mid-block) */
		const char *dir = getenv("MODEL_DUMP_DIR"); char fn[600]; CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0]));
		struct { const char *name; CUdeviceptr p; size_t bytes; } bufs[] = {
			{ "S", db[0].S, 4 * 10240 }, { "xh", db[0].xh, 4 * 10240 }, { "t", db[0].t, 4 * 324 }, { "r", db[0].r, 4 * 513 }, { "out", db[0].out, 4 * 2560 },
			{ "part", db[0].part, 4 * 2560 }, { "inbox0", xc[0].inbox, 4 * 10240 }, { "inbox1", xc[0].inbox + XSLOT, 4 * 10240 }, { "idx", db[0].idx, 40 }, { "w", db[0].w, 40 },
		};
		for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof bufs / sizeof *bufs; i++) {
			void *h = malloc(bufs[i].bytes); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(h, bufs[i].p, bufs[i].bytes));
			snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/%s.bin", dir, bufs[i].name); FILE *f = fopen(fn, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(h, 1, bufs[i].bytes, f); fclose(f); }
			free(h);
		}
		/* z: the quantised MoE/qkv input, dequantised (int16 codes x per-32 scale) */
		int16_t *q = malloc(2 * 2560); float *as = malloc(4 * 80), *z = malloc(4 * 2560);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(q, db[0].zq, 2 * 2560)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(as, db[0].zas, 4 * 80));
		for (int i = 0; i < 2560; i++) z[i] = (float)q[i] * as[i / 32];
		snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/z.bin", dir); FILE *f = fopen(fn, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(z, 4, 2560, f); fclose(f); }
		int16_t *oq = malloc(2 * 6144); float *oas = malloc(4 * 192), *o = malloc(4 * 6144);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(oq, db[0].oq, 2 * 6144)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(oas, db[0].oas, 4 * 192));
		for (int i = 0; i < 6144; i++) o[i] = (float)oq[i] * oas[i / 32];
		snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/on.bin", dir); f = fopen(fn, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(o, 4, 6144, f); fclose(f); }
		printf("  dumped die 0 buffers to %s\n", dir);
	}
	if (getenv("MODEL_DUMP_S")) {   /* die 0's stream after the last token (reference comparisons per block prefix); per-token files too */
		float *S = malloc(4 * 10240); CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[0])); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(S, db[0].S, 4 * 10240));
		FILE *f = fopen(getenv("MODEL_DUMP_S"), "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(S, 4, 10240, f); fclose(f); }
		double ss = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) ss += (double)S[i] * S[i];
		printf("  S dumped to %s: lanes sum %.6g %.6g %.6g %.6g, |S| %.6g\n", getenv("MODEL_DUMP_S"), (double)S[0], (double)S[2560], (double)S[5120], (double)S[7680], ss);
		free(S);
	}
	printf("%s: %d of %d tokens %s; mean %.3f ms per token\n", fails ? "FAIL" : "OK", T - fails, T, notwin ? "run" : "exact", tsum / T * 1e3);
	for (int d = 0; d < nd; d++) { CK(cuCtxSetCurrent(ctx[d])); hold_close(&ar[d]); }
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/moe_test.c
/* moe_test: the MoE GEMV modes against the references, bit for bit:
 *   gather: 10 routed experts' gate matrices (640 x 2560 Q2_0) in one launch
 *   down:   10 routed experts' down matrices (2560 x 640 Q2_0), y = fma chain over experts
 *   acc640: y = fma(s, dot, y) with the scale read from device memory (shared expert down)
 *   bias:   BF16 48 x 2560 with a per-row bias (ssm_alpha + ssm_dt.bias)
 * Random Q2_0 blocks for a table of NEXP experts, random routing. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "quant.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 123;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static uint32_t urand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return rs >> 8; }

/* random raw Q2_0 rows (18-byte blocks of 64: fp16 d + 16 code bytes), repacked to tiles */
static uint8_t *random_q2_tiles(int rows, int K, int *stride) {
	size_t rawbytes = (size_t)rows * (K / 64) * 18;
	uint8_t *raw = malloc(rawbytes);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < rawbytes; i++) raw[i] = (uint8_t)urand();
	for (size_t b = 0; b < (size_t)rows * (K / 64); b++) { uint16_t h = (uint16_t)(0x2c00 + (urand() % 0x1000)); memcpy(raw + 18 * b, &h, 2); }
	*stride = q2_0_tile_stride(K);
	uint8_t *tile = malloc((size_t)*stride * rows);
	repack_q2_0(raw, rows, K, tile);
	free(raw);
	return tile;
}
static void quant(const float *x, int K, int16_t *x16, int32_t *s32, float *as, int8_t *xq) {
	int32_t *s16 = malloc(4 * K / 16);
	quant_act_gpu32(x, K, x16, s32, s16, as);
	for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) xq[k] = (int8_t)x16[k];
	free(s16);
}
static int cmp(const char *what, const float *ref, const float *got, int n) {
	int bad = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&ref[i], &got[i], 4)) { if (bad < 3) printf("  %s[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", what, i, got[i], ref[i]); bad++; }
	printf("%-7s %s (%d of %d differ)\n", what, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, n);
	return bad;
}

int main(void) {
	const int NEXP = 16, NR = 10, G = 16;      /* experts in the table, routed, grid */
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CUmodule mg, md, ma, mb; CUfunction fg, fd, fa, fb;
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mg, "gemv_q2_0_moeg.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fg, mg, "gemv_q2_0"));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&md, "gemv_q2_0_moed.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fd, md, "gemv_q2_0"));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&ma, "gemv_q2_0_acc640.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fa, ma, "gemv_q2_0"));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mb, "gemv_bf16_bias.cubin")); CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fb, mb, "gemv_bf16"));
	int fails = 0;
	float xs = 1.f;
	unsigned idx[10];
	for (int e = 0; e < NR; e++) { int again; do { idx[e] = urand() % NEXP; again = 0; for (int j = 0; j < e; j++) if (idx[j] == idx[e]) again = 1; } while (again); }
	float we[10]; for (int e = 0; e < NR; e++) we[e] = 0.05f + 0.1f * (float)(urand() % 100) / 100.f;
	CUdeviceptr dIDX, dWE; CK(cuMemAlloc(&dIDX, 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dWE, 64));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIDX, idx, 40)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dWE, we, 40));

	/* ---- gather: K = 2560, 640 rows per expert ---- */
	{
		int K = 2560, R = 640, st;
		uint8_t *tiles = malloc((size_t)NEXP * R * q2_0_tile_stride(K));
		for (int e = 0; e < NEXP; e++) { uint8_t *t = random_q2_tiles(R, K, &st); memcpy(tiles + (size_t)e * st * R, t, (size_t)st * R); free(t); }
		float *x = malloc(4 * K); for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 3.f * frand();
		int16_t *x16 = malloc(2 * K); int32_t *s32 = malloc(4 * K / 32); float *as = malloc(4 * K / 32); int8_t *xq = malloc(K);
		quant(x, K, x16, s32, as, xq);
		float *yref = malloc(4 * NR * R), *ygot = malloc(4 * NR * R);
		for (int e = 0; e < NR; e++) gemv_q2_0_ref(tiles + (size_t)idx[e] * st * R, R, K, xq, s32, as, yref + e * R);
		CUdeviceptr dW, dX, dS, dY, dAS;
		CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, (size_t)NEXP * st * R)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 2 * K)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, 4 * K / 32)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, 4 * NR * R)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dAS, 4 * K / 32));
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, tiles, (size_t)NEXP * st * R)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x16, 2 * K)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, s32, 4 * K / 32)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dAS, as, 4 * K / 32));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, NR * R));
		unsigned rows = R;
		void *params[] = { &dW, &dX, &dS, &dY, &rows, &xs, &dIDX, &dAS, &dWE };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fg, G, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ygot, dY, 4 * NR * R));
		fails += cmp("gather", yref, ygot, NR * R);
	}
	/* ---- down: K = 640, 2560 rows per expert, 10 activation vectors ---- */
	{
		int K = 640, R = 2560, st;
		uint8_t *tiles = malloc((size_t)NEXP * R * q2_0_tile_stride(K));
		for (int e = 0; e < NEXP; e++) { uint8_t *t = random_q2_tiles(R, K, &st); memcpy(tiles + (size_t)e * st * R, t, (size_t)st * R); free(t); }
		int16_t *x16 = malloc(2 * K * 11); int32_t *s32 = malloc(4 * K / 32 * 11); float *as = malloc(4 * K / 32 * 11); int8_t *xq = malloc(K * 11);
		for (int e = 0; e < 11; e++) { float x[640]; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = 2.f * frand(); quant(x, K, x16 + e * K, s32 + e * K / 32, as + e * K / 32, xq + e * K); }
		float *yref = malloc(4 * R), *ygot = malloc(4 * R), *p = malloc(4 * R);
		for (int e = 0; e < NR; e++) {
			gemv_q2_0_ref(tiles + (size_t)idx[e] * st * R, R, K, xq + e * K, s32 + e * K / 32, as + e * K / 32, p);
			for (int r = 0; r < R; r++) yref[r] = e ? fmaf(we[e], p[r], yref[r]) : we[0] * p[r];
		}
		CUdeviceptr dW, dX, dS, dY, dAS;
		CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, (size_t)NEXP * st * R)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 2 * K * 11)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, 4 * K / 32 * 11)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, 4 * R)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dAS, 4 * K / 32 * 11));
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, tiles, (size_t)NEXP * st * R)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x16, 2 * K * 11)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, s32, 4 * K / 32 * 11)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dAS, as, 4 * K / 32 * 11));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, R));
		unsigned rows = R;
		void *params[] = { &dW, &dX, &dS, &dY, &rows, &xs, &dIDX, &dAS, &dWE };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fd, G, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ygot, dY, 4 * R));
		fails += cmp("down", yref, ygot, R);
		/* ---- acc640: shared expert down on top: y = fma(s, dot_s, y) ---- */
		float s = 0.731f; CUdeviceptr dSC; CK(cuMemAlloc(&dSC, 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSC, &s, 4));
		gemv_q2_0_ref(tiles + (size_t)idx[0] * st * R, R, K, xq + 10 * K, s32 + 10 * K / 32, as + 10 * K / 32, p);
		for (int r = 0; r < R; r++) yref[r] = fmaf(s, p[r], yref[r]);
		CUdeviceptr dW0 = dW + (size_t)idx[0] * st * R, dX10 = dX + 2 * K * 10, dS10 = dS + 4 * K / 32 * 10, dAS10 = dAS + 4 * K / 32 * 10;
		void *params2[] = { &dW0, &dX10, &dS10, &dY, &rows, &xs, &dIDX, &dAS10, &dSC };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fa, G, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params2, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ygot, dY, 4 * R));
		fails += cmp("acc640", yref, ygot, R);
	}
	/* ---- bias: BF16 48 x 2560 + bias ---- */
	{
		int K = 2560, R = 48;
		uint16_t *w = malloc(2 * R * K); float *x = malloc(4 * K), bias[48], *yref = malloc(4 * R), *ygot = malloc(4 * R);
		for (int i = 0; i < R * K; i++) { float f = frand(); uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &f, 4); w[i] = (uint16_t)(u >> 16); }
		for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = frand();
		for (int r = 0; r < R; r++) bias[r] = 2.f * frand();
		gemv_bf16_ref(w, R, K, x, yref);
		for (int r = 0; r < R; r++) yref[r] = yref[r] + bias[r];
		CUdeviceptr dW, dX, dY, dB;
		CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, 2 * R * K)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * K)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, 4 * R)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dB, 4 * R));
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, w, 2 * R * K)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * K)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dB, bias, 4 * R)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, R));
		unsigned rows = R;
		void *params[] = { &dW, &dX, &dY, &rows, &dB };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fb, G, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ygot, dY, 4 * R));
		fails += cmp("bias", yref, ygot, R);
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/moesel.sass
# Kernel: moesel
#
# Expert selection for one die of the expert split: of the routed experts
# idx[10] / w[10] (every die holds the same router result), keep the ones this
# die owns (map[idx] != 0xffffffff, map = global expert id -> local tile index)
# in slot order: lidx[j] = map[idx[e]], lw[j] = w[e], *ne = count. Also zero-fills
# this die's partial sum (2560 floats), so a die with no routed expert still
# contributes zeros to the reduction. One warp.
#

File: kern/normq.sass
# Kernel: normq
#
# RMSNorm + per-32 activation quantiser for one 2560-element fp32 vector, one warp:
#   ss  = sum x_i^2 (one FFMA chain per lane in element order, SHFL butterfly)
#   m   = ss * (1/2560) ; v = m + eps
#   s   = sqrt_rn(v)   (ptxas fast path: MUFU.RSQ + one Newton step = IEEE sqrt)
#   r2  = rcp_rn(s)    (MUFU.RCP + one Newton step = IEEE 1/s)
#   y_i = (x_i * r2) * w_i                      -> Y (fp32)
#   then the actq per-32 quantiser on y: gmax = max(max |y|, 2^-100) per 32,
#   inv = rcp_rn(gmax) * 127, q = F2I.RN(y * inv), as = gmax / 127, per-16 /
#   per-32 sums                                 -> Q, S16, S32, AS
# Bit-exact twin: ref/quant.c rmsnorm_quant_gpu32. Lane l owns the 4-element
# chunks at 4 (l + 32 j); x (then y) and w stay in registers; the packed codes,
# the sums and the group maxima reuse the weight registers.
# Barriers: 1 = x loads, 2 = w loads and store reads, 3 = MUFU/F2I, 4 = y store
# reads, 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 X  1:0x148:8 W  2:0x150:8 Y  3:0x158:8 Q  4:0x160:8 S32
#         5:0x168:8 S16  6:0x170:8 AS  7:0x178:4 eps

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_Q0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_Q1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_S320 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_S321 : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_S160 : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_S161 : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_AS0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_AS1  : c[0x0][0x174]
    param_eps  : c[0x0][0x178]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-79 : x<00-79>
    80-159 : wt<00-79>
    80-119 : pk<00-39>
    120-139 : s16_<00-19>
    140-159 : g<00-19>
    160-179 : r<00-19>
    180-199 : tt<00-19>
    180-199 : s32_<00-19>
    200 : ss
    201 : mm
    202 : vv
    203 : s0
    204 : hh
    205 : rr
    206 : e

    209 : tid

    214,215 : xp<0-1>
    216,217 : wp<0-1>
    218,219 : yp<0-1>
    220,221 : qp<0-1>
    222,223 : hp<0-1>

</REGISTER_MAPPING>

    my $U = 20;

    my $round = sub {
        my ($f, $wait) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        for my $u (0..$U-1) {
            my $line = $f->($u);
            my $w = ($u == 0 && $wait) ? $wait : '--';

        return $x;

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P3, PT, t, RZ, PT;\n";
    # pointers
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x4;\n";

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, t, param_W0;\n";

    for my $j (0..$C-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 wt%02d, [wp+0x%x];\n", $j == $C-1 ? '2' : '1', 4*$j, 512*$j; }
    # ss = sum of squares, one chain in element order
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMUL ss, x00, x00;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, x%02d, x%02d, ss;\n", $_, $_ for 1..79;

    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL mm, ss, invn;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD vv, mm, eps;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RSQ rr, vv;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      FMUL.FTZ s0, vv, rr;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL.FTZ hh, rr, 0.5;\n";

File: kern/normq_test.c
/*
 * normq_test: the fused RMSNorm + quantiser kernel against rmsnorm_quant_gpu, bit
 * for bit (normalised vector, codes, sums, scale) on random inputs.
 */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 11;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(void) {
	int n = 2560;
	float eps = 1e-6f;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "normq.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "normq"));
	CUdeviceptr dX, dW, dY, dQ, dS32, dS16, dSC;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQ, 2 * n));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS32, 4 * n / 32 + 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS16, 4 * n / 16 + 64)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dSC, 4 * n / 32 + 64));
	float *x = malloc(4 * n), *w = malloc(4 * n), *y = malloc(4 * n), *yg = malloc(4 * n);
	int16_t *q = malloc(2 * n), *qg = malloc(2 * n);
	int32_t *s32 = malloc(4 * n / 32), *s16 = malloc(4 * n / 16), *s32g = malloc(4 * n / 32), *s16g = malloc(4 * n / 16);
	float *as = malloc(4 * n / 32), *asg = malloc(4 * n / 32);
	const float mags[] = { 1.f, 1e-3f, 37.5f, 1e4f, 0.f, 2.5f };
	int fails = 0;
	for (unsigned m = 0; m < sizeof mags / sizeof mags[0]; m++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { x[i] = mags[m] * frand() * (1.f + (i % 7) * 0.25f); w[i] = 1.f + 0.5f * frand(); }
		if (m == 5) x[n - 1] = 1e4f;
		rmsnorm_quant_gpu32(x, w, n, eps, y, q, s32, s16, as);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, w, 4 * n));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, n)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dQ, 0x7fff7fffu, n / 2));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dS32, 0x7fffffffu, n / 32)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dS16, 0x7fffffffu, n / 16)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dSC, 0x7fc00000u, n / 32));
		void *params[] = { &dX, &dW, &dY, &dQ, &dS32, &dS16, &dSC, &eps };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 1, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(yg, dY, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(qg, dQ, 2 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s32g, dS32, 4 * n / 32));
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(s16g, dS16, 4 * n / 16)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(asg, dSC, 4 * n / 32));
		int by = 0, bq = 0, b32 = 0, b16 = 0;

		for (int i = 0; i < n / 16; i++) if (s16[i] != s16g[i]) b16++;

		int bad = by || bq || b32 || b16 || bs;

		if (bad) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;

File: kern/nullengine.c
/* nullengine: a stand-in libengine.so that only exercises flashcore's plumbing (load, serve, reload,
 * fall back when a replacement fails to initialise). NULLENGINE_FAIL=1 makes engine_init fail;
 * NULLENGINE_TAG is printed so successive builds can be told apart. Commands: echo <text>, reload
 * [path], quit. */
#include "core.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static char rp[512];
int engine_init(core_t *c) {
	fprintf(stderr, "nullengine[%s]: init: %d dies, table at %p (compact %d, first words %02x %02x), context 0 %p\n", getenv("NULLENGINE_TAG") ? getenv("NULLENGINE_TAG") : "-",
	        c->nd, (void *)c->ple_host, c->ple_compact, c->ple_host[4095], c->ple_host[0], (void *)c->ctx[0]);
#ifdef FAILINIT
	return -1;
#else
	return getenv("NULLENGINE_FAIL") ? -1 : 0;
#endif
}
void engine_fini(void) { fprintf(stderr, "nullengine[%s]: fini\n", getenv("NULLENGINE_TAG") ? getenv("NULLENGINE_TAG") : "-"); }
const char *engine_reload_path(void) { return rp[0] ? rp : NULL; }
int engine_session(FILE *in, FILE *out) {
	char line[512];
	while (fgets(line, sizeof line, in)) {
		if (!strncmp(line, "quit", 4)) return 1;
		if (!strncmp(line, "fault", 5)) return 3;   /* pretend the engine hit a CUDA error */
		if (!strncmp(line, "reload", 6)) { rp[0] = 0; sscanf(line + 6, "%511s", rp); return 2; }
		if (!strncmp(line, "echo ", 5)) { fputs(line + 5, out); fflush(out); }
	}
	return 0;
}

/* Exercise flashd's actual token decoder and SSE writer with the published vocabulary. */
#define main flashd_program_main
#include "flashd.c"

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc != 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: output_tokens_test <shard1.gguf>\n"); return 2; }
    V = tok_load(argv[1]); if (!V) return 1;
    ID_THINK_END = (uint32_t)tok_find(V, "</think>");
    const char *expected = "<tool_call>{\"name\":\"ping\",\"arguments\":{}}</tool_call>";
    uint32_t ids[256]; int n = tok_encode(V, expected, strlen(expected), 0, ids, 256);
    int open = tok_find(V, "<tool_call>"), close_tag = tok_find(V, "</tool_call>");
    if (n < 1 || open != 248058 || close_tag != 248059 ||
        tok_is_hidden(V, (uint32_t)open) || tok_is_hidden(V, (uint32_t)close_tag) ||
        !tok_is_special(V, (uint32_t)open) || !tok_is_hidden(V, 248044) || !tok_is_hidden(V, 248046)) return 1;
    for (int stream = 0; stream <= 1; stream++) {
        int sv[2]; if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, sv)) return 1;
        gen g = {.fd = sv[0], .stream = stream};
        on_token(&g, 248044);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) on_token(&g, ids[i]);
        on_token(&g, 248046);
        if (!g.content.s || strcmp(g.content.s, expected) || g.gone || g.cap_hit) {
            fprintf(stderr, "stream=%d decoded: %s\n", stream, g.content.s ? g.content.s : "(empty)"); return 1;
        }
        shutdown(sv[0], SHUT_WR);
        char wire[16384]; size_t used = 0; ssize_t nr;
        while ((nr = read(sv[1], wire + used, sizeof wire - 1 - used)) > 0) used += (size_t)nr;
        wire[used] = 0;
        if (stream && (!strstr(wire, "<tool_call>") || !strstr(wire, "</tool_call>"))) return 1;
        close(sv[0]); close(sv[1]); sb_free(&g.content); sb_free(&g.reasoning);
        printf("PASS stream=%d: USER_DEFINED tool delimiters retained; CONTROL hidden\n", stream);
    }
    return 0;
}

        CK(cuMemsetD32(dy,sentinel,nout));launch(fn,dp,ctl,pair,1);CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(got,dy,4*nout));

        float x[N],a[H],bb[H];for(unsigned i=0;i<N;i++)x[i]=rnd()*(float)(k+1);
        for(unsigned i=0;i<H;i++){a[i]=rnd();bb[i]=rnd();}
        b[k]=(buffers){.x=upload(x,sizeof x),.u=alloc(4*N),.a=upload(a,sizeof a),.b=upload(bb,sizeof bb),
            .o=alloc(4*O),.q=alloc(2*O),.s32=alloc(4*O/32),.s16=alloc(4*O/16),.as=alloc(4*O/32),
            .am=alloc(8),.part=alloc(16*8),.cnt=alloc(4)};
        REGION("conv output",b[k].u,4*N);REGION("DeltaNet output",b[k].o,4*O);REGION("quant codes",b[k].q,2*O);
        REGION("sum32",b[k].s32,4*O/32);REGION("sum16",b[k].s16,4*O/16);REGION("quant scales",b[k].as,4*O/32);
        REGION("argmax",b[k].am,8);REGION("argmax counter",b[k].cnt,4);
    }
    prog_t p0,p1,pair,serial;prog_init(&p0);prog_init(&p1);prog_init(&pair);prog_init(&serial);
    program(&p0,&b[0],0,cs,ds,dCW,dSA);program(&p1,&b[1],1,cs,ds,dCW,dSA);
    if(prog_pair(&pair,&p0,&p1)){fputs("prog_pair rejected valid programs\n",stderr);return 2;}
    for(int k=0;k<2;k++){const prog_t*p=k?&p1:&p0;for(int i=0;i<p->n;i++)*prog_add(&serial,p->p[i].w[0],p->p[i].w[1])=p->p[i];}
    const unsigned starts[]={0,1,2,3,4,7,8,9,127,128,2047,2048};int fails=0;unsigned cases=sizeof starts/sizeof starts[0];
    void*got=malloc(dn>cn?dn:cn);
    for(unsigned c=0;c<cases;c++){
        unsigned start=starts[c];int bad=0;
        for(int paired=0;paired<2;paired++){
            CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(cs,cinit,cn));CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(ds,dinit,dn));
            for(int i=2;i<nr;i++)CK(cuMemsetD8(r[i].p,0xa5,r[i].n));
            for(int k=0;k<2;k++){CK(cuMemsetD8(b[k].part,0,16*8));CK(cuMemsetD32(b[k].cnt,0,1));}
            bad+=launch(fn,ctl,paired?&pair:&serial,start,paired?4u:8u);
            for(int i=0;i<nr;i++){
                if(!paired)CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(r[i].ref,r[i].p,r[i].n));
                else{CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(got,r[i].p,r[i].n));if(memcmp(got,r[i].ref,r[i].n)){fprintf(stderr,"start%u region%d %s mismatch\n",start,i,r[i].name);bad++;}}
            }
            for(int k=0;k<2;k++){
                float oo[O];unsigned am[2],cnt;CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(oo,b[k].o,sizeof oo));CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(am,b[k].am,8));CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(&cnt,b[k].cnt,4));
                unsigned best=0;for(unsigned i=1;i<O;i++)if(oo[i]>oo[best])best=i;
                if(cnt||am[0]!=best||memcmp(&am[1],&oo[best],4)){fprintf(stderr,"argmax start%u pos%d invalid\n",start,k);bad++;}
            }
        }
        printf("start=%u positions=%u,%u state/outputs=%s scalar_barriers=8 pair_barriers=4\n",start,start,start+1,bad?"FAIL":"BIT-EXACT");fails+=bad;
    }
    printf("pair_state_test: %u cases, %d failures\n",cases,fails);
    prog_free(&p0);prog_free(&p1);prog_free(&pair);prog_free(&serial);
    for(int i=0;i<nr;i++)free(r[i].ref);
    free(cinit);free(dinit);free(cw);free(got);
    CK(cuCtxDestroy(ctx));return fails?1:0;
}


File: kern/ple_eos_test.c
/* The published PLE metadata resets at endoftext, not the chat turn terminator. */
#include "ple.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
int main(void) {
    const uint32_t eos = PLE_EOS_TOKEN, ids[] = {42, 248046, 198};
    uint64_t got[16], reset[16], pad[16];
    ple_rows(ids, 2, eos, &eos, 1, got);
    /* Independent unsigned-64 XOR/modulo witness for [198, 248046, 42]. */
    if (got[0] != 510813 || got[8] != 165588995) {
        fprintf(stderr, "chat-turn history lost: rows %llu/%llu, expected 510813/165588995\n",
                (unsigned long long)got[0], (unsigned long long)got[8]); return 1;
    }
    const uint32_t at_end[] = {42, 248044, 198}, absent[] = {248044, 248044, 198};
    ple_rows(at_end, 2, eos, &eos, 1, reset);
    ple_rows(absent, 2, eos, &eos, 1, pad);
    if (memcmp(reset, pad, sizeof reset)) { fputs("PLE EOS did not reset the window\n", stderr); return 1; }
    if (!memcmp(got, reset, sizeof got)) { fputs("turn and PLE EOS were conflated\n", stderr); return 1; }
    puts("PASS: im_end preserves history; PLE endoftext resets all 16 heads");
    return 0;
}


File: kern/pleconv.sass
# Kernel: pleconv
#
# PLE dilated causal conv (kernel 4, dilation 3) + SiLU + residual + stream add,
# over n = 10240 channels, 4 channels per thread, 256 threads per CTA, grid 10.
# X is the conv input at position t (RMS-normed G x ple_norm_conv); the ring
# STATE[10][n] keeps the last inputs (slot p mod 10 holds x(p)); W is F16 [n][4],
# tap k contiguous (ple_conv1d.weight):
#   y = w0 * x(t-9); y = fma(w1, x(t-6), y); y = fma(w2, x(t-3), y); y = fma(w3, x(t), y)
#   (x of a position before 0 is 0)
#   S[c] = S[c] + (G[c] + SiLU(y));  then x(t) -> STATE[t mod 10]
# Bit-exact twin: ple_conv_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 X  1:0x148 STATE  2:0x150 W  3:0x158 G  4:0x160 S  5:0x168 t (u32)

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0 : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1 : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_ST0 : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_ST1 : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_W0 : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_W1 : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_G0 : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_G1 : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_S0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_S1 : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_t  : c[0x0][0x168]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-3   : x<0-3>
    4-7   : a<0-3>
    8-11  : b<0-3>
    12-15 : d<0-3>
    16-23 : wh<0-7>
    24-39 : w<00-15>
    40-43 : y<0-3>
    44-47 : g<0-3>
    48-51 : s<0-3>

    59    : ln2lo

    84,85 : s1p<0-1>

    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
    my $n = 10240;
    my $o = '';
    # slot(p) = p mod 10 by repeated subtraction of 10 * 2^k (p < 2^32): 32 steps of
    # IMNMX.U32, branch free, exact.
    my $mod10 = sub {
        my ($dst, $src) = @_;
        my $x = sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      MOV %s, %s;\n", $dst, $src;
        for my $k (reverse 0..28) {       # 10 << 28 < 2^32; larger shifts overflow
            my $sub = 10 << $k;
            if ($sub > 0x7ffff) {       # immediates are sign-magnitude: 19-bit magnitude
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I u2, 0x%x;\n", $sub;
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, %s, -u2;\n", $dst;
            } else {
                $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD u1, %s, -0x%x;\n", $dst, $sub;
            }
            $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 %s, %s, u1, PT;\n", $dst, $dst;
        }
        return $x;
    };
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R cta, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV pos, param_t;\n";
    # channel offset c0 = 1024 cta + 4 tid -> bytes 16 (256 cta + tid)
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      SHL t, cta, 0x8;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, t, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, t, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD gp0.CC, t, param_G0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X gp1, RZ, param_G1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD sp0.CC, t, param_S0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X sp1, RZ, param_S1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, t, 0x1;\n";                           # weights: 4 channels x 4 taps x 2 B = 32 B per thread
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, t2, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 x0, [xp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 g0, [gp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 s0, [sp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 wh0, [wp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.128 wh4, [wp+0x10];\n";
    # ring slots for positions t-9, t-6, t-3 (read) and t (write): base + 40960 slot + t
    my @slots = (['s0p', 9, 'P0'], ['s1p', 6, 'P1'], ['s2p', 3, 'P2'], ['swp', 0, 'P3']);
    for my $sl (@slots) {
        my ($p, $back, $pred) = @$sl;
        # no "-0x0": MaxAs assembles it as -0x80000 (negative zero)
        $o .= $back ? sprintf("--:-:-:-:6      IADD t2, pos, -0x%x;\n", $back) : "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t2, pos;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND %s, PT, pos, 0x%x, PT;\n", $pred, $back;
        $o .= $mod10->('slot', 't2');
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t2, slot, 0xf;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t3, slot, 0xd;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t2, t2, t3;\n";
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t2, t2, t;\n";
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s0.CC, t2, param_ST0;\n", $p;
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s1, RZ, param_ST1;\n", $p;
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV a0, RZ;\n" ; $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV a%d, RZ;\n", $_ for 1..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV b%d, RZ;\n", $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      MOV d%d, RZ;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1  \@P0 LDG.E.128 a0, [s0p];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1  \@P1 LDG.E.128 b0, [s1p];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:2  \@P2 LDG.E.128 d0, [s2p];\n";
    # weights: wh holds 16 halfwords: channel i taps 0..3 at halfwords 4i..4i+3
    for my $i (0..3) {
        for my $k (0..3) {
            my $hw = 4 * $i + $k;
            my $src = sprintf "wh%d", $hw >> 1;
            if ($hw & 1) { $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      F2F.F32.F16 w%02d, %s.H1;\n", ($i == 0 && $k == 1) ? '--' : '--', $hw, $src; }
            else         { $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      F2F.F32.F16 w%02d, %s;\n", ($i == 0 && $k == 0) ? '01' : '--', $hw, $src; }
        }
    }
    # y = w0 x(t-9); fma w1 x(t-6); fma w2 x(t-3); fma w3 x(t)
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMUL y%d, w%02d, a%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '02' : '--', $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, 4 * $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FFMA y%d, w%02d, b%d, y%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, 4 * $_ + 1, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FFMA y%d, w%02d, d%d, y%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, 4 * $_ + 2, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FFMA y%d, w%02d, x%d, y%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, 4 * $_ + 3, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    # x(t) -> its slot (x registers stay intact)
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [swp], x0;\n";
    for my $k (0..3) { $o .= fm_silu("a$k", "y$k", 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', 'ft5', \%C); }
    # S += G + u
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD g%d, g%d, a%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      FADD s%d, s%d, g%d;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_, $_ for 0..3;
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:6      STG.E.128 [sp], s0;\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/pleconv_test.c
/* pleconv_test: PLE dilated conv + SiLU + residual + stream add over a sequence of
 * positions (ring state carried on the device) against ple_conv_gpu, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "ple.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 31;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }
static uint16_t f2h(float f) {       /* round-to-nearest fp16 for test weights (normal range only) */
	uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &f, 4);
	uint32_t s = (u >> 16) & 0x8000; int e = (int)((u >> 23) & 0xff) - 127 + 15; uint32_t m = u & 0x7fffff;
	if (e <= 0) return (uint16_t)s;
	uint32_t r = (m >> 13) + ((m >> 12) & 1);
	return (uint16_t)(s | (((uint32_t)e << 10) + r));
}

int main(void) {
	const int n = 10240, T = 14;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "pleconv.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "pleconv"));
	float *x = malloc(4 * n), *g = malloc(4 * n), *s = malloc(4 * n), *sg = malloc(4 * n), *w = malloc(4 * n * 4);
	uint16_t *wh = malloc(2 * n * 4);
	float (*state)[10240] = calloc(10, 4 * n);
	for (int i = 0; i < 4 * n; i++) { float f = 0.5f * frand(); wh[i] = f2h(f); w[i] = fp16_to_fp32(wh[i]); }
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[i] = 2.f * frand();
	CUdeviceptr dX, dST, dW, dG, dS;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dST, 10 * 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, 2 * n * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dG, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dS, 4 * n));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dST, 0x7fc00000u, 10 * n));       /* unread slots may hold anything */
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, wh, 2 * n * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dS, s, 4 * n));
	int fails = 0;
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < (unsigned)T; t++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { x[i] = 3.f * frand(); g[i] = frand(); }
		ple_conv_gpu(x, state, w, t, g, s);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dG, g, 4 * n));
		void *params[] = { &dX, &dST, &dW, &dG, &dS, &t };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, n / 1024, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(sg, dS, 4 * n));
		{ static float ring[10][10240]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ring, dST, 10 * 4 * n)); int bs = 0, nanslots = 0;
		  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&ring[t % 10][i], &x[i], 4)) bs++;
		  for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) if (ring[k][0] != ring[k][0]) nanslots |= 1 << k;
		  printf("  ring slot %u: %d of %d differ from x(t); NaN slots mask 0x%03x\n", t % 10, bs, n, nanslots); }
		int bad = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&s[i], &sg[i], 4)) { if (bad < 3) printf("  t %u S[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", t, i, sg[i], s[i]); bad++; }
		printf("t=%2u: %s (%d of %d differ)\n", t, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, n);
		if (bad) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}

# Kernel: plegate
#
# PLE per-lane gate and value broadcast. Grid = 4 CTAs (lane l) x 256 threads:
#   s_l  = sum_c KN[l][c] QN[l][c]     (thread t: c = t + 256 k, k = 0..9, FMUL then
#          fmaf chain; xor 16..1 warp butterfly; the 8 warp sums added in order)
#   s'   = s_l * (1/sqrt(2560)); mag = max(|s'|, 1e-6); root = sqrt_rn(mag)
#   sign = (s' > 0) - (0 > s'); gate_l = sigmoid(sign * root)
#   G[l][c] = gate_l * V[c]
# Bit-exact twin: ple_gate_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140 KN (10240)  1:0x148 QN (10240)  2:0x150 V (2560)  3:0x158 G (10240)  4:0x160 GATES (4)

    param_V1  : c[0x0][0x154]
