    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 chalf cone mneg1);
    my $rsc = unpack 'L', pack 'f', 1 / sqrt(2560);
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R l, SR_CTAID.X;\n";
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I rsc, 0x%08x;\n", $rsc;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I eps6, 0x358637bd;\n";                 # 1e-6
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 warp, tid, 0x5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P4, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.AND P5, PT, tid, RZ, PT;\n";
    # kp = KN + 4 (2560 l + tid), qp likewise, gp = G + same, vp = V + 4 tid, op = GATES + 4 l
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t, l, 0xa00, RZ;\n";                    # 2560 l
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, t, tid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, t, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD kp0.CC, t, param_KN0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X kp1, RZ, param_KN1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD qp0.CC, t, param_QN0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X qp1, RZ, param_QN1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD gp0.CC, t, param_G0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X gp1, RZ, param_G1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, tid, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD vp0.CC, t, param_V0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X vp1, RZ, param_V1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, l, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD op0.CC, t, param_GT0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X op1, RZ, param_GT1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E a%d, [kp+0x%x];\n", $_, 1024 * $_ for 0..9;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%d      LDG.E b%d, [qp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 9 ? 2 : 1, $_, 1024 * $_ for 0..9;
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMUL s, a0, b0;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA s, a%d, b%d, s;\n", $_, $_ for 1..9;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:2      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, s, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD s, s, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, warp, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P4 STS [t], s;\n";
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      BAR.SYNC 0x0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:1      LDS.128 r0, [RZ];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDS.128 r4, [RZ+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      FADD s, r0, r1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD s, s, r%d;\n", $_ for 2..7;
    # gate
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL s, s, rsc;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FSETP.GT.AND P0, PT, s, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FSETP.GT.AND P1, PT, RZ, s, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mag, s, -s, !PT;\n";                   # |s|
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mag, mag, eps6, !PT;\n";               # max(|s|, 1e-6)
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RSQ rr, mag;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      FMUL.FTZ s0, mag, rr;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL.FTZ hh, rr, 0.5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ ee, -s0, -RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA ee, s0, ee, mag;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA root, ee, hh, s0;\n";                   # sqrt_rn(mag)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV sgn, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 MOV sgn, cone;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P1 MOV sgn, mneg1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL root, sgn, root;\n";                    # sign * root
    $o .= fm_sigmoid('gate', 'root', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', 'ft4', \%C);
    $o .= "--:1:-:-:6  \@P5 STG.E [op], gate;\n";
    # G = gate * V
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%d      LDG.E a%d, [vp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 9 ? 2 : 1, $_, 1024 * $_ for 0..9;
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMUL a%d, gate, a%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_ == 9 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..9;
    $o .= sprintf "--:1:-:-:%d      STG.E [gp+0x%x], a%d;\n", $_ == 9 ? 6 : 1, 1024 * $_, $_ for 0..9;
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/plegate_test.c
/* plegate_test: the PLE lane gate + value broadcast against ple_gate_gpu, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "ple.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 29;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(void) {
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, "plegate.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "plegate"));
	float *kn = malloc(10240 * 4), *qn = malloc(10240 * 4), *v = malloc(2560 * 4), *g = malloc(10240 * 4), *gg = malloc(10240 * 4), gates[4], gatesg[4];
	CUdeviceptr dKN, dQN, dV, dG, dGT;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dKN, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dQN, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dV, 2560 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dG, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dGT, 16));
	int fails = 0;
	for (int trial = 0; trial < 4; trial++) {
		float sc = trial == 1 ? 1e-4f : trial == 2 ? 40.f : 1.f;
		for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) { kn[i] = sc * frand(); qn[i] = frand(); }
		for (int i = 0; i < 2560; i++) v[i] = 3.f * frand();
		if (trial == 3) for (int i = 0; i < 2560; i++) qn[2 * 2560 + i] = 0.f;      /* lane 2: s = 0 -> gate 0.5 */
		ple_gate_gpu(kn, qn, v, g, gates);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKN, kn, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQN, qn, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dV, v, 2560 * 4));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dG, 0x7fc00000u, 10240)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dGT, 0x7fc00000u, 4));
		void *params[] = { &dKN, &dQN, &dV, &dG, &dGT };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 4, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(gg, dG, 10240 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(gatesg, dGT, 16));
		int bg = 0, bt = 0;
		for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) if (memcmp(&gates[l], &gatesg[l], 4)) { printf("  gate[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", l, gatesg[l], gates[l]); bt++; }
		for (int i = 0; i < 10240; i++) if (memcmp(&g[i], &gg[i], 4)) { if (bg < 3) printf("  g[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, gg[i], g[i]); bg++; }
		printf("trial %d: gates %s, G %s (%d of 10240 differ); gates = %g %g %g %g\n", trial, bt ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bg ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bg, gates[0], gates[1], gates[2], gates[3]);
		if (bg || bt) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/plerows.sass
# Kernel: plerows
#
# PLE (n-gram) row lookup for one token: one warp, lane h < 16 = head h.
#   context c_b = ids[pos - b] for b = 0..2, or `absent` when pos < b or an end id
#   lies in ids[pos-b, pos); mixed = c0 m0 ^ c1 m1 (heads 0-7) ^ c2 m2 (heads 8-15),
#   64-bit wrapping (16x16-bit XMAD partials added with carries); row_h = off[h] +
#   mixed mod voc[h] (64-step restoring division, branch free via IMNMX.U32); the
#   90-byte IQ4_NL row (5 blocks: fp16 d + 16 nibble bytes) is read from the
#   host-mapped table and decoded, y = d * kvalues[nibble], into G[160 h + j].
# Bit-exact twin: ple_rows_c + dequant(GG_IQ4_NL).
#
# Params: 0:0x140 IDS (u32 tokens)  1:0x148 PC  2:0x150 TAB (host-mapped)  3:0x158 G (2560 f32)
#         4:0x160 ROWS (u32[16], debug)  5:0x168 pos (u32)
# PC layout: u64 mult[3] @0, u32 off[16] @24, u32 voc[16] @88, u32 absent @152, u32 end @156

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_IDS0  : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_IDS1  : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_PC0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_PC1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_TAB0  : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_TAB1  : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_G0    : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_G1    : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_ROWS0 : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_ROWS1 : c[0x0][0x164]
    param_pos   : c[0x0][0x168]
    param_cmp   : c[0x0][0x16c]
    param_RDY0  : c[0x0][0x170]
    param_RDY1  : c[0x0][0x174]
    param_rid   : c[0x0][0x178]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0     : h
    1     : pos
    2     : id0
    3     : id1
    4     : id2
    5     : c0
    6     : c1
    7     : c2
    8,9   : m0<0-1>
    10,11 : m1<0-1>
    12,13 : m2<0-1>
    14,15 : acc<0-1>
    16,17 : pl<0-1>
    18-24 : p<0-6>
    25    : t
    26    : t2
    27    : t3
    28    : v
    29    : off
    30    : rem
    31    : rem2
    32    : word
    33    : absent
    34    : endid
    36,37 : ip<0-1>
    38,39 : pp<0-1>
    40,41 : tp<0-1>
    42,43 : gp<0-1>
    44,45 : rp<0-1>
    48-92 : hw<00-44>
    93    : d
    96-99 : y<0-3>
    100-103 : q<0-3>
    104-107 : k<0-3>
</REGISTER_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $o = '';
    my @kv = (-127, -104, -83, -65, -49, -35, -22, -10, 1, 13, 25, 38, 53, 69, 89, 113);
    # 64-bit product (lo, hi) = a (32-bit) * (mlo, mhi), mod 2^64
    my $mul64 = sub {
        my ($a, $mlo, $mhi, $lo, $hi) = @_;
        my $x = '';
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD %s, %s, %s, RZ;\n", $lo, $a, $mlo;            # aL m0
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD p1, %s, %s.H1, RZ;\n", $a, $mlo;              # aL m1
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD p2, %s.H1, %s, RZ;\n", $a, $mlo;              # aH m0
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD %s, %s, %s, RZ;\n", $hi, $a, $mhi;            # aL m2
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD p4, %s.H1, %s.H1, RZ;\n", $a, $mlo;           # aH m1
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD p5, %s, %s.H1, RZ;\n", $a, $mhi;              # aL m3
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD p6, %s.H1, %s, RZ;\n", $a, $mhi;              # aH m2
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHL p0, p1, 0x10;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHR.U32 p1, p1, 0x10;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHL p3, p2, 0x10;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 p2, p2, 0x10;\n";
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s.CC, %s, p0;\n", $lo, $lo;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s, %s, p1;\n", $hi, $hi;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s.CC, %s, p3;\n", $lo, $lo;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X %s, %s, p2;\n", $hi, $hi;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, p4;\n", $hi, $hi;
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHL p5, p5, 0x10;\n";
        $x .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL p6, p6, 0x10;\n";
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, p5;\n", $hi, $hi;
        $x .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD %s, %s, p6;\n", $hi, $hi;
        return $x;
    };
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R h, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV pos, param_pos;\n";
    # lanes 16..31 mirror heads 0..15 (same rows, same stores) instead of leaving early:
    # a branch that splits the warp never reconverges inside the persistent kernel
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND h, h, 0xf;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV pp0, param_PC0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV pp1, param_PC1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P1, PT, pos, 0x1, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P2, PT, pos, 0x2, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P5, PT, h, 0x8, PT;\n";                   # order-3 heads
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, h, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD rp0.CC, pp0, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X rp1, pp1, RZ;\n";
    # constants
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.64 m00, [pp];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.64 m10, [pp+0x8];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.64 m20, [pp+0x10];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E off, [rp+0x18];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E v, [rp+0x58];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E absent, [pp+0x98];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E endid, [pp+0x9c];\n";
    # ids[pos-2 .. pos]
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD t, pos, -0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, t, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR t2, t, 0x1f;\n";                                       # sign word of the (possibly negative) offset
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ip0.CC, t, param_IDS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ip1, t2, param_IDS1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1      LDG.E id0, [ip+0x8];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:1  \@P1 LDG.E id1, [ip+0x4];\n";
    $o .= "--:-:1:-:2  \@P2 LDG.E id2, [ip];\n";
    # kvalues as floats into smem (every lane writes the same 16 words)
    for my $k (0..15) {
        my $f = unpack 'L', pack 'f', $kv[$k];
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I t, 0x%08x;\n", $f;            # 6 cycles before the STS reads it
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      STS [RZ+0x%x], t;\n", 4 * $k;
    }
    # contexts
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      MOV c0, id0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P3, PT, id1, endid, P1;\n";                   # id1 present, not an end
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P4, PT, id2, endid, P2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.AND P4, PT, id1, endid, P4;\n";                   # and id1 not an end
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SEL c1, id1, absent, P3;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SEL c2, id2, absent, P4;\n";
    # mixed
    $o .= $mul64->('c0', 'm00', 'm01', 'acc0', 'acc1');
    $o .= $mul64->('c1', 'm10', 'm11', 'pl0', 'pl1');
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.XOR acc0, acc0, pl0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.XOR acc1, acc1, pl1;\n";
    $o .= $mul64->('c2', 'm20', 'm21', 'pl0', 'pl1');
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P5 LOP.XOR acc0, acc0, pl0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P5 LOP.XOR acc1, acc1, pl1;\n";
    # rem = mixed mod v, one bit at a time from the top
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV rem, RZ;\n";
    for my $w ('acc1', 'acc0') {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      MOV word, %s;\n", $w;
        for my $b (0..31) {
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 t, word, 0x1f;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL word, word, 0x1;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD rem, rem, t, 0x1;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD rem2, rem, -v;\n";
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 rem, rem, rem2, PT;\n";
        }
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD off, off, rem;\n";                                    # row
    # compact mode (param_cmp != 0): the host staged the 16 rows of every position at
    # TAB + 90 (16 pos + h) (teacher-forced runs with the real table, which CUDA 11.4
    # cannot pin from a file mapping); the hash above still runs and lands in ROWS
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t, param_cmp;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P6, PT, t, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISCADD rem2, pos, h, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 2;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P6 MOV off, rem2;\n";
    # ROWS[h] = row (debug / host check)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, h, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD rp0.CC, t, param_ROWS0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X rp1, RZ, param_ROWS1;\n";
    $o .= "--:2:-:-:1      STG.E [rp], off;\n";
    if ($ENV{PLE_NOGATHER}) { $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n"; return $o; }
    # the host stager (param_rid != 0, FLASH_PLE_DISK): wait until it has staged the rows of this position, RDY[pos] == rid. LDG.CV: the flag is written by the CPU and a cached
    # line would be stale. rid is never 0 and is a new value for every response, so the flags need no reset. Every lane polls the same word.
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV t3, param_rid;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P0, PT, t3, RZ, PT;\n";                    # P0: a stager is running
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, pos, 0x2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD ip0.CC, t, param_RDY0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X ip1, RZ, param_RDY1;\n";
    $o .= "\nWAITRDY:\n";
    $o .= "--:-:5:-:2  \@P0 LDG.E.CV t2, [ip];\n";
    $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      ISETP.NE.U32.AND P3, PT, t2, t3, P0;\n";                   # P3: a stager is running and the flag is not there yet
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      NOP;\n" x 3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P3 BRA WAITRDY;\n";
    # tp = TAB + 90 row (64-bit)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      XMAD p0, off, 0x5a, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD p1, off.H1, 0x5a, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      SHL p2, p1, 0x10;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHR.U32 p1, p1, 0x10;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD p0.CC, p0, p2;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X p1, p1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD tp0.CC, p0, param_TAB0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X tp1, p1, param_TAB1;\n";
    # the 45 halfwords of the row
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:3:-:%d      LDG.E.U16 hw%02d, [tp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 44 ? 2 : 1, $_, 2 * $_ for 0..44;
    # G + 640 h
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD t, h, 0x280, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD gp0.CC, t, param_G0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X gp1, RZ, param_G1;\n";
    # decode: block b: d = hw[9b]; bytes from hw[9b+1..9b+8]
    for my $b (0..4) {
        $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      F2F.F32.F16 d, hw%02d;\n", $b == 0 ? '04' : '--', 9 * $b;
        for my $k (0..3) {
            my ($ha, $hb) = (sprintf("hw%02d", 9 * $b + 1 + 2 * $k), sprintf("hw%02d", 9 * $b + 2 + 2 * $k));
            for my $half (0, 1) {           # 0: low nibbles (values 4k..), 1: high nibbles (values 16 + 4k..)
                my $s = $half ? 4 : 0;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      BFE.U32 q0, %s, 0x%x;\n", $ha, 0x400 + $s;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      BFE.U32 q1, %s, 0x%x;\n", $ha, 0x408 + $s;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      BFE.U32 q2, %s, 0x%x;\n", $hb, 0x400 + $s;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      BFE.U32 q3, %s, 0x%x;\n", $hb, 0x408 + $s;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%d      SHL q%d, q%d, 0x2;\n", $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..3;
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:4:-:%d      LDS k%d, [q%d];\n", $_ == 3 ? 2 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..3;
                $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%d      FMUL y%d, d, k%d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '08' : '--', $_ == 3 ? 6 : 1, $_, $_ for 0..3;
                $o .= sprintf "--:2:-:-:6      STG.E.128 [gp+0x%x], y0;\n", 4 * (32 * $b + 16 * $half + 4 * $k);
            }
        }
    }
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>


File: kern/plerows_test.c
/* plerows_test: n-gram row hash + host-mapped IQ4_NL row gather against
 * ple_rows_c + dequant, bit for bit, on a small random table (the real head
 * offsets/vocabularies are scaled down; the multipliers are the model's). */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "ple.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 11;
static uint32_t urand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return rs >> 8; }

int main(void) {
	const size_t R = 1u << 20;                   /* rows in the fake table */
	const uint32_t absent = PLE_EOS_TOKEN, endid = getenv("PLE_DISTINCT_IDS") ? 248046u : PLE_EOS_TOKEN;
	uint64_t off[16], voc[16];
	for (int h = 0; h < 16; h++) { off[h] = (uint64_t)h * 65000; voc[h] = 60000 + 13 * h; }
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN | CU_CTX_MAP_HOST, dev));
	int ng = getenv("PLE_NOGATHER") != NULL;
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, ng ? "plerows_ng.cubin" : "plerows.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "plerows"));
	/* the table in host-mapped memory, read by the GPU over PCIe */
	uint8_t *tab; CUdeviceptr dTAB;
	CK(cuMemHostAlloc((void **)&tab, R * 90, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP));
	CK(cuMemHostGetDevicePointer(&dTAB, tab, 0));
	for (size_t i = 0; i < R * 90; i++) tab[i] = (uint8_t)urand();
	for (size_t r = 0; r < R; r++) for (int b = 0; b < 5; b++) { uint16_t hd = (uint16_t)(0x2c00 + (urand() % 0x1000)); memcpy(tab + r * 90 + 18 * b, &hd, 2); }
	/* constants block */
	uint8_t pc[160]; memset(pc, 0, sizeof pc);
	memcpy(pc, ple_multipliers, 24);
	for (int h = 0; h < 16; h++) { uint32_t o32 = (uint32_t)off[h], v32 = (uint32_t)voc[h]; memcpy(pc + 24 + 4 * h, &o32, 4); memcpy(pc + 88 + 4 * h, &v32, 4); }
	memcpy(pc + 152, &absent, 4); memcpy(pc + 156, &endid, 4);
	/* a token sequence with ends planted */
	const int T = 40;
	uint32_t ids[40];
	for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) ids[i] = urand() % 248320;
	ids[0] = 42; ids[1] = 248046; ids[2] = 198;
	ids[10] = endid; ids[20] = endid; ids[21] = endid; ids[30] = absent;
	CUdeviceptr dIDS, dPC, dG, dROWS;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dIDS, 4 * T)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPC, 160)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dG, 2560 * 4)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dROWS, 64));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIDS, ids, 4 * T)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPC, pc, 160));
	float *gref = malloc(2560 * 4), *ggot = malloc(2560 * 4);
	uint32_t rowsg[16];
	uint64_t rows[16];
	int fails = 0;
	const unsigned poss[] = { 0, 1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 20, 21, 22, 23, 30, 31, 39 };
	for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof poss / sizeof poss[0]; k++) {
		unsigned pos = poss[k];
		ple_rows_c(ids, pos, absent, &endid, 1, ple_multipliers, off, voc, rows);
		for (int h = 0; h < 16; h++) dequant(GG_IQ4_NL, tab + rows[h] * 90, gref + 160 * h, 160);
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dG, 0x7fc00000u, 2560)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dROWS, 0xffffffffu, 16));
		void *params[] = { &dIDS, &dPC, &dTAB, &dG, &dROWS, &pos };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 1, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ggot, dG, 2560 * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(rowsg, dROWS, 64));
		int br = 0, bg = 0;
		for (int h = 0; h < 16; h++) if (rowsg[h] != rows[h]) { if (br < 3) printf("  pos %u head %d: row gpu %u ref %llu\n", pos, h, rowsg[h], (unsigned long long)rows[h]); br++; }
		for (int i = 0; i < (ng ? 0 : 2560); i++) if (memcmp(&gref[i], &ggot[i], 4)) { if (bg < 3) printf("  pos %u g[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", pos, i, ggot[i], gref[i]); bg++; }
		printf("pos %2u: rows %s (%d differ), g %s (%d of 2560 differ)\n", pos, br ? "MISMATCH" : "OK", br, bg ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bg);
		if (br || bg) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/prog.c
#include "prog.h"
#include "split.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <limits.h>

void prog_init(prog_t *P) { P->cap = 64; P->n = 0; P->xj = 0; P->loop = 0; P->token_offset = 0; P->pending_wait = 0; P->stop[0] = P->stop[1] = 0xffffffffu; P->end = 0; P->samp_k = 0; P->samp_topp = 1.0f; P->samp_invT = 1.0f; P->p = malloc(sizeof(phase_t) * P->cap); }
void prog_free(prog_t *P) { free(P->p); P->p = NULL; P->n = P->cap = 0; }
int prog_pair(prog_t *out, const prog_t *a, const prog_t *b) {
    /* Validate before changing out. Parameters name separate activations and
       consecutive causal positions; logical exchanges are published once. */
    if (!out || !a || !b || out == a || out == b || a->n <= 0 || a->n != b->n ||
        a->n > INT_MAX / 2 || !a->p || !b->p || a->xj != b->xj ||
        a->loop != b->loop || a->pending_wait != b->pending_wait ||
        a->stop[0] != b->stop[0] || a->stop[1] != b->stop[1] || a->end != b->end ||
        a->samp_k != b->samp_k || a->samp_topp != b->samp_topp ||
        a->samp_invT != b->samp_invT ||
        (a->loop && (a->token_offset == UINT32_MAX || b->token_offset != a->token_offset + 1u)))
        return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < a->n; i++) {
        const phase_t *x = &a->p[i], *y = &b->p[i];
        if (x->w[0] != y->w[0] || x->w[1] != y->w[1] || x->w[30] != y->w[30] ||
            (x->w[30] & 24u)) return -1;
    }
    size_t n = (size_t)a->n * 2u;
    if (n > SIZE_MAX / sizeof(phase_t)) return -2;
    phase_t *p = malloc(n * sizeof *p);
    if (!p) return -2;
    for (int i = 0; i < a->n; i++) {
        p[2*i] = a->p[i]; p[2*i+1] = b->p[i];
        p[2*i].w[30] |= 8u;
    }
    free(out->p);
    *out = *a;
    out->p = p; out->n = out->cap = (int)n;
    return 0;
}
static uint64_t desc_ptr(const phase_t *p, int word) {
    return p->w[word] | ((uint64_t)p->w[word + 1] << 32);
}
static int overlaps(uint64_t a, uint64_t an, uint64_t b, uint64_t bn) {
    return an && bn && (a <= b ? b - a < an : a - b < bn);
}
int prog_pair_fuse_bf16(prog_t *P, int disjoint_xout) {
    int fused = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i + 1 < P->n; i++) {
        phase_t *a = &P->p[i], *b = a + 1;
        if ((a->w[30] & 24u) != 8u) continue;
        i++;
        if (a->w[0] != b->w[0] || a->w[1] != b->w[1] ||
            desc_ptr(a, 2) != desc_ptr(b, 2) || a->w[8] != b->w[8] ||
            a->w[31] || b->w[31]) continue;
        int op, k = 2560, slices = 1, bias = 0, xout = 0;
        switch (a->w[0]) {
        case OP_BF16BIAS: op = OP_BF16BIASP; bias = 1; break;
        case OP_BF16K2560: op = OP_BF16K2560P; break;
        case OP_BF16K320: op = OP_BF16K320P; k = 320; break;
        case OP_BF16HC: op = OP_BF16HCP; slices = 4; break;
        case OP_BF16HCX: op = OP_BF16HCXP; slices = 4; xout = 1; break;
        default: continue;
        }
        if (xout && !disjoint_xout) continue;
        if (!xout) {
            uint64_t yn = 4ull * a->w[8], xn = 4ull * k * slices;
            uint64_t wn = 2ull * k * slices * a->w[8];
            uint64_t y[2] = { desc_ptr(a, 6), desc_ptr(b, 6) };
            int alias = overlaps(y[0], yn, y[1], yn);
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                alias |= overlaps(y[j], yn, desc_ptr(a, 2), wn);
                alias |= overlaps(y[j], yn, desc_ptr(a, 4), xn);
                alias |= overlaps(y[j], yn, desc_ptr(b, 4), xn);
                if (bias) {
                    alias |= overlaps(y[j], yn, desc_ptr(a, 10), yn);
                    alias |= overlaps(y[j], yn, desc_ptr(b, 10), yn);
                }
            }
            if (alias) continue;
        }
        a->w[0] = (uint32_t)op; a->w[30] |= 16u; fused++;
    }
    return fused;
}
phase_t *prog_add(prog_t *P, int op, unsigned units) {
	if (P->n == P->cap) { P->cap *= 2; P->p = realloc(P->p, sizeof(phase_t) * P->cap); }
	phase_t *p = &P->p[P->n++];
	memset(p, 0, sizeof *p);
	p->w[0] = (uint32_t)op; p->w[1] = units;
	if (P->pending_wait) { p->w[30] |= 2; P->pending_wait = 0; }   /* wait for the exchange before running */
	return p;
}
/* the phase just added needs no grid barrier after it: the next phase neither reads what it
   writes nor writes what it reads (independent GEMVs on the same input). Not for sends. */
void prog_nobar(prog_t *P) {
	if (getenv("PROG_NONOBAR") || !P->n) return;
	phase_t *p = &P->p[P->n - 1];
	if (p->w[30] & 1) { fprintf(stderr, "prog_nobar on a send phase\n"); exit(1); }
	p->w[30] |= 4;
}
void ph_ptr(phase_t *p, int addr, CUdeviceptr v) { int w = 2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4; p->w[w] = (uint32_t)v; p->w[w + 1] = (uint32_t)(v >> 32); }
void ph_u32(phase_t *p, int addr, uint32_t v) { p->w[2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4] = v; }
void ph_f32(phase_t *p, int addr, float v) { uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &v, 4); ph_u32(p, addr, u); }
void ph_tokv(prog_t *P, phase_t *p, int addr, uint32_t base, uint32_t value) {
	if (P->loop) { ph_u32(p, addr, base + P->token_offset); p->w[31] |= 1u << (2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4); } else ph_u32(p, addr, value);   /* descriptor word 2 + i */
}

void ph_rms(prog_t *P, int op, CUdeviceptr X, CUdeviceptr W, CUdeviceptr Y, float eps, unsigned vectors) {
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, op, vectors);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, X); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, W); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, Y); ph_f32(p, 0x158, eps);
}

}
