int gemv_op(uint32_t type, int K, int acc) {
	switch (type) {
	case GG_Q2_0: return K == 2560 ? OP_Q2K2560 : acc ? OP_Q2ACC640 : OP_Q2K640;
	case GG_Q4_K: return K == 2560 ? OP_Q4KK2560 : OP_Q4KK6144;
	case GG_Q5_K: return K == 2560 ? OP_Q5KK2560 : OP_Q5KK6144;
	case GG_Q3_K: return K == 2560 ? OP_Q3KK2560 : OP_Q3KK6144;
	case GG_Q6_K: return K == 2560 ? OP_Q6KK2560 : getenv("FAKE_Q6K") ? OP_Q5KK6144 : 0;   /* FAKE_Q6K: timing runs only (wrong numbers) until the K=6144 Q6_K kernel exists */
	case GG_IQ4_XS: return K == 2560 ? OP_IQ4K2560 : OP_IQ4K6144;
	case GG_Q4_0: return acc ? OP_B32Q40ACC : OP_B32Q40;
	case GG_Q5_0: return acc ? OP_B32Q50ACC : OP_B32Q50;
	case GG_Q8_0: return acc ? OP_B32Q80ACC : OP_B32Q80;
	case GG_IQ4_NL: return acc ? OP_B32IQ4NLACC : OP_B32IQ4NL;
	default: return 0;
	}
}
int gemv_op_is_q2(int op) { return op == OP_Q2K2560 || op == OP_Q2K640 || op == OP_Q2ACC640 || op == OP_Q2MOEG || op == OP_Q2MOED || op == OP_Q2MOEGN || op == OP_Q2MOEDN; }
int gemv_op_is_b32(int op) { return op == OP_B32Q40 || op == OP_B32Q50 || op == OP_B32Q80 || op == OP_B32IQ4NL || op == OP_B32Q40ACC || op == OP_B32Q50ACC || op == OP_B32Q80ACC || op == OP_B32IQ4NLACC; }

void ph_gemv_any(prog_t *P, uint32_t type, int K, CUdeviceptr W, CUdeviceptr Xq, CUdeviceptr S32, CUdeviceptr S16, CUdeviceptr Y, unsigned rows, CUdeviceptr AS, int acc, CUdeviceptr scale) {
	if (type == GG_Q6_K && K == 6144) {   /* four K = 1536 column slices (the holder's layout), y = ((p0 + p1) + p2) + p3 */
		size_t sl = (size_t)rows * (size_t)q6_k_tile_stride(1536);
		for (unsigned s = 0; s < 4; s++) ph_gemvk(P, s ? OP_Q6KK1536ACC : OP_Q6KK1536, W + sl * s, Xq + 2u * 1536u * s, S16 + 4u * 96u * s, Y, rows, AS + 4u * 48u * s);
		return;
	}
	int op = gemv_op(type, K, acc);
	if (!op) { fprintf(stderr, "prog: no GEMV op for type %u K %d\n", type, K); exit(1); }
	if (gemv_op_is_q2(op)) ph_q2(P, op, W, Xq, S32, Y, rows, 0, AS, scale, 0);
	else if (gemv_op_is_b32(op)) ph_b32(P, op, W, Xq, S32, Y, rows, scale, AS);
	else ph_gemvk(P, op, W, Xq, type == GG_Q6_K ? S16 : S32, Y, rows, AS);   /* Q6_K takes the per-16 sums */
}

/* ---- exchange ---- */
/* the fused hc up (bf16hcup): t = SiLU(0.25 DOWN) (tn values, the last tn - 320 copied), the die's 4 lane rows
   of up (u -> LUP, rows l cols + c), z_c = mix of the 4 lanes into every die's slot at myoff + 4 c */
CUdeviceptr ph_hcup(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, CUdeviceptr W, CUdeviceptr DOWN, CUdeviceptr LUP, unsigned cols, CUdeviceptr XH, CUdeviceptr T, unsigned tn, unsigned myoff) {
	unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_BF16HCUP, 16);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, W); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, DOWN); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, LUP); ph_u32(p, 0x158, 4 * cols);
	ph_u32(p, 0x168, slot + myoff); ph_ptr(p, 0x170, x->xtab); ph_ptr(p, 0x178, XH); ph_ptr(p, 0x180, T); ph_u32(p, 0x188, tn);
	p->w[30] |= 1; P->pending_wait = 1; P->xj++;
	return x->inbox + slot;
}
/* hcmix / dnnorm variants whose output lands in every die's inbox slot (HC_XOUT / DN_XOUT ops) */
CUdeviceptr ph_hcx(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, int op, CUdeviceptr P0, CUdeviceptr P1, unsigned n, unsigned us, unsigned units, unsigned myoff) {
	unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, op, units);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, P0); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, P1); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, x->xtab); ph_u32(p, 0x158, n); ph_u32(p, 0x15c, us); ph_u32(p, 0x160, slot + myoff);
	p->w[30] |= 1; P->pending_wait = 1; P->xj++;
	return x->inbox + slot;
}
CUdeviceptr ph_dnnormx(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, CUdeviceptr O, CUdeviceptr W, CUdeviceptr G, float eps, unsigned heads, unsigned myoff) {
	unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_DNNORMX, heads);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, O); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, W); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, G); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, x->xtab); ph_f32(p, 0x160, eps); ph_u32(p, 0x168, slot + myoff);
	p->w[30] |= 1; P->pending_wait = 1; P->xj++;
	return x->inbox + slot;
}

/* a GEMV whose rows go straight into every die's inbox slot (op built with GEMV_XOUT): the
   phase is a send, the next phase waits; returns the gathered slot */
/* the hc down GEMV with the RMS norm of S fused (bf16hcrx): every CTA normalises S into shared memory, the
   rows go to every die's slot, xh (the normalised stream) is stored for the up / mix that follows */
CUdeviceptr ph_bf16rx(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, CUdeviceptr W, CUdeviceptr S, CUdeviceptr NW, CUdeviceptr XH, float eps, unsigned rows, unsigned myoff) {
	unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_BF16HCRX, 16);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, W); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, S); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, x->xtab); ph_u32(p, 0x158, rows); ph_u32(p, 0x168, slot + myoff);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x178, XH); ph_ptr(p, 0x190, NW); ph_f32(p, 0x198, eps);
	p->w[30] |= 1; P->pending_wait = 1; P->xj++;
	return x->inbox + slot;
}
CUdeviceptr ph_bf16x(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, int op, CUdeviceptr W, CUdeviceptr X, unsigned rows, unsigned myoff) {
	unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, op, 16);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, W); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, X); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, x->xtab); ph_u32(p, 0x158, rows); ph_u32(p, 0x168, slot + myoff);
	p->w[30] |= 1; P->pending_wait = 1; P->xj++;
	return x->inbox + slot;
}

CUdeviceptr ph_xchg(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, int me, int ndies, CUdeviceptr src, unsigned nbytes, unsigned myoff, unsigned total) {
	unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_XSEND, 16);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, x->xtab); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, src); ph_u32(p, 0x150, nbytes); ph_u32(p, 0x154, myoff); ph_u32(p, 0x158, slot); ph_u32(p, 0x15c, (unsigned)ndies); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, x->xgen); ph_u32(p, 0x168, (unsigned)me);
	p->w[30] |= 1;             /* a send (every CTA publishes its flag itself; the bit is informational) ... */
	P->pending_wait = 1;       /* ... and the next phase polls for every die's and CTA's flag first */
	(void)total;
	P->xj++;
	return x->inbox + slot;
}

void prog_token_end(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, int me, int ndies, CUdeviceptr any) {
	if (P->loop && (P->xj & 1)) ph_xchg(P, x, me, ndies, any, 0, 0, 16);
}

/* ---- the split ---- */
void split_of(split_t *s, int d, int n, int blk) {
	s->d = d; s->n = n;
	s->dj0 = split_bound(324, d, n);  s->djn = split_bound(324, d + 1, n) - s->dj0;
	s->cb0 = split_bound(80, d, n);   s->cbn = split_bound(80, d + 1, n) - s->cb0;
	s->h0 = split_bound(48, d, n);    s->hn = split_bound(48, d + 1, n) - s->h0;
	/* value head h pairs with key head h mod 16 (ggml_repeat_4d / the fused GDN kernel: head h uses q/k
	   head h % neq1 — not h / 3, which cost 2 of 7 reference tokens): the die holds key heads
	   (klo + j) % 16, j < nk, in that order, so local value head j reads local key head j % 16 */
	s->klo = s->h0 % 16;   s->nk = s->hn < 16 ? s->hn : 16; s->khi = (s->klo + s->nk - 1) % 16;
	s->y0 = split_bound(2560, d, n);  s->yn = split_bound(2560, d + 1, n) - s->y0;
	s->pk0 = split_bound(10240, d, n); s->pkn = split_bound(10240, d + 1, n) - s->pk0;
	s->o0 = split_bound(248320, d, n); s->on = split_bound(248320, d + 1, n) - s->o0;
	s->hd0 = split_bound(320, d, n);  s->hdn = split_bound(320, d + 1, n) - s->hd0;
	s->e0 = split_bound(512, d, n);   s->en = split_bound(512, d + 1, n) - s->e0;
	s->shexp = (blk % n) == d;
}

/* hyper-connection read: xh = per-lane RMS(S) * norm (whole, on every die); this die's
 * rows of down ++ inject, gathered; t = SiLU(0.25 down) ++ inj; this die's rows of
 * up (the 4 lanes of its z columns); z columns mixed locally, gathered; z quantised.
 * Returns the gathered z (an inbox slot). */
/* Y / inj: the pending stream write of the attention side (gathered y, inject values) or 0: with them
   the read runs bf16hcrwx, which first applies the write (S + 2 sigmoid(inj / 4) y) into S2 */
static CUdeviceptr ph_hc_read(prog_t *P, const split_t *s, const xchg_t *x, CUdeviceptr norm, CUdeviceptr dj, CUdeviceptr up, const dn_bufs_t *b, float eps, CUdeviceptr Y, CUdeviceptr inj) {
	unsigned cols = 32u * (unsigned)s->cbn;
	CUdeviceptr DOWN;
	if (Y) {
		unsigned slot = (unsigned)(P->xj & 1) * XSLOT;
		phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_BF16HCRWX, 16);
		ph_ptr(p, 0x140, dj); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->S); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, x->xtab); ph_u32(p, 0x158, (unsigned)s->djn); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->S2);
		ph_u32(p, 0x168, slot + 4u * (unsigned)s->dj0); ph_ptr(p, 0x178, b->xh); ph_ptr(p, 0x190, norm); ph_f32(p, 0x198, eps); ph_ptr(p, 0x1a0, Y); ph_ptr(p, 0x1a8, inj);
		p->w[30] |= 1; P->pending_wait = 1; P->xj++;
		DOWN = x->inbox + slot;
	} else if (getenv("PROG_NORMSFUSE")) {
		ph_rms(P, OP_RMS2560, b->S, norm, b->xh, eps, 4);
		DOWN = ph_bf16x(P, x, OP_BF16HCX, dj, b->xh, (unsigned)s->djn, 4u * (unsigned)s->dj0);   /* down ++ inject rows straight into every die's slot */
	} else DOWN = ph_bf16rx(P, x, dj, b->S, norm, b->xh, eps, (unsigned)s->djn, 4u * (unsigned)s->dj0);   /* + the RMS norm */
	CUdeviceptr Z = getenv("PROG_NOHCUP") ? 0 : ph_hcup(P, x, up, DOWN, b->lup, cols, b->xh + 4u * 32u * (unsigned)s->cb0, b->t, 324, 4u * 32u * (unsigned)s->cb0);
	if (!Z) {
		ph_hc(P, OP_HCSILU, DOWN, b->t, 0, 324, 320, 2);
		ph_bf16(P, OP_BF16K320, up, b->t, b->lup, 4 * cols, 0);
		Z = ph_hcx(P, x, OP_HCMIXX, b->lup, b->xh + 4u * 32u * (unsigned)s->cb0, cols, 4 * cols, (cols + 255) / 256, 4u * 32u * (unsigned)s->cb0);
	}
	ph_actq(P, OP_ACTQ256, Z, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->zas, 256, 10);
	return Z;
}

/* the MoE hyper-block (expert split: this die's routed experts, partials reduced) */
static void ph_moe_half(prog_t *P, const split_t *s, const xchg_t *x, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, float eps, CUdeviceptr Y) {
	CUdeviceptr inj = b->t + 320 * 4;
	/* Y: the attention side's gathered output, its write fused into this read (the stream goes to S2 and
	   the MoE end writes S from S2); 0: the write already happened (S2 = S, in place) */
	CUdeviceptr Z = ph_hc_read(P, s, x, w->hc_ffn_norm, w->hc_ffn_dj, w->hc_ffn_up, b, eps, Y, inj);
	CUdeviceptr SIN = Y ? b->S2 : b->S;
	ph_bf16(P, OP_BF16K2560, w->ffn_gate_inp_x, Z, b->r, 513, 0);
	ph_router(P, b->r, b->r + 512 * 4, b->idx, b->w, b->s);
	ph_moesel(P, b->idx, b->w, w->emap, b->lidx, b->lw, b->ne, b->part);
	ph_q2(P, OP_Q2MOEGN, w->ffn_gate_exps, b->zq, b->zs32, b->g, 640, b->lidx, b->zas, 0, b->ne);
	prog_nobar(P);   /* expert gate / up and shared gate / up: four GEMVs of z into disjoint rows */
	ph_q2(P, OP_Q2MOEGN, w->ffn_up_exps, b->zq, b->zs32, b->gu, 640, b->lidx, b->zas, 0, b->ne);
	if (s->shexp) {
		prog_nobar(P);
		ph_gemv_any(P, w->ffn_gate_shexp_type, 2560, w->ffn_gate_shexp, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->g + 6400 * 4, 640, b->zas, 0, 0);
		prog_nobar(P);
		ph_gemv_any(P, w->ffn_up_shexp_type, 2560, w->ffn_up_shexp, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->gu + 6400 * 4, 640, b->zas, 0, 0);
		if (getenv("PROG_DUP")) ph_gemv_any(P, w->ffn_up_shexp_type, 2560, w->ffn_up_shexp, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->gu + 6400 * 4, 640, b->zas, 0, 0);
	}
	ph_ffnact(P, b->g, b->gu, b->hq, b->hs32, b->hs16, b->has, 640, s->shexp ? 11 : 10);
	ph_q2(P, OP_Q2MOEDN, w->ffn_down_exps, b->hq, b->hs32, b->part, 2560, b->lidx, b->has, b->lw, b->ne);
	if (s->shexp) ph_gemv_any(P, w->ffn_down_shexp_type, 640, w->ffn_down_shexp, b->hq + 10 * 640 * 2, b->hs32 + 10 * 20 * 4, b->hs16 + 10 * 40 * 4, b->part, 2560, b->has + 10 * 20 * 4, 1, b->s);
	CUdeviceptr PARTS = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->part, 2560 * 4, 2560u * 4u * (unsigned)s->d, 2560u * 4u * (unsigned)s->n);
	/* out = the fixed-order sum of the parts (sumn's order), fused into the stream write */
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_HCWSUM, 10);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, inj); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, PARTS); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->S); ph_u32(p, 0x158, 2560); ph_u32(p, 0x15c, 2560 * 4); ph_u32(p, 0x164, (unsigned)s->n); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->out); ph_ptr(p, 0x170, SIN);
}

/* QSA attention (ref/qsa.h): the q/k/v projections of z and the indexer projections (Z, the gathered fp32 z), the int8 KV append,
 * the indexer (q norm + rope, key ring, pooled keys, scores, 5 selection passes), the gather of the attended blocks into the compact
 * caches and flash-decoding over them (n keys from the token position, see ref/qsa.h qsa_nkeys), then the merge with the output gate */
static void ph_attn_qsa(prog_t *P, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t, float eps, CUdeviceptr Z) {
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_q_type, 2560, w->attn_q, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->qg, 12288, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_k_type, 2560, w->attn_k, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->k, 512, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_v_type, 2560, w->attn_v, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->v, 512, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);
	ph_bf16(P, OP_BF16K2560, w->indexer_x, Z, b->iqk, 640, 0);   /* iq (512) ++ ik (128) */
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_ATTNQKQ, 26);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->qg); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->k); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->v); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, w->attn_q_norm); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, w->attn_k_norm);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->rope_cs); ph_ptr(p, 0x170, b->rope_sn); ph_ptr(p, 0x178, b->qo); ph_ptr(p, 0x180, b->kq); ph_ptr(p, 0x188, b->vq);
	ph_tokv(P, p, 0x190, 0, t); ph_f32(p, 0x194, eps); ph_ptr(p, 0x198, b->ks); ph_ptr(p, 0x1a0, b->vs);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x1a8, b->kv_rawmax);
	prog_nobar(P);   /* the indexer does not read what the cache append writes */
	p = prog_add(P, OP_IDXQK, 6);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->iqk); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, w->indexer_qn); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, w->indexer_kn); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->rope_cs); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->rope_sn); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->iq);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x170, b->ring); ph_ptr(p, 0x178, b->pkt); ph_ptr(p, 0x180, b->hst); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x188, 0, t); ph_f32(p, 0x18c, eps);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_IDXSCORE, 16);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->pkt); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->iq); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->sc); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->hst); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x160, 0, t); ph_u32(p, 0x164, b->nblk);
	for (unsigned pass = 2; pass <= 6; pass++) {
		p = prog_add(P, OP_IDXSEL, 16);
		ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->sc); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->hst); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->sel); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x158, 0, t); ph_u32(p, 0x15c, b->nblk); ph_u32(p, 0x160, pass);
	}
	p = prog_add(P, OP_KVGATHER, b->nblk + 1);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->kq); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->ks); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->vq); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->vs); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->kc); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->vc);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x170, b->sel); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x178, 0, t); ph_u32(p, 0x17c, b->nblk);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_ATTNPARTN, 32);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->qo); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->kc); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->vc); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->pm); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->pd); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->po); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x170, 1, t + 1); ph_u32(p, 0x174, b->nblk);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_ATTNMERGE, 24);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->pm); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->pd); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->po); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->qg); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->aout);
}

/* attention proper on die 0 (v1): q/k/v GEMVs, per-head norm + RoPE + cache append,
 * flash-decoding partials over the t+1 keys, merge with the output gate */
static void ph_attn_core(prog_t *P, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t, float eps) {
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_q_type, 2560, w->attn_q, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->qg, 12288, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_k_type, 2560, w->attn_k, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->k, 512, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);   /* q, k, v GEMVs of z into separate buffers */
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_v_type, 2560, w->attn_v, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->v, 512, b->zas, 0, 0);
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_ATTNQK, 26);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->qg); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->k); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->v); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, w->attn_q_norm); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, w->attn_k_norm);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->rope_cs); ph_ptr(p, 0x170, b->rope_sn); ph_ptr(p, 0x178, b->qo); ph_ptr(p, 0x180, b->kc); ph_ptr(p, 0x188, b->vc);
	ph_tokv(P, p, 0x190, 0, t); ph_f32(p, 0x194, eps);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_ATTNPART, 32);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->qo); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->kc); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->vc); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->pm); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->pd); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->po); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x170, 1, t + 1);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_ATTNMERGE, 24);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->pm); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->pd); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->po); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->qg); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->aout);
}

void prog_attn_block(prog_t *P, const split_t *s, const xchg_t *x, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t, float eps) {
	CUdeviceptr inj = b->t + 320 * 4;
	CUdeviceptr Z = ph_hc_read(P, s, x, w->hc_attn_norm, w->hc_attn_dj, w->hc_attn_up, b, eps, 0, 0);
	int here = b->qsa ? b->kq != 0 : s->d == attn_die();   /* the die that runs this layer: the one holding its KV cache (QSA), else attn_die() */
	if (here) { if (b->qsa) ph_attn_qsa(P, w, b, t, eps, Z); else ph_attn_core(P, w, b, t, eps); }
	CUdeviceptr AOUT = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->aout, here ? 6144 * 4 : 0, 0, 6144 * 4);
	ph_actq(P, OP_ACTQ256, AOUT, b->oq, b->os32, b->os16, b->oas, 256, 24);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_output_type, 6144, w->attn_output, b->oq, b->os32, b->os16, b->ly, (unsigned)s->yn, b->oas, 0, 0);
	CUdeviceptr Y = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->ly, 4u * (unsigned)s->yn, 4u * (unsigned)s->y0, 4 * 2560);
	if (getenv("PROG_NORMSW")) { ph_hc(P, OP_HCWRITE, inj, Y, b->S, 2560, 0, 10); ph_moe_half(P, s, x, w, b, eps, 0); }
	else ph_moe_half(P, s, x, w, b, eps, Y);   /* the write is fused into the MoE side's read */
}

void prog_embed(prog_t *P, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t) {
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_EMBROW, 10);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, w->token_embd); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->S); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x150, 0, t); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->ids);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->imap); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->img);
}

/* The token embedding with token_embd on one die only: the owner decodes the row into S (the four lanes, 40,960 bytes) and sends it, the other dies
   send nothing and copy what arrived (inbox slot 0, the program starts at an even exchange count) into their own S. */
void prog_embed_bcast(prog_t *P, const xchg_t *x, int me, int ndies, int owner, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t) {
	if (me == owner) prog_embed(P, w, b, t);
	CUdeviceptr in = ph_xchg(P, x, me, ndies, b->S, me == owner ? 4u * 10240u : 0u, 0, 4u * 10240u);
	if (me != owner) { phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_XCOPY, 10); ph_ptr(p, 0x140, in); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->S); }
}

void prog_head(prog_t *P, const split_t *s, const xchg_t *x, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, float eps, unsigned t, unsigned nprompt) {
	unsigned cols = 32u * (unsigned)s->cbn;
	/* the read gate without an inject: 320 down rows, nothing copied behind t */
	CUdeviceptr DOWN = ph_bf16rx(P, x, w->output_hc_down, b->S, w->output_hc_norm, b->xh, eps, (unsigned)s->hdn, 4u * (unsigned)s->hd0);
	CUdeviceptr Z = ph_hcup(P, x, w->output_hc_up, DOWN, b->lup, cols, b->xh + 4u * 32u * (unsigned)s->cb0, b->t, 320, 4u * 32u * (unsigned)s->cb0);
	ph_actq(P, OP_ACTQ256, Z, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->zas, 256, 10);
	ph_gemv_any(P, GG_Q5_K, 2560, w->output, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->hlo, (unsigned)s->on, b->zas, 0, 0);
	phase_t *p;
	if (P->samp_k >= 2) {   /* top-k -> top-p -> temperature, the dies agree on the token (kern/sample.sass) */
		p = prog_add(P, OP_TOPK, 16);
		ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->hlo); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->tkout); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->tkpart); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->tkcnt); ph_u32(p, 0x160, (unsigned)s->on); ph_u32(p, 0x164, 16); ph_u32(p, 0x168, (unsigned)P->samp_k);
		CUdeviceptr LISTS = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->tkout, 256, 256u * (unsigned)s->d, 256u * (unsigned)s->n);
		p = prog_add(P, OP_SAMPLE, 1);
		ph_ptr(p, 0x140, LISTS); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, w->obases); ph_u32(p, 0x150, (unsigned)s->n); ph_u32(p, 0x154, (unsigned)P->samp_k); ph_f32(p, 0x158, P->samp_topp); ph_f32(p, 0x15c, P->samp_invT);
		ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->ids); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->toks); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x170, 0, t); ph_u32(p, 0x174, nprompt);
		ph_u32(p, 0x178, P->stop[0]); ph_u32(p, 0x17c, P->stop[1]); ph_ptr(p, 0x180, P->end); ph_ptr(p, 0x188, b->rnd);
		return;
	}
	p = prog_add(P, OP_ARGMAX, 16);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->hlo); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->amo); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->apart); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->acnt); ph_u32(p, 0x160, (unsigned)s->on); ph_u32(p, 0x164, 16);
	CUdeviceptr PAIRS = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->amo, 8, 8u * (unsigned)s->d, 8u * (unsigned)s->n);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_AMAX, 1);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, PAIRS); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, w->obases); ph_u32(p, 0x150, (unsigned)s->n); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->tokout);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->ids); ph_ptr(p, 0x168, b->toks); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x170, 0, t); ph_u32(p, 0x174, nprompt);
	ph_u32(p, 0x178, P->stop[0]); ph_u32(p, 0x17c, P->stop[1]); ph_ptr(p, 0x180, P->end);
}

void prog_ple_prefix(prog_t *P, const split_t *s, const xchg_t *x, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t, float eps) {
	phase_t *p = prog_add(P, OP_PLEROWS, 1);   /* every die hashes and gathers the 16 rows itself */
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->ids); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->ple_pc); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, b->ple_tab); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->pg); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->prows); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x168, 0, t); ph_u32(p, 0x16c, b->ple_compact);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x170, b->ple_rdy); ph_u32(p, 0x178, b->ple_rid);
	ph_actq(P, OP_ACTQ256, b->pg, b->pgq, b->pgs32, b->pgs16, b->pgas, 256, 10);
	ph_gemv_any(P, GG_Q2_0, 2560, w->ple_key, b->pgq, b->pgs32, b->pgs16, b->lk, (unsigned)s->pkn, b->pgas, 0, 0);
	CUdeviceptr K = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->lk, 4u * (unsigned)s->pkn, 4u * (unsigned)s->pk0, 4 * 10240);
	ph_rms(P, OP_RMS2560, K, w->ple_norm_key, b->kn, eps, 4);
	ph_rms(P, OP_RMS2560, b->S, w->ple_norm_query, b->qn, eps, 4);
	ph_bf16(P, OP_BF16K2560, w->ple_value, b->pg, b->lv, (unsigned)s->yn, 0);
	CUdeviceptr V = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->lv, 4u * (unsigned)s->yn, 4u * (unsigned)s->y0, 4 * 2560);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_PLEGATE, 4);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->kn); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->qn); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, V); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->pG); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->pgates);
	ph_rms(P, OP_RMS2560, b->pG, w->ple_norm_conv, b->px, eps, 4);
	p = prog_add(P, OP_PLECONV, 10);
	ph_ptr(p, 0x140, b->px); ph_ptr(p, 0x148, b->ple_state); ph_ptr(p, 0x150, w->ple_conv1d); ph_ptr(p, 0x158, b->pG); ph_ptr(p, 0x160, b->S); ph_tokv(P, p, 0x168, 0, t);
}

void prog_deltanet_block(prog_t *P, const split_t *s, const xchg_t *x, const dn_weights_t *w, const dn_bufs_t *b, unsigned t, float eps) {
	unsigned nloc = SPLIT_NLOC(s), hrows = 128u * (unsigned)s->hn;
	CUdeviceptr inj = b->t + 320 * 4;
	/* ---- attention-side hyper-block: Gated DeltaNet ---- */
	CUdeviceptr Z = ph_hc_read(P, s, x, w->hc_attn_norm, w->hc_attn_dj, w->hc_attn_up, b, eps, 0, 0);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_qkv_type, 2560, w->attn_qkv, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->lqkv, nloc, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->attn_gate_type, 2560, w->attn_gate, b->zq, b->zs32, b->zs16, b->lgate, hrows, b->zas, 0, 0);
	prog_nobar(P);   /* qkv, gate and the alpha/beta rows all read z only */
	ph_bf16(P, OP_BF16BIAS, w->ssm_ab, Z, b->la, 2u * (unsigned)s->hn, w->ssm_ab_bias);
	ph_conv1d(P, b->lqkv, b->conv_state, w->ssm_conv1d, b->lu, t, nloc);
	ph_dnstep(P, b->dn_state, b->lu, b->lu + 512u * (unsigned)s->nk, b->lu + 1024u * (unsigned)s->nk, b->la, b->la + 4u * (unsigned)s->hn, w->ssm_a, b->lo, eps, (unsigned)s->h0, (unsigned)s->klo, (unsigned)s->hn);
	CUdeviceptr ON = ph_dnnormx(P, x, b->lo, w->ssm_norm, b->lgate, eps, (unsigned)s->hn, 4u * 128u * (unsigned)s->h0);
	ph_actq(P, OP_ACTQ256, ON, b->oq, b->os32, b->os16, b->oas, 256, 24);
	ph_gemv_any(P, w->ssm_out_type, 6144, w->ssm_out, b->oq, b->os32, b->os16, b->ly, (unsigned)s->yn, b->oas, 0, 0);
	CUdeviceptr Y = ph_xchg(P, x, s->d, s->n, b->ly, 4u * (unsigned)s->yn, 4u * (unsigned)s->y0, 4 * 2560);
	if (getenv("PROG_NORMSW")) { ph_hc(P, OP_HCWRITE, inj, Y, b->S, 2560, 0, 10); ph_moe_half(P, s, x, w, b, eps, 0); }
	else ph_moe_half(P, s, x, w, b, eps, Y);   /* the write is fused into the MoE side's read */
}


File: kern/qsa_test.c
/* qsa_test: the QSA ops through the persistent kernel (die.cubin) against ref/qsa.c, token by token.
 *   qsa_test kv <T> <NBLK>     attnqkq (int8 KV append) + kvgather + attnpartn + attnmerge: caches, compact caches and the
 *                              attention output bit for bit; the attended blocks are a pseudo-random ascending selection
 * Run with the die index in CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "attn.h"
#include "qsa.h"
#include "quant_range_cases.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

#include "dieops.h"
static uint32_t rs = 4242;
static uint32_t urand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return rs >> 8; }
static float frand(void) { return (urand() & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

typedef struct { uint32_t w[32]; } desc_t;
static void d_init(desc_t *d, int op, unsigned units) { memset(d, 0, sizeof *d); d->w[0] = (uint32_t)op; d->w[1] = units; }
static void d_ptr(desc_t *d, int addr, CUdeviceptr p) { int w = 2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4; d->w[w] = (uint32_t)p; d->w[w + 1] = (uint32_t)(p >> 32); }
static void d_u32(desc_t *d, int addr, uint32_t v) { d->w[2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4] = v; }
static void d_f32(desc_t *d, int addr, float v) { uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &v, 4); d_u32(d, addr, u); }
/* token-relative: the kernel adds its token counter to this parameter */
static void d_tok(desc_t *d, int addr, uint32_t base) { d_u32(d, addr, base); d->w[31] |= 1u << (2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4); }

static CUmodule mod; static CUfunction fn; static CUdeviceptr dPROG, dCTL;
static void dev_init(void) {
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, getenv("DIE_CUBIN") ? getenv("DIE_CUBIN") : "die.cubin"));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "die"));
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dPROG, 128 * 256)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dCTL, 8192)); CK(cuMemsetD8(dCTL, 0, 8192));
}
static CUdeviceptr dalloc(size_t n) { CUdeviceptr p; CK(cuMemAlloc(&p, n ? n : 4)); CK(cuMemsetD8(p, 0, n ? n : 4)); return p; }
/* the same, in pinned host memory the die reads and writes over PCIe (QSA_HOSTKV=1 runs the KV cache of the kv test there) */
static CUdeviceptr halloc(size_t n) { void *h; CUdeviceptr d; CK(cuMemHostAlloc(&h, n, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP | CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_PORTABLE)); memset(h, 0, n); CK(cuMemHostGetDevicePointer(&d, h, 0)); return d; }
/* run the program once at token t (the kernel's token counter starts at t) */
static void run_token(const desc_t *prog, unsigned nph, unsigned t) {
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPROG, prog, sizeof(desc_t) * nph));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCTL + 8, &t, 4));
	unsigned ntok = t + 1; void *params[] = { &dPROG, &nph, &dCTL, &ntok };
	CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 16, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
	CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
}
static int cmpb(const char *what, const void *ref, const void *got, size_t n, int *shown) {
	if (!memcmp(ref, got, n)) return 0;
	size_t i = 0; while (((const uint8_t *)ref)[i] == ((const uint8_t *)got)[i]) i++;
	if ((*shown)++ < 6) printf("  %s differs at byte %zu: gpu %02x ref %02x\n", what, i, ((const uint8_t *)got)[i], ((const uint8_t *)ref)[i]);
	return 1;
}


static unsigned quant_extreme_fixture(unsigned token, unsigned group) {
 return (2u * token + group) % QUANT_RANGE_SIGNED_COUNT;
}
static uint32_t quant_raw_max_bits(const float *x) {
 uint32_t maximum = 0;
 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
  uint32_t magnitude = quant_float_bits(x[i]) & 0x7fffffffu;
  if (magnitude > maximum) maximum = magnitude;
 }
 return maximum;
}
static void quant_extremes_(float *v, unsigned token) {
 for (unsigned group = 0; group < 16; ++group) {
  unsigned fixture = quant_extreme_fixture(token, group);
  quant_range_group(v + 32 * group, quant_range_amplitude(fixture));
 }
}
static int quant_extremes_check(unsigned token, const float *v,
                               const int8_t *cpu_q, const uint16_t *cpu_s,
                               const int8_t *gpu_q, const uint16_t *gpu_s,
                               unsigned char *seen) {
 int bad = 0;
 for (unsigned group = 0; group < 16; ++group) {
  unsigned fixture = quant_extreme_fixture(token, group);
  const quant_range_case *test = &quant_range_cases[fixture / 2];
  size_t qi = (size_t)token * 512 + 32 * group;
  size_t si = (size_t)token * 16 + group;
  if (gpu_s[si] != test->scale_bits || cpu_s[si] != test->scale_bits) {
   fprintf(stderr, "quant-range scale failure t=%u group=%u case=%s expected=%04x cpu=%04x gpu=%04x\n",
           token, group, test->name, test->scale_bits, cpu_s[si], gpu_s[si]);
   bad = 1;
  }
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
   float x = v[32 * group + i];
   int expected = x > 0.f ? 127 : x < 0.f ? -127 : 0;
   if (gpu_q[qi + i] != expected || cpu_q[qi + i] != expected) {
    fprintf(stderr, "quant-range code failure t=%u group=%u channel=%u expected=%d cpu=%d gpu=%d\n",
            token, group, i, expected, cpu_q[qi + i], gpu_q[qi + i]);
    bad = 1; break;
   }
  }
  if (!seen[fixture]) {
   printf("quant-range gpu fixture=%u case=%s input=%08x expected_scale=%04x cpu_scale=%04x gpu_scale=%04x cpu_q1=%d gpu_q1=%d cpu_q2=%d gpu_q2=%d cpu_deq1=%08x gpu_bits_deq1=%08x\n",
          fixture, test->name, quant_float_bits(quant_range_amplitude(fixture)),
          test->scale_bits, cpu_s[si], gpu_s[si], cpu_q[qi + 1], gpu_q[qi + 1],
          cpu_q[qi + 2], gpu_q[qi + 2],
          quant_float_bits(kv_deq_gpu(cpu_q[qi + 1], cpu_s[si])),
          quant_float_bits(kv_deq_gpu(gpu_q[qi + 1], gpu_s[si])));
   seen[fixture] = 1;
  }
 }
 return bad;
}
static int test_kv(unsigned T, unsigned NBLK) {
	const float eps = 1e-6f;
	unsigned npos = T + 64;
	const int trace_check = getenv("QSA_KV_TRACE_CHECK") != NULL;
	CUdeviceptr dTRACE = 0;
	uint32_t trace_expected[32], trace_got[32];
	if (trace_check) {
		dTRACE = dalloc((size_t)npos * 32 * sizeof(uint32_t));
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dTRACE, 0xffffffffu, (size_t)npos * 32));
	}
	float *rcs = malloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), *rsn = malloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos);
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < npos; t++) rope_table_gpu(t, 1e7f, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t);
	float qn[256], kn[256]; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) { qn[i] = 0.5f + 0.5f * frand(); kn[i] = 0.5f + 0.5f * frand(); }
	/* host mirrors of the caches */
	int8_t *kq = calloc((size_t)npos * 512, 1), *vq = calloc((size_t)npos * 512, 1);
	uint16_t *ks = calloc((size_t)npos * 16, 2), *vs = calloc((size_t)npos * 16, 2);
	unsigned cpos = 4 * (NBLK + 1) + 2048; cpos = (cpos + 31) / 32 * 32;
	size_t kcf = ATTN_KC_FLOATS(cpos), vcf = (size_t)cpos * 512;
	CUdeviceptr dQG = dalloc(4 * 12288), dK = dalloc(4 * 512), dV = dalloc(4 * 512), dQN = dalloc(4 * 256), dKN = dalloc(4 * 256), dCS = dalloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), dSN = dalloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos);
	int hk = getenv("QSA_HOSTKV") != NULL;
	CUdeviceptr dQO = dalloc(4 * 6144), dKQ = hk ? halloc((size_t)npos * 512) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 512), dVQ = hk ? halloc((size_t)npos * 512) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 512), dKS = hk ? halloc((size_t)npos * 32) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 32), dVS = hk ? halloc((size_t)npos * 32) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 32);
	CUdeviceptr dKC = dalloc(kcf * 4), dVC = dalloc(vcf * 4), dSEL = dalloc(4 * (NBLK + 8)), dPM = dalloc(4 * 24 * 8), dPD = dalloc(4 * 24 * 8), dPO = dalloc(4 * 24 * 8 * 256), dAOUT = dalloc(4 * 6144);
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQN, qn, 4 * 256)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKN, kn, 4 * 256)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCS, rcs, 4 * 32 * (size_t)npos)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSN, rsn, 4 * 32 * (size_t)npos));
	desc_t prog[4];
	d_init(&prog[0], OP_ATTNQKQ, 26);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x140, dQG); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x148, dK); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x150, dV); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x158, dQN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x160, dKN);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x168, dCS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x170, dSN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x178, dQO); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x180, dKQ); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x188, dVQ);
	d_tok(&prog[0], 0x190, 0); d_f32(&prog[0], 0x194, eps); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x198, dKS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x1a0, dVS);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x1a8, dTRACE);
	d_init(&prog[1], OP_KVGATHER, NBLK + 1);
	d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x140, dKQ); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x148, dKS); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x150, dVQ); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x158, dVS); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x160, dKC); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x168, dVC);
	d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x170, dSEL); d_tok(&prog[1], 0x178, 0); d_u32(&prog[1], 0x17c, NBLK);
	d_init(&prog[2], OP_ATTNPARTN, 32);
	d_ptr(&prog[2], 0x140, dQO); d_ptr(&prog[2], 0x148, dKC); d_ptr(&prog[2], 0x150, dVC); d_ptr(&prog[2], 0x158, dPM); d_ptr(&prog[2], 0x160, dPD); d_ptr(&prog[2], 0x168, dPO);
	d_tok(&prog[2], 0x170, 1); d_u32(&prog[2], 0x174, NBLK);
	d_init(&prog[3], OP_ATTNMERGE, 24);
	d_ptr(&prog[3], 0x140, dPM); d_ptr(&prog[3], 0x148, dPD); d_ptr(&prog[3], 0x150, dPO); d_ptr(&prog[3], 0x158, dQG); d_ptr(&prog[3], 0x160, dAOUT);

	float *qg = malloc(4 * 12288), *k = malloc(4 * 512), *v = malloc(4 * 512), *qo = malloc(4 * 6144), *out = malloc(4 * 6144), *outg = malloc(4 * 6144);
	float *kc = calloc(kcf, 4), *vc = calloc(vcf, 4), *kcg = malloc(kcf * 4), *vcg = malloc(vcf * 4);
	int8_t *kqg = malloc((size_t)npos * 512), *vqg = malloc((size_t)npos * 512); uint16_t *ksg = malloc((size_t)npos * 32), *vsg = malloc((size_t)npos * 32);
	uint32_t *sel = malloc(4 * (NBLK + 8));
	int bad = 0, shown = 0;
	const int last_only = getenv("QSA_KV_LAST_ONLY") != NULL;
	const int extremes = getenv("QSA_KV_EXTREMES") != NULL;
	unsigned char quant_seen[QUANT_RANGE_SIGNED_COUNT] = {0};
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < T; t++) {
		int b = 0, check_attn = !last_only || t + 1 == T;
		for (int i = 0; i < 12288; i++) qg[i] = 2.f * frand();
		for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) { k[i] = 2.f * frand(); v[i] = frand(); }
		if (t % 7 == 3) for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) v[i] *= 1e-4f;          /* tiny scales (fp16 subnormals) */
		if (t % 11 == 5) for (int i = 256; i < 512; i++) v[i] = 0.f;          /* an all-zero kv head */
		if (t % 13 == 6) for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) v[i] *= 3e3f;
		if (extremes) quant_extremes_(v, t);
		unsigned nv = (t + 1) >> 2, ns = nv < NBLK ? nv : NBLK;
		if (nv > NBLK) {   /* a pseudo-random ascending selection of NBLK of the nv blocks */
			unsigned *perm = malloc(4 * nv); for (unsigned i = 0; i < nv; i++) perm[i] = i;
			for (unsigned i = 0; i < NBLK; i++) { unsigned j = i + urand() % (nv - i), tmp = perm[i]; perm[i] = perm[j]; perm[j] = tmp; sel[i] = perm[i]; }
			for (unsigned i = 1; i < NBLK; i++) { uint32_t x = sel[i]; int j = (int)i - 1; while (j >= 0 && sel[j] > x) { sel[j + 1] = sel[j]; j--; } sel[j + 1] = x; }
			free(perm);
			CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSEL, sel, 4 * NBLK));
		}
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQG, qg, 4 * 12288)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dK, k, 4 * 512)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dV, v, 4 * 512));
		run_token(prog, 4, t);
		/* the twin: q/k norm + RoPE, int8 append, gather, attention */
		for (int h = 0; h < 24; h++) qk_norm_rope_gpu(qg + 512 * h, qn, eps, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t, qo + 256 * h);
		for (int h = 0; h < 2; h++) {
			float y[256];
			qk_norm_rope_gpu(k + 256 * h, kn, eps, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t, y);
			for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
				size_t row = (size_t)t * 2 + h;
				if (trace_check) {
					trace_expected[h * 8 + b] = quant_raw_max_bits(y + 32 * b);
					trace_expected[16 + h * 8 + b] = quant_raw_max_bits(v + 256 * h + 32 * b);
				}
				kv_quant32_gpu(y + 32 * b, kq + row * 256 + 32 * b, &ks[row * 8 + b]);
				kv_quant32_gpu(v + 256 * h + 32 * b, vq + row * 256 + 32 * b, &vs[row * 8 + b]);
			}
		}
		unsigned n = qsa_gather_gpu(kq, ks, vq, vs, sel, t, NBLK, kc, vc);
		if (trace_check) {
			CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(trace_got, dTRACE + (size_t)t * sizeof trace_got, sizeof trace_got));
			b |= cmpb("raw KV maxima", trace_expected, trace_got, sizeof trace_got, &shown);
		}
		if (check_attn) attn_decode_gpu(qo, kc, vc, n, qg, out);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(kqg, dKQ, (size_t)npos * 512)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(vqg, dVQ, (size_t)npos * 512)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ksg, dKS, (size_t)npos * 32)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(vsg, dVS, (size_t)npos * 32));
		if (extremes) b |= quant_extremes_check(t, v, vq, vs, vqg, vsg, quant_seen);
        for(unsigned j=0;j<16;j++){size_t si=(size_t)t*16+j;if(!isfinite(qsa_h2f(ksg[si]))||!isfinite(qsa_h2f(vsg[si]))){fprintf(stderr,"nonfinite KV scale at t=%u group=%u\n",t,j);b=1;}}
        for(unsigned j=0;j<512;j++){size_t qi=(size_t)t*512+j,si=(size_t)t*16+j/32;if(!isfinite(kv_deq_gpu(kqg[qi],ksg[si]))||!isfinite(kv_deq_gpu(vqg[qi],vsg[si])))b=1;}

		{ float *qog = malloc(4 * 6144); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(qog, dQO, 4 * 6144));
			/* Corrupt only the readback: prove that an isolated query failure reaches main. */
			if (getenv("QSA_INJECT_QO_MISMATCH") && t + 1 == T) ((unsigned char *)qog)[0] ^= 1;
			int bq = cmpb("qo", qo, qog, 4 * 6144, &shown); b |= bq;
			if (bq && !bad) printf("  (qo differs at t = %u)\n", t);
			free(qog); }
		if (getenv("QSA_DUMP") && t == 0) { printf("kq gpu:"); for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) printf(" %d", kqg[i]); printf("\n    ref:"); for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) printf(" %d", kq[i]); printf("\nks gpu:"); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) printf(" %04x", ksg[i]); printf("\n    ref:"); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) printf(" %04x", ks[i]); printf("\nvq gpu:"); for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) printf(" %d", vqg[i]); printf("\n    ref:"); for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) printf(" %d", vq[i]); printf("\n"); }
		b |= cmpb("kq", kq + (size_t)t * 512, kqg + (size_t)t * 512, 512, &shown); b |= cmpb("vq", vq + (size_t)t * 512, vqg + (size_t)t * 512, 512, &shown);
		b |= cmpb("ks", ks + (size_t)t * 16, ksg + (size_t)t * 16, 32, &shown); b |= cmpb("vs", vs + (size_t)t * 16, vsg + (size_t)t * 16, 32, &shown);
		/* All GPU stages and append/query checks run at every position. The opt-in
		 * long regression computes expensive scalar attention only at the last one. */
		if (check_attn) {
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(kcg, dKC, kcf * 4)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(vcg, dVC, vcf * 4));
		unsigned nb = ns + ((t + 1) & 3 ? 1 : 0);
		for (unsigned j = 0; j < nb; j++) for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
			unsigned slot = 4 * j + i;
			for (int kv = 0; kv < 2; kv++) for (int d = 0; d < 256; d += 4) {
				b |= cmpb("kc", &kc[attn_kidx(slot, kv, d)], &kcg[attn_kidx(slot, kv, d)], 16, &shown);
				b |= cmpb("vc", &vc[(size_t)slot * 512 + 256 * kv + d], &vcg[(size_t)slot * 512 + 256 * kv + d], 16, &shown);
			}
		}
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(outg, dAOUT, 4 * 6144));
        for(int j=0;j<6144;j++)if(!isfinite(outg[j]))b=1;
		b |= cmpb("out", out, outg, 4 * 6144, &shown);
		}
		if (b && !bad) printf("first mismatch at t = %u (n = %u keys, %u blocks selected)\n", t, n, ns);
		bad += b;
	}
	if (trace_check)
		printf("quant-range raw-maxima trace: %zu groups; %s\n", (size_t)T * 32, bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS");
	unsigned coverage = 0;
	int coverage_bad = 0;
	if (extremes) {
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < QUANT_RANGE_SIGNED_COUNT; ++i) coverage += quant_seen[i] != 0;
		coverage_bad = coverage != QUANT_RANGE_SIGNED_COUNT;
		printf("quant-range coverage: %u/%u signed fixtures; %s\n",
		       coverage, (unsigned)QUANT_RANGE_SIGNED_COUNT, bad || coverage_bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS");
		if (coverage_bad) fputs("incomplete extreme fixture coverage; use at least 16 tokens\n", stderr);
	}
	printf("kv: %u tokens, NBLK %u: %s (%d tokens differ; query/append checks %u, gather/attention checks %u)\n", T, NBLK, bad || coverage_bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad, T, last_only && T ? 1 : T);
	return bad || coverage_bad;
}

static size_t pkt_idx(unsigned b, int d) { return (size_t)(b >> 5) * 4096 + (size_t)(d >> 2) * 128 + (b & 31) * 4 + (d & 3); }

static int test_idxqk(unsigned T) {
	const float eps = 1e-6f;
	unsigned npos = T + 64, nblk = (T + 3) / 4, ngrp = (nblk + 31) / 32 + 1;
	float *rcs = malloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), *rsn = malloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos);
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < npos; t++) rope_table_gpu(t, 1e7f, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t);
	float qn[128], kn[128]; for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) { qn[i] = 0.5f + 0.5f * frand(); kn[i] = 0.5f + 0.5f * frand(); }
	CUdeviceptr dIQK = dalloc(4 * 640), dQN = dalloc(4 * 128), dKN = dalloc(4 * 128), dCS = dalloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), dSN = dalloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), dIQ = dalloc(4 * 512), dRING = dalloc(4 * 512), dPKT = dalloc((size_t)ngrp * 8192), dHST = dalloc(4 * 1280);
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQN, qn, 4 * 128)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKN, kn, 4 * 128)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCS, rcs, 4 * 32 * (size_t)npos)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSN, rsn, 4 * 32 * (size_t)npos));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dHST, 0xdeadbeefu, 1280));
	desc_t prog[1];
	d_init(&prog[0], OP_IDXQK, 6);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x140, dIQK); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x148, dQN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x150, dKN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x158, dCS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x160, dSN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x168, dIQ);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x170, dRING); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x178, dPKT); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x180, dHST); d_tok(&prog[0], 0x188, 0); d_f32(&prog[0], 0x18c, eps);
	float iqk[640], iq[512], iqg[512], ring[4 * 128];
	uint16_t *pool = calloc((size_t)(nblk + 1) * 128, 2), *pktg = malloc((size_t)ngrp * 8192), *pkt = calloc((size_t)ngrp * 4096, 2);
	uint32_t hst[1280];
	int bad = 0, shown = 0;
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < T; t++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < 640; i++) iqk[i] = 1.5f * frand();
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIQK, iqk, 4 * 640));
		run_token(prog, 1, t);
		for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) idx_norm_rope_gpu(iqk + 128 * h, qn, eps, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t, iq + 128 * h);
		memcpy(ring + 128 * (t & 3), iqk + 512, 4 * 128);
		if ((t & 3) == 3) {
			unsigned b = t >> 2; uint16_t p[128];
			idx_pool_gpu(ring, kn, eps, rcs + 32 * (t - 3), rsn + 32 * (t - 3), p);
			for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) { pool[(size_t)b * 128 + d] = p[d]; pkt[pkt_idx(b, d)] = p[d]; }
		}
		int b = 0;
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(iqg, dIQ, 4 * 512)); b |= cmpb("iq", iq, iqg, 4 * 512, &shown);
		float ringg[512]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ringg, dRING, 4 * 512)); b |= cmpb("ring", ring, ringg, 4 * 128 * ((t & 3) + 1), &shown);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(pktg, dPKT, (size_t)ngrp * 8192)); b |= cmpb("pool", pkt, pktg, (size_t)ngrp * 8192, &shown);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(hst, dHST, 4 * 1280)); for (int i = 0; i < 1280; i++) if (hst[i]) { if (shown++ < 4) printf("  HST[%d] = %08x not zeroed\n", i, hst[i]); b = 1; break; }
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dHST, 0xdeadbeefu, 1280));
		if (b && !bad) printf("first mismatch at t = %u\n", t);
		bad += b;
	}
	printf("idxqk: %u tokens: %s (%d tokens differ)\n", T, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", bad);
	return bad;
}

static int test_idxscore(unsigned nv, unsigned NBLK) {
	unsigned ngrp = (nv + 31) / 32 + 1, t = 4 * nv + (urand() & 3) - ((nv > 0) ? 1 : 0);
	if (nv == 0) t = 0;
	float iq[512]; for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) iq[i] = 1.5f * frand();
	uint16_t *pool = calloc((size_t)(nv + 1) * 128, 2), *pkt = calloc((size_t)ngrp * 4096, 2);
	for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) { uint16_t h = qsa_f2h(2.f * frand() + (b % 5 == 0 ? 0.7f : 0.f)); pool[(size_t)b * 128 + d] = h; pkt[pkt_idx(b, d)] = h; }
	CUdeviceptr dPKT = dalloc((size_t)ngrp * 8192), dIQ = dalloc(4 * 512), dSC = dalloc(4 * ((size_t)ngrp * 32 + 32)), dHST = dalloc(4 * 1280);
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPKT, pkt, (size_t)ngrp * 8192)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIQ, iq, 4 * 512));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dSC, 0x7fc00000u, ngrp * 32 + 32));
	desc_t prog[1];
	d_init(&prog[0], OP_IDXSCORE, 16);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x140, dPKT); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x148, dIQ); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x150, dSC); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x158, dHST); d_tok(&prog[0], 0x160, 0); d_u32(&prog[0], 0x164, NBLK);
	run_token(prog, 1, t);
	float *sc = malloc(4 * (nv + 1)), *scg = malloc(4 * ((size_t)ngrp * 32 + 32));
	idx_scores_gpu(iq, pool, nv, sc);
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(scg, dSC, 4 * ((size_t)ngrp * 32 + 32)));
	uint32_t hist[256] = { 0 }, histg[1280];
	for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) { uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &sc[b], 4); hist[u >> 23]++; }
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(histg, dHST, 4 * 1280));
	int bad = 0, shown = 0;
	if (nv > NBLK) { bad |= cmpb("scores", sc, scg, 4 * (size_t)nv, &shown); bad |= cmpb("hist", hist, histg, 4 * 256, &shown); }
	else for (unsigned i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (scg[i] == scg[i] && scg[i] != 0.f) { printf("  wrote scores although nv <= NBLK\n"); bad = 1; break; }
	printf("idxscore: nv %u NBLK %u: %s\n", nv, NBLK, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT");
	return bad;
}

static int test_idxsel(unsigned nv, unsigned NBLK, int mode, int npass) {
	unsigned t = 4 * nv - 1;
	float *sc = malloc(4 * (nv + 8)); uint32_t *sel = calloc(NBLK + 8, 4), *selg = malloc(4 * (NBLK + 8)), *selw = calloc(NBLK + 8, 4);
	for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) {
		float v = fabsf(frand()) * 3.f;
		if (mode == 1 && (urand() % 3)) v = 0.f;                   /* mostly exact zeros: a tie at the threshold */
		if (mode == 2) v = (float)(urand() % 7) * 0.5f;             /* a few distinct values */
		if (mode == 3) v = 1.25f;                                   /* all equal */
		sc[b] = v;
	}
	CUdeviceptr dSC = dalloc(4 * (nv + 8)), dHST = dalloc(4 * 1280), dSEL = dalloc(4 * (NBLK + 8));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSC, sc, 4 * nv));
	uint32_t hst[1280] = { 0 };
	for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) { uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &sc[b], 4); hst[u >> 23]++; }
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dHST, hst, 4 * 1280));
	CK(cuMemsetD32(dSEL, 0xffffffffu, NBLK + 8));
	desc_t prog[5];
	for (int p = 0; p < 5; p++) { d_init(&prog[p], OP_IDXSEL, 16); d_ptr(&prog[p], 0x140, dSC); d_ptr(&prog[p], 0x148, dHST); d_ptr(&prog[p], 0x150, dSEL); d_tok(&prog[p], 0x158, 0); d_u32(&prog[p], 0x15c, NBLK); d_u32(&prog[p], 0x160, 2 + p); }
	run_token(prog, (unsigned)npass, t);
	unsigned k = idx_select_gpu(sc, nv, NBLK, sel);
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(selg, dSEL, 4 * (NBLK + 8)));
	int bad = 0, shown = 0;
	if (getenv("QSA_DEBUG") && nv <= 8000)
	{ uint32_t hg[1280]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(hg, dHST, 4 * 1280)); uint32_t *bits = malloc(4 * nv), Th = 0; unsigned gt = 0, eq = 0; for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) memcpy(&bits[b], &sc[b], 4);
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < nv; i++) { unsigned c = 0; for (unsigned j = 0; j < nv; j++) if (bits[j] > bits[i] || (bits[j] == bits[i] && j < i)) c++; if (c == (nv < NBLK ? nv : NBLK) - 1) Th = bits[i]; }
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < nv; i++) { if (bits[i] > Th) gt++; else if (bits[i] == Th) eq++; }
		for (int p = 2; p <= 6; p++) printf("  pass %d scan: pre %08x kk %u\n", p, hg[1056 + 2 * p], hg[1057 + 2 * p]);
		{ uint32_t eh[4][256] = { { 0 } }; unsigned sh[4] = { 23, 15, 7, 0 }, mk[4] = { 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0x7f }; uint32_t pf[4] = { 0 };
			for (int L = 0; L < 4; L++) { pf[L] = L ? (L == 1 ? Th >> 23 : L == 2 ? Th >> 15 : Th >> 7) : 0; for (unsigned i = 0; i < nv; i++) { if (L == 0 || (bits[i] >> (sh[L - 1])) == pf[L]) eh[L][(bits[i] >> sh[L]) & mk[L]]++; }
				unsigned bad2 = 0, s2 = 0, es = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) { s2 += hg[256 * L + i]; es += eh[L][i]; if (hg[256 * L + i] != eh[L][i]) { if (bad2 < 4 && L == 1) printf("    G2 bin %02x: gpu %u host %u\n", i, hg[256 * L + i], eh[L][i]); bad2++; } } printf("  G%d: %u bins differ, gpu sum %u host sum %u\n", L + 1, bad2, s2, es); } }
		printf("  G1[0x7e] = %u, above: ", hg[0x7e]); { unsigned a = 0; for (int i = 0x7f; i < 256; i++) a += hg[i]; printf("%u\n", a); }
		printf("  T: gpu %08x host %08x ; need: gpu %u host %u (gt %u eq %u); hist2 sum %u hist3 sum %u hist4 sum %u\n", hg[1088], Th, hg[1089], NBLK - gt, gt, eq, 0u, 0u, 0u); free(bits); }
	bad |= cmpb("sel", sel, selg, 4 * (size_t)k, &shown);
	printf("idxsel: nv %u NBLK %u mode %d: %s\n", nv, NBLK, mode, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT");
	if (bad) { printf("  twin:"); for (unsigned i = 0; i < k && i < 24; i++) printf(" %u", sel[i]); printf("\n  gpu :"); for (unsigned i = 0; i < k && i < 24; i++) printf(" %u", selg[i]); printf("\n"); }
	(void)selw;
	return bad;
}

/* the whole indexer: idxqk, idxscore, the five idxsel passes, against the twins; then the time of the 8 phases per token */
static int test_idxfull(unsigned nv, unsigned NBLK, int iters) {
	const float eps = 1e-6f;
	unsigned t = 4 * nv - 1, npos = t + 8 + (unsigned)iters, ngrp = (npos / 4 + 31) / 32 + 1, nsc = ngrp * 32 + 32;
	float *rcs = malloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), *rsn = malloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos);
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < npos; i++) rope_table_gpu(i, 1e7f, rcs + 32 * i, rsn + 32 * i);
	float qn[128], kn[128], iqk[640]; for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) { qn[i] = 0.5f + 0.5f * frand(); kn[i] = 0.5f + 0.5f * frand(); }
	for (int i = 0; i < 640; i++) iqk[i] = 1.5f * frand();
	uint16_t *pkt = calloc((size_t)ngrp * 4096, 2);
	for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) pkt[pkt_idx(b, d)] = qsa_f2h(2.f * frand() + (b % 5 == 0 ? 0.7f : 0.f));
	CUdeviceptr dIQK = dalloc(4 * 640), dQN = dalloc(512), dKN = dalloc(512), dCS = dalloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), dSN = dalloc(4 * 32 * (size_t)npos), dIQ = dalloc(2048), dRING = dalloc(2048), dPKT = dalloc((size_t)ngrp * 8192), dHST = dalloc(4 * 1280), dSC = dalloc(4 * (size_t)nsc), dSEL = dalloc(4 * (NBLK + 8));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIQK, iqk, 4 * 640)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dQN, qn, 512)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dKN, kn, 512)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCS, rcs, 4 * 32 * (size_t)npos)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSN, rsn, 4 * 32 * (size_t)npos));
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPKT, pkt, (size_t)ngrp * 8192));
	desc_t prog[8];
	d_init(&prog[0], OP_IDXQK, 6);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x140, dIQK); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x148, dQN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x150, dKN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x158, dCS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x160, dSN); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x168, dIQ);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x170, dRING); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x178, dPKT); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x180, dHST); d_tok(&prog[0], 0x188, 0); d_f32(&prog[0], 0x18c, eps);
	d_init(&prog[1], OP_IDXSCORE, 16);
	d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x140, dPKT); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x148, dIQ); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x150, dSC); d_ptr(&prog[1], 0x158, dHST); d_tok(&prog[1], 0x160, 0); d_u32(&prog[1], 0x164, NBLK);
	for (int p = 0; p < 5; p++) { d_init(&prog[2 + p], OP_IDXSEL, 16); d_ptr(&prog[2 + p], 0x140, dSC); d_ptr(&prog[2 + p], 0x148, dHST); d_ptr(&prog[2 + p], 0x150, dSEL); d_tok(&prog[2 + p], 0x158, 0); d_u32(&prog[2 + p], 0x15c, NBLK); d_u32(&prog[2 + p], 0x160, 2 + p); }
	run_token(prog, 7, t);
	/* the twin from what the device holds: its pool, its IQ */
	uint16_t *pktg = malloc((size_t)ngrp * 8192); float iqg[512]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(pktg, dPKT, (size_t)ngrp * 8192)); CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(iqg, dIQ, 2048));
	float iq[512]; for (int h = 0; h < 4; h++) idx_norm_rope_gpu(iqk + 128 * h, qn, eps, rcs + 32 * t, rsn + 32 * t, iq + 128 * h);
	uint16_t *pool = malloc((size_t)nv * 256); for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) pool[(size_t)b * 128 + d] = pktg[pkt_idx(b, d)];
	float *sc = malloc(4 * (size_t)nv); idx_scores_gpu(iq, pool, nv, sc);
	uint32_t *sel = malloc(4 * (NBLK + 8)), *selg = malloc(4 * (NBLK + 8)); unsigned k = idx_select_gpu(sc, nv, NBLK, sel);
	CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(selg, dSEL, 4 * (NBLK + 8)));
	int bad = 0, shown = 0; bad |= cmpb("iq", iq, iqg, 2048, &shown);
	if (nv > NBLK) bad |= cmpb("sel", sel, selg, 4 * (size_t)k, &shown);
	printf("idxfull: nv %u NBLK %u: %s\n", nv, NBLK, bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT");
	if (iters > 0) {   /* the time of the 7 phases: iters tokens in one launch (the context grows by iters/4 blocks) */
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPROG, prog, sizeof(desc_t) * 7)); unsigned nph = 7, tk = t;
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCTL + 8, &tk, 4));
		unsigned ntok = t + (unsigned)iters; void *params[] = { &dPROG, &nph, &dCTL, &ntok };
		CUevent e0, e1; CK(cuEventCreate(&e0, 0)); CK(cuEventCreate(&e1, 0));
		CK(cuEventRecord(e0, 0)); CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 16, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL)); CK(cuEventRecord(e1, 0)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		float ms; CK(cuEventElapsedTime(&ms, e0, e1));
		printf("  %d tokens (7 phases each) in %.2f ms: %.1f us per token\n", iters, ms, 1e3 * ms / iters);
		{ uint32_t ts[16]; CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(ts, dCTL + 0x100, 4 * 7)); printf("  last token, us per phase (idxscore, idxsel 2..6; idxqk, the first phase, has no start stamp):"); for (int i = 1; i < 7; i++) printf(" %.1f", (uint32_t)(ts[i] - ts[i - 1]) / 1e3); printf("\n"); }
	}
	return bad;
}

/* embrow: image rows from the fp16 table, token rows from a Q3_K table, through the same op */
static int test_embimg(void) {
	const int R = 32; unsigned npos = 6;
	uint8_t *tab = malloc((size_t)R * 1100); for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)R * 1100; i++) tab[i] = (uint8_t)urand();
	for (int r = 0; r < R; r++) for (int b = 0; b < 10; b++) { uint16_t h = (uint16_t)(0x2c00 + (urand() % 0x1000)); memcpy(tab + (size_t)r * 1100 + 110 * b + 108, &h, 2); }
	unsigned nimg = 4; uint16_t *img = malloc(2 * 2560 * (size_t)nimg); for (size_t i = 0; i < 2560 * (size_t)nimg; i++) img[i] = qsa_f2h(3.f * frand());
	uint32_t ids[6] = { 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15 }, imap[6] = { 0xffffffffu, 3, 0xffffffffu, 0xffffffffu, 0, 2 };
	CUdeviceptr dE = dalloc((size_t)R * 1100), dS = dalloc(4 * 10240), dIDS = dalloc(64), dIMAP = dalloc(64), dIMG = dalloc(2 * 2560 * (size_t)nimg);
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dE, tab, (size_t)R * 1100)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIDS, ids, 24)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIMAP, imap, 24)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dIMG, img, 2 * 2560 * (size_t)nimg));
	desc_t prog[1]; d_init(&prog[0], OP_EMBROW, 10);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x140, dE); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x148, dS); d_tok(&prog[0], 0x150, 0); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x158, dIDS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x160, dIMAP); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x168, dIMG);
	int bad = 0, shown = 0;
	for (unsigned t = 0; t < npos; t++) {
		CK(cuMemsetD32(dS, 0x7fc00000u, 10240));
		run_token(prog, 1, t);
		float ref[2560], got[10240];
		if (imap[t] == 0xffffffffu) dequant(GG_Q3_K, tab + (size_t)ids[t] * 1100, ref, 2560);
		else for (int j = 0; j < 2560; j++) ref[j] = qsa_h2f(img[(size_t)imap[t] * 2560 + j]);
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(got, dS, 4 * 10240));
		for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) bad |= cmpb(imap[t] == 0xffffffffu ? "token row" : "image row", ref, got + 2560 * l, 4 * 2560, &shown);
	}
	printf("embrow with images: %s\n", bad ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT");
	return bad;
}

/* the time of kvgather over 2051 attended keys with the int8 cache in VRAM or in pinned host memory */
static int test_gathertime(int host, unsigned nv) {
	unsigned NBLK = 512, t = 4 * nv - 1, npos = 4 * nv + 400;
	size_t cpos = (4 * (NBLK + 1) + 2048 + 31) / 32 * 32;
	CUdeviceptr dKQ = host ? halloc((size_t)npos * 512) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 512), dVQ = host ? halloc((size_t)npos * 512) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 512), dKS = host ? halloc((size_t)npos * 32) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 32), dVS = host ? halloc((size_t)npos * 32) : dalloc((size_t)npos * 32);
	CUdeviceptr dKC = dalloc(ATTN_KC_FLOATS(cpos) * 4), dVC = dalloc(cpos * 512 * 4), dSEL = dalloc(4 * (NBLK + 8));
	uint32_t sel[512]; for (unsigned i = 0; i < NBLK; i++) sel[i] = i * (nv / NBLK);
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dSEL, sel, 4 * NBLK));
	desc_t prog[1]; d_init(&prog[0], OP_KVGATHER, NBLK + 1);
	d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x140, dKQ); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x148, dKS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x150, dVQ); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x158, dVS); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x160, dKC); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x168, dVC); d_ptr(&prog[0], 0x170, dSEL); d_tok(&prog[0], 0x178, 0); d_u32(&prog[0], 0x17c, NBLK);
	CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dPROG, prog, sizeof(desc_t))); unsigned nph = 1, ntok = t + 1 + 50; CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dCTL + 8, &t, 4));
	void *params[] = { &dPROG, &nph, &dCTL, &ntok };
	CUevent e0, e1; CK(cuEventCreate(&e0, 0)); CK(cuEventCreate(&e1, 0));
	CK(cuEventRecord(e0, 0)); CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 16, 1, 1, 256, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL)); CK(cuEventRecord(e1, 0)); CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
	float ms; CK(cuEventElapsedTime(&ms, e0, e1));
	printf("kvgather, cache in %s memory: %.1f us per token (2051 keys)\n", host ? "host" : "device", 1e3 * ms / 51);
	return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: qsa_test kv <T> <NBLK>\n"); return 2; }
	dev_init();
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "idxscore")) return test_idxscore(argc > 2 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[2]) : 700, argc > 3 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[3]) : 512) ? 3 : 0;
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "idxsel")) return test_idxsel(argc > 2 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[2]) : 700, argc > 3 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[3]) : 512, argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 0, argc > 5 ? atoi(argv[5]) : 5) ? 3 : 0;
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "idxfull")) return test_idxfull(argc > 2 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[2]) : 2000, argc > 3 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[3]) : 512, argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 0) ? 3 : 0;
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "embimg")) return test_embimg() ? 3 : 0;
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "gathertime")) return test_gathertime(argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 0, argc > 3 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[3]) : 5000);
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "idxqk")) return test_idxqk(argc > 2 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[2]) : 100) ? 3 : 0;
	if (!strcmp(argv[1], "kv")) return test_kv(argc > 2 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[2]) : 200, argc > 3 ? (unsigned)atoi(argv[3]) : 8) ? 1 : 0;
	fprintf(stderr, "unknown test %s\n", argv[1]); return 2;
}


File: kern/quant_bench.c
/* Paired OP_ATTNQKQ benchmark. One persistent launch repeats a fixed-position
 * descriptor. Event intervals exclude initialization, copies and validation.
 * The complete operation includes RMSNorm, RoPE, quantization, dispatch and
 * synchronization; paired differences estimate incremental clamp/trace cost.
 * This is not a whole-model performance measurement. */
#include <cuda.h>
#include "dieops.h"
#include <errno.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef FLASH_REV
#define FLASH_REV "unknown"
#endif
CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *, unsigned int, CUdevice);
#define CK(call) do { CUresult r_ = (call); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { \
 const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
 fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #call, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

enum { BOUNDED, UNBOUNDED, TRACE, NVARIANTS };
enum { NQG=12288, NQO=6144, NKV=512, NWEIGHT=256, NROT=32, NSCALE=16, NRAW=32, CTL_BYTES=8192 };
typedef struct { uint32_t w[32]; } desc_t;
typedef struct { CUdeviceptr device; void *host; size_t bytes; } buffer_t;
typedef struct {
 float qo[NQO];
 int8_t kq[NKV], vq[NKV];
 uint16_t ks[NSCALE], vs[NSCALE];
 float raw[NRAW];
} snapshot_t;
typedef struct {
 buffer_t qg, k, v, qn, kn, cs, sn, qo, kq, vq, ks, vs, raw;
 buffer_t program[NVARIANTS], control;
 CUmodule module[NVARIANTS]; CUfunction function[NVARIANTS];
 CUevent start, stop;
} bench_t;
static const char *variant_name[NVARIANTS] = {"bounded", "unbounded", "trace"};
static void fail(const char *s) { fprintf(stderr, "quant_bench: %s\n", s); exit(1); }
static void *allocate(size_t n, size_t size) {
 void *p = calloc(n, size); if (!p) fail("host allocation failed"); return p;
}
static buffer_t buffer_alloc(size_t bytes, int mapped) {
 buffer_t b = {0}; b.bytes = bytes;
 if (mapped) {
  CK(cuMemHostAlloc(&b.host, bytes, CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP | CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_PORTABLE));
  CK(cuMemHostGetDevicePointer(&b.device, b.host, 0)); memset(b.host, 0, bytes);
 } else { CK(cuMemAlloc(&b.device, bytes)); CK(cuMemsetD8(b.device, 0, bytes)); }
 return b;
}
static void buffer_write(const buffer_t *b, const void *src) {
 if (b->host) memcpy(b->host, src, b->bytes);
 else CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(b->device, src, b->bytes));
}
static void buffer_read(const buffer_t *b, void *dst) {
 if (b->host) memcpy(dst, b->host, b->bytes);
 else CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(dst, b->device, b->bytes));
}
static void buffer_fill(const buffer_t *b, unsigned char v) {
 if (b->host) memset(b->host, v, b->bytes);
 else CK(cuMemsetD8(b->device, v, b->bytes));
}
static void buffer_free(buffer_t *b) {
 if (b->host) CK(cuMemFreeHost(b->host));
 else if (b->device) CK(cuMemFree(b->device));
 memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
}
static void desc_ptr(desc_t *d, unsigned addr, CUdeviceptr p) {
 unsigned w = 2 + (addr - 0x140) / 4; d->w[w] = (uint32_t)p; d->w[w+1] = (uint32_t)(p >> 32);
}
static desc_t make_descriptor(const bench_t *b, int variant) {
 desc_t d = {{0}}; d.w[0] = OP_ATTNQKQ;
 d.w[1] = 26; /* Work units: 24 query heads + 2 KV heads, not parameter words. */
 desc_ptr(&d, 0x140, b->qg.device); desc_ptr(&d, 0x148, b->k.device);
 desc_ptr(&d, 0x150, b->v.device); desc_ptr(&d, 0x158, b->qn.device);
 desc_ptr(&d, 0x160, b->kn.device); desc_ptr(&d, 0x168, b->cs.device);
 desc_ptr(&d, 0x170, b->sn.device); desc_ptr(&d, 0x178, b->qo.device);
 desc_ptr(&d, 0x180, b->kq.device); desc_ptr(&d, 0x188, b->vq.device);
 float eps = 1e-6f; memcpy(&d.w[2 + (0x194 - 0x140) / 4], &eps, sizeof eps);
 desc_ptr(&d, 0x198, b->ks.device); desc_ptr(&d, 0x1a0, b->vs.device);
 if (variant == TRACE) desc_ptr(&d, 0x1a8, b->raw.device);
 /* param_t=0 and w[31]=0: fixed position and pointers for every iteration. */
 return d;
}
static void initialize_fixture(bench_t *b, float k[NKV], float v[NKV]) {
 float *qg = allocate(NQG, sizeof *qg), weight[NWEIGHT], cs[NROT], sn[NROT];
 for (int i=0; i<NQG; ++i) qg[i] = (float)((i*13+17)%101-50)/32.f;
 for (int i=0; i<NKV; ++i) {
  k[i] = (float)((i*17+11)%97-48)/16.f;
  v[i] = (float)((i*29+7)%113-56)/8.f;
 }
 for (int i=0; i<NWEIGHT; ++i) weight[i] = 1.f;
 for (int i=0; i<NROT; ++i) { cs[i] = 1.f; sn[i] = 0.f; }
 buffer_write(&b->qg, qg); buffer_write(&b->k, k); buffer_write(&b->v, v);
 buffer_write(&b->qn, weight); buffer_write(&b->kn, weight);
 buffer_write(&b->cs, cs); buffer_write(&b->sn, sn); free(qg);
}
static void reset_outputs(bench_t *b) {
 CK(cuMemsetD32(b->qo.device, 0x7fc00000u, NQO));
 buffer_fill(&b->kq, 0x80); buffer_fill(&b->vq, 0x80);
 buffer_fill(&b->ks, 0xff); buffer_fill(&b->vs, 0xff); buffer_fill(&b->raw, 0xff);
}
static void read_snapshot(const bench_t *b, snapshot_t *s, int trace) {
 memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
 buffer_read(&b->qo, s->qo); buffer_read(&b->kq, s->kq); buffer_read(&b->vq, s->vq);
 buffer_read(&b->ks, s->ks); buffer_read(&b->vs, s->vs);
 if (trace) buffer_read(&b->raw, s->raw);
}
static float half_value(uint16_t h) {
 unsigned e = (h >> 10) & 31u, f = h & 1023u;
 float x = !e ? ldexpf((float)f, -24) :
   e == 31u ? (f ? NAN : INFINITY) : ldexpf((float)(1024u+f), (int)e-25);
 return h & 0x8000u ? -x : x;
}
static void compare_snapshot(const snapshot_t *expected, const snapshot_t *actual, int variant, int sample) {
 if (memcmp(expected->qo, actual->qo, sizeof expected->qo) ||
     memcmp(expected->kq, actual->kq, sizeof expected->kq) ||
     memcmp(expected->vq, actual->vq, sizeof expected->vq) ||
     memcmp(expected->ks, actual->ks, sizeof expected->ks) ||
     memcmp(expected->vs, actual->vs, sizeof expected->vs)) {
  fprintf(stderr, "ordinary output mismatch: variant=%s sample=%d\n", variant_name[variant], sample); exit(1);
 }
}
/* Independent moderate-range check. K normalization uses double precision;
 * identity rotation and unit weights make the expected input explicit.
 * Tolerance includes integer rounding and FP16 scale rounding. */
static void check_vector(const char *name, const float input[NKV],
                         const int8_t code[NKV], const uint16_t scale[NSCALE]) {
 for (int group=0; group<NSCALE; ++group) {
  double maximum=0, s=half_value(scale[group]);
  for (int j=0; j<32; ++j) {
   double a=fabs((double)input[group*32+j]); if (a>maximum) maximum=a;
  }
  double expected=maximum/127., tolerance=expected/1024.+0x1p-24;
  if (!(s>0) || !isfinite(s) || fabs(s-expected)>tolerance) {
   fprintf(stderr, "%s scale mismatch group=%d observed=%.9g expected=%.9g\n", name, group, s, expected); exit(1);
  }
  double error=0.51*s+maximum/1024.+1e-5;
  for (int j=0; j<32; ++j) {
   int i=group*32+j;
   if (code[i]==INT8_MIN || fabs((double)code[i]*s-input[i])>error) {
    fprintf(stderr, "%s reconstruction mismatch component=%d\n", name, i); exit(1);
   }
  }
 }
}
static void check_reference(const snapshot_t *s, const float k[NKV],
                            const float v[NKV], float normalized[NKV]) {
 for (int i=0; i<NQO; ++i) if (!isfinite(s->qo[i])) fail("nonfinite/unwritten Q output");
 for (int h=0; h<2; ++h) {
  double sum=0;
  for (int j=0; j<256; ++j) { double x=k[h*256+j]; sum+=x*x; }
  double inv=1./sqrt(sum/256.+1e-6);
  for (int j=0; j<256; ++j) normalized[h*256+j]=(float)(k[h*256+j]*inv);
 }
 check_vector("K", normalized, s->kq, s->ks); check_vector("V", v, s->vq, s->vs);
}
static void check_trace(const snapshot_t *s, const float normalized[NKV], const float v[NKV]) {
 for (int kind=0; kind<2; ++kind) for (int g=0; g<NSCALE; ++g) {
  const float *input=kind?v:normalized; double expected=0;
  for (int j=0; j<32; ++j) { double a=fabs((double)input[g*32+j]); if (a>expected) expected=a; }
  double got=s->raw[kind*NSCALE+g];
  if (!(got>0) || !isfinite(got) || fabs(got-expected)>2e-5*expected+1e-6) {
   fprintf(stderr, "raw %c maximum mismatch group=%d observed=%.9g expected=%.9g\n",
           kind?'V':'K', g, got, expected); exit(1);
  }
 }
}
static float launch(bench_t *b, int variant, unsigned iterations, int timed) {
 unsigned nph=1; CUdeviceptr program=b->program[variant].device, control=b->control.device;
 void *parameters[]={&program, &nph, &control, &iterations};
 CK(cuMemsetD8(control, 0, CTL_BYTES));
 float ms = 0;
 if (timed) CK(cuEventRecord(b->start, 0));
 CK(cuLaunchKernel(b->function[variant], 16,1,1, 256,1,1, 0,0, parameters,NULL));
 if (timed) {
  CK(cuEventRecord(b->stop, 0)); CK(cuEventSynchronize(b->stop));
  CK(cuEventElapsedTime(&ms, b->start, b->stop));
  if (!(ms>0) || !isfinite(ms)) fail("invalid event interval");
 } else {
  CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
 }
 unsigned completed = 0;
 CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(&completed, control + 8, sizeof completed));
 if (completed != iterations) fail("persistent loop did not complete every requested operation");
 return ms;
}
static unsigned number(const char *s, unsigned lo, unsigned hi, const char *option) {
 char *end; errno=0; unsigned long n=strtoul(s, &end, 10);
 if (!*s || *s=='-' || errno || *end || n<lo || n>hi) {
  fprintf(stderr, "invalid %s: %s\n", option, s); exit(2);
 }
 return (unsigned)n;
}
static int compare_double(const void *a, const void *b) {
 double x=*(const double *)a, y=*(const double *)b; return (x>y)-(x<y);
}
static double median(const double *data, unsigned n) {
 double *copy=allocate(n, sizeof *copy); memcpy(copy, data, n*sizeof *copy);
 qsort(copy, n, sizeof *copy, compare_double);
 double m=n&1u ? copy[n/2] : (copy[n/2-1]+copy[n/2])/2.; free(copy); return m;
}

  if (v==TRACE) check_trace(&actual,normalized,v_input);
  printf("%u,%d,%s,%d,%u,%.9g,%.9g\n",sample,slot,variant_name[v],host,iterations,(double)ms,us[v][sample]); fflush(stdout);
 }

         s,clamp[s],clamp_pct[s],trace[s],trace_pct[s]);
 }

 printf("# median_paired_clamp_delta_us=%.9g,median_paired_clamp_delta_percent=%.9g\n",median(clamp,samples),median(clamp_pct,samples));
 printf("# median_paired_trace_delta_us=%.9g,median_paired_trace_delta_percent=%.9g\n",median(trace,samples),median(trace_pct,samples));
 printf("# measured_launch_output_checks=%u,all_bitwise_agreement=PASS\n",samples*NVARIANTS);
 puts("# note=negative_deltas_retained;no_claim_of_statistical_significance");

static void old(const float*x,int8_t*q,uint16_t*s){
 float g=0;for(int i=0;i<32;i++)if(fabsf(x[i])>g)g=fabsf(x[i]);
 if(g<7.8886090522101180541e-31f)g=7.8886090522101180541e-31f;
 float inv=rcp_gpu(g)*127.f;for(int i=0;i<32;i++)q[i]=(int8_t)lrintf(x[i]*inv);*s=qsa_f2h(g*(1.f/127.f));
}
static void group(float a){
 float x[32],clip[32];for(int i=0;i<32;i++){x[i]=i%3==0?0:(i&1)?-a:a;clip[i]=fmaxf(-QSA_KV_MAX_ABS,fminf(QSA_KV_MAX_ABS,x[i]));}
 int8_t q[32],eq[32];uint16_t s,es;assert(!kv_quant32_checked(x,q,&s));old(clip,eq,&es);assert(!memcmp(q,eq,32)&&s==es);

File: kern/rmsnorm.sass
# Kernel: rmsnorm
#
# fp32 RMSNorm of one vector of n = GEMV_K elements (2560 or 10240), one warp;
# CTA b handles vector b (X, W, Y offset by 4 n b: the 4 hyper lanes in one launch):
#   ss = sum x_i^2 (one FFMA chain per lane over its 4-element chunks at
#   4 (l + 32 j), j in order; SHFL butterfly xor 16..1), m = ss * (1/n),
#   v = m + eps, s = sqrt_rn(v), r = rcp_rn(s), y_i = (x_i * r) * w_i.
# Two streaming passes over U chunks per iteration (x is reloaded for the apply
# pass). Bit-exact twin: ref/quant.c rmsnorm_gpu.
# Barriers: 1 = x loads, 2 = w loads, 3 = MUFU, 4 = y store reads, 5 = SHFL, 6 = S2R.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 X  1:0x148:8 W  2:0x150:8 Y  3:0x158:4 eps

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_X0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_X1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_Y0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_Y1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_eps  : c[0x0][0x158]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<CODE>
    my $n = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $C = $n / 128;
    my $U = $C <= 20 ? $C : 16;
    my $o = "<REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    my $r = 0;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : x<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + 4*$U - 1, 4*$U - 1; $r += 4*$U;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d-%d : wt<00-%02d>\n", $r, $r + 4*$U - 1, 4*$U - 1; $r += 4*$U;
    for my $name (qw(ss mm vv s0 hh rr e mneg1 t it tid lane invn eps bid off)) { $o .= sprintf "    %d : %s\n", $r++, $name; }
    $r += $r & 1;
    $o .= sprintf "    %d,%d : xp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : wp<0-1>\n    %d,%d : yp<0-1>\n", $r, $r+1, $r+2, $r+3, $r+4, $r+5;
    $o .= "</REGISTER_MAPPING>\n";
    return $o;
</CODE>

<CODE>
    my $n = $ENV{GEMV_K} || 2560;
    my $C = $n / 128;
    my $U = $C <= 20 ? $C : 16;
    my $NI = $C / $U;
    my $invn = unpack("L", pack("f", 1.0 / $n));
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R bid, SR_CTAID.X;\n";                   # CTA b normalises vector b (X, W, Y + 4 n b)
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I mneg1, 0xbf800000;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:1      MOV32I invn, 0x%08x;\n", $invn;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV eps, param_eps;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      XMAD off, bid, 0x%x, RZ;\n", 4 * $n;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD off, off, t;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV it, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 EXIT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, off, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, off, param_W0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, RZ, param_W1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, off, param_Y0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, RZ, param_Y1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV ss, RZ;\n";
    # pass 1: sum of squares
    $o .= "\nPASS1:\n";
    for my $u (0..$U-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 x%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", $u == $U-1 ? '2' : '1', 4*$u, 512*$u; }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD it, it, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, it, 0x%x, PT;\n", $NI;
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:6      FFMA ss, x%02d, x%02d, ss;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_, $_ for 0..4*$U-1;
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, xp0, 0x%x;\n", 512*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, xp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA PASS1;\n" if $NI > 1;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, ss, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FADD ss, ss, t;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL mm, ss, invn;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD vv, mm, eps;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RSQ rr, vv;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:1      FMUL.FTZ s0, vv, rr;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMUL.FTZ hh, rr, 0.5;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ e, -s0, -RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA e, s0, e, vv;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA s0, e, hh, s0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:3:-:2      MUFU.RCP rr, s0;\n";
    $o .= "04:-:-:-:6      FFMA e, s0, rr, mneg1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD.FTZ e, -e, -RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FFMA rr, rr, e, rr;\n";
    # reset xp, it
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, off, param_X0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, RZ, param_X1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV it, RZ;\n";
    # pass 2: y = (x * r) * w
    $o .= "\nPASS2:\n";
    for my $u (0..$U-1) { $o .= sprintf "%s:-:1:-:1      LDG.E.CI.128 x%02d, [xp+0x%x];\n", $u == 0 ? '08' : '--', 4*$u, 512*$u; }
    for my $u (0..$U-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:-:2:-:%s      LDG.E.CI.128 wt%02d, [wp+0x%x];\n", $u == $U-1 ? '2' : '1', 4*$u, 512*$u; }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD it, it, 0x1;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.LT.U32.AND P4, PT, it, 0x%x, PT;\n", $NI;
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      DEPBAR.LE SB0, 0x0;\n" if $ENV{RMS_DEPBAR};
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL x%02d, x%02d, rr;\n", $_ == 0 ? '01' : '--', $_ == 4*$U-1 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..4*$U-1;
    $o .= "02:-:-:-:6      DEPBAR.LE SB1, 0x0;\n" if $ENV{RMS_DEPBAR};
    $o .= sprintf "%s:-:-:-:%s      FMUL x%02d, x%02d, wt%02d;\n", $_ == 0 ? '02' : '--', $_ == 4*$U-1 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_, $_ for 0..4*$U-1;
    for my $u (0..$U-1) { $o .= sprintf "--:4:-:-:1      STG.E.128 [yp+0x%x], x%02d;\n", 512*$u, 4*$u; }
    $o .= sprintf "08:-:-:-:6      IADD xp0.CC, xp0, 0x%x;\n", 512*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X xp1, xp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD wp0.CC, wp0, 0x%x;\n", 512*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X wp1, wp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD yp0.CC, yp0, 0x%x;\n", 512*$U;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X yp1, yp1, RZ;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P4 BRA PASS2;\n" if $NI > 1;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:f      EXIT;\n";
    return $o;

File: kern/rmsnorm_test.c
/* rmsnorm_test N: the fp32 RMSNorm kernel against rmsnorm_gpu, bit for bit. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "quant.h"
#include <cuda.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

CUresult cuCtxCreate_v2(CUcontext *pctx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice dev);
#define CK(x) do { CUresult r_ = (x); if (r_ != CUDA_SUCCESS) { const char *s_ = "?"; cuGetErrorString(r_, &s_); \
	fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: %s -> %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, s_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static uint32_t rs = 13;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	int n = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 2560;
	float eps = 1e-6f;
	CK(cuInit(0));
	CUdevice dev; CUcontext ctx; CUmodule mod; CUfunction fn;
	CK(cuDeviceGet(&dev, 0));
	CK(cuCtxCreate_v2(&ctx, CU_CTX_SCHED_SPIN, dev));
	char cubin[64];
	snprintf(cubin, sizeof cubin, "rmsnorm_k%d.cubin", n);
	CK(cuModuleLoad(&mod, cubin));
	CK(cuModuleGetFunction(&fn, mod, "rmsnorm"));
	CUdeviceptr dX, dW, dY;
	CK(cuMemAlloc(&dX, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dW, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemAlloc(&dY, 4 * n));
	float *x = malloc(4 * n), *w = malloc(4 * n), *y = malloc(4 * n), *yg = malloc(4 * n);
	const float mags[] = { 1.f, 1e-3f, 37.5f, 1e4f, 0.f, 2.5f };
	int fails = 0;
	for (unsigned m = 0; m < sizeof mags / sizeof mags[0]; m++) {
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { x[i] = mags[m] * frand() * (1.f + (i % 7) * 0.25f); w[i] = 1.f + 0.5f * frand(); }
		rmsnorm_gpu(x, w, n, eps, y);
		CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dX, x, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemcpyHtoD(dW, w, 4 * n)); CK(cuMemsetD32(dY, 0x7fc00000u, n));
		void *params[] = { &dX, &dW, &dY, &eps };
		CK(cuLaunchKernel(fn, 1, 1, 1, 32, 1, 1, 0, 0, params, NULL));
		CK(cuCtxSynchronize());
		CK(cuMemcpyDtoH(yg, dY, 4 * n));
		int by = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (memcmp(&y[i], &yg[i], 4)) { if (by < 3) printf("  y[%d]: gpu %.9g ref %.9g\n", i, yg[i], y[i]); by++; }
		printf("n=%d mag %-8g: %s (%d of %d differ)\n", n, mags[m], by ? "MISMATCH" : "BIT-EXACT", by, n);
		if (by) fails++;
	}
	return fails ? 3 : 0;
}


File: kern/router.sass
# Kernel: router
#
# MoE router, one warp: 512 logits (lane l holds r[16 l .. 16 l + 15]).
#   m0 = max r (lane FMNMX chain, xor 16..1 butterfly)
#   10 rounds: m_j = max of the remaining values; the lowest index among the
#     values bit-equal to m_j (XOR + ICMP.EQ candidates, IMNMX.U32 chain and
#     butterfly); that element becomes -inf (IADD + ICMP.EQ, no predicates)
#   e_j = exp(m_j - m0) (fmath), den = ((e_0 + e_1) + ...) in selection order,
#   w_j = e_j * rcp(den); s = sigmoid(sh). Lane 0 stores idx[10], w[10], s.
# Bit-exact twin: ref/router.c router_gpu.
#
# Params: 0:0x140:8 R  1:0x148:8 SH  2:0x150:8 IDX  3:0x158:8 W  4:0x160:8 S

<CONSTANT_MAPPING>
    param_R0   : c[0x0][0x140]
    param_R1   : c[0x0][0x144]
    param_SH0  : c[0x0][0x148]
    param_SH1  : c[0x0][0x14c]
    param_I0   : c[0x0][0x150]
    param_I1   : c[0x0][0x154]
    param_W0   : c[0x0][0x158]
    param_W1   : c[0x0][0x15c]
    param_S0   : c[0x0][0x160]
    param_S1   : c[0x0][0x164]
</CONSTANT_MAPPING>

<REGISTER_MAPPING>
    0-15  : v<00-15>
    16-31 : kb<00-15>
    32-41 : m<0-9>
    42-51 : e<0-9>
    52-56 : ft<1-5>
    57    : log2e
    58    : ln2hi
    59    : ln2lo
    60    : c720
    61    : c120
    62    : c24

<CODE>
    require './fmath.pl';
    my %C = map { $_ => $_ } qw(log2e ln2hi ln2lo c720 c120 c24 c6 c11 c9 c7 c5 c3 mneg1 chalf cone);
    my $o = '';
    $o .= "--:-:6:-:1      S2R tid, SR_TID.X;\n";
    $o .= fm_consts(\%C);
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I neginf, 0xff800000;\n";
    $o .= "20:-:-:-:6      ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, tid, 0x20, PT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      LOP32I.AND lane, tid, 0x1f;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x6;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6  \@P0 EXIT;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD rp0.CC, t, param_R0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IADD.X rp1, RZ, param_R1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      ISETP.EQ.U32.AND P1, PT, lane, RZ, PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:1:-:%s      LDG.E.128 v%02d, [rp+0x%x];\n", $_ == 3 ? '2' : '1', 4*$_, 16*$_ for 0..3;
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op0, param_SH0;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV op1, param_SH1;\n";
    $o .= "--:-:2:-:2      LDG.E sh, [op];\n";
    # kb_k = 16 lane + k
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      SHL t, lane, 0x4;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:%s      IADD kb%02d, t, 0x%x;\n", $_ == 15 ? '6' : '1', $_, $_ for 0..15;
    # m0
    $o .= "01:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mx, v00, v01, !PT;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mx, mx, v%02d, !PT;\n", $_ for 2..15;
    for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
        $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, mx, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
        $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mx, mx, t, !PT;\n";
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV mtop, mx;\n";
    for my $j (0..9) {
        if ($j > 0) {
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mx, v00, v01, !PT;\n";
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mx, mx, v%02d, !PT;\n", $_ for 2..15;
            for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
                $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, mx, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
                $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      FMNMX mx, mx, t, !PT;\n";
            }
        }
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV m$j, mx;\n";
        # lowest index with v == mx: candidates via XOR + ICMP.EQ, then IMNMX.U32
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV32I ix, 0xffffffff;\n";
        for my $k (0..15) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      LOP.XOR d, v%02d, mx;\n", $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ICMP.EQ t, kb%02d, ix, d;\n", $k;
            $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 ix, ix, t, PT;\n";
        }
        for my $x (16, 8, 4, 2, 1) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:5:-:3      SHFL.BFLY PT, t, ix, 0x%x, 0x1f;\n", $x;
            $o .= "10:-:-:-:6      IMNMX.U32 ix, ix, t, PT;\n";
        }
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV idx$j, ix;\n";
        # knock the winner out
        for my $k (0..15) {
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      IADD d, kb%02d, -ix;\n", $k;
            $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      ICMP.EQ v%02d, neginf, v%02d, d;\n", $k, $k;
        }
    }
    # weights (every lane computes them; lane 0 stores)
    for my $j (0..9) {
        $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      FADD ft5, m$j, -mtop;\n";
        $o .= fm_exp("e$j", 'ft5', 'ft1', 'ft2', 'ft3', \%C);
    }
    $o .= "--:-:-:-:6      MOV den, e0;\n";
    $o .= sprintf "--:-:-:-:6      FADD den, den, e%d;\n", $_ for 1..9;
