	case GG_Q3_K: e = 256; b = 110; break;
	case GG_Q4_K: e = 256; b = 144; break;
	case GG_Q5_K: e = 256; b = 176; break;
	case GG_Q6_K: e = 256; b = 210; break;
	case GG_Q8_K: e = 256; b = 292; break;
	case GG_IQ4_NL: e = 32; b = 18; break;
	case GG_IQ4_XS: e = 256; b = 136; break;
	case GG_Q2_0: e = 64; b = 18; break;
	}
	*elems = e;
	*bytes = b;
}

const char *gguf_type_name(uint32_t type) {
	switch (type) {
	case GG_F32: return "F32"; case GG_F16: return "F16"; case GG_Q4_0: return "Q4_0"; case GG_Q4_1: return "Q4_1";
	case GG_Q5_0: return "Q5_0"; case GG_Q5_1: return "Q5_1"; case GG_Q8_0: return "Q8_0"; case GG_Q8_1: return "Q8_1";
	case GG_Q2_K: return "Q2_K"; case GG_Q3_K: return "Q3_K"; case GG_Q4_K: return "Q4_K"; case GG_Q5_K: return "Q5_K";
	case GG_Q6_K: return "Q6_K"; case GG_Q8_K: return "Q8_K"; case GG_IQ4_NL: return "IQ4_NL"; case GG_IQ4_XS: return "IQ4_XS";
	case GG_BF16: return "BF16"; case GG_Q2_0: return "Q2_0";
	}
	return "?";
}

/* ---- metadata ---- */
const gguf_kv *gguf_get(const gguf_file *g, const char *key) {
	size_t kl = strlen(key);
	for (uint64_t i = 0; i < g->nkv; i++)
		if (g->kv[i].klen == kl && !memcmp(g->kv[i].key, key, kl)) return &g->kv[i];
	return NULL;
}
int gguf_get_int(const gguf_file *g, const char *key, int64_t *out) {
	const gguf_kv *kv = gguf_get(g, key);
	if (!kv) return -1;
	const uint8_t *p = kv->val;
	switch (kv->type) {
	case 0: case 7: *out = p[0]; return 0;
	case 1: *out = (int8_t)p[0]; return 0;
	case 2: { uint16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); *out = v; return 0; }
	case 3: { int16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); *out = v; return 0; }
	case 4: { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); *out = v; return 0; }
	case 5: { int32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); *out = v; return 0; }
	case 10: case 11: { int64_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 8); *out = v; return 0; }
	default: return -1;
	}
}
const char *gguf_get_str(const gguf_file *g, const char *key, uint64_t *len) {
	const gguf_kv *kv = gguf_get(g, key);
	if (!kv || kv->type != 8) return NULL;
	uint64_t n; memcpy(&n, kv->val, 8);
	if (len) *len = n;
	return (const char *)kv->val + 8;
}
int gguf_get_arr(const gguf_file *g, const char *key, uint32_t *etype, uint64_t *n, const uint8_t **data) {
	const gguf_kv *kv = gguf_get(g, key);
	if (!kv || kv->type != 9) return -1;
	memcpy(etype, kv->val, 4); memcpy(n, kv->val + 4, 8);
	*data = kv->val + 12;
	return 0;
}


File: ref/ggufhdr.c
/*
 * ggufhdr: print a GGUF header (metadata and tensor table) from a file or a
 * truncated head of one. Sizes come from the gaps between tensor offsets, so
 * bits per weight are reported per tensor without knowing the type.
 *
 *   ggufhdr FILE            everything
 *   ggufhdr FILE kv         metadata only
 *   ggufhdr FILE tensors    tensor table only (tab separated)
 *   ggufhdr FILE summary    bytes per type and per block
 */
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static FILE *f;
static int eof;

static uint64_t rd(int n) {
	uint64_t v = 0;
	if (fread(&v, n, 1, f) != 1) eof = 1;
	return v;
}
static char *rds(void) {
	uint64_t n = rd(8);
	if (eof || n > (1u << 24)) { eof = 1; return strdup("?"); }
	char *s = malloc(n + 1);
	if (fread(s, 1, n, f) != n) eof = 1;
	s[n] = 0;
	return s;
}
static int scalar_size(uint32_t t) {
	switch (t) {
	case 0: case 1: case 7: return 1;
	case 2: case 3: return 2;
	case 4: case 5: case 6: return 4;
	case 10: case 11: case 12: return 8;
	default: return 0;
	}
}
static void print_scalar(uint32_t t) {
	int n = scalar_size(t);
	uint64_t v = rd(n);
	switch (t) {
	case 1: printf("%d", (int8_t)v); break;
	case 3: printf("%d", (int16_t)v); break;
	case 5: printf("%d", (int32_t)v); break;
	case 11: printf("%" PRId64, (int64_t)v); break;
	case 6: { float x; memcpy(&x, &v, 4); printf("%g", x); break; }
	case 12: { double x; memcpy(&x, &v, 8); printf("%g", x); break; }
	case 7: printf(v ? "true" : "false"); break;
	default: printf("%" PRIu64, v);
	}
}
static void print_value(uint32_t t, int show) {
	if (t == 8) {
		char *s = rds();
		if (show) {
			if (strlen(s) > 120) { s[117] = 0; printf("\"%s...\"", s); } else printf("\"%s\"", s);
		}
		free(s);
	} else if (t == 9) {
		uint32_t et = (uint32_t)rd(4);
		uint64_t n = rd(8);
		if (show) printf("[type %u x %" PRIu64 "]", et, n);
		int all = n <= 64;
		if (show) printf(all ? " [" : " [");
		for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n && !eof; i++) {
			int s = show && (all || i < 8);
			if (et == 8 || et == 9) print_value(et, s);
			else print_scalar(et), (void)0;
			if (!s && et != 8 && et != 9) {
				/* printed nothing but consumed the value */
			}
			if (s && i + 1 < n) printf(all || i < 7 ? ", " : ", ...");
		}
		if (show) printf("]");
	} else print_scalar(t), (void)0;
}
/* print_scalar always prints; wrap it so hidden array elements consume silently */
static void consume_scalar(uint32_t t) { rd(scalar_size(t)); }

static const char *tname(uint32_t t) {
	static const char *n[] = { "F32", "F16", "Q4_0", "Q4_1", "?4", "?5", "Q5_0", "Q5_1", "Q8_0", "Q8_1", "Q2_K", "Q3_K",
		"Q4_K", "Q5_K", "Q6_K", "Q8_K", "IQ2_XXS", "IQ2_XS", "IQ3_XXS", "IQ1_S", "IQ4_NL", "IQ3_S", "IQ2_S", "IQ4_XS",
		"I8", "I16", "I32", "I64", "F64", "IQ1_M", "BF16", "?31", "?32", "?33", "TQ1_0", "TQ2_0", "?36", "?37", "?38", "MXFP4" };
	static char buf[16];
	if (t < sizeof n / sizeof n[0]) return n[t];
	snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "type%u", t);
	return buf;
}

struct tensor { char *name; uint32_t nd; uint64_t dims[4]; uint32_t type; uint64_t off; uint64_t elems; uint64_t bytes; };

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: ggufhdr FILE [kv|tensors|summary]\n"); return 2; }
	const char *mode = argc > 2 ? argv[2] : "all";
	int show_kv = !strcmp(mode, "all") || !strcmp(mode, "kv");
	int show_t = !strcmp(mode, "all") || !strcmp(mode, "tensors");
	int show_s = !strcmp(mode, "all") || !strcmp(mode, "summary");
	f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
	if (!f) { perror(argv[1]); return 1; }
	char magic[4];
	if (fread(magic, 4, 1, f) != 1 || memcmp(magic, "GGUF", 4)) { fprintf(stderr, "not a GGUF file\n"); return 1; }
	uint32_t ver = (uint32_t)rd(4);
	uint64_t nt = rd(8), nkv = rd(8);
	printf("gguf v%u tensors %" PRIu64 " kv %" PRIu64 "\n", ver, nt, nkv);
	uint64_t align = 32;
	for (uint64_t i = 0; i < nkv && !eof; i++) {
		char *k = rds();
		uint32_t t = (uint32_t)rd(4);
		if (show_kv) printf("kv %s = ", k);
		if (t == 9) {
			uint32_t et = (uint32_t)rd(4);
			uint64_t n = rd(8);
			int all = n <= 64;
			if (show_kv) printf("[%s x %" PRIu64 "] [", tname(et) + 0 * et, n);
			for (uint64_t j = 0; j < n && !eof; j++) {
				int s = show_kv && (all || j < 6);
				if (et == 8) { char *v = rds(); if (s) printf("\"%s\"", v); free(v); }
				else if (s) print_scalar(et);
				else consume_scalar(et);
				if (s && j + 1 < n) printf(all || j < 5 ? ", " : ", ...");
			}
			if (show_kv) printf("]\n");
		} else {
			if (t == 8) { char *v = rds(); if (show_kv) printf("\"%s\"\n", v); free(v); }
			else {
				uint64_t raw = 0;
				long pos = ftell(f);
				if (show_kv) { print_scalar(t); printf("\n"); } else consume_scalar(t);
				if (!strcmp(k, "general.alignment")) { fseek(f, pos, SEEK_SET); raw = rd(scalar_size(t)); align = raw; }
			}
		}
		free(k);
	}
	if (eof) { fprintf(stderr, "truncated inside metadata\n"); return 1; }
	struct tensor *ts = calloc(nt, sizeof *ts);
	for (uint64_t i = 0; i < nt && !eof; i++) {
		ts[i].name = rds();
		ts[i].nd = (uint32_t)rd(4);
		ts[i].elems = 1;
		for (uint32_t d = 0; d < ts[i].nd && d < 4; d++) { ts[i].dims[d] = rd(8); ts[i].elems *= ts[i].dims[d]; }
		ts[i].type = (uint32_t)rd(4);
		ts[i].off = rd(8);
	}
	if (eof) { fprintf(stderr, "truncated inside tensor table\n"); return 1; }
	long hdr_end = ftell(f);
	uint64_t data_start = ((uint64_t)hdr_end + align - 1) / align * align;
	fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
	uint64_t file_len = (uint64_t)ftell(f);
	/* sizes from offset gaps; tensors are stored in offset order but sort defensively */
	for (uint64_t i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
		uint64_t next = UINT64_MAX;
		for (uint64_t j = 0; j < nt; j++) if (ts[j].off > ts[i].off && ts[j].off < next) next = ts[j].off;
		ts[i].bytes = next == UINT64_MAX ? 0 : next - ts[i].off;
	}
	printf("header %ld bytes, data at %" PRIu64 ", alignment %" PRIu64 ", file %" PRIu64 " bytes%s\n", hdr_end, data_start, align, file_len,
	       file_len < data_start ? " (truncated head)" : "");
	if (show_t) {
		printf("name\ttype\tdims\toffset\tbytes\tbpw\n");
		for (uint64_t i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
			printf("%s\t%s\t", ts[i].name, tname(ts[i].type));
			for (uint32_t d = 0; d < ts[i].nd; d++) printf("%" PRIu64 "%s", ts[i].dims[d], d + 1 < ts[i].nd ? "x" : "");
			printf("\t%" PRIu64 "\t%" PRIu64 "\t", ts[i].off, ts[i].bytes);
			if (ts[i].bytes) printf("%.4f\n", 8.0 * (double)ts[i].bytes / (double)ts[i].elems); else printf("last\n");
		}
	}
	if (show_s) {
		uint64_t by_type[64] = { 0 }, el_type[64] = { 0 }, n_type[64] = { 0 };
		uint64_t blk[128] = { 0 }, other = 0;
		for (uint64_t i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
			uint32_t t = ts[i].type < 64 ? ts[i].type : 63;
			by_type[t] += ts[i].bytes; el_type[t] += ts[i].elems; n_type[t]++;
			int b;
			if (sscanf(ts[i].name, "blk.%d.", &b) == 1 && b >= 0 && b < 128) blk[b] += ts[i].bytes; else other += ts[i].bytes;
		}
		printf("type\ttensors\telements\tbytes\tbpw\n");
		for (int t = 0; t < 64; t++) if (n_type[t])
			printf("%s\t%" PRIu64 "\t%" PRIu64 "\t%" PRIu64 "\t%.4f\n", tname(t), n_type[t], el_type[t], by_type[t],
			       by_type[t] ? 8.0 * (double)by_type[t] / (double)el_type[t] : 0.0);
		printf("block\tbytes\n");
		for (int b = 0; b < 128; b++) if (blk[b]) printf("blk.%d\t%" PRIu64 "\n", b, blk[b]);
		printf("other\t%" PRIu64 "\n", other);
	}
	return 0;
}


File: ref/hc.c
#include "hc.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include <math.h>

void hc_silu_gpu(const float *d, float *t) {
	for (int i = 0; i < 320; i++) t[i] = silu_gpu(d[i] * 0.25f);
}

void hc_mix_gpu(const float *up, const float *xh, float *z) {
	for (int c = 0; c < 2560; c++) {
		float g0 = sigmoid_gpu(up[c]), g1 = sigmoid_gpu(up[2560 + c]), g2 = sigmoid_gpu(up[5120 + c]), g3 = sigmoid_gpu(up[7680 + c]);
		float acc = g0 * xh[c];
		acc = fmaf(g1, xh[2560 + c], acc);
		acc = fmaf(g2, xh[5120 + c], acc);
		acc = fmaf(g3, xh[7680 + c], acc);
		z[c] = acc * 0.25f;
	}
}

void hc_write_gpu(const float *inj, const float *y, float *S) {
	float w[4];
	for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) w[l] = 2.0f * sigmoid_gpu(0.25f * inj[l]);
	for (int c = 0; c < 2560; c++)
		for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) S[2560 * l + c] = fmaf(w[l], y[c], S[2560 * l + c]);
}


File: ref/ple.c
#include "ple.h"

const uint64_t ple_multipliers[PLE_NGRAM] = { 23703573157769ull, 20109073645365ull, 8052911324071ull };
const uint64_t ple_head_offsets[PLE_HEADS] = {
	0, 20000003, 40000026, 60000059, 80000106, 100000165, 120000228, 140000297,
	160000374, 180000455, 200000548, 220000655, 240000802, 260000955, 280001114, 300001275 };
const uint64_t ple_head_vocab[PLE_HEADS] = {
	20000003, 20000023, 20000033, 20000047, 20000059, 20000063, 20000069, 20000077,
	20000081, 20000093, 20000107, 20000147, 20000153, 20000159, 20000161, 20000171 };

static int is_end(uint32_t id, const uint32_t *ends, int nends) {
	for (int i = 0; i < nends; i++) if (ends[i] == id) return 1;
	return 0;
}

void ple_rows(const uint32_t *ids, size_t pos, uint32_t absent, const uint32_t *ends, int nends, uint64_t rows[PLE_HEADS]) {
	ple_rows_c(ids, pos, absent, ends, nends, ple_multipliers, ple_head_offsets, ple_head_vocab, rows);
}

void ple_rows_c(const uint32_t *ids, size_t pos, uint32_t absent, const uint32_t *ends, int nends, const uint64_t *mult, const uint64_t *off, const uint64_t *voc, uint64_t rows[PLE_HEADS]) {
	uint64_t ctx[PLE_NGRAM];
	for (size_t back = 0; back < PLE_NGRAM; back++) {
		int ok = back <= pos;
		for (size_t p = pos - back; ok && p < pos; p++) if (is_end(ids[p], ends, nends)) ok = 0;
		ctx[back] = ok ? ids[pos - back] : absent;
	}
	int h = 0;
	for (int order = 2; order <= PLE_NGRAM; order++) {
		uint64_t mixed = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < order; i++) mixed ^= ctx[i] * mult[i];
		for (int k = 0; k < PLE_HEADS / (PLE_NGRAM - 1); k++, h++) rows[h] = off[h] + mixed % voc[h];
	}
}

#include "fmath.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

void ple_gate_gpu(const float *kn, const float *qn, const float *v, float *g, float *gates) {
	const float rsc = (float)(1.0 / sqrt(2560.0));
	for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
		float ws[8];
		for (int w = 0; w < 8; w++) {
			float lv[32], tv[32];
			for (int ln = 0; ln < 32; ln++) {
				int t = 32 * w + ln;
				const float *a = kn + 2560 * l + t, *b = qn + 2560 * l + t;
				float s = a[0] * b[0];
				for (int k = 1; k < 10; k++) s = fmaf(a[256 * k], b[256 * k], s);
				lv[ln] = s;
			}
			for (int o = 16; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
				for (int ln = 0; ln < 32; ln++) tv[ln] = lv[ln] + lv[ln ^ o];
				memcpy(lv, tv, sizeof lv);
			}
			ws[w] = lv[0];
		}
		float s = ws[0] + ws[1];
		for (int w = 2; w < 8; w++) s = s + ws[w];
		s = s * rsc;
		float mag = fabsf(s);
		if (!(mag > 1e-6f)) mag = 1e-6f;
		float root = sqrtf(mag);
		float sign = (float)((s > 0.f) - (0.f > s));
		float gate = sigmoid_gpu(sign * root);
		gates[l] = gate;
		for (int c = 0; c < 2560; c++) g[2560 * l + c] = gate * v[c];
	}
}

void ple_conv_gpu(const float *x, float state[10][10240], const float *w, unsigned t, const float *g, float *s) {
	const float *x9 = t >= 9 ? state[(t - 9) % 10] : NULL, *x6 = t >= 6 ? state[(t - 6) % 10] : NULL, *x3 = t >= 3 ? state[(t - 3) % 10] : NULL;
	for (int c = 0; c < 10240; c++) {
		float y = w[4 * c] * (x9 ? x9[c] : 0.f);
		y = fmaf(w[4 * c + 1], x6 ? x6[c] : 0.f, y);
		y = fmaf(w[4 * c + 2], x3 ? x3[c] : 0.f, y);
		y = fmaf(w[4 * c + 3], x[c], y);
		s[c] = s[c] + (g[c] + silu_gpu(y));
	}
	memcpy(state[t % 10], x, 4 * 10240);
}


File: ref/qsa.c
#include "qsa.h"
#include "attn.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <fenv.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

uint16_t qsa_f2h(float f) {
	uint32_t x; memcpy(&x, &f, 4);
	uint32_t sign = (x >> 16) & 0x8000u, m = x & 0x7fffffu;
	int32_t e = (int32_t)((x >> 23) & 0xff) - 127 + 15;
	if (((x >> 23) & 0xff) == 0xff) return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7c00u | (m ? 0x200u : 0));
	if (e >= 31) return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7c00u);
	if (e <= 0) {
		if (e < -10) return (uint16_t)sign;
		m |= 0x800000u;
		int shift = 14 - e;
		uint32_t half = m >> shift, rem = m & ((1u << shift) - 1u), halfway = 1u << (shift - 1);
		if (rem > halfway || (rem == halfway && (half & 1u))) half++;
		return (uint16_t)(sign | half);
	}
	uint32_t h = ((uint32_t)e << 10) | (m >> 13), rem = m & 0x1fffu;
	if (rem > 0x1000u || (rem == 0x1000u && (h & 1u))) h++;   /* a carry runs into the exponent, which is right */
	return (uint16_t)(sign | h);
}

float qsa_h2f(uint16_t h) {
	uint32_t sign = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000u) << 16, e = (h >> 10) & 0x1f, m = h & 0x3ffu, x;
	if (e == 0) {
		if (m == 0) x = sign;
		else { int s = 0; while (!(m & 0x400u)) { m <<= 1; s++; } m &= 0x3ffu; x = sign | ((uint32_t)(127 - 15 - s + 1) << 23) | (m << 13); }
	} else if (e == 31) x = sign | 0x7f800000u | (m << 13);
	else x = sign | ((e - 15 + 127) << 23) | (m << 13);
	float f; memcpy(&f, &x, 4); return f;
}

void kv_quant32_gpu(const float *x, int8_t *q, uint16_t *s16) {
    float bounded[32];
    for (int e=0;e<32;e++) {
        float v=x[e];
        if(v>QSA_KV_MAX_ABS)v=QSA_KV_MAX_ABS;
        if(v<-QSA_KV_MAX_ABS)v=-QSA_KV_MAX_ABS;
        bounded[e]=v;
    }
    x=bounded;

	const float tiny = 7.8886090522101180541e-31f;   /* 2^-100 */
	float gmax = 0.f;
	for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) { float a = fabsf(x[e]); if (a > gmax) gmax = a; }
	if (gmax < tiny) gmax = tiny;
	float r = rcp_gpu(gmax);
	float inv = r * 127.0f;
	for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) q[e] = (int8_t)lrintf(x[e] * inv);
	*s16 = qsa_f2h(gmax * (1.0f / 127.0f));
}

float kv_deq_gpu(int8_t q, uint16_t s16) { return (float)q * qsa_h2f(s16); }

unsigned qsa_nkeys(unsigned t, unsigned nblk) {
	unsigned nv = (t + 1) >> 2, tail = (t + 1) & 3;
	return nv <= nblk ? t + 1 : 4 * nblk + tail;
}

unsigned qsa_gather_gpu(const int8_t *kq, const uint16_t *ks, const int8_t *vq, const uint16_t *vs, const uint32_t *sel, unsigned t, unsigned nblk, float *kc, float *vc) {
	unsigned nv = (t + 1) >> 2, tail = (t + 1) & 3, ns = nv < nblk ? nv : nblk;
	unsigned nb = ns + (tail ? 1 : 0);
	for (unsigned j = 0; j < nb; j++) {
		unsigned src = j < ns ? (nv <= nblk ? j : sel[j]) : nv;
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
			unsigned slot = 4 * j + i, tok = 4 * src + i;
			for (int kv = 0; kv < 2; kv++)
				for (int d = 0; d < 256; d++) {
					size_t row = (size_t)tok * 2 + kv;
					kc[attn_kidx(slot, kv, d)] = kv_deq_gpu(kq[row * 256 + d], ks[row * 8 + (d >> 5)]);
					vc[(size_t)slot * 512 + 256 * kv + d] = kv_deq_gpu(vq[row * 256 + d], vs[row * 8 + (d >> 5)]);
				}
		}
	}
	return qsa_nkeys(t, nblk);
}

void idx_norm_rope_gpu(const float *x, const float *w, float eps, const float *cs, const float *sn, float *y) {
	float v[32], t[32];
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) {
		float ss = 0.f;
		for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) ss = fmaf(x[4 * l + k], x[4 * l + k], ss);
		v[l] = ss;
	}
	for (int o = 16; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
		for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) t[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
		memcpy(v, t, sizeof v);
	}
	float m = v[0] * (1.0f / 128.0f);
	float vv = m + eps;
	float s = sqrtf(vv);
	float r = rcp_gpu(s);
	for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) y[d] = (x[d] * r) * w[d];
	for (int p = 0; p < 32; p++) {
		float yp = y[p], yq = y[p + 32];
		float a = yp * cs[p], b = yq * cs[p];
		y[p] = fmaf(yq, -sn[p], a);
		y[p + 32] = fmaf(yp, sn[p], b);
	}
}

void idx_pool_gpu(const float *raw, const float *kn, float eps, const float *cs, const float *sn, uint16_t *out) {
	float m[128], y[128];
	for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) {
		float s = ((raw[d] + raw[128 + d]) + raw[256 + d]) + raw[384 + d];
		m[d] = s * 0.25f;
	}
	idx_norm_rope_gpu(m, kn, eps, cs, sn, y);
	for (int d = 0; d < 128; d++) out[d] = qsa_f2h(y[d]);
}

void idx_scores_gpu(const float *iq, const uint16_t *pool, unsigned nv, float *score) {
	for (unsigned b = 0; b < nv; b++) {
		float s = 0.f;
		for (int h = 0; h < QSA_NIDXH; h++) {
			float a = 0.f;
			for (int d = 0; d < QSA_IDIM; d++) a = fmaf(iq[h * QSA_IDIM + d], qsa_h2f(pool[(size_t)b * QSA_IDIM + d]), a);
			a = (a > 0.f ? a : 0.f) + 0.f;
			s = h ? s + a : a;
		}
		score[b] = s;
	}
}

typedef struct { float s; uint32_t i; } sc_t;
static int cmp_sc(const void *a, const void *b) {
	const sc_t *x = a, *y = b;
	if (x->s != y->s) return x->s > y->s ? -1 : 1;
	return x->i < y->i ? -1 : x->i > y->i;
}
static int cmp_u32(const void *a, const void *b) { uint32_t x = *(const uint32_t *)a, y = *(const uint32_t *)b; return x < y ? -1 : x > y; }

unsigned idx_select_gpu(const float *score, unsigned nv, unsigned nblk, uint32_t *sel) {
	unsigned k = nv < nblk ? nv : nblk;
	sc_t *a = malloc(sizeof *a * (nv ? nv : 1));
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < nv; i++) { a[i].s = score[i]; a[i].i = i; }
	qsort(a, nv, sizeof *a, cmp_sc);
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < k; i++) sel[i] = a[i].i;
	qsort(sel, k, 4, cmp_u32);
	free(a);
	return k;
}

int kv_quant32_checked(const float *x,int8_t *q,uint16_t *s16) {
    if(!x||!q||!s16||fegetround()!=FE_TONEAREST)return 1;
    for(int i=0;i<32;i++)if(!isfinite(x[i]))return 1;
    int8_t tq[32];uint16_t ts;kv_quant32_gpu(x,tq,&ts);
    memcpy(q,tq,sizeof tq);*s16=ts;return 0;
}


File: ref/quant.c
#include "quant.h"
#include "gguf.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

float fp16_to_fp32(uint16_t h) {
	uint32_t sign = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000) << 16;
	uint32_t exp = (h >> 10) & 0x1f;
	uint32_t man = h & 0x3ff;
	uint32_t bits;
	if (exp == 0) {
		if (man == 0) bits = sign;
		else {
			/* subnormal: normalise */
			int e = -1;
			do { e++; man <<= 1; } while (!(man & 0x400));
			man &= 0x3ff;
			bits = sign | ((uint32_t)(127 - 15 - e) << 23) | (man << 13);
		}
	} else if (exp == 31) bits = sign | 0x7f800000 | (man << 13);
	else bits = sign | ((exp + 112) << 23) | (man << 13);
	float f;
	memcpy(&f, &bits, 4);
	return f;
}

float bf16_to_fp32(uint16_t b) {
	uint32_t bits = (uint32_t)b << 16;
	float f;
	memcpy(&f, &bits, 4);
	return f;
}

static const int8_t kvalues_iq4nl[16] = { -127, -104, -83, -65, -49, -35, -22, -10, 1, 13, 25, 38, 53, 69, 89, 113 };

static inline uint16_t ld16(const uint8_t *p) { uint16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); return v; }
static inline uint32_t ld32(const uint8_t *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }

static void scale_min_k4(int j, const uint8_t *q, uint8_t *sc, uint8_t *m) {
	if (j < 4) { *sc = q[j] & 63; *m = q[j + 4] & 63; }
	else { *sc = (q[j + 4] & 0xF) | ((q[j - 4] >> 6) << 4); *m = (q[j + 4] >> 4) | ((q[j] >> 6) << 4); }
}

int dequant(uint32_t type, const void *vsrc, float *y, uint64_t n) {
	const uint8_t *x = vsrc;
	uint32_t be, bb;
	gguf_block(type, &be, &bb);
	if (!be) return -1;
	uint64_t nb = n / be;
	for (uint64_t i = 0; i < nb; i++, x += bb, y += be) {
		switch (type) {
		case GG_F32: memcpy(y, x, 4); break;
		case GG_F16: y[0] = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x)); break;
		case GG_BF16: y[0] = bf16_to_fp32(ld16(x)); break;
		case GG_Q2_0: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x));
			const uint8_t *qs = x + 2;
			for (int j = 0; j < 64; j++) y[j] = d * (float)(((qs[j >> 2] >> (2 * (j & 3))) & 3) - 1);
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q4_0: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x));
			const uint8_t *qs = x + 2;
			for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) { y[j] = d * (float)((qs[j] & 0xf) - 8); y[j + 16] = d * (float)((qs[j] >> 4) - 8); }
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q5_0: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x));
			uint32_t qh = ld32(x + 2);
			const uint8_t *qs = x + 6;
			for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
				int xh0 = ((qh >> j) & 1) << 4, xh1 = (qh >> (j + 12)) & 0x10;
				y[j] = d * (float)(((qs[j] & 0xf) | xh0) - 16);
				y[j + 16] = d * (float)(((qs[j] >> 4) | xh1) - 16);
			}
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q8_0: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x));
			const int8_t *qs = (const int8_t *)x + 2;
			for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) y[j] = d * (float)qs[j];
			break;
		}
		case GG_IQ4_NL: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x));
			const uint8_t *qs = x + 2;
			for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) { y[j] = d * kvalues_iq4nl[qs[j] & 0xf]; y[j + 16] = d * kvalues_iq4nl[qs[j] >> 4]; }
			break;
		}
		case GG_IQ4_XS: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x));
			uint16_t sh = ld16(x + 2);
			const uint8_t *sl = x + 4, *qs = x + 8;
			float *yy = y;
			for (int ib = 0; ib < 8; ib++, qs += 16, yy += 32) {
				int ls = ((sl[ib / 2] >> (4 * (ib % 2))) & 0xf) | (((sh >> (2 * ib)) & 3) << 4);
				float dl = d * (float)(ls - 32);
				for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) { yy[j] = dl * kvalues_iq4nl[qs[j] & 0xf]; yy[j + 16] = dl * kvalues_iq4nl[qs[j] >> 4]; }
			}
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q3_K: {
			const uint8_t *hm = x, *q = x + 32;
			uint32_t aux[4];
			memcpy(aux, x + 96, 12);
			float d_all = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x + 108));
			const uint32_t kmask1 = 0x03030303, kmask2 = 0x0f0f0f0f;
			uint32_t tmp = aux[2];
			aux[2] = ((aux[0] >> 4) & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 4) & kmask1) << 4);
			aux[3] = ((aux[1] >> 4) & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 6) & kmask1) << 4);
			aux[0] = (aux[0] & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 0) & kmask1) << 4);
			aux[1] = (aux[1] & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 2) & kmask1) << 4);
			const int8_t *scales = (const int8_t *)aux;
			int is = 0;
			uint8_t m = 1;
			float *yy = y;
			for (int nn = 0; nn < 256; nn += 128) {
				int shift = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
					float dl = d_all * (float)(scales[is++] - 32);
					for (int l = 0; l < 16; l++) *yy++ = dl * (float)((int8_t)((q[l] >> shift) & 3) - ((hm[l] & m) ? 0 : 4));
					dl = d_all * (float)(scales[is++] - 32);
					for (int l = 0; l < 16; l++) *yy++ = dl * (float)((int8_t)((q[l + 16] >> shift) & 3) - ((hm[l + 16] & m) ? 0 : 4));
					shift += 2;
					m <<= 1;
				}
				q += 32;
			}
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q4_K: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x)), min = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x + 2));
			const uint8_t *sc8 = x + 4, *q = x + 16;
			float *yy = y;
			for (int j = 0, is = 0; j < 256; j += 64, q += 32, is += 2) {
				uint8_t sc, m;
				scale_min_k4(is, sc8, &sc, &m);
				float d1 = d * sc, m1 = min * m;
				scale_min_k4(is + 1, sc8, &sc, &m);
				float d2 = d * sc, m2 = min * m;
				for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) *yy++ = d1 * (float)(q[l] & 0xf) - m1;
				for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) *yy++ = d2 * (float)(q[l] >> 4) - m2;
			}
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q5_K: {
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x)), min = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x + 2));
			const uint8_t *sc8 = x + 4, *qh = x + 16, *ql = x + 48;
			float *yy = y;
			uint8_t u1 = 1, u2 = 2;
			for (int j = 0, is = 0; j < 256; j += 64, ql += 32, is += 2, u1 <<= 2, u2 <<= 2) {
				uint8_t sc, m;
				scale_min_k4(is, sc8, &sc, &m);
				float d1 = d * sc, m1 = min * m;
				scale_min_k4(is + 1, sc8, &sc, &m);
				float d2 = d * sc, m2 = min * m;
				for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) *yy++ = d1 * (float)((ql[l] & 0xf) + ((qh[l] & u1) ? 16 : 0)) - m1;
				for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) *yy++ = d2 * (float)((ql[l] >> 4) + ((qh[l] & u2) ? 16 : 0)) - m2;
			}
			break;
		}
		case GG_Q6_K: {
			const uint8_t *ql = x, *qh = x + 128;
			const int8_t *sc = (const int8_t *)x + 192;
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(x + 208));
			float *yy = y;
			for (int nn = 0; nn < 256; nn += 128, yy += 128, ql += 64, qh += 32, sc += 8) {
				for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) {
					int is = l / 16;
					int q1 = (int8_t)((ql[l] & 0xF) | (((qh[l] >> 0) & 3) << 4)) - 32;
					int q2 = (int8_t)((ql[l + 32] & 0xF) | (((qh[l] >> 2) & 3) << 4)) - 32;
					int q3 = (int8_t)((ql[l] >> 4) | (((qh[l] >> 4) & 3) << 4)) - 32;
					int q4 = (int8_t)((ql[l + 32] >> 4) | (((qh[l] >> 6) & 3) << 4)) - 32;
					yy[l] = d * sc[is] * q1;
					yy[l + 32] = d * sc[is + 2] * q2;
					yy[l + 64] = d * sc[is + 4] * q3;
					yy[l + 96] = d * sc[is + 6] * q4;
				}
			}
			break;
		}
		default: return -1;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

float quant_act_int8(const float *x, int8_t *q, int32_t *sum32, int n) {
	float amax = 0.f;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { float a = fabsf(x[i]); if (a > amax) amax = a; }
	float scale = amax / 127.f, inv = amax > 0.f ? 127.f / amax : 0.f;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		long v = lrintf(x[i] * inv);
		if (v > 127) v = 127;
		if (v < -127) v = -127;
		q[i] = (int8_t)v;
	}
	for (int h = 0; h < n / 32; h++) {
		int32_t s = 0;
		for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) s += q[32 * h + j];
		sum32[h] = s;
	}
	return scale;
}

int q2_0_tile_stride(int K) {
	int B = K / 64;
	int scales = (2 * B + 15) / 16 * 16;
	return scales + 16 * B;
}

int repack_q2_0(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 64, stride = q2_0_tile_stride(K), scales = stride - 16 * B;
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * 18;
		uint8_t *d = dst + (size_t)r * stride;
		memset(d, 0, scales);
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			memcpy(d + 2 * b, s + 18 * b, 2);
			memcpy(d + scales + 16 * b, s + 18 * b + 2, 16);
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

int q2_0_lanes_per_row(int K) {
	int halves = K / 32;
	return halves / 5;   /* 2560 -> 16 lanes, 640 -> 4 lanes */
}

void gemv_q2_0_ref(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const int32_t *sum32, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 64, stride = q2_0_tile_stride(K), scales = stride - 16 * B;
	int L = q2_0_lanes_per_row(K);
	float v[32] = { 0 }, w[32] = { 0 };
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *row = tile + (size_t)r * stride;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
				int h = l + L * i, b = h >> 1;
				const uint8_t *qs = row + scales + 16 * b + 8 * (h & 1);
				int32_t dot = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) dot += ((qs[j >> 2] >> (2 * (j & 3))) & 3) * xq[32 * h + j];
				float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(row + 2 * b));
				{ float u = d * (float)(dot - sum32[h]); acc = fmaf(as[h], u, acc); }
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

void gemv_q2_0_float(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, const float *x, float *y) {
	float w[4096];
	if (K > 4096) K = 4096;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		dequant(GG_Q2_0, src + (size_t)r * (K / 64) * 18, w, (uint64_t)K);
		double s = 0;
		for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) s += (double)w[k] * x[k];
		y[r] = (float)s;
	}
}

void act_nsum64(const int8_t *q, int32_t *nsum64, int n) {
	for (int b = 0; b < n / 64; b++) {
		int32_t s = 0;
		for (int j = 0; j < 64; j++) s += q[64 * b + j];
		nsum64[b] = -s;
	}
}

void gemv_q2_0_ref_v2(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const int32_t *nsum64, float xscale, float *y) {
	int B = K / 64, stride = q2_0_tile_stride(K), scales = stride - 16 * B;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *row = tile + (size_t)r * stride;
		float acc = 0.f;
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *qs = row + scales + 16 * b;
			int32_t dot = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < 64; j++) dot += ((qs[j >> 2] >> (2 * (j & 3))) & 3) * xq[64 * b + j];
			float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(row + 2 * b));
			acc = fmaf(d, (float)(dot + nsum64[b]), acc);
		}
		y[r] = acc * xscale;
	}
}

int bf16_lanes_per_row(int K) {
	return K >= 2560 ? 32 : 8;   /* 2560 -> 80 elements per lane, 320 -> 40 */
}

void gemv_bf16_ref(const uint16_t *W, int rows, int K, const float *x, float *y) {
	int L = bf16_lanes_per_row(K), C = K / (8 * L);
	float v[32], w[32];
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint16_t *row = W + (size_t)r * K;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
				int base = 8 * (l + L * j);
				for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) acc = fmaf(bf16_to_fp32(row[base + i]), x[base + i], acc);
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

int q4_k_tile_stride(int K) { return 144 * (K / 256); }

int q4_k_lanes_per_row(int K) { return K >= 6144 ? 32 : 16; }

void q4_k_scale_min(const uint8_t *q, int j, int *scale, int *min) {
	if (j < 4) { *scale = q[j] & 63; *min = q[j + 4] & 63; }
	else { *scale = (q[j + 4] & 0xF) | ((q[j - 4] >> 6) << 4); *min = (q[j + 4] >> 4) | ((q[j] >> 6) << 4); }
}

int repack_q4_k(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = q4_k_tile_stride(K);
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * 144;
		uint8_t *hdr = dst + (size_t)r * stride, *codes = hdr + 16 * B;
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *blk = s + 144 * b;
			memcpy(hdr + 16 * b, blk, 16);               /* d, dmin, scales[12] */
			const uint8_t *qs = blk + 16;
			for (int g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
				uint8_t *lo = codes + 128 * b + 16 * (2 * g), *hi = lo + 16;
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
					const uint8_t *p = qs + 32 * g + 2 * i;
					lo[i] = (uint8_t)((p[0] & 0xF) | ((p[1] & 0xF) << 4));
					hi[i] = (uint8_t)((p[0] >> 4) | ((p[1] >> 4) << 4));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

void gemv_q4_k_ref(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const int32_t *sum32, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = q4_k_tile_stride(K);
	int L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), n = (K / 32) / L;
	float v[32], w[32];
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *hdr = tile + (size_t)r * stride, *codes = hdr + 16 * B;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				int s = l + L * i, b = s >> 3, j = s & 7;
				const uint8_t *h = hdr + 16 * b, *q = codes + 128 * b + 16 * j;
				int sc, mn;
				q4_k_scale_min(h + 4, j, &sc, &mn);
				int32_t dot = 0;
				for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) dot += ((q[e >> 1] >> (4 * (e & 1))) & 0xF) * xq[32 * s + e];
				float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(h)), dmin = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(h + 2));
				float t1 = (float)dot * (float)sc;
				float u = d * t1;
				float t2 = (float)(mn * sum32[s]);
				if (!getenv("GEMV_NOMIN")) u = fmaf(-dmin, t2, u);
				acc = fmaf(as[s], u, acc);
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

int q5_k_tile_stride(int K) { return 176 * (K / 256); }

int repack_q5_k(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = q5_k_tile_stride(K);
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * 176;
		uint8_t *hdr = dst + (size_t)r * stride, *codes = hdr + 16 * B, *hb = hdr + 144 * B;
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *blk = s + 176 * b;
			memcpy(hdr + 16 * b, blk, 16);
			const uint8_t *qh = blk + 16, *qs = blk + 48;
			for (int g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
				uint8_t *lo = codes + 128 * b + 16 * (2 * g), *hi = lo + 16;
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
					const uint8_t *p = qs + 32 * g + 2 * i;
					lo[i] = (uint8_t)((p[0] & 0xF) | ((p[1] & 0xF) << 4));
					hi[i] = (uint8_t)((p[0] >> 4) | ((p[1] >> 4) << 4));
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
				uint32_t w = 0;
				for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) w |= (uint32_t)((qh[l] >> j) & 1) << l;
				memcpy(hb + 32 * b + 4 * j, &w, 4);
			}
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

void gemv_q5_k_ref(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const int32_t *sum32, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = q5_k_tile_stride(K);
	int L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), n = (K / 32) / L;
	float v[32], w[32];
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *hdr = tile + (size_t)r * stride, *codes = hdr + 16 * B, *hb = hdr + 144 * B;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				int s = l + L * i, b = s >> 3, j = s & 7;
				const uint8_t *h = hdr + 16 * b, *q = codes + 128 * b + 16 * j;
				uint32_t hw;
				memcpy(&hw, hb + 32 * b + 4 * j, 4);
				int sc, mn;
				q4_k_scale_min(h + 4, j, &sc, &mn);
				int32_t dot = 0;
				for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) dot += (((q[e >> 1] >> (4 * (e & 1))) & 0xF) + 16 * ((hw >> e) & 1)) * xq[32 * s + e];
				float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(h)), dmin = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(h + 2));
				float t1 = (float)dot * (float)sc;
				float u = d * t1;
				float t2 = (float)(mn * sum32[s]);
				if (!getenv("GEMV_NOMIN")) u = fmaf(-dmin, t2, u);
				acc = fmaf(as[s], u, acc);
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

/* ---- Q3_K: per-16 groups, 2-bit codes plus inverted high bits ---- */

int q3_k_tile_stride(int K) { return 16 * (q4_k_lanes_per_row(K) / 8) + 112 * (K / 256); }

/* the 16 6-bit scales of a block, as ggml unpacks them */
static void q3_k_scales(const uint8_t *sc12, int8_t *sc16) {
	uint32_t aux[4];
	memcpy(aux, sc12, 12);
	const uint32_t kmask1 = 0x03030303, kmask2 = 0x0f0f0f0f;
	uint32_t tmp = aux[2];
	aux[2] = ((aux[0] >> 4) & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 4) & kmask1) << 4);
	aux[3] = ((aux[1] >> 4) & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 6) & kmask1) << 4);
	aux[0] = (aux[0] & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 0) & kmask1) << 4);
	aux[1] = (aux[1] & kmask2) | (((tmp >> 2) & kmask1) << 4);
	memcpy(sc16, aux, 16);
}

int repack_q3_k(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 256, L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), Q = L / 8, stride = q3_k_tile_stride(K);
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * 110;
		uint8_t *pre = dst + (size_t)r * stride, *blocks = pre + 16 * Q;
		memset(pre, 0, 16 * Q);
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *blk = s + 110 * b, *hm = blk, *qs = blk + 32;
			uint8_t *rec = blocks + 112 * b;
			memcpy(pre + 16 * (b % Q) + 2 * (b / Q), blk + 108, 2);
			int8_t sc[16];
			q3_k_scales(blk + 96, sc);
			for (int g = 0; g < 16; g++) {
				int nn = g >> 3, j = (g >> 1) & 3, which = g & 1;
				uint32_t cw = 0, hw = 0;
				for (int l = 0; l < 16; l++) {
					int code = (qs[32 * nn + 16 * which + l] >> (2 * j)) & 3;
					int h = (hm[16 * which + l] >> (4 * nn + j)) & 1;
					cw |= (uint32_t)code << (16 * (l >> 3) + 2 * (l & 7));
					hw |= (uint32_t)(h ^ 1) << l;
				}
				memcpy(rec + 4 * g, &cw, 4);
				rec[64 + 2 * g] = (uint8_t)hw;
				rec[65 + 2 * g] = (uint8_t)(hw >> 8);
				rec[96 + g] = (uint8_t)(sc[g] - 32);
			}
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

void gemv_q3_k_ref(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = q3_k_tile_stride(K);
	int L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), Q = L / 8, n = B / Q;
	float v[32], w[32];
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *pre = tile + (size_t)r * stride, *blocks = pre + 16 * Q;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			int q = l >> 3, jj = l & 7;
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				int b = Q * i + q;
				const uint8_t *rec = blocks + 112 * b;
				int32_t sumi = 0;
				for (int gg = 0; gg < 2; gg++) {
					int g = 2 * jj + gg;
					uint32_t cw;
					memcpy(&cw, rec + 4 * g, 4);
					uint32_t hw = rec[64 + 2 * g] | (rec[65 + 2 * g] << 8);
					int32_t dot = 0;
					for (int e = 0; e < 16; e++) {
						int code = (cw >> (16 * (e >> 3) + 2 * (e & 7))) & 3, hinv = (hw >> e) & 1;
						dot += (code - 4 * hinv) * xq[256 * b + 16 * g + e];
					}
					sumi += (int8_t)rec[96 + g] * dot;
				}
				{ float u = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(pre + 16 * q + 2 * i)) * (float)sumi; acc = fmaf(as[8 * b + jj], u, acc); }
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

/* ---- Q6_K: per-16 int8 scales, low nibbles plus 2-bit high fields ---- */

int q6_k_tile_stride(int K) { return 16 * (q4_k_lanes_per_row(K) / 8) + 208 * (K / 256); }

void act_sum16(const int8_t *q, int32_t *sum16, int n) {
	for (int g = 0; g < n / 16; g++) {
		int32_t s = 0;
		for (int e = 0; e < 16; e++) s += q[16 * g + e];
		sum16[g] = s;
	}
}

/* q6 of element e (0..255) of a raw Q6_K block */
static int q6_k_elem(const uint8_t *blk, int e) {
	const uint8_t *ql = blk + 64 * (e >> 7), *qh = blk + 128 + 32 * (e >> 7);
	int l = e & 31, part = (e & 127) >> 5;      /* part 0..3 = q1..q4 of the decoder */
	int lo;
	if (part == 0) lo = ql[l] & 0xF;
	else if (part == 1) lo = ql[l + 32] & 0xF;
	else if (part == 2) lo = ql[l] >> 4;
	else lo = ql[l + 32] >> 4;
	int hi = (qh[l] >> (2 * part)) & 3;
	return lo | (hi << 4);
}

int repack_q6_k(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 256, L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), Q = L / 8, stride = q6_k_tile_stride(K);
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * 210;
		uint8_t *pre = dst + (size_t)r * stride, *blocks = pre + 16 * Q;
		memset(pre, 0, 16 * Q);
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *blk = s + 210 * b;
			uint8_t *rec = blocks + 208 * b;
			memcpy(pre + 16 * (b % Q) + 2 * (b / Q), blk + 208, 2);
			memcpy(rec + 192, blk + 192, 16);
			for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
					int a = q6_k_elem(blk, 32 * j + 2 * i), c = q6_k_elem(blk, 32 * j + 2 * i + 1);
					rec[16 * j + i] = (uint8_t)((a & 0xF) | ((c & 0xF) << 4));
				}
				for (int w = 0; w < 2; w++) {
					uint32_t hw = 0;
					for (int e = 0; e < 16; e++) {
						int hi = q6_k_elem(blk, 32 * j + 16 * w + e) >> 4;
						hw |= (uint32_t)hi << (16 * (e >> 3) + 2 * (e & 7));
					}
					memcpy(rec + 128 + 8 * j + 4 * w, &hw, 4);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

void gemv_q6_k_ref(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const int32_t *sum16, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = q6_k_tile_stride(K);
	int L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), Q = L / 8, n = B / Q;
	float v[32], w[32];
	(void)sum16;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *pre = tile + (size_t)r * stride, *blocks = pre + 16 * Q;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			int q = l >> 3, jj = l & 7;
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				int b = Q * i + q;
				const uint8_t *rec = blocks + 208 * b, *nib = rec + 16 * jj;
				int32_t sumi = 0;
				for (int gg = 0; gg < 2; gg++) {
					uint32_t hw;
					memcpy(&hw, rec + 128 + 8 * jj + 4 * gg, 4);
					int32_t dot = 0;
					for (int e = 0; e < 16; e++) {
						int el = 16 * gg + e;
						int q6 = ((nib[el >> 1] >> (4 * (el & 1))) & 0xF) | (((hw >> (16 * (e >> 3) + 2 * (e & 7))) & 3) << 4);
						dot += (q6 - 32) * xq[256 * b + 32 * jj + el];
					}
					sumi += (int8_t)rec[192 + 2 * jj + gg] * dot;
				}
				{ float u = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(pre + 16 * q + 2 * i)) * (float)sumi; acc = fmaf(as[8 * b + jj], u, acc); }
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

/* ---- IQ4_XS: per-32 6-bit scales, non-linear 4-bit codes ---- */

int iq4_xs_tile_stride(int K) { return 16 * (q4_k_lanes_per_row(K) / 8) + 136 * (K / 256); }
int iq4_kvalue(int q) { return kvalues_iq4nl[q & 15]; }

int repack_iq4_xs(const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 256, L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), Q = L / 8, stride = iq4_xs_tile_stride(K);
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * 136;
		uint8_t *pre = dst + (size_t)r * stride, *nib = pre + 16 * Q, *scs = nib + 128 * B;
		memset(pre, 0, 16 * Q);
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *blk = s + 136 * b, *sl = blk + 4, *qs = blk + 8;
			uint16_t sh = ld16(blk + 2);
			memcpy(pre + 16 * (b % Q) + 2 * (b / Q), blk, 2);
			for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
				int ls = ((sl[j / 2] >> (4 * (j % 2))) & 0xf) | (((sh >> (2 * j)) & 3) << 4);
				scs[8 * b + j] = (uint8_t)(ls - 32);
				const uint8_t *q = qs + 16 * j;
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
					int e0 = 2 * i, e1 = 2 * i + 1;
					int n0 = e0 < 16 ? (q[e0] & 0xF) : (q[e0 - 16] >> 4);
					int n1 = e1 < 16 ? (q[e1] & 0xF) : (q[e1 - 16] >> 4);
					nib[128 * b + 16 * j + i] = (uint8_t)(n0 | (n1 << 4));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

void gemv_iq4_xs_ref(const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 256, stride = iq4_xs_tile_stride(K);
	int L = q4_k_lanes_per_row(K), Q = L / 8, n = B / Q;
	float v[32], w[32];
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *pre = tile + (size_t)r * stride, *nib = pre + 16 * Q, *scs = nib + 128 * B;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			int q = l >> 3, jj = l & 7;
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				int b = Q * i + q;
				const uint8_t *p = nib + 128 * b + 16 * jj;
				int32_t dot = 0;
				for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) dot += kvalues_iq4nl[(p[e >> 1] >> (4 * (e & 1))) & 0xF] * xq[256 * b + 32 * jj + e];
				int32_t sumi = (int8_t)scs[8 * b + jj] * dot;
				{ float u = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(pre + 16 * q + 2 * i)) * (float)sumi; acc = fmaf(as[8 * b + jj], u, acc); }
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

/* ---- block-32 formats at K = 640 ---- */

static int b32_block_bytes(uint32_t type) { return type == GG_Q8_0 ? 32 : 16; }

int b32_tile_stride(uint32_t type, int K) {
	int B = K / 32;
	return 48 + B * b32_block_bytes(type) + (type == GG_Q5_0 ? 4 * B : 0);
}

/* integer code of element e (0..31) of a raw block: the value before the offset */
static int b32_code(uint32_t type, const uint8_t *blk, int e) {
	switch (type) {
	case GG_Q4_0: return e < 16 ? (blk[2 + e] & 0xF) : (blk[2 + e - 16] >> 4);
	case GG_IQ4_NL: return e < 16 ? (blk[2 + e] & 0xF) : (blk[2 + e - 16] >> 4);
	case GG_Q5_0: {
		uint32_t qh = ld32(blk + 2);
		int lo = e < 16 ? (blk[6 + e] & 0xF) : (blk[6 + e - 16] >> 4);
		int hi = e < 16 ? ((qh >> e) & 1) : ((qh >> (e - 16 + 12)) & 0x10) >> 4;
		return lo | (hi << 4);
	}
	case GG_Q8_0: return (int8_t)blk[2 + e];
	}
	return 0;
}

static int b32_offset(uint32_t type) { return type == GG_Q4_0 ? 8 : type == GG_Q5_0 ? 16 : 0; }

int repack_b32(uint32_t type, const uint8_t *src, int rows, int K, uint8_t *dst) {
	int B = K / 32, stride = b32_tile_stride(type, K), bb = b32_block_bytes(type);
	uint32_t ge, gb;
	gguf_block(type, &ge, &gb);
	if (!dst) return stride;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *s = src + (size_t)r * B * gb;
		uint8_t *pre = dst + (size_t)r * stride, *data = pre + 48, *qh = data + bb * B;
		memset(pre, 0, 48);
		for (int b = 0; b < B; b++) {
			const uint8_t *blk = s + gb * b;
			memcpy(pre + 2 * b, blk, 2);
			if (type == GG_Q8_0) {
				memcpy(data + 32 * b, blk + 2, 32);
			} else {
				for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
					int c0 = b32_code(type, blk, 2 * i) & 0xF, c1 = b32_code(type, blk, 2 * i + 1) & 0xF;
					data[16 * b + i] = (uint8_t)(c0 | (c1 << 4));
				}
				if (type == GG_Q5_0) {
					uint32_t w = 0;
					for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) w |= (uint32_t)(b32_code(type, blk, e) >> 4) << e;
					memcpy(qh + 4 * b, &w, 4);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return stride;
}

static int b32_tile_code(uint32_t type, const uint8_t *pre, int K, int e) {
	int B = K / 32, b = e >> 5, el = e & 31, bb = b32_block_bytes(type);
	const uint8_t *data = pre + 48;
	if (type == GG_Q8_0) return (int8_t)data[32 * b + el];
	int q = (data[16 * b + (el >> 1)] >> (4 * (el & 1))) & 0xF;
	if (type == GG_Q5_0) { uint32_t w; memcpy(&w, data + bb * B + 4 * b, 4); q |= ((w >> el) & 1) << 4; }
	return q;
}

float b32_tile_value(uint32_t type, const uint8_t *tile, int K, int r, int e) {
	const uint8_t *pre = tile + (size_t)r * b32_tile_stride(type, K);
	float d = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(pre + 2 * (e >> 5)));
	int q = b32_tile_code(type, pre, K, e);
	if (type == GG_IQ4_NL) return d * kvalues_iq4nl[q];
	return d * (float)(q - b32_offset(type));
}

void gemv_b32_ref(uint32_t type, const uint8_t *tile, int rows, int K, const int8_t *xq, const int32_t *sum32, const float *as, float *y) {
	int B = K / 32, stride = b32_tile_stride(type, K), L = 4, n = B / L, off = b32_offset(type);
	float v[4], w[4];
	(void)sum32;
	for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
		const uint8_t *pre = tile + (size_t)r * stride;
		for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) {
			float acc = 0.f;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				int b = l + L * i;
				int32_t dot = 0;
				for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) {
					int q = b32_tile_code(type, pre, K, 32 * b + e);
					int val = type == GG_IQ4_NL ? kvalues_iq4nl[q] : q - off;
					dot += val * xq[32 * b + e];
				}
				{ float u = fp16_to_fp32(ld16(pre + 2 * b)) * (float)dot; acc = fmaf(as[b], u, acc); }
			}
			v[l] = acc;
		}
		for (int o = L / 2; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
			for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) w[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
			memcpy(v, w, sizeof(float) * L);
		}
		y[r] = v[0];
	}
}

float quant_act_gpu(const float *x, int n, int16_t *q16, int32_t *sum32, int32_t *sum16) {
	float amax = 0.f;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { float a = fabsf(x[i]); if (a > amax) amax = a; }
	float r = amax > 0.f ? 1.0f / amax : 0.f;
	float inv = amax > 0.f ? r * 127.0f : 0.f;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		float t = x[i] * inv;
		q16[i] = (int16_t)lrintf(t);
	}
	for (int g = 0; g < n / 16; g++) {
		int32_t s = 0;
		for (int e = 0; e < 16; e++) s += q16[16 * g + e];
		sum16[g] = s;
	}
	for (int g = 0; g < n / 32; g++) sum32[g] = sum16[2 * g] + sum16[2 * g + 1];
	return amax * (1.0f / 127.0f);
}

float rmsnorm_quant_gpu(const float *x, const float *w, int n, float eps, float *y, int16_t *q16, int32_t *sum32, int32_t *sum16) {
	float v[32], t[32];
	int C = n / 128;
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) {
		float ss = 0.f;
		for (int j = 0; j < C; j++)
			for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { float e = x[4 * (l + 32 * j) + k]; ss = fmaf(e, e, ss); }
		v[l] = ss;
	}
	for (int o = 16; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
		for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) t[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
		memcpy(v, t, sizeof v);
	}
	float m = v[0] * (1.0f / 2560.0f);
	float vv = m + eps;
	float s = sqrtf(vv);
	float r = 1.0f / s;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) y[i] = (x[i] * r) * w[i];
	return quant_act_gpu(y, n, q16, sum32, sum16);
}

void rmsnorm_gpu(const float *x, const float *w, int n, float eps, float *y) {
	float v[32], t[32];
	int C = n / 128;
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) {
		float ss = 0.f;
		for (int j = 0; j < C; j++)
			for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { float e = x[4 * (l + 32 * j) + k]; ss = fmaf(e, e, ss); }
		v[l] = ss;
	}
	for (int o = 16; o >= 1; o >>= 1) {
		for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) t[l] = v[l] + v[l ^ o];
		memcpy(v, t, sizeof v);
	}
	float m = v[0] * (1.0f / (float)n);
	float vv = m + eps;
	float s = sqrtf(vv);
	float r = 1.0f / s;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) y[i] = (x[i] * r) * w[i];
}

void quant_act_gpu32(const float *x, int n, int16_t *q16, int32_t *sum32, int32_t *sum16, float *as) {
	const float tiny = 7.8886090522101180541e-31f;   /* 2^-100 */
	for (int g = 0; g < n / 32; g++) {
		float gmax = 0.f;
		for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) { float a = fabsf(x[32 * g + e]); if (a > gmax) gmax = a; }
		if (gmax < tiny) gmax = tiny;
		float r = 1.0f / gmax;
		float inv = r * 127.0f;
		for (int e = 0; e < 32; e++) q16[32 * g + e] = (int16_t)lrintf(x[32 * g + e] * inv);
		as[g] = gmax * (1.0f / 127.0f);
	}
	for (int g = 0; g < n / 16; g++) {
		int32_t s = 0;
		for (int e = 0; e < 16; e++) s += q16[16 * g + e];
		sum16[g] = s;
	}
	for (int g = 0; g < n / 32; g++) sum32[g] = sum16[2 * g] + sum16[2 * g + 1];
}

void rmsnorm_quant_gpu32(const float *x, const float *w, int n, float eps, float *y, int16_t *q16, int32_t *sum32, int32_t *sum16, float *as) {
	rmsnorm_gpu(x, w, n, eps, y);
	quant_act_gpu32(y, n, q16, sum32, sum16, as);
}


File: ref/ref_test.c
/* Sanity checks for the reference decoders against the real GGUF:
 *   ref_test SHARD1 [tensor ...]
 * Decodes the first rows of each listed tensor (default: one of every type),
 * prints statistics, and checks the Q2_0 integer GEMV against a double dot of
 * the dequantised values. */
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "gguf.h"
#include "quant.h"
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + 1e-9 * t.tv_nsec; }

static void stats(const char *name, uint32_t type, const float *w, uint64_t n) {
	double s = 0, s2 = 0, amax = 0;
	uint64_t nan = 0, zero = 0;
	for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		if (isnan(w[i]) || isinf(w[i])) { nan++; continue; }
		s += w[i]; s2 += (double)w[i] * w[i];
		if (fabs(w[i]) > amax) amax = fabs(w[i]);
		if (w[i] == 0.f) zero++;
	}
	printf("%-36s %-7s n=%-8" PRIu64 " mean=% .3e rms=%.3e amax=%.3e zeros=%.1f%% nan=%" PRIu64 "\n", name, gguf_type_name(type), n,
	       s / n, sqrt(s2 / n), amax, 100.0 * zero / n, nan);
}

static uint32_t rs = 12345;
static float frand(void) { rs = rs * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return ((rs >> 8) & 0xffff) / 32768.f - 1.f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: ref_test SHARD1 [tensor ...]\n"); return 2; }
	gguf_file g;
	double t0 = now();
	if (gguf_open(&g, argv[1])) return 1;
	printf("opened %s: %" PRIu64 " tensors in %.2f s\n", argv[1], g.ntensors, now() - t0);
	const char *defaults[] = {
		"blk.4.ffn_gate_exps.weight", "blk.4.attn_qkv.weight", "blk.4.attn_gate.weight", "blk.4.ssm_out.weight",
		"blk.3.attn_output.weight", "blk.3.attn_v.weight", "blk.7.attn_output.weight", "blk.4.hc_attn_down.weight",
		"blk.4.ssm_conv1d.weight", "blk.1.ple_conv1d.weight", "blk.3.ffn_down_shexp.weight", "blk.0.ffn_down_shexp.weight",
		"blk.8.ffn_down_shexp.weight", "token_embd.weight", "output.weight", NULL
	};
	int n = argc > 2 ? argc - 2 : 0;
	for (int i = 0; n ? i < n : defaults[i] != NULL; i++) {
		const char *name = n ? argv[2 + i] : defaults[i];
		const gguf_tensor *t = gguf_find(&g, name);
		if (!t) { printf("%s: not found\n", name); continue; }
		if (!t->data) { printf("%s: outside the mapping\n", name); continue; }
		uint32_t be, bb;
		gguf_block(t->type, &be, &bb);
		uint64_t K = t->dims[0], rows = t->elems / K;
		uint64_t take = rows < 4 ? rows : 4;
		if (!be) { printf("%s: type %u unsupported\n", name, t->type); continue; }
		if (K % be) { printf("%s: K=%" PRIu64 " not a multiple of block %u\n", name, K, be); continue; }
		uint64_t rowbytes = K / be * bb;
		if (rowbytes * rows != t->nbytes) printf("%s: WARNING size %" PRIu64 " != rows*rowbytes %" PRIu64 "\n", name, t->nbytes, rowbytes * rows);
		float *w = malloc(sizeof(float) * K * take);
		double t1 = now();
		for (uint64_t r = 0; r < take; r++) dequant(t->type, t->data + r * rowbytes, w + r * K, K);
		double t2 = now();
		char label[80];
		snprintf(label, sizeof label, "%s[%" PRIu64 "x%" PRIu64 "]", name, rows, K);
		stats(label, t->type, w, K * take);
		(void)t1; (void)t2;
		free(w);
	}

	/* Q2_0 GEMV: integer path in GPU order vs double dot of the dequantised row */
	const gguf_tensor *t = gguf_find(&g, "blk.4.ffn_gate_exps.weight");
	if (t && t->data) {
		int K = (int)t->dims[0], rows = (int)t->dims[1];   /* one expert: 640 rows of 2560 */
		float *x = malloc(sizeof(float) * K);
		for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) x[k] = frand() * (1.f + (k % 7));
		int8_t *xq = malloc(K);
		int16_t *x16 = malloc(sizeof(int16_t) * K);
		int32_t *sum32 = malloc(sizeof(int32_t) * K / 32), *sum16 = malloc(sizeof(int32_t) * K / 16);
		float *as = malloc(sizeof(float) * K / 32);
		quant_act_gpu32(x, K, x16, sum32, sum16, as);
		for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) xq[k] = (int8_t)x16[k];
		float *xd = malloc(sizeof(float) * K);
		for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) xd[k] = as[k / 32] * xq[k];
		int stride = q2_0_tile_stride(K);
		uint8_t *tile = malloc((size_t)stride * rows);
		double t1 = now();
		repack_q2_0(t->data, rows, K, tile);
		double t2 = now();
		float *y = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows), *yf = malloc(sizeof(float) * rows);
		gemv_q2_0_ref(tile, rows, K, xq, sum32, as, y);
		double t3 = now();
		gemv_q2_0_float(t->data, rows, K, xd, yf);
		double maxrel = 0, maxabs = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			double a = fabs(y[r] - yf[r]);
			double rel = a / (fabs(yf[r]) + 1e-6);
			if (a > maxabs) maxabs = a;
			if (rel > maxrel) maxrel = rel;
		}
		printf("q2_0 gemv expert0 %dx%d: stride %d, repack %.1f ms, ref %.1f ms, int-vs-float max abs %.3e rel %.3e, y[0..3] = %g %g %g %g\n",
		       rows, K, stride, (t2 - t1) * 1e3, (t3 - t2) * 1e3, maxabs, maxrel, y[0], y[1], y[2], y[3]);
		free(x); free(xq); free(sum32); free(xd); free(tile); free(y); free(yf);
	}
	gguf_close(&g);
	return 0;
}


File: ref/router.c
#include "router.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

void router_gpu(const float *r, float sh, unsigned *idx, float *w, float *s) {
	float v[512], m[10], e[10];
	memcpy(v, r, sizeof v);
	float m0 = v[0];
	for (int i = 1; i < 512; i++) if (v[i] > m0) m0 = v[i];
	for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
		float best = v[0];
		for (int i = 1; i < 512; i++) if (v[i] > best) best = v[i];
		unsigned bi = 0xffffffffu;
		for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) if (memcmp(&v[i], &best, 4) == 0 && (unsigned)i < bi) bi = (unsigned)i;
		idx[j] = bi;
		m[j] = best;
		v[bi] = -INFINITY;
	}
	float den = 0.f;
	for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) { e[j] = exp_gpu(m[j] - m0); den = j ? den + e[j] : e[j]; }
	float rw = rcp_gpu(den);
	for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) w[j] = e[j] * rw;
	*s = sigmoid_gpu(sh);
}


File: ref/sample.c
#include "sample.h"
#include "fmath.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uint32_t idx; float val; } cand_t;
static int cand_cmp(const void *a, const void *b) {
	const cand_t *x = a, *y = b;
	if (x->val > y->val) return -1;
	if (x->val < y->val) return 1;
	return x->idx < y->idx ? -1 : x->idx > y->idx;
}

void topk_gpu(const float *x, unsigned n, int K, uint32_t *idx, float *val) {
	cand_t *c = malloc(sizeof *c * (n ? n : 1));
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) c[i] = (cand_t){ i, x[i] };
	qsort(c, n, sizeof *c, cand_cmp);
	for (int r = 0; r < 32; r++) {
		if (r < K && (unsigned)r < n) { idx[r] = c[r].idx; val[r] = c[r].val; }
		else { idx[r] = 0xffffffffu; val[r] = -INFINITY; }
	}
	free(c);
}

static void bfly_sum(float *t) {   /* t[l] += t[l ^ s] for s = 16, 8, 4, 2, 1 */
	for (int s = 16; s >= 1; s >>= 1) { float n[32]; for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) n[l] = t[l] + t[l ^ s]; memcpy(t, n, sizeof n); }
}
static void scan_sum(float *c) {   /* inclusive Kogge-Stone: c[l] += c[l - s] for s = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 */
	for (int s = 1; s <= 16; s <<= 1) { float n[32]; for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) n[l] = l >= s ? c[l] + c[l - s] : c[l]; memcpy(c, n, sizeof n); }
}

uint32_t sample_gpu(const uint32_t idx[][32], const float val[][32], const uint32_t *bases, int ndies, int K, float topp, float invT, float u) {
	cand_t c[6 * 32]; int nc = 0;
	for (int d = 0; d < 6; d++)
		for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) {
			if (d < ndies) c[nc++] = (cand_t){ idx[d][l] + bases[d], val[d][l] };
			else c[nc++] = (cand_t){ 0xffffffffu, -INFINITY };
		}
	qsort(c, (size_t)nc, sizeof *c, cand_cmp);
	float sm[32]; uint32_t si[32];
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) { if (l < K) { sm[l] = c[l].val; si[l] = c[l].idx; } else { sm[l] = -INFINITY; si[l] = 0xffffffffu; } }
	float m0 = sm[0], e[32], tot[32], cum[32], w[32], W[32];
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) { e[l] = l < K ? exp_gpu(sm[l] - m0) : 0.f; tot[l] = e[l]; cum[l] = e[l]; }
	bfly_sum(tot); scan_sum(cum);
	float thr0 = tot[0] * topp, excl[32];
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) excl[l] = l > 0 ? cum[l - 1] : 0.f;   /* SHFL.UP of the inclusive scan */
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) {
		int keep = l < K && excl[l] < thr0;
		w[l] = keep ? exp_gpu((sm[l] - m0) * invT) : 0.f;
		W[l] = w[l]; cum[l] = w[l];
	}
	bfly_sum(W); scan_sum(cum);
	float thr = W[0] * u;
	unsigned cand = 32, lk = 0;
	for (int l = 0; l < 32; l++) { if (cum[l] > thr && (unsigned)l < cand) cand = (unsigned)l; if (w[l] > 0.f && (unsigned)l > lk) lk = (unsigned)l; }
	unsigned r = cand < lk ? cand : lk;
	return si[r];
}


File: ref/split.c
/* The row/expert/head split over the dies, shared by the holder, the program builder,
 * the twin and the tests so every one of them draws the same boundaries.
 *
 * SPLIT_SHARES=s0,s1,...  (integers, one per die; default equal) weights die d's share:
 * die d owns [split_bound(total, d, n), split_bound(total, d + 1, n)). Die 0 of archy has
 * a bad VRAM band above 5.76 GiB (cx-flash's device-usable-bytes), so it gets a smaller
 * share and the attention die (ATTN_DIE, default 0: the die that holds attn_q/k/v and
 * runs the attention core) moves off it. */
#include "split.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static int shares_n = -1; static unsigned long shares[16], shares_sum;

static void load_shares(void) {
	shares_n = 0; shares_sum = 0;
	const char *s = getenv("SPLIT_SHARES");
	if (!s) return;
	char *copy = strdup(s), *save = NULL;
	for (char *tok = strtok_r(copy, ",", &save); tok && shares_n < 16; tok = strtok_r(NULL, ",", &save)) {
		unsigned long v = strtoul(tok, NULL, 10);
		if (!v) { fprintf(stderr, "split: SPLIT_SHARES entries must be positive\n"); exit(1); }
		shares[shares_n++] = v; shares_sum += v;
	}
	free(copy);
}

unsigned split_bound(unsigned total, int d, int n) {
	if (shares_n < 0) load_shares();
	if (d <= 0) return 0;
	if (d >= n) return total;
	if (shares_n == 0) return (unsigned)((unsigned long)total * (unsigned)d / (unsigned)n);
	if (shares_n != n) { fprintf(stderr, "split: SPLIT_SHARES has %d entries for %d dies\n", shares_n, n); exit(1); }
	unsigned long acc = 0; for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) acc += shares[i];
	return (unsigned)((unsigned long)total * acc / shares_sum);
}

int attn_die(void) {
	const char *s = getenv("ATTN_DIE");
	return s ? atoi(s) : 0;
}

/* ATTN_MAP=d0,d1,...,d11: the die that runs attention layer i (block 3 + 4 i) and keeps its projections, KV cache and indexer
 * pool; unset: every attention layer on attn_die() */
int attn_die_of(int blk) {
	static int map[12], mapped = -1;
	if (mapped < 0) {
		mapped = 0;
		const char *s = getenv("ATTN_MAP");
		if (s) {
			char *copy = strdup(s), *save = NULL; int n = 0;
			for (char *tok = strtok_r(copy, ",", &save); tok && n < 12; tok = strtok_r(NULL, ",", &save)) map[n++] = atoi(tok);
			free(copy);
			if (n != 12) { fprintf(stderr, "split: ATTN_MAP needs 12 dies, got %d\n", n); exit(1); }
			mapped = 1;
		}
	}
	int i = (blk - 3) / 4;
	return mapped && i >= 0 && i < 12 ? map[i] : attn_die();
}
